title: Building Together Reception
title_ko: 빌딩 투게더 리셉션
summary_ko: AWS와 Amazon Together 커뮤니티가 세상을 더 낫게 만드는 이들을 기념하며 여는 저녁 리셉션입니다.
abstract: Join AWS and Amazon Together Community for an evening reception celebrating those who make the world better. Connect with builders and developers who use AWS AI and cloud technology for positive change. Over light bites and beverages at Tableau in the Wynn, explore skilling and social impact, spark new ideas, and celebrate the work we do best — together. All builders welcome.

title: AWS re:Invent 5K Race
title_ko: AWS re:Invent 5K 레이스
summary_ko: 일반적인 코스가 아닌 독특한 경로로 3.1마일을 달리는 re:Invent 특별 5K 달리기 대회입니다.
abstract: Get ready for a 5K unlike any other. Skip the traditional point to point course. Instead, you will conquer 3.1 miles in six high energy laps around the perimeter of Allegiant Stadium alongside the global AWS community. Completely free and open to all paces. This fun run is in partnership with AWS Customer, Lululemon and supports the Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research. Sign up now at the attendee experience desk located in the artist foyer at Venetian.

title: Road to re:Invent
title_ko: 로드 투 re:Invent
summary_ko: 정오부터 현장과 라이브스트림으로 진행되는 re:Invent 공식 해커톤 Road to re:Invent를 관람하는 행사입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Summit 216 | Showcase Theater
abstract: Watch Road to re:Invent | The official re:Invent Hackathon in-person and on livestream, starting at 12 PM. Get up front as teams compete in an in-person hackathon where the pressure is on. Be sure to catch the Special Guests, VIP Cameos, and the thrilling finale where these talented developers showcase their innovative solutions and one team will be crowned 2026 champion walking away with $100K. Don't miss the excitement as we celebrate the creativity of building and technical excellence of the AWS community.

title: Showcase Theater
title_ko: 쇼케이스 시어터
summary_ko: 4일간 외부 연사들이 기술의 미래를 이끄는 주요 대화를 나누는 re:Invent 무대 프로그램입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Summit 216 | Showcase Theater
abstract: Where re:Invent steps into the conversations shaping technology. Across four days, this stage brings external voices (open-source icons, researchers, cultural commentators, and cross-disciplinary thinkers) into candid discussions about the questions the industry is wrestling with: the future of frontier AI, robotics, quantum, privacy, sustainability, healthcare, access, and the gaps between what AI promises and what it delivers. Catch debates, interviews, and unexpected pairings that will grab your attention and make you think.

title: Customer Showcase
title_ko: 고객 쇼케이스
summary_ko: 선도 기업들이 AWS로 미래를 구축하는 방식을 직접 시연하는 몰입형 핸즈온 체험 공간입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Summit 216 | Customer Showcase
abstract: An immersive, hands-on experience where pioneering organizations demonstrate how they're building the future of their industries. Anchored in real implementations and measurable outcomes, attendees engage shoulder-to-shoulder with customer counterparts and technical architects tackling the same challenges they face. Every story reveals the full arc of innovation: the breakthroughs, the missteps, and the hard-won lessons that shaped better outcomes. Attendees walk away with actionable insights they can apply immediately, along with the confidence that their goals are within reach, enabled by AWS to experiment boldly and innovate beyond what they thought possible.

title: Amazon’s World Famous Chicken Wing Eating Competition
title_ko: 아마존 세계적으로 유명한 치킨윙 먹기 대회
summary_ko: re:Play에서 용감한 참가자들이 치킨윙 먹기에 도전하는 아마존의 명물 대회입니다.
abstract: Join us at re:Play for Amazon's World Famous Chicken Wing Eating Competition, where brave competitors will face off at 6:45 PM. Competitors must register prior at the Attendee Experiences Desk (Venetian | Level 2 | Artist Foyer) to devour as many wings as possible in this epic battle of endurance for a chance at a re:Invent 2027 Ticket. This is one of re:Invent's most memorable and exciting spectacles.

title: re:Play
title_ko: re:Play
summary_ko: 올해 얼리전트 스타디움에서 열리는 re:Invent 공식 파티로, 음악과 엔터테인먼트를 즐기는 행사입니다.
abstract: Don't miss the official party of re:Invent! re:Play is hosted at Allegiant Stadium this year, bringing an even bigger lineup of entertainment and experiences. Catch live performances from St. Vincent with headliner Calvin Harris and explore activations throughout the stadium. Join us Thursday, December 3, 2026, for a night of music, food, and fun. Shuttles to Allegiant Stadium start at 6:15 PM.

title: Edge-to-Action: Powering Agentic AI via Cloudera's Anywhere Cloud (sponsored by Cloudera)
title_ko: 엣지에서 실행까지: Cloudera Anywhere Cloud로 에이전틱 AI 구현 (Cloudera 후원)
summary_ko: 엣지 자산과 센서, 거래 시스템에 고립된 운영 데이터를 Cloudera로 연결해 에이전틱 AI에 활용하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Distributed edge assets, remote sensors, and transactional systems often leave operational data isolated from cloud AI platforms. This session demonstrates how to break down these boundaries using Cloudera Anywhere Cloud. Discover an event-driven architectural blueprint that standardizes real-time streaming on-premises, unifies hybrid pipelines, and lands telemetry directly into Cloudera’s Open Data Lakehouse on AWS. Learn how grounding autonomous AI agents on AWS with continuous edge context simplifies data sovereignty, eliminates bottlenecks, and enables real-time, closed-loop enterprise automation. This presentation is brought to you by Cloudera, an AWS Partner.

title: AI Is Getting Smarter. AI-Generated Code Isn’t Getting Safer. (sponsored by Veracode, Inc.)
title_ko: AI는 똑똑해지지만 AI 생성 코드는 안전해지지 않는다 (Veracode 후원)
summary_ko: 100개 이상의 모델 분석을 바탕으로 AI 생성 코드의 보안 성능이 개선되지 않는 현황과 대응 방안을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: AI-generated code is scaling fast, but its security performance is not keeping up. Across more than 100 models tested since 2023, the average security pass rate remains stuck at 56%, even as syntax performance approaches perfection. For security leaders, this is no longer a developer tooling discussion. It is a verification, release-control, and accountability issue. In this session, Veracode leaders unpack the findings from the 2026 GenAI Code Security Report and turn them into practical actions for secure software delivery at scale. Whether you’re a developer, security lead, or business decision-maker, this session will help you navigate the real-world security implications of GenAI in your development workflow. This presentation is brought to you by Veracode, Inc., an AWS Partner.

title: Small Startup. Big Data. Rare Hopes. (sponsored by Cloudera)
title_ko: 작은 스타트업, 빅데이터, 희귀한 희망 (Cloudera 후원)
summary_ko: Rare Hopes 공동 창업자 Brian Martin이 작은 꿈에서 시작해 데이터로 희귀질환에 큰 영향을 만든 여정을 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Making a big impact always starts small - a dream, an idea, a hope. Brian Martin - co-founder of Rare Hopes NFP and CTO of Applied AI at Cloudera - will share the story of the non-profit he and industry colleagues founded with the support of AWS, Cloudera, and other companies to deliver a multi-million dollar equivalent platform supporting drug repurposing for rare disease hypothesis generation. Illustrating the concept and components necessary to deliver this advanced graph analytical approach to transforming knowledge into insights, the story demonstrates the power and potential that AI brings allowing companies to work with knowledge - not just data. This presentation is brought to you by Cloudera, an AWS Partner.

title: Autonomous AI Ops with AWS DevOps Agent and New Relic Autopilot (sponsored by New Relic)
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent와 New Relic Autopilot으로 구현하는 자율 AI 운영 (New Relic 후원)
summary_ko: 장애 조사에 드는 엔지니어 시간을 줄이기 위해 AWS DevOps Agent와 New Relic Autopilot으로 운영을 자동화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Incident investigation still consumes 1-2 hours of engineering time per event. See how New Relic's Intelligent Observability Platform integrates with AWS DevOps Agent to: Autonomously triage incidents, pinpoint root cause, and deliver actionable remediation with no custom tooling required. Investigate incidents agentically correlating telemetry, code, and deployments across AWS, multi cloud, and on-prem environments. Demonstrate how this innovation proactively prevents future incidents by analyzing patterns and recommending improvements. Learn how customers are cutting MTTR by 75% and shifting from firefighting to prevention, and walk away ready to get started. This presentation is brought to you by New Relic, an AWS Partner.

title: From Gen AI to Agentic AI: Transforming Finance Operations on AWS with Barclays (sponsored by Capgemini)
title_ko: 생성형 AI에서 에이전틱 AI로: Barclays의 AWS 기반 재무 운영 혁신 (Capgemini 후원)
summary_ko: Barclays가 생성형 AI와 에이전틱 AI를 결합한 AWS 기반 AI 플랫폼으로 재무 운영을 혁신한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Barclays is transforming finance operations through an AWS-powered AI platform that combines Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector knowledge bases, and Agentic AI. The platform unifies structured and unstructured finance data to automate SOX controls, enhance management reporting, enable finance data enrichment, and support intelligent decision-making across strategic finance initiatives. Built with enterprise-grade governance, explainability, and auditability, the solution helps strengthen control effectiveness, improve regulatory compliance, and accelerate reporting outcomes. Learn how AI-powered agents, explainable workflows, and governed human-in-the-loop processes are driving operational efficiency, enhancing regulatory confidence, improving audit readiness, and laying the foundation for autonomous finance operations. This presentation is brought to you by Capgemini, an AWS Partner.

title: How Vanguard Scales AI Oversight Without Scaling Human Review (sponsored by Capgemini)
title_ko: Vanguard가 인력 검토 확대 없이 AI 감독을 확장한 방법 (Capgemini 후원)
summary_ko: Vanguard AI CoE가 폐쇄 루프 체계로 생성형 AI 결과물 감독을 사람의 검토 증가 없이 확장한 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Human review can't scale linearly with generative-AI volume. Vanguard's AI Center of Excellence built a closed-loop oversight system where every AI response is scored by an LLM-as-judge, confirmed or overturned by a subject-matter expert, and routed through a confusion matrix: confirmed catches sharpen the agent, disagreements calibrate the judge. Each SME label grows a benchmark that resets how much oversight the next cycle needs, proving mathematically that coverage can fall while risk holds flat. Built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda-hosted detector SLMs, SQS, DynamoDB, and SageMaker, the loop moves toward real-time interruption of harmful responses before customers see them. This presentation is brought to you by Capgemini, an AWS Partner.

title: Trust the Agent, Keep the Keys: The Journey to Autonomous Operations (sponsored by PagerDuty)
title_ko: 에이전트를 신뢰하되 열쇠는 쥐고: 자율 운영으로 가는 여정 (PagerDuty 후원)
summary_ko: AI로 배포 코드는 늘었지만 장애 해결은 길어지는 상황에서 자율 운영으로 전환하는 여정과 통제 방안을 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: AI is shipping more code to production than ever before, but incidents are taking longer to resolve. Hear from peers at different stages of operational maturity, all testing out ways to put AI and automation to work so their teams get more time back for innovation. Panelists will share how they decide what's safe to automate outright, where to keep a human in or on the loop, and where full human judgment still matters. You'll hear what convinced them to hand over more control, what happened when it didn't go as planned, and how they cut toil without losing their grip on the systems they're accountable for. This presentation is brought to you by PagerDuty, an AWS Partner.

title: Beyond pilots: agentic AI transforming mortgage operations and IT at scale (sponsored by Tata Consultancy Services)
title_ko: 파일럿을 넘어: 모기지 운영과 IT를 대규모로 혁신하는 에이전틱 AI (TCS 후원)
summary_ko: 미국 주요 모기지 대출사가 수작업 검토 중심 업무를 에이전틱 AI로 대규모 전환한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Mortgage lending still runs on handoffs, exceptions, and manual review. See how a leading US mortgage lender is rebuilding origination and servicing with agentic AI on AWS, cutting cycle times while keeping controls and auditability intact. We will also show how the same agent patterns reach IT operations, resolving incidents before customers feel them. Tata Consultancy Services shares the reference architecture, guardrails, and adoption model behind both. Built for financial services business and operations leaders, CIOs and IT operations heads, and data and AI leaders, this session gives you a practical path from promising pilots to production at enterprise scale. This presentation is brought to you by Tata Consultancy Services, an AWS Partner.

title: Build Trust in AI with Agent Observability​ (sponsored by Splunk by Cisco)
title_ko: 에이전트 관측성으로 AI 신뢰 구축 (Splunk by Cisco 후원)
summary_ko: 예측하기 어렵게 동작하고 실패하는 AI 에이전트를 관측성으로 파악해 고객 신뢰를 지키는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: AI agents behave (and fail) in unpredictable and nuanced ways that erode customer trust before engineering teams know anything is wrong. Teams want to deploy agents into critical business workflows, but it's hard to know if agents are behaving as intended or returning wrong answers.​ ​ In this talk, you’ll learn how to observe the entire AI stack, optimize tokenomics, and see a demo on how to evaluate and control agent behavior with guardrails to stop harmful or inaccurate outputs. All of this can be done in near real- time and at low cost.​ This presentation is brought to you by Splunk by Cisco, an AWS Partner.

title: Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) with the UK Home Office (sponsored by Capgemini)
title_ko: 영국 내무부와 함께한 에이전틱 소프트웨어 개발 수명주기(SDLC) (Capgemini 후원)
summary_ko: Capgemini가 영국 내무부와 함께 에이전틱 AI를 소프트웨어 개발 수명주기에 적용한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: The UK Home Office is tasked with keeping the UK Safe and Prosperous. Capgemini is working with the Home Office to increase effectiveness and efficiency of its digital and cloud services. Key areas include case management, legacy modernization and SDLC efficiency. This is being delivered in collaboration with AWS and Anthropic. Using Claude agents via AWS Bedrock, this capability is forecast to deliver >30% cashable savings compared to existing processes and improve quality by >20% through better informed decisions. This presentation is brought to you by Capgemini, an AWS Partner.

title: Deploying the foundation for successful enterprise AI (sponsored by Glean)
title_ko: 성공적인 엔터프라이즈 AI를 위한 기반 구축 (Glean 후원)
summary_ko: 최신 모델을 넘어 기업 컨텍스트와 데이터 기반을 갖춰야 하는 엔터프라이즈 AI 성공 요건을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Successful enterprise AI depends on more than just the latest models. It requires context that connects knowledge across systems, intelligence that turns information into useful action, and protection that preserves permissions, security, and trust. This session presents a practical foundation for deploying AI across the enterprise—using AWS and Bedrock to move from isolated pilots to governed workflows. Learn how leaders are designing for adoption, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement from the start. This presentation is brought to you by Glean, an AWS Partner.

title: Give agents governed access to your APIs over MCP with a domain model (sponsored by Apollo GraphQL)
title_ko: 도메인 모델로 MCP를 통해 에이전트에 API 거버넌스 접근 제공 (Apollo GraphQL 후원)
summary_ko: 기존 기업 API를 도메인 모델과 MCP로 AI 에이전트에 통제된 방식으로 노출하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Enterprises have spent years building APIs for applications and developers. They now need to make those systems available to AI agents, and connecting them through MCP is only the beginning. How do agents discover how to use APIs accurately, retrieve only the fields they need without runaway token costs, and access only what they're authorized to see? This session demonstrates an architecture that answers all three questions. A domain model built on a graph describes what each API means and how the data connects. Each agent gets its own identity, policy is set on individual fields, and every call is logged. This presentation is brought to you by Apollo GraphQL, an AWS Partner.

title: AIOPs for cloud data infrastructure (sponsored by NetApp)
title_ko: 클라우드 데이터 인프라를 위한 AIOps (NetApp 후원)
summary_ko: 워크로드 변화와 구성 드리프트로 최적 상태를 벗어나는 클라우드 데이터 인프라를 AIOps로 관리하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Cloud data infrastructure rarely stays optimal — workloads change, configurations drift, and data infrastructure expertise is scarce. AIOps applies AI-powered, agentic automation to cloud data storage operations: continuously assessing the environment, analyzing it against workload-specific best practices, recommending fixes, and applying them at the level of autonomy you choose. In this lightning talk, we’ll explore how NetApp Workload Factory does all this while providing customers with right-sized cost, on-target performance, stronger resilience and protection — without the need for deep data infrastructure expertise, and while always staying in control. This presentation is brought to you by NetApp, an AWS Partner.

title: Agentic AI Control Plane on AWS: govern agents at enterprise scale (sponsored by Tata Consultancy Services)
title_ko: AWS 기반 에이전틱 AI 컨트롤 플레인: 엔터프라이즈 규모의 에이전트 거버넌스 (TCS 후원)
summary_ko: 수백 개로 늘어나는 AI 에이전트를 공통 계층에서 식별·통제·관리하는 컨트롤 플레인 구축 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Enterprises are moving from a handful of agents to hundreds. Without a shared layer for identity, policy, orchestration, and observability, that growth stalls. In this 20-minute launch session, we introduce the Agentic AI Control Plane on AWS: a governed foundation for building, deploying, and running agents across business and IT workflows. See how it handles agent onboarding, guardrails, cost and performance visibility, and human oversight, with a live look at the platform. Built for CIOs, data and AI leaders, and platform and risk teams who need agent fleets to scale safely, with the controls their auditors expect. This presentation is brought to you by Tata Consultancy Services, an AWS Partner.

title: Fuel Intelligent AI Agents with Trusted Enterprise Data (sponsored by Informatica)
title_ko: 신뢰할 수 있는 기업 데이터로 지능형 AI 에이전트 강화 (Informatica 후원)
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 비즈니스 성과를 내기 위해 필요한 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터 기반 구축 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: To unlock transformative business outcomes, AI agents require a foundation of trusted data with rich enterprise context. Delivering success means bridging the knowledge, trust, and action gaps across a highly complex data landscape. In this session, learn how Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) provides the comprehensive AI-ready data needed to power reliable agentic workflows. Explore how headless IDMC architecture via integrations with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Agent Registry and Amazon Quick fuels agents with trusted enterprise context and end-to-end governance, driving impactful results and long-term project success. This presentation is brought to you by Informatica, an AWS Partner.

title: Deploying Frontier Voice Agents Privately on AWS (sponsored by ElevenLabs)
title_ko: AWS에서 최첨단 음성 에이전트를 프라이빗하게 배포하기 (ElevenLabs 후원)
summary_ko: 의료·금융 기관의 실제 고객 통화를 처리하는 음성 에이전트를 AWS에 프라이빗하게 배포하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Frontier voice agents are already handling live customer calls inside health systems, banks and insurers, without audio ever leaving the customer's AWS account. This session covers the architecture that makes that possible, from in-VPC deployment and zero data retention to integration with their existing stack. Working from a production deployment taking real calls, we walk through the latency budget that keeps conversational voice feeling human, the trade-offs private deployment brings, and how to size it for your own environment. Leave with an understanding of where ElevenAgents fits in your current environment, a reference architecture and a deployment checklist. This presentation is brought to you by ElevenLabs, an AWS Partner.

title: Boost Performance: Salesforce, Slack and AWS Headless Connectivity (sponsored by Salesforce)
title_ko: 성능 향상: Salesforce, Slack, AWS 헤드리스 연결 (Salesforce 후원)
summary_ko: Agentforce, Slack, Bedrock AgentCore를 연결해 단절된 시스템 문제를 해결하고 팀 생산성을 높이는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Disconnected systems slow teams down. See how Agentforce, Slack and AgentCore Bedrock enable your Headless agentic strategy to unlock seamless collaboration and boost productivity across teams in real time. This presentation is brought to you by Salesforce, an AWS Partner.

title: Future-Proof Your Customer Service with Salesforce, Slack and AWS (sponsored by Salesforce)
title_ko: Salesforce, Slack, AWS로 고객 서비스의 미래 대비 (Salesforce 후원)
summary_ko: Agentforce Service와 Slack, AWS를 활용해 상시 개인화된 고객 서비스 경험을 제공하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Modern service demands always-on, personalized experiences. See how Agentforce Service and Slack partner with Amazon Connect Customer, so you can cut handle times, costs & boost CSAT. This presentation is brought to you by Salesforce, an AWS Partner.

title: Everyone Says They Have an Ontology. Almost Nobody Does (sponsored by TextQL)
title_ko: 누구나 온톨로지가 있다고 말하지만, 실제로는 거의 없다 (TextQL 후원)
summary_ko: 엔터프라이즈 AI의 핵심 개념으로 떠오른 온톨로지의 실체와 이를 제대로 구축하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Ontology has become one of the defining ideas in enterprise AI. Every cloud and data platform now claims to have one. They rarely converge on the same structure, conventions, or architecture. Those differences determine whether an ontology can support agentic AI. That test comes down to three things: how it's structured, how it's generated from the systems and context already in place, and how it stays current as the business changes. This talk lays out the practical requirements for an ontology built for agentic AI, drawing on the architecture TextQL runs across the messiest data estates at Fortune 50 companies. This presentation is brought to you by TextQL, an AWS Partner.

title: AI Meets Production: The New Reliability Playbook for Financial Services (sponsored by Traversal)
title_ko: AI가 프로덕션을 만나다: 금융 서비스를 위한 새로운 안정성 플레이북 (Traversal 후원)
summary_ko: 24시간 가용성이 필수인 금융 서비스에서 AI로 장애에 대응하고 안정성을 높이는 새로운 방법을 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Financial services depend on software that needs to be available around the clock. When that software fails, the consequences can affect millions of customers and create regulatory, financial, and reputational risk. This panel brings together technology leaders from some of the world’s largest financial institutions across banking, payments, and investment management for a conversation moderated by Anish Agrawal, CEO & Cofounder of Traversal, the AI SRE helping diagnose, fix, and prevent incidents across complex enterprise environments. Together, they’ll discuss how AI is changing production reliability across financial services, where it’s already being used, the emerging role of AI SREs, what teams look for when evaluating new approaches, and what it takes to deploy AI safely in highly regulated environments. This presentation is brought to you by Traversal, an AWS Partner.

title: AI is Breaking Data Security… And Fixing It (sponsored by Concentric AI)
title_ko: AI가 데이터 보안을 깨뜨리고, 또 고친다 (Concentric AI 후원)
summary_ko: 생산성을 높이는 AI가 데이터 보안에 새로운 위험을 만드는 동시에 이를 해결하는 수단이 되는 방식을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: AI is rapidly becoming one of the biggest drivers of productivity and innovation in the enterprise — and one of the fastest-growing sources of data security risk. As copilots, assistants, and public AI tools become integrated into daily work, sensitive data is flowing into systems that most security teams can’t fully see, understand, or control. The problem is that traditional data security controls were never built for this. In fact, many organizations were already struggling to operationalize data security before AI accelerated the challenge. The good news? AI isn’t just creating the problem — it’s also enabling a smarter, more effective way to solve it. Attendees will leave with a clearer understanding of how AI is reshaping data security — and how they can use that same technology to gain control, minimize exposure, and support safer AI adoption across the business. This presentation is brought to you by Concentric AI, an AWS Partner.

title: ServiceNow: The Super Intelligence Control Tower for Business Reinvention (sponsored by ServiceNow)
title_ko: ServiceNow: 비즈니스 재창조를 위한 초지능 컨트롤 타워 (ServiceNow 후원)
summary_ko: 워크플로와 결합된 AI로 비즈니스를 재창조하는 ServiceNow의 AI 컨트롤 타워 접근 방식을 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: AI without workflows is just expensive advice. The next generation of AI leaders are moving beyond disconnected copilots and isolated use cases to reinvent how work gets done. Join ServiceNow to learn how the Super Intelligence Control Tower for Business Reinvention helps organizations govern AI, connect enterprise data, and orchestrate work across every agent, model, and workflow. Discover how AI that thinks and workflows that act enable enterprises to deploy AI quickly while maintaining trust, security, and control. This presentation is brought to you by ServiceNow, an AWS Partner.

title: No room for error: deploying trusted AI when the stakes are high (sponsored by Monte Carlo)
title_ko: 실수가 허용되지 않는 곳: 고위험 환경에서 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 배포 (Monte Carlo 후원)
summary_ko: 헬스케어처럼 위험이 큰 분야에서 데이터 신뢰성을 확보하며 AI 에이전트를 대규모로 배포하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Deploying agents at scale is a major endeavor for any organization; in healthcare, the stakes are especially high. Unpredictable behaviors & unreliable outputs pose a risk to patients, invite scrutiny from regulators, & erode hard-won institutional trust. Regulated industries must balance accuracy alongside their drive to innovate. Barr Moses, co-founder & CEO of Monte Carlo, will delve into this challenging topic with leaders from GE Healthcare. They’ll dissect some of the most difficult failure modes for agents & discuss how reliability practices have to evolve as teams scale agentic workflows in high-stakes environments. Discussed: how AI itself can be turned back on the problem of observing, resolving, and optimizing agents as well as building the guardrails, ownership models, & trust infrastructure that let a highly regulated organization move quickly without compromising on trust. This presentation is brought to you by Monte Carlo, an AWS Partner.

title: How Iberdrola Increased Marketing Capacity 4x with Agentic AI (sponsored by Accenture)
title_ko: Iberdrola가 에이전틱 AI로 마케팅 역량을 4배 높인 방법 (Accenture 후원)
summary_ko: 스페인 전력 기업 Iberdrola가 에이전틱 AI로 마케팅 업무를 혁신해 역량을 4배 늘린 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Iberdrola, a Spanish multinational electric utility company, is transforming marketing with CreatIA, an agentic AI platform co-developed with Accenture and AWS. Facing rising demand for content, faster decisions and accelerated campaign delivery, Iberdrola adopted a new operating model powered by specialized AI agents across the marketing lifecycle. CreatIA unifies market intelligence, insights generation, content creation, validation and campaign activation in a single enterprise platform. The solution has reduced time spent analyzing and processing information by 80%, accelerated strategic decision making by 40%, increased creative production capacity by up to four times, and reduced content production costs by 60%. This presentation is brought to you by Accenture, an AWS Partner.

title: High Growth. Bold Innovation. The Kiwibank Story. (sponsored by Accenture)
title_ko: 고성장과 과감한 혁신: Kiwibank 이야기 (Accenture 후원)
summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 국영 은행 Kiwibank가 훨씬 큰 경쟁사보다 앞선 혁신을 이뤄낸 방법을 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: How does a nationally owned bank out-innovate much larger competitors? Kiwibank, New Zealand's only 100% NZ-owned bank, must compete against four far larger Australian-owned banks — with a fraction of the resources. Working with Accenture and AWS, Kiwibank is building a governed enterprise AI layer that every future application can draw from. The result: a compounding AI advantage that grows with each new use case, letting the bank launch products faster, serve customers more intelligently, and scale without proportional cost growth. Hear how Kiwibank is using Accenture and AWS to build the AI foundation for its next decade of growth. This presentation is brought to you by Accenture, an AWS Partner.

title: How Cox Achieved 7x ROI with Agentic AI on AWS (sponsored by Accenture)
title_ko: Cox가 AWS 기반 에이전틱 AI로 7배 ROI를 달성한 방법 (Accenture 후원)
summary_ko: Cox Communications가 Accenture, AWS 기반 Anthropic Claude와 함께 B2B 업무를 혁신해 7배 ROI를 얻은 사례입니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Cox Communications partnered with Accenture and Anthropic's Claude on AWS to transform B2B marketing and sales, generating a 7x return on its first-year AI investment. By deploying AI-powered marketing and sales agents across 120 micro-industries and eight customer segments, Cox replaced one-size-fits-all campaigns with personalized engagement at scale. The initiative delivered 55% faster speed to market, a 2-point increase in B2B conversion, 40% higher campaign efficiency, and an 86% reduction in lead management costs while improving data accuracy from 18% to 97%. Today, Cox is operating an end-to-end agentic go-to-market system with human oversight. This presentation is brought to you by Accenture, an AWS Partner.

title: How SoCalGas Is Using Agentic AI for SAP Migration Hypercare on AWS with Accenture (sponsored by Accenture)
title_ko: SoCalGas가 Accenture와 AWS에서 에이전틱 AI로 SAP 마이그레이션 하이퍼케어를 수행하는 방법 (Accenture 후원)
summary_ko: SoCalGas가 노후 고객정보시스템을 SAP IS-U로 이전하며 에이전틱 AI로 하이퍼케어를 지원하는 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Orange Theater
abstract: SoCalGas is migrating its decades-old Customer Information System to SAP IS-U, where hypercare is a critical phase for customer and regulatory impacts. Traditional command centers require teams to manually correlate signals across ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, dashboards, logs, and staffing systems, which may slow response times. SoCalGas worked with Accenture on a multi-agent AI command center using Amazon Bedrock. A Commander agent is designed to orchestrate Platform Health, Business KPI, Knowledge, and Situational Awareness agents, while every recommendation is intended to be citation-grounded and human-supervised. Learn about SoCalGas’s project experience using agentic AI to unify operational intelligence in a mission-critical utility environment. References are for informational purposes only and do not constitute endorsement, recommendation, warranty, certification or representation. This presentation is brought to you by Accenture, an AWS Partner.

title: Taming AI Token Costs and Security Risks with Cribl and AWS (sponsored by Cribl)
title_ko: Cribl과 AWS로 AI 토큰 비용과 보안 위험 길들이기 (Cribl 후원)
summary_ko: Cribl로 엔터프라이즈 AI의 비용을 최적화하고 프롬프트 위험을 통제하며 가시성을 확보하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Govern enterprise AI: Optimize costs, control prompt risks, and gain visibility with Cribl and AWS. This presentation is brought to you by Cribl, an AWS Partner.

title: From First Workload to the Autonomous Enterprise: Transform and Scale with SAP on AWS (sponsored by SAP)
title_ko: 첫 워크로드에서 자율 기업까지: AWS 기반 SAP로 혁신하고 확장하기 (SAP 후원)
summary_ko: 에이전틱 AI 시대에 더 시급해진 ERP 현대화를 AWS 기반 SAP로 추진하고 확장하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Agentic AI is making ERP modernization more urgent than ever. To coordinate decisions across the organization enterprise, AI must be grounded in a modern cloud ERP foundation—one that connects data, processes, business rules, and controls. ERP is no longer just where work is recorded. It has become the operational foundation that enables enterprise agentic AI and ultimately the Autonomous Enterprise.​ SAP and AWS are partnering to help clients accelerate their AI vision Autonomous Enterprise where people set direction, AI executes operational tasks, and organizations respond faster to change leveraging a single intelligent system with full business context. Join us to explore how SAP on AWS helps moves organizations of all sizes to move beyond isolated AI pilots to enterprise-wide outcomes delivered with reliability and confidence.​ This presentation is brought to you by SAP, an AWS Partner.

title: When Software Builds and Improves Itself (sponsored by Factory)
title_ko: 소프트웨어가 스스로 만들고 개선할 때 (Factory 후원)
summary_ko: 소프트웨어가 기업 운영의 시스템으로 진화하며 AI 에이전트가 스스로 개발·개선하는 미래를 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Software is becoming more than something companies build. It is becoming the system through which they improve. The next generation of software factories will turn business signals into production software, measure the outcomes, and use those outcomes to improve each cycle of development. Engineers set the goals, architecture, policies, and approval gates, while the system handles execution and continuously improves itself. Factory cofounder Eno Reyes will share what this future looks like, what has to be true to build it, and why self-improving software will fundamentally change how every company operates. This presentation is brought to you by Factory, an AWS Partner.

title: Responsible AI Enablement: Balancing Innovation, Governance and Control (sponsored by Island)
title_ko: 책임 있는 AI 도입: 혁신, 거버넌스, 통제의 균형 (Island 후원)
summary_ko: AI 도입의 시급성과 보안·거버넌스 요구 사이에서 균형을 잡아 책임 있게 AI를 활성화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Most organizations are currently stuck between two worlds: the urgent need to adopt AI to remain competitive, & the critical mandate to protect corporate data & reputation. AI is evolving faster than any tool in IT history, and faster than any organization can keep up with. The temptation to simply block access to AI is strong, but just saying "No" means ceding the advantage to those able to say "Yes!". The 3 Pillars of a "Secure Yes": Visibility: Knowing what AI is being used across the org. Accountability: Defining who owns the data & the output. Resilience: Building frameworks that adapt as regulations change. In this session, we will outline the framework for secure AI adoption. We will move past the hype to discuss how leaders can build visibility, maintain accountability, and foster a culture of responsible innovation. This presentation is brought to you by Island, an AWS Partner.

title: Transforming Customer Experiences Through Tapestry’s Order Management (sponsored by Digitate)
title_ko: Tapestry 주문 관리로 고객 경험 혁신하기 (Digitate 후원)
summary_ko: Tapestry가 주문 관리 시스템을 개선해 빠르고 개인화된 매끄러운 고객 경험을 제공한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Customers expect fast, personalized, and seamless experiences across every interaction with a brand. For Tapestry, connecting consumer feedback, sentiment, and operational signals is key to identifying issues that can impact customer experience and brand reputation. In this session, Sonal Sharan will share how Tapestry is leveraging ignio's AI Agents to continuously analyze these signals, surface emerging concerns, and provide real-time visibility into business-impacting issues. Intelligent workflows help prioritize and route issues for faster resolution, while actionable insights support more proactive customer engagement, resulting in a more connected, responsive, and customer-centric organization delivering exceptional experiences across Tapestry’s leading brands. This presentation is brought to you by Digitate, an AWS Partner.

title: Live AI and the Infrastructure Behind It (sponsored by Decart)
title_ko: 라이브 AI와 이를 뒷받침하는 인프라 (Decart 후원)
summary_ko: 정적 생성에서 실시간 경험으로 진화하는 라이브 AI와 이를 가능하게 하는 인프라를 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: AI is entering a new era: from static generation to live experiences. From shopping to entertainment, digital experiences are becoming live, visual, and personalized. In this session, Decart will explore the infrastructure powering this shift, what it takes to deliver AI-generated video in real time, and how to bring these experiences to scale. Join us for a look at the technology behind Live AI, and where it’s going next. This presentation is brought to you by Decart, an AWS Partner.

title: From AI Pilots to Enterprise Impact: NJIT's Blueprint for AI Governance and Adoption (sponsored by Kyndryl)
title_ko: AI 파일럿에서 전사적 성과로: NJIT의 AI 거버넌스와 도입 청사진 (Kyndryl 후원)
summary_ko: NJIT가 고립된 AI 파일럿을 넘어 거버넌스 체계를 갖추고 전사적으로 AI를 확산한 청사진을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: Many organizations are racing to implement AI use cases but struggle to scale beyond isolated experiments. New Jersey Institute of Technology (NJIT) faced a similar challenge, with AI activity emerging across the institution without a unified strategy, governance model or operating framework. In partnership with Kyndryl, NJIT established an AI governance strategy, operating model and leadership alignment process that transformed fragmented experimentation into a coordinated, institution-wide programme. Join NJIT, Kyndryl and AWS to learn how governance, stakeholder alignment and dedicated operating models can accelerate AI innovation with confidence. Discover why successful AI transformation begins with strategy before technology, and how organisations can move from experimentation to scalable impact. This presentation is brought to you by Kyndryl, an AWS Partner.

title: Beyond AI Productivity, What It Takes to Deliver Real Business Value (sponsored by JetBrains)
title_ko: AI 생산성을 넘어, 실질적 비즈니스 가치를 내기 위한 조건 (JetBrains 후원)
summary_ko: AI로 코드 작성은 쉬워졌지만 더 많은 코드가 곧 가치는 아니라는 관점에서 실질적 성과를 내는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: AI is making it easier than ever to write code. But more code doesn't necessarily mean better software or better business results. As companies invest in AI tools and agents, the bigger question is whether they're getting real value from them. How do they measure what's working, maintain quality, and keep costs under control? This presentation is brought to you by JetBrains, an AWS Partner.

title: What's new with the AWS Sustainability service
title_ko: AWS Sustainability 서비스의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 클라우드 사용이 환경에 미치는 영향을 파악할 수 있는 AWS Sustainability 서비스의 최신 기능을 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: If you've ever wanted to know more about the environmental impact of your cloud usage, this session is for you. In this lightning talk, learn about the latest features of the AWS Sustainability service, including expanded impact areas beyond carbon, increased data granularity, and programmatic access via APIs. We walk through how to use the service to track progress against your sustainability goals and integrate environmental data into your existing workflows and reporting processes. Whether you're just getting started or already reporting on cloud emissions, this session has you covered.

title: AWS AI from chips to agents: The end-to-end production AI foundation
title_ko: 칩부터 에이전트까지 AWS AI: 엔드투엔드 프로덕션 AI 기반
summary_ko: 실험 단계를 넘어 실제로 작동해야 하는 AI를 위해 칩부터 에이전트까지 아우르는 AWS AI 플랫폼을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: The AI experiment is over. Now it has to work. This session walks through the AWS AI Platform end-to-end, starting at the chip layer with AWS Trainium and AWS Graviton delivering up to 40% better price performance. From there, model inference and customization through Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker AI. Then production agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Every layer co-designed so workloads move across the stack without rearchitecting. You will leave knowing which service handles which job, where the layers connect to accelerate production timelines, and how to keep your architecture open as your AI strategy evolves.

title: Using AI for Impact: Achieving Sustainability and ROI on AWS
title_ko: 임팩트를 위한 AI: AWS에서 지속가능성과 ROI 달성하기
summary_ko: 효율적인 인프라를 기반으로 AI를 활용해 지속가능성 목표와 투자 수익을 함께 달성하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: AI is accelerating sustainability at unprecedented speed, but only if the infrastructure behind it keeps pace. In this session, we will explore how AWS makes AI infrastructure more sustainable through hardware design decisions that minimize embodied carbon, custom silicon optimized for energy efficiency, and ML-driven data center optimization. Amazon Operations will show how AI and ML turn facility maintenance into prescriptive, autonomous operations: optimizing HVAC, water, and utilities for greater equipment reliability, and sustainability. Leave with a clear understanding of the AWS services powering these solutions, how AWS is building a more sustainable infrastructure, and how to get started with tracking and reducing your environmental impact.

title: AWS AI Factories: Bring production scale AI to your data center
title_ko: AWS AI Factories: 프로덕션 규모 AI를 데이터센터로
summary_ko: 데이터 주권, 데이터 중력, 지연 시간 요건이 있는 조직이 자체 데이터센터에서 대규모 AI를 운영하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Data sovereignty, data gravity, and latency requirements prevent many organizations from running all AI workloads in the public cloud. AWS AI Factories with Amazon Bedrock bring Frontier intelligence including Claude on-premises for the first time to customers highest classifications of data, with dedicated AWS Trainium and NVIDIA GPUs fully operated, maintained, and continuously updated by AWS. In this session, hear from Anthropic on how organizations will be able to accelerate AI adoption, reduce time to value, and maintain full control and isolation of their data with the AWS experience in their own facilities.

title: How Trainium powers the next AI frontier, from silicon to application
title_ko: 실리콘부터 애플리케이션까지, Trainium이 이끄는 AI의 다음 개척지
summary_ko: 칩, 서버, 소프트웨어 전 스택에 걸친 혁신으로 Trainium이 차세대 AI를 뒷받침하는 방식을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Every AI breakthrough demands innovation across the full stack: chips, servers, software, and the models built on top, each layer making the next one faster and cheaper to run. In this session, discover how AWS and frontier AI builders drive full-stack innovation on AWS Trainium to scale post-training and reinforcement learning, serve at high throughput, and bend the cost-per-token curve. Examine real architectural decisions from silicon to application, then look ahead to what's next in Trainium and AWS infrastructure. You will see how each layer of innovation compounds and learn where to place your bets on AI infrastructure.

title: Best practices for production agents on AgentCore, with Nasdaq
title_ko: Nasdaq과 함께하는 AgentCore 프로덕션 에이전트 모범 사례
summary_ko: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore에서 에이전트 전체 수명주기를 관리하고 프로덕션에 배포하는 모범 사례를 Nasdaq 사례로 배웁니다.
abstract: Learn best practices for the full agent lifecycle on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Ship agents to production with microVM isolation, persistent memory, and any framework. Use gateway to connect agents to MCP servers, knowledge bases, and APIs with automatic authentication. Trace model calls with OpenTelemetry-compatible observability and run continuous evaluations. Nasdaq joins to share how its GenAI platform empowers 10,000 employees build agents for research, coding, and workflow automation. Hear how Nasdaq scales agent runtime infrastructure and handles multi-account isolation and agent identity, and the operational patterns required to run agentic AI reliably in a regulated financial services environment.

title: Scalable LLM inference, easy on the ops: CrowdStrike on SageMaker AI
title_ko: 운영 부담 없는 확장형 LLM 추론: SageMaker AI 기반 CrowdStrike 사례
summary_ko: CrowdStrike가 SageMaker AI로 운영 부담을 줄이며 빠르고 확장 가능한 LLM 추론을 구현한 방법을 공유합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: When adversaries move in seconds, security has to move faster. CrowdStrike shares how they built scalable, real time LLM inference on Amazon SageMaker to power threat detection at massive scale, where sub second latency is a hard requirement. Learn how dedicated, configurable endpoints gave them full control over performance, while SageMaker AI's managed infrastructure removed the operational overhead.​

title: How Vanguard uses SageMaker HyperPod from training to inference for custom LLMs
title_ko: Vanguard의 SageMaker HyperPod 활용: 커스텀 LLM 학습부터 추론까지
summary_ko: Vanguard가 SageMaker HyperPod로 커스텀 LLM의 학습과 추론 전 과정을 직접 운영하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Enterprises that own their AI lifecycle across training and inference can adapt their models as fast as their users' need change. Vanguard outgrew off the shelf models and built infrastructure that runs custom large language models (LLMs) and specialized small language models (SLMs) side by side. Go inside the implementation to see how Amazon SageMaker HyperPod powers resilient multi node training and high throughput inference. Hear lessons from engineering alongside AWS product teams.

title: Accelerate intelligent document processing with Amazon Textract
title_ko: Amazon Textract로 지능형 문서 처리 가속화
summary_ko: 파운데이션 모델 기반 맞춤 추출 파이프라인의 비용 부담 없이 Amazon Textract로 문서 처리를 가속하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Building custom extraction pipelines on foundation models is powerful but expensive to maintain, and production adds demands of its own: consistent answers, confidence scores you can automate against, and every value traced back to the page. In this session, learn how new generative capabilities in Amazon Textract split, classify, and extract the fields you describe across complex document packets as a managed service, with a confidence score and location on every value. We also cover support for more languages and Regions, then show AI agents turn a 26-page mortgage packet into a decision a human approves.

title: Build Voice AI experiences with Amazon Polly and Transcribe
title_ko: Amazon Polly와 Transcribe로 음성 AI 경험 구축하기
summary_ko: Amazon Transcribe의 음성 인식과 Amazon Polly의 음성 합성으로 애플리케이션에 음성 기능을 더하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Give your applications a voice and ears. This session shows how Amazon Transcribe converts speech to text and Amazon Polly turns text into lifelike speech. See how to build real-time voice agents, and multilingual experiences, with practical patterns for latency, accuracy, and scale.

title: Building conversational AI with Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic
title_ko: Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic으로 대화형 AI 구축하기
summary_ko: 양방향 오디오 스트리밍으로 자연스럽고 지연이 적은 대화를 구현하는 Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic 활용법을 다룹니다.
abstract: We'll explore how bidirectional audio streaming enables natural, low-latency dialogue, with expressive voices across multiple languages. See how new capabilities like cross-modal voice-and-text switching, asynchronous tool calling for multi-step tasks, and a large context window let you build voice agents, customer service automation, and conversational apps.

title: Agentic commerce: Use AI agents with AWS Marketplace
title_ko: 에이전틱 커머스: AWS Marketplace에서 AI 에이전트 활용하기
summary_ko: 여러 도구·팀·계정에 걸친 복잡한 소프트웨어 조달을 AI 에이전트와 AWS Marketplace로 간소화하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Managing software procurement across dozens of tools, teams, and accounts is slow and error-prone. In this lightning talk, we use AI agents to automate the buyer journey on AWS Marketplace to discover and evaluate products, accept discounted offers instantly, enforce governance, achieve operational excellence, request refunds and cancellations, and gain unified visibility into spend and cost management. Compress procurement from weeks to minutes while maintaining governance and financial controls.

title: What's new in Amazon Bedrock
title_ko: Amazon Bedrock의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 새로운 모델, 비용 구조, 거버넌스 기능 등 빠르게 진화하는 Amazon Bedrock의 최신 업데이트를 소개합니다.
abstract: AI moves fast: new models, new economics, and new governance capabilities. Attend this breakout to learn about the latest innovations across Amazon Bedrock. We cover recent model additions from OpenAI, Anthropic, and more, along with advances in inference and updates across security, governance, and cost management. Whether you are new to Bedrock or tracking the latest releases, see what is available today and where to focus next.

title: How TeleTracking runs AWS at a 30:1 ratio with Grafana Cloud AI (sponsored by Grafana Labs)
title_ko: TeleTracking이 Grafana Cloud AI로 AWS를 30:1 비율로 운영하는 방법 (Grafana Labs 후원)
summary_ko: 20만 개 이상 병상을 관리하는 TeleTracking이 Grafana Cloud AI로 적은 인력으로 AWS 인프라를 운영하는 사례입니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: TeleTracking's platform is air traffic control for hospitals: 200K+ beds and 100+ command centers depend on it. Re-platforming onto an AI-native foundation has taken its service-to-engineer ratio from 6:1 to 30:1. The lever isn't headcount: It’s relying on one agent to pair gcx and the Grafana Cloud MCP server with AWS MCP tooling. Oren Lion replays an MSK incident where Grafana Assistant identified a cluster-wide broker disruption in minutes, pairing Frontend Observability with Amazon CloudFront to line up what hurt with what changed. He closes with Assistant Investigations, read-only guardrails, and a recipe you can run yourself.. This presentation is brought to you by Grafana Labs, an AWS Partner.

title: AI Transformation: Redesigning How Work Gets Done (sponsored by Lucid Software)
title_ko: AI 트랜스포메이션: 일하는 방식의 재설계 (Lucid Software 후원)
summary_ko: 새 기술로 옛 방식을 반복하는 데서 벗어나 AI로 업무 방식 자체를 재설계하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Every major technology shift starts the same way. We use new technology to do the old thing. Early factories replaced steam engines with electric motors, but real transformation came when they redesigned the factory around what electricity made possible. We’re doing the same thing with AI. AI transformation isn’t about adding agents to existing workflows. It’s about redesigning how work gets done. That starts with context. In this session, we’ll show how teams can make work visible, give humans and AI a shared understanding of it, redesign workflows around agents, and turn that understanding into action. This presentation is brought to you by Lucid Software, an AWS Partner.

title: Building Proprietary Multi-Agentic AI Workflows for Low Latency and High Reliability (sponsored by Capital One)
title_ko: 저지연·고신뢰성을 위한 독자적 멀티 에이전트 AI 워크플로 구축 (Capital One 후원)
summary_ko: Capital One이 복잡한 추론을 처리하는 확장 가능한 멀티 에이전트 워크플로를 저지연·고신뢰로 구축한 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Enterprise AI requires scalable, multi-agentic workflows capable of handling complex reasoning without sacrificing real-time speed. This session explores how Capital One designs proprietary multi-agent systems on AWS, optimized for governance, performance, and reliability. You’ll hear how state-of-the-art serving frameworks like vLLM, efficient distributed serving platforms like llm-d, and advanced agentic inference optimization techniques can enhance latency and boost throughput. We’ll showcase these principles through real-world applications, including complex real employee- and customer-facing banking use cases while meeting rigorous business standards around accuracy, reliability, and risk management. This presentation is brought to you by Capital One, an AWS Partner.

title: Securing AI and Autonomous Agents: Protecting the Lifecycle Across Any Platform (sponsored by Fortinet)
title_ko: AI와 자율 에이전트 보안: 모든 플랫폼에서 수명주기 보호하기 (Fortinet 후원)
summary_ko: 코드를 실행하고 데이터베이스에 접근하는 AI 에이전트를 전체 수명주기에 걸쳐 보호하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: AI agents are actively running code, accessing databases, and making critical business decisions across every industry. But as these systems gain independence, they also introduce complex security risks throughout their lifecycle. Are you ready to protect a system that learns and acts on its own as your organization embarks on the AI journey? Join our panel of top AI and cybersecurity experts as they break down the end-to-end security of AI systems and agentic applications. We will explore real-world customer challenges and share practical strategies to safeguard autonomous agents across cloud and on-premises environments. This presentation is brought to you by Fortinet, an AWS Partner.

title: Your Agent Has an Upstream Dependency You Can't See (sponsored by Brave)
title_ko: 당신의 에이전트에는 보이지 않는 업스트림 의존성이 있다 (Brave 후원)
summary_ko: 재현 가능한 테스트로 AI 에이전트의 선언되지 않은 업스트림 호출을 찾아내 검증하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Verify, don't trust: a reproducible needle test that surfaces undeclared upstream calls in any stack. This presentation is brought to you by Brave, an AWS Partner.

title: Your data, optimized models, lower costs: Turn business knowledge into AI you control
title_ko: 내 데이터, 최적화된 모델, 낮은 비용: 비즈니스 지식을 통제 가능한 AI로 전환하기
summary_ko: 수많은 모델 중 선택의 고민 속에서 자사 데이터로 모델을 최적화해 비용을 낮추고 통제 가능한 AI를 만드는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: With dozens of models now available and new ones launching every week, customers face three questions: which models to start from, when does model customization unlock added performance or savings, and when to replace a model, either because their own needs changed or because a better model emerged. In this session, learn how to build custom evaluations for your specific use case with your own data, then reuse it choose the model for your use case based on quality and cost, track how customization improves performance, and confidently decide when a model is ready to deploy to production. When requirements change or new models become available, you can update and rerun the evaluation, enabling ongoing improvement of performance and cost against your specific business needs.

title: Beyond the Build: Scaling and Governing AI Agents with Dataiku and Amazon Bedrock (sponsored by Dataiku)
title_ko: 구축을 넘어: Dataiku와 Amazon Bedrock으로 AI 에이전트 확장 및 거버넌스 (Dataiku 후원)
summary_ko: AI 에이전트를 실험에서 대규모 배포로 전환할 때 Dataiku와 Amazon Bedrock으로 확장하고 통제하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: As enterprises move from experimenting with AI agents to deploying them at scale, the challenge is no longer just how to build agents, it’s how to maintain visibility, performance, and control across the growing agent ecosystem. This session will explore how Amazon Bedrock and Dataiku Agent Management support the agent lifecycle from creation through enterprise-wide management. Attendees will see how organizations can build and deploy agents with AWS while using Dataiku to discover agents, monitor performance, and identify risk across environments, helping teams scale agentic AI with greater confidence and governance. This presentation is brought to you by Dataiku, an AWS Partner.

title: Who's Your Security MVP? Here's How AI Ranks Them (sponsored by Trellix)
title_ko: 당신의 보안 MVP는? AI가 순위를 매기는 방법 (Trellix 후원)
summary_ko: AI SOC의 과장을 넘어 보안 운영에서 AI로 실제 성과를 얻기 위해 필요한 요소를 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Yeah, yeah, AI SOC, we get it. But what really goes into getting wins out of AI in security vs saving a couple of clicks? This talk will show the importance of small (dumb) LLM's and how they create opportunities for secops by allowing you to use more tokens, anywhere you want. It will demo how you can go beyond enriching a few alerts to stack rank your most valuable security tools in an ROI thunderdome. You'll learn the AI confidence guardrail framework you need so you to actually start taking actions on your behalf without accidentally deleting all your VM's when you asked it to "eliminate all vulnerabilities." Seeing is believing, so there will be real-world demos of where AI works, where it doesn't, and why--bring your 3D glasses. This presentation is brought to you by Trellix, an AWS Partner.

title: AI Governance: The Framework, The Pitfalls, The Playbook (sponsored by Vanta)
title_ko: AI 거버넌스: 프레임워크, 함정, 플레이북 (Vanta 후원)
summary_ko: 섀도 AI 확산 등 AI가 보안·GRC 프로그램에 미치는 변화에 대응하는 거버넌스 프레임워크와 실천법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: The AI revolution is upending organizations’ security and GRC programs. Shadow AI is exploding as employees adopt new agent harnesses, workflows, platforms, and plugins. Even sanctioned AI poses new challenges that don’t yet have standardized solutions. Meanwhile, developers are moving AI applications from experimentation to production, introducing new risks. This session will break down what AI Governance is all about, cover common concerns that it’s meant to resolve, and provide attendees with practical tips for solving some of their most pressing AI Governance challenges. What you’ll learn. What AI Governance entails, from practical policy to active protections. How to solve AI Governance concerns across different layers of the AI stack. This presentation is brought to you by Vanta, an AWS Partner.

title: How Philips accelerated sales quoting with Agentic AI (sponsored by EPAM)
title_ko: Philips가 에이전틱 AI로 영업 견적을 가속한 방법 (EPAM 후원)
summary_ko: 글로벌 헬스테크 기업 Philips가 에이전틱 AI로 고객 견적 프로세스를 가속화한 사례를 공유합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Philips, a global health technology company, identified an opportunity to accelerate customer quoting for complex solutions combining equipment, software and services. Working with EPAM, Philips built the solution on AWS using an AI-native approach. A team of fewer than 20 used Amazon Kiro across the software development lifecycle, with Amazon Bedrock and the Strands Agents SDK powering an agentic architecture. The result is Sensei, an AI-powered sales experience. This session shares practical lessons for applying agentic AI, accelerating development and business operations, embedding governance, and moving from prototype to enterprise production at scale. This presentation is brought to you by EPAM, an AWS Partner.

title: Golden Opportunities: Unlocking Business Value with Agentic AI (sponsored by Atos)
title_ko: 황금 같은 기회: 에이전틱 AI로 비즈니스 가치 창출 (Atos 후원)
summary_ko: 에이전트 논의를 넘어 실제 업무에 투입하고 파일럿에서 비즈니스 가치로 전환하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Companies have shifted from talking about agents to putting them to work, but moving from an AWS Bedrock AgentCore demo to a governed, production multi-agent system inside a regulated enterprise isn't a straight line. Atos will show what that path looks like, where it breaks, and how to fix it. What you'll learn ⮚Enterprise patterns that separate successful AWS agentic AI deployments from stalled pilots ⮚Building a governance layer on Amazon Bedrock that regulated industries will approve ⮚How GSI partners turn ideas into completed, production-ready deployments ⮚Where AWS tooling is mature, where it's still evolving, and how to architect around the gaps This presentation is brought to you by Atos, an AWS Partner.

title: What's new with NVIDIA GPUs in Amazon EC2
title_ko: Amazon EC2의 NVIDIA GPU 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 수천 개의 상호 연결된 GPU에서 수주간 실행되는 대규모 AI 워크로드를 위한 Amazon EC2 NVIDIA GPU 인스턴스의 최신 기능을 소개합니다.
abstract: A large-scale AI workload can run for weeks across thousands of interconnected GPUs, where a single failure or security gap can be costly. Amazon EC2 brings together a portfolio of accelerated computing instances and innovations that keep the most demanding AI workloads secure by default and resilient to failures and maintenance. In this session, discover what's new in the AWS accelerated compute portfolio and dive deep into the architecture behind the latest generation of GPU instances for training and inference across large language and multimodal models. Hear real-world examples of how leading companies build on AWS, and leave understanding how AWS accelerated computing enables AI at scale.

title: From Cost to Compliance: Scaling Scalable GenAI with Amazon Nova
title_ko: 비용에서 컴플라이언스까지: Amazon Nova로 생성형 AI 확장하기
summary_ko: 통제, 비용, 규정 준수 압박 속에서 Amazon Nova로 생성형 AI를 프로덕션 규모로 확장하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Enterprises putting generative AI into production face three converging pressures: controlling inference cost at scale, meeting compliance and data-residency requirements, and migrating off incumbent models without losing accuracy or quality. Amazon Nova is purpose-built for this reality. In this session, learn how organizations across regulated and cost-sensitive industries are standardizing on Amazon Nova to run high-volume GenAI workloads at a fraction of the cost while meeting strict compliance requirements.

title: DevEx 2026: The AI Era (sponsored by Atlassian)
title_ko: DevEx 2026: AI 시대 (Atlassian 후원)
summary_ko: AI가 개발자를 빠르게 만든다는 통념을 데이터로 검증하며 AI 시대 개발자 경험의 실제를 살펴봅니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: The hype machine says AI makes developers faster. This was true in 2025, when 68% of devs said they were saving 10 hours per week, but we’re not in 2025. Our 2026 data shows only 26% of devs are still saving 10 hours per week, but are facing more bottlenecks with increasing levels of cognitive load. The role of a developer has shifted, with organisations moving from AI adoption to looking for impact. This is presenting developers with new opportunities and challenges. What are the organisations and developers who are moving faster, and delivering at a higher quality point doing differently to those still looking for impact? In this session, we’ll explore the results from the latest State of DevEx report, diving into how developer roles have changed, and how you can unlock the transformational power of AI. This presentation is brought to you by Atlassian, an AWS Partner.

title: How leading AI builders push the frontier with AWS Trainium
title_ko: 선도 AI 빌더들이 AWS Trainium으로 한계를 넓히는 방법
summary_ko: 실시간 비디오 등 1년 전엔 없던 경험을 만드는 네 AI 기업이 AWS Trainium 활용 사례를 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: Hear from four AI leaders building experiences that didn't exist a year ago: real-time video generation, world models, physical AI, and LLMs for drug discovery. These breakthroughs demand both high performance and low cost to work at all. AWS Trainium helped turn that future into production reality. Each panelist walks through their use case: the specific technical barrier they hit, how they used Trainium to get past it, and what shipping it to customers unlocked.

title: Accelerating Applications with Data on AWS Marketplace
title_ko: AWS Marketplace 데이터로 애플리케이션 가속화
summary_ko: AI 애플리케이션 구축 시 서드파티 데이터 조달의 어려움을 AWS Marketplace로 해결하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Every enterprise building AI applications hits the same wall: procuring third-party data and licensed content takes months of negotiations, bespoke contracts, and custom integrations. In this session, learn how you can more easily discover, subscribe to, and access the datasets and content your applications and AI workloads demand.

title: World Models & Physical AI: The next frontier in intelligent systems
title_ko: 월드 모델과 피지컬 AI: 지능형 시스템의 다음 개척지
summary_ko: 복잡한 환경을 시뮬레이션하고 예측하는 월드 모델과 피지컬 AI의 최신 동향과 가능성을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: World models—AI systems that simulate and predict complex environments—are emerging with new modalities including Video, Vision, Language, Action to power physical AI, autonomous systems, and real-time video generation. From humanoid robotics to immersive entertainment, these models are transforming how machines perceive, think, and interact with the physical world. In this panel, hear from researchers and customers on how they're building and deploying world models in production, the business opportunities they unlock, and the unique technical challenges they present. Learn how AWS AI infrastructure powers these use cases at scale with speed, efficiency, and automatic fault recovery.

title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more freedom without losing control
title_ko: 심층 신뢰: 통제력을 잃지 않으면서 에이전트에 더 많은 자율성 부여하기
summary_ko: 사람의 검토보다 빠르게 행동하는 AI 에이전트에 자율성을 주면서도 책임과 통제를 유지하는 다층 방어 전략을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: You're accountable for what your AI agents do, but they act faster than anyone can review. So capable agents wait while the work piles up. There's a way out of that bind. Join this panel for a candid discussion of how you build trust across the agent lifecycle: scope the agent to its job, know which agents are acting, bound what it does and says, and see what it did after. Then learn how provable bounds let you set how far an agent goes, and prove it stays there. Come ready to question your own systems. Leave able to answer.

title: Accelerating the Journey to Autonomous Operations with AI on AWS (sponsored by Genpact)
title_ko: AWS 기반 AI로 자율 운영으로의 전환 가속화 (Genpact 후원)
summary_ko: GE Vernova가 기존 인프라·애플리케이션 운영에서 AI 기반 자율 운영으로 전환하는 여정을 소개합니다.
abstract: GE Vernova is moving from traditional infrastructure and application operations toward autonomous, AI-enabled operations on AWS. The company is modernizing its operating model across data centers, storage, compute, cloud, middleware, and application management. This session will explore how AI can increase the speed, productivity, and effectiveness of large-scale modernization programs. This presentation is brought to you by Genpact, an AWS Partner.

title: [NEW LAUNCH] Coming soon!
title_ko: [신규 출시] 곧 공개 예정
summary_ko: 신규 출시 관련 세션으로, 세부 내용은 추후 공개될 예정입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Check back soon for more details about this session.

title: Hands-On Workshop: Build & Deploy AI Agents with Cloudera Agent Studio (sponsored by Cloudera)
title_ko: 핸즈온 워크숍: Cloudera Agent Studio로 AI 에이전트 구축 및 배포 (Cloudera 후원)
summary_ko: Cloudera Agent Studio로 고효과 AI 에이전트를 직접 구축하고 배포해 보는 실습 워크숍입니다.
abstract: Join this exclusive hands-on workshop to master building and deploying high-impact AI agents with Cloudera Agent Studio. Move from experimentation to production using trusted data, scalable workflows, and governed infrastructure. Led by Cloudera solution architects, you will build multi-agent workflows without code, develop agentic chatbots for data access, learn Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration with AWS tools including Amazon Bedrock and PuppyGraph, and explore the latest Cloudera AI and Workbench enhancements. Designed for data scientists, developers, engineers, and analysts ready to enable secure, scalable, open AI across hybrid environments. This presentation is brought to you by Cloudera, an AWS Partner.

title: Scaling AI Defenses with AWS and CrowdStrike (sponsored by CrowdStrike)
title_ko: AWS와 CrowdStrike로 AI 방어 확장하기 (CrowdStrike 후원)
summary_ko: 프롬프트 인젝션 등 AI로 가속화되는 위협에 AWS와 CrowdStrike로 대응하는 보안 전략을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: AI is accelerating innovation — and accelerating attackers. From prompt injection and data exfiltration to cloud privilege escalation, adversaries are increasingly exploiting AI-powered architectures to move faster than traditional defenses. In this session, AWS and CrowdStrike experts will demonstrate how organizations can securely build and defend modern AI workloads running on AWS. Attendees will explore real-world architectures using Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore and see how attackers move across identity, cloud, and AI services to exploit security gaps. Through live demonstrations and architectural guidance, the session will show how AWS and CrowdStrike help organizations surface shadow AI; visualize attack paths across code and AI services; stop AI-specific attacks; automate protection workflows; and deliver real-time cloud detection and response (CDR) across modern AI environments. This presentation is brought to you by CrowdStrike, an AWS Partner.

title: Vertiv’s Amazon Quick Journey: Scaling Agentic AI Globally with Deloitte & AWS (sponsored by Deloitte)
title_ko: Vertiv의 Amazon Quick 여정: Deloitte, AWS와 함께 에이전틱 AI 글로벌 확장 (Deloitte 후원)
summary_ko: Vertiv가 파편화된 AI 실험을 넘어 Amazon Quick으로 에이전틱 AI를 전 세계로 확장한 사례입니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Vertiv, a global digital infrastructure company, faced fragmented AI experimentation, limited accessibility, and complex enterprise integrational barriers preventing consistent scaling. Vertiv's AI journey began with VeGA, a GenAI platform turned agentic with their recent release of VeGA 3.0. Powered by Amazon Quick, it enables employees to generate content, automate workflows, and create custom applications. In one year, nearly one-third of the workforce was registered in VeGA, spanning functions across all functions and regions. Attendees will learn the architectural blueprint for evolving from basic AI assistants to intelligent agentic systems, including connectors used, data streamlining strategies, and practical implementation steps. This presentation is brought to you by Deloitte, an AWS Partner.

title: Creating resilient multi-channel customer experiences for NAB with Amazon Connect (sponsored by Deloitte)
title_ko: Amazon Connect로 NAB의 탄력적 멀티채널 고객 경험 구축 (Deloitte 후원)
summary_ko: 호주국립은행(NAB)이 Amazon Connect로 디지털 고객 서비스를 현대화하고 멀티채널 경험을 구축한 사례입니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: National Australia Bank (NAB) modernized its digital customer service capability by migrating priority banker groups from legacy messaging platforms to Amazon Connect Chat. The transformation delivered a scalable, integrated, and future-ready messaging environment while improving banker productivity, operational control, and reporting capabilities, and enabling a pathway to enhanced self-service and assisted-service experiences. Deloitte led the end-to-end migration through a structured release approach, encompassing experience design, backlog and epic management, governance, business readiness, training, cutover planning, and operational risk management using AWS services. This session explores the strategy, execution, and lessons learned from delivering a successful enterprise messaging transformation. This presentation is brought to you by Deloitte, an AWS Partner.

title: Reimagining the Operating Room: Gen AI's Impact on Surgery (sponsored by Deloitte)
title_ko: 수술실의 재구상: 생성형 AI가 수술에 미치는 영향 (Deloitte 후원)
summary_ko: Proximie와 AWS 기반 생성형 AI가 수술실 운영과 수술 방식을 근본적으로 바꾸는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Explore how Generative AI, powered by Proximie and AWS, is fundamentally reshaping the operating room. This session will detail how computer vision and LLMs are creating the OR of the future, supported by Deloitte, to improve productivity and treat more patients in UK NHS Trusts. Attendees will gain insights into the practical application of this powerful alliance and why this innovative approach is vital for the future of healthcare. This presentation is brought to you by Deloitte, an AWS Partner.

title: Turning Data into Decisions: Pacific Life's Modern Insurance Operations with AWS AI (sponsored by PwC)
title_ko: 데이터를 의사결정으로: AWS AI 기반 Pacific Life의 현대적 보험 운영 (PwC 후원)
summary_ko: PwC가 AWS에 구축한 생성형 AI 데이터 처리 솔루션으로 Pacific Life Re의 보험 운영을 혁신한 사례입니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Abstract: PwC-built Generative AI data processing solution for Pacific Life Re, hosted on AWS. The solution automates the ingestion, transformation, validation, schema mapping, and PII redaction of client actuarial datasets that arrive in different formats, languages, and quality levels. In short, it helps PLRe move from manual, time-consuming data preparation to a secure, auditable, AI-enabled workflow that can reduce processing times from weeks to days, improve data quality, and provide clean, validated outputs for actuarial, pricing, and R&D teams. This presentation is brought to you by PwC, an AWS Partner.

title: From Data Overload to Action: A Voice-Enabled Digital Assistant for O&G Field Ops
title_ko: 데이터 과부하에서 실행으로: 석유·가스 현장 운영을 위한 음성 기반 디지털 어시스턴트
summary_ko: 석유·가스 현장 작업자가 생산 데이터와 설비 경보를 음성 어시스턴트로 손쉽게 파악하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Field operators in oil and gas often have to piece together production data, equipment alarms, safety notifications, and maintenance priorities from multiple systems to decide how to spend their day. Join Continental Resources and PwC to discover how they collaborated to develop a voice-enabled, mobile-first AI solution built on AWS that brings prioritized route-based worklists, well-health visibility, shift handover insights, and voice work note capture into one place. The session covers the journey from frontline challenges to scaling across multiple basins, including the phased delivery approach and lessons learned from field operators, and shows how to move beyond AI experimentation to solutions embedded in everyday workflows.

title: How Securian Uses Agentic AI to Prioritize CIO Investments (sponsored by PwC)
title_ko: Securian이 에이전틱 AI로 CIO 투자 우선순위를 정하는 방법 (PwC 후원)
summary_ko: Securian이 에이전틱 AI를 활용해 기술 역량 강화를 위한 CIO 투자 우선순위를 결정하는 사례를 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: CIOs face a question: where should they invest next to strengthen technology capabilities? Securian Financial Group and PwC built an agentic AI Capability Maturity Measurement Instrument (CMMI) engine using Amazon Quick that turns evidence into a repeatable view of capability gaps, investment priorities, and recommendations across 20 IT domains and 2,000+ capability criteria. The solution ingests documents and surveys, applies consistent scoring, and translates results into prioritized actions spanning skills, resources, processes, and tools. Learn how Securian moved from periodic, manual assessments to an on-demand decision engine that helps technology leaders' direct investment where it matters most. This presentation is brought to you by PwC, an AWS Partner.

title: Own Your Harness: Control Cost & Risk in Enterprise-Wide AI Adoption (sponsored by Presidio)
title_ko: 하네스를 확보하라: 전사적 AI 도입의 비용과 위험 통제 (Presidio 후원)
summary_ko: 에이전트가 무분별하게 늘어나지 않도록 하네스를 갖춰 전사 AI 도입의 비용과 위험을 통제하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: The fastest way to lose control of AI is to let agents multiply without a harness. This talk walks through Presidio's journey from scattered pilots to enterprise-wide adoption, built on a custom orchestration layer that treats cost, identity, and policy as first-class concerns. Attendees will get an inside look at the architectural decisions, guardrails, and economic models that let us scale AI use predictably across the business. If you're weighing governance (cost and risk) against velocity, this is the playbook you want from day one. This presentation is brought to you by Presidio, an AWS Partner.

title: AI That Answers: Customer Experiences Reimagined with Amazon Connect (sponsored by PwC)
title_ko: 답하는 AI: Amazon Connect로 재구상한 고객 경험 (PwC 후원)
summary_ko: PwC와 여러 산업의 고객 4곳이 Amazon Connect로 고객 경험을 혁신한 실제 사례를 공유합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Join PwC and four leading clients across industries to hear real examples of how Amazon Connect is transforming customer experience and delivering business outcomes. This session showcases cutting-edge omnichannel solutions across voice, chat, and messaging, along with agentic AI capabilities driving automation in areas like order management and real-time updates. Hear how organizations are deploying next-generation, AI-powered voice solutions in production, with new innovations continuing to emerge. Discover how these advancements deliver measurable business value, backed by PwC's outcome-based approach that ties technology investment directly to efficiency gains and improved customer and business performance. This presentation is brought to you by PwC, an AWS Partner.

title: 4 primitives to evaluate your on-call agent's autonomy (sponsored by Resolve AI)
title_ko: 온콜 에이전트의 자율성을 평가하는 4가지 기본 요소 (Resolve AI 후원)
summary_ko: 알림 분류와 조사 등 온콜 업무를 자율 처리하는 AI 에이전트의 자율성 수준을 평가하는 4가지 기준을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: AI that handles on-call autonomously requires agents to take on alert triage, investigations, acting on production, and learning from what happened. Autonomy progresses unevenly as investigations are bottlenecked on quality while actions are limited by trust. In this session we will walk through how we build each primitive of our autonomous agents at ResolveAI, and how we help engineering teams handle on-call and incident resolutions. This presentation is brought to you by Resolve AI, an AWS Partner.

title: Your AI agent gets a budget when Agentic AIOps meets FinOps (sponsored by ManageEngine)
title_ko: 에이전틱 AIOps와 FinOps가 만날 때 AI 에이전트에 예산이 생긴다 (ManageEngine 후원)
summary_ko: 몇 초 만에 탐지·진단·조치하는 AI 에이전트에 FinOps 관점의 비용 통제를 결합하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: AI agents can now detect, diagnose, and act in seconds. Observability tells them what is happening. The harder question is how they decide. What is an action worth, and what should an agent optimize for? The intersection of Agentic AIOps and FinOps answers both. The result is a blueprint for business-aware autonomous operations, and three practical steps to apply it in your own environment. This presentation is brought to you by ManageEngine, an AWS Partner.

title: Machines on Call for Humans: Agents to run and fix your prod (sponsored by Resolve AI)
title_ko: 사람 대신 온콜하는 머신: 프로덕션을 운영하고 고치는 에이전트 (Resolve AI 후원)
