room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Data engineering teams lose time to siloed data, manual ETL, and tribal knowledge. This session shows how agents change that in Amazon SageMaker. Use SageMaker Data Agent to trace errors, refactor code, and deploy pipelines in natural language, then bring your own agents through MCP servers to work with third-party clients and models directly on your data. See how the same agentic approach extends across SageMaker, so teams can consolidate fragmented pipelines, standardize environments, and put agents to work on more of the data engineering lifecycle.

title: Develop with natural language and agentic AI in Amazon SageMaker
title_ko: Amazon SageMaker에서 자연어와 에이전틱 AI로 개발하기
summary_ko: SageMaker Data Agent를 활용해 하나의 대화만으로 데이터 탐색부터 분석, 모델 개발까지 수행하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
abstract: Dive into how data analytics and data engineering workflows are changing with natural language and agentic AI in Amazon SageMaker. Using the SageMaker Data Agent, we'll show how a single conversation can take you from a business question to a governed, scheduled data pipeline, and how to keep that data trustworthy with data quality checks defined in natural language.

title: Inside DuckDB and how AWS Analytics puts it to work
title_ko: DuckDB의 내부와 AWS Analytics의 활용 방식
summary_ko: 인프로세스 분석 데이터베이스 DuckDB의 아키텍처를 깊이 살펴보고 AWS Analytics가 이를 활용하는 방식을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: DuckDB has become one of the most talked-about innovations in analytics, and now the team behind it, DuckLabs, is part of AWS. In this session, dive deep into the architecture of DuckDB, the in-process analytical database that brings fast OLAP performance to laptops, serverless functions, and data pipelines. Learn how its vectorized execution engine, columnar storage, and zero-dependency design make it well suited for embedded analytics, local development, and edge processing. Explore real-world use cases, performance characteristics, and how DuckDB complements AWS analytics services, including Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, and Amazon Redshift. Whether you're a data engineer, data scientist, or architect, gain the technical depth to put DuckDB to work.

title: Your data, your engine: How open source and open standards power analytics on AWS
title_ko: 나의 데이터, 나의 엔진: 오픈소스와 개방형 표준이 이끄는 AWS 분석
summary_ko: 오픈소스 도구와 개방형 표준을 활용해 AWS에서 유연한 분석 환경을 구축하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Open table formats and open-source engines like DuckDB give organizations the freedom to choose the right tool for each workload, from interactive dashboards and exploratory analytics to large-scale data processing, with no lock-in. In this session, learn how to capitalize these open tools to build on AWS and turn it into a competitive advantage for your business. We deep dive into the application of each engine, how they complement one another across the analytics lifecycle, and how data governance capabilities like catalog access, fine-grained governance, and consistent table management on AWS further simplify multi-engine architectures in production.

title: Cut your data lake and lakehouse bills: Cost and performance tuning best practices
title_ko: 데이터 레이크와 레이크하우스 비용 절감: 비용 및 성능 튜닝 모범 사례
summary_ko: AWS에서 Iceberg 기반 데이터 레이크의 비용을 줄이고 성능을 높이는 고급 튜닝 기법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Open data lakehouses and data lakes, built on open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, can quietly accumulate cost through uncompacted small files, over-partitioned tables, and inefficient scan patterns. In this session, learn advanced Iceberg cost savings and tuning techniques on AWS that cut storage and compute costs while improving performance. We cover partitioning strategies, predicate pushdown optimizations, compaction tradeoffs, Graviton efficiencies, Intelligent-Tiering storage and how to eliminate common anti-patterns that inflate your bill. Learn from practical examples on Amazon S3 Tables, Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, Amazon EMR and leave with a comprehensive playbook to lower your analytics costs

title: Optimize AI ROI with cost-efficient data analytics on AWS
title_ko: AWS의 비용 효율적인 데이터 분석으로 AI ROI 최적화
summary_ko: AWS 데이터 분석 서비스의 다양한 비용 효율화 수단을 결합해 AI 투자 수익을 높이는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Delivering ROI for AI and ML at enterprise scale demands more than just great models — it requires a data and analytics foundation engineered for cost efficiency from day one. This session examines different cost efficiency levers that pair AWS data and analytics services with AI/ML workloads to maximize price-performance. We explore patterns including right-sizing your data infrastructure for training, inference, feature extraction, ETL pipelines and selecting optimal storage formats to minimize costs. You'll learn how to instrument cost observability across your analytics stack, apply tagging strategies for AI workload attribution, and implement governance guardrails that prevent runaway spend — turning your data foundation into a competitive advantage for ML and AI delivery.

title: Building high-quality data products for AI agents
title_ko: AI 에이전트를 위한 고품질 데이터 제품 구축
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 신뢰하고 활용할 수 있는 고품질 데이터 제품을 구축하고 관리하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: AI agents are only as effective as the data they rely on. This chalk talk focuses on how to build and manage high-quality data products and contextual information for use by AI agents. You'll learn how to deliver accurate, up-to-date, and well-governed data for AI systems, including context engineering, RAG strategies, fine-tuning dataset curation, and automated quality checks. We'll cover how to manage AI context, handle data drift, and perform classical data management activities in the Agentic AI world.

title: From human search to agent retrieval on OpenSearch Service
title_ko: 사람의 검색에서 에이전트 검색으로: OpenSearch Service
summary_ko: 작업당 수백 개의 하위 쿼리를 수행하는 에이전트 검색 특성에 맞춰 OpenSearch Service를 설계하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Agents don't search like humans. They fire hundreds of sub-queries per task, need to carry knowledge across sessions, and act on whatever they retrieve. In production, teams hit the same walls: wrong retrieval cascades into wrong actions; when knowledge disappears between sessions, agents repeat work and mistakes; and teams need to see what an agent retrieved, why it acted, and what happened downstream. In this session, learn how Amazon OpenSearch Service helps agents find, remember, and observe on one open foundation, see it in a live demo, and hear how Intuit uses OpenSearch Service across its platform and products.

title: Boost Apache Spark performance and reduce costs with AWS Analytics
title_ko: AWS Analytics로 Apache Spark 성능 향상 및 비용 절감
summary_ko: AWS의 성능 최적화 Apache Spark 런타임을 활용해 Spark 작업 속도를 높이고 비용을 줄이는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Join this interactive chalk talk to explore best practices for building high-performing, cost-efficient Spark applications using AWS analytics data processing services. We'll discuss the AWS performance-optimized runtime for Apache Spark—delivering up to 4.5x faster execution across Amazon EMR, Amazon Athena, and AWS Glue—meaning faster jobs and lower compute spend. Explore flexible deployment models—long-running clusters, on-demand elasticity with EMR Serverless, Kubernetes integration with EMR on EKS, and Graviton instances for up to 30% cost reduction. We'll also highlight how Glue's auto scaling, Flex execution class, and Iceberg integrations simplify pipelines while optimizing costs.

title: Build scalable streaming and messaging applications with Amazon Kinesis and AmazonMSK
title_ko: Amazon Kinesis와 Amazon MSK로 확장 가능한 스트리밍 및 메시징 애플리케이션 구축
summary_ko: Amazon MSK와 Kinesis Data Streams로 확장 가능한 스트리밍 및 메시징 애플리케이션을 손쉽게 구축하는 방법을 알아봅니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Messaging and streaming should be simple, elastic, and cost-efficient, no matter how your workloads change. In this session, discover how Amazon MSK and Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is making it easier and more affordable to build messaging and streaming applications at any scale. Learn how you can stop worrying about capacity planning and reduce costs automatically as your traffic scales up and down. See how you can land your streaming data directly into Amazon S3 and S3 Tables without building or managing separate pipelines so you can focus on deriving insights instead of maintaining infrastructure. Join us to see how these innovations come together to help you move faster, spend less, and eliminate operational overhead at any scale.

title: Build at scale real-time ingestion pipelines for Apache Iceberg tables
title_ko: Apache Iceberg 테이블을 위한 대규모 실시간 수집 파이프라인 구축
summary_ko: Iceberg 테이블로 실시간 데이터를 수집하는 세 가지 참조 아키텍처를 분석하고 장단점을 비교합니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan I
abstract: Landing streaming data into Apache Iceberg at scale is a complex undertaking. In this chalk talk, we dissect three reference architectures for real-time ingestion into Iceberg tables on Amazon S3 Tables: zero-code delivery with streaming tables for Amazon MSK and Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, in-stream enrichment with Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink, and change data capture from operational databases with Apache Flink CDC and zero-ETL integrations. Learn which architecture fits your latency and cost requirements, how to keep Iceberg tables query-ready under continuous writes, and how these pipelines feed downstream analytics and AI workloads.

title: What's new in AWS Glue Data Catalog for data and AI governance
title_ko: 데이터 및 AI 거버넌스를 위한 AWS Glue Data Catalog의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 개방형 표준과 오픈 테이블 포맷을 수용한 AWS Glue Data Catalog의 데이터 및 AI 거버넌스 신규 기능을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Data spread across lakes, warehouses, and third-party platforms is hard to find, govern, and use. In this session, explore how AWS Glue Data Catalog embraces open standards and open table formats so your data stays portable and accessible across the tools and engines your teams already use. Learn how to discover and register data from a range of sources, govern and manage access from one place, and connect your catalog to Apache Iceberg-compatible engines, so you can avoid lock-in and keep the freedom to choose the right tool for each job. Ideal for data engineers, platform teams, and data architects building open, governed analytics across their data estate.

title: What's new with the Amazon SageMaker Data Agent
title_ko: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 데이터 탐색과 이해, 코드 생성 등을 돕는 Amazon SageMaker Data Agent의 최신 기능을 소개합니다.
abstract: The Amazon SageMaker Data Agent helps data teams move from a plain-language request to results faster. In this session, learn how it helps you discover and understand your data, generate and run analysis, build and operationalize data workflows, and connect analytics work through to model development. See how it can take on the repetitive, time-consuming steps of data work so your team can focus on the questions that matter and the decisions that follow. Whether you're exploring a new dataset or building an end-to-end workflow, learn how the Data Agent brings governed, agentic development to every step of your data work.

title: What's new with Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
title_ko: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 화이트보드를 통해 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams의 최신 기능과 스트리밍 데이터 처리 방식의 변화를 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Organizations increasingly need to work with the same real-time data in different ways depending on the workload, and today that often means integrating services and building custom workarounds to make it fit. In this chalk talk, we head to the whiteboard to explore how Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is evolving to handle more of these patterns natively, so you can consolidate more of your real-time architecture onto one service. We work through how to design for the way your workload actually behaves, how scaling can adapt automatically as traffic rises and falls, and where teams can remove complexity and cost rather than adding another pipeline.

title: Cost-effective serverless data integrations and workflows for AI-ready data
title_ko: AI 준비 데이터를 위한 비용 효율적인 서버리스 데이터 통합 및 워크플로
summary_ko: AWS Glue 등 서버리스 서비스로 AI에 바로 활용 가능한 데이터셋을 비용 효율적으로 구축하는 방법을 배웁니다.
services: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA)
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: AI is only as good as the data beneath it and building high-quality, well-integrated data products shouldn't break your budget. In this session, learn how to build cost-effective AI-ready datasets using AWS Glue, Amazon MWAA and Apache Iceberg. We'll show how Glue Data Quality and Glue serverless ETL, now with generative AI-assisted development, lets you ingest, transform, and prepare high-quality data at scale. We’ll demonstrate how Amazon MWAA serverless empowers a single DAG to coordinate workloads across AWS Glue, and other engines - all of this while paying only for what you use. Pairing this setup with Apache Iceberg further enhances your AI workloads with query-ready production data pipelines that move the needle without breaking the bank.

title: Observe, investigate, act: smarter ops with Amazon OpenSearch Service
title_ko: 관찰, 조사, 조치: Amazon OpenSearch Service로 더 스마트한 운영
summary_ko: LLM 트레이스 모니터링 등 에이전트 워크로드 관측을 포함해 OpenSearch Service로 운영을 고도화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: AI agents are becoming your best investigators, triaging alerts, correlating telemetry, and performing root-cause analysis across metrics, logs, and traces in seconds. And agents are a critical workload to observe: you need LLM trace monitoring, per-call cost attribution, and multi-agent workflow debugging to keep token spend and accuracy under control. Whether you're scaling an existing observability platform or modernizing your stack, Amazon OpenSearch Service addresses both sides. In this session, we present capabilities including native OpenTelemetry ingestion, MCP-based agent skills for natural-language issue investigation, and an optimized log-analytics engine delivering 4× price-performance at petabyte scale. Learn how to put AI agents to work on your observability data and how to keep them accountable in production.

title: Introducing AWS Context: Build governed intelligence for agents at scale
title_ko: AWS Context 소개: 대규모 에이전트를 위한 거버넌스 기반 인텔리전스 구축
summary_ko: AWS Context가 데이터를 통합해 거버넌스가 적용된 지식 그래프를 자동 구축하고 에이전트에 제공하는 방식을 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: AI agents need to understand what your data means, how it connects, and which definitions and rules apply to each use case. AWS Context automatically builds a governed knowledge graph by unifying structured and unstructured data, managed knowledge bases, and technical and business metadata from AWS and third-party sources. This shared foundation grounds agents in your organization’s data, business rules, relationships, and domain knowledge. In this session, dive into the reference architecture and learn best practices for integrating agents with AWS Context, including considerations for identity management, workload sizing, and production deployments.

title: Unlock Workday data with AWS: Building Trustworthy Agents (sponsored by Workday)
title_ko: AWS로 Workday 데이터 활용하기: 신뢰할 수 있는 에이전트 구축 (Workday 후원)
summary_ko: Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick 등과 Workday 데이터를 연결해 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 에이전트를 구축하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Generative AI agents and analytics in AWS are only as effective as the enterprise context behind them. While tools like Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Quick deliver powerful reasoning capabilities, grounding those models in authoritative, real-time HR and financial data traditionally requires complex ETL pipelines, custom integrations, and data duplication. In this session, we’ll demonstrate how Workday natively bridges this gap on AWS. Through live cross-system AI agent demos, you’ll see how to deliver unified, real-time enterprise insights without writing ETL code or moving data. This presentation is brought to you by Workday, an AWS Partner.

title: Data governance for trustworthy AI: from raw data to trusted products
title_ko: 신뢰할 수 있는 AI를 위한 데이터 거버넌스: 원시 데이터에서 신뢰 가능한 데이터 제품까지
summary_ko: 비즈니스 용어집과 메타데이터 양식을 구축해 원시 데이터를 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터 제품으로 만드는 방법을 실습합니다.
abstract: In this hands-on workshop, transform fictional retailer RetailMax's raw, ungoverned data into trusted, governed data products using Amazon SageMaker platform . Learn to build a business glossary and metadata forms, create an analysis-ready dataset with an ETL job, and trace end-to-end data lineage. Gain hands-on experience enforcing data quality rules, enriching and publishing a governed data product, and sharing it through a publish-and-subscribe model with approval workflows and least-privilege access. Discover how to deliver trustworthy, explainable answers with the Gen-AI data agent. Leave equipped to build the governance and metadata foundation that makes data — and the AI that runs on it — trustworthy across your organization. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: Reduce spend and data movement with Amazon Redshift Data Sharing and Graviton
title_ko: Amazon Redshift Data Sharing과 Graviton으로 비용과 데이터 이동 줄이기
summary_ko: Redshift Data Sharing으로 데이터 복사 없이 실시간 공유하고 Graviton으로 비용을 절감하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Organizations sharing data across business units often rely on slow, error-prone ETL jobs that create costly duplication. Amazon Redshift Data Sharing enables secure, live access across provisioned and serverless warehouses — within or across accounts and regions — eliminating data movement entirely. Additionally, Graviton-powered Redshift RG instances accelerate workloads on Apache Iceberg tables through optimized columnar processing and parallel I/O. In this session, learn how to break down data silos with cross-warehouse data sharing and boost open data lakehouse performance with Redshift on Graviton.

title: Govern data and AI agents with lineage and context in AWS Glue Data Catalog
title_ko: AWS Glue Data Catalog의 계보와 컨텍스트로 데이터 및 AI 에이전트 거버넌스
summary_ko: 데이터 계보와 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 제공해 AI 에이전트가 컬럼 의미를 오해하지 않도록 거버넌스하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: AI agents generate SQL, surface insights, and take action on your data. Without governance guardrails, they hallucinate column meanings, query stale tables, and return wrong answers with high confidence. In this session, learn how to ground your AI agents in trusted metadata using AWS Glue Data Catalog. See how to flow business context like glossary terms, descriptions, and quality scores into agent workflows so they generate accurate, schema-aware queries instead of guessing. Walk away with practical patterns for governing AI-assisted analytics the same way you govern human analysts

title: From self-managed to AWS managed: agentic AI for Kafka and MQ migrations
title_ko: 자체 관리형에서 AWS 관리형으로: Kafka 및 MQ 마이그레이션을 위한 에이전틱 AI
summary_ko: 토픽 매핑, 오프셋 변환, ACL 이전 등 까다로운 Kafka와 MQ 마이그레이션을 에이전틱 AI로 자동화하는 방법을 소개합니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
abstract: Migrating self-managed Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ to Amazon MSK and Amazon MQ is hard. Topic mapping, offset translation, ACL migration, and the notoriously long cutover phase slow teams down for weeks. In this chalk talk, we walk through these challenges and show how agentic AI paired with AWS replication tooling compresses the longest migration phase from days to minutes. Watch a complete live migration executed end-to-end in under 60 minutes and leave with a repeatable playbook for your own migration.

title: Give your AI agent an expert-level playbook with the Agent Toolkit for AWS
title_ko: Agent Toolkit for AWS로 AI 에이전트에 전문가 수준의 플레이북 제공하기
summary_ko: Agent Toolkit for AWS의 설정과 에이전트 워크플로를 다루고 참가자의 어려운 질문에 답하는 세션입니다.
abstract: What if your AI agent could explore schemas, generate correct SQL, load data, and run migrations — all through the Agent Toolkit for AWS with expert-level context? In this chalk talk, we explore how the AWS MCP Server paired with packaged AWS Analytics skills give agents like Claude Code, Kiro, and Cursor deep AWS service expertise — from SQL syntax and metadata discovery to migration planning and performance tuning. Bring your toughest questions — we'll cover setup, agent workflows, and best practices for your environments.

title: Simplify identity and security management in an open data architecture on AWS
title_ko: AWS 개방형 데이터 아키텍처에서 ID 및 보안 관리 간소화
summary_ko: 신뢰할 수 있는 ID 전파로 최종 사용자 ID 기반 접근 제어를 개방형 데이터 아키텍처 전반에 적용하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: As organizations unify data across Amazon S3 data lakes, S3 Tables, and Amazon Redshift using the open data lakehouse architecture, securing access at scale becomes critical. In this chalk talk, we dive deep into simplifying trusted identity propagation so end-user identities — not shared service roles — reach the data plane, designing multi-dimensional tag-based access control taxonomies that scale automatically through inheritance, enforcing column-level and cell-level security across federated catalogs, and auditing every access event to individual users.

title: Apache Iceberg V3 on AWS: Lower Costs, Better Lakehouse Performance
title_ko: AWS의 Apache Iceberg V3: 비용 절감과 레이크하우스 성능 향상
summary_ko: Amazon EMR, Glue, Athena 등으로 Iceberg V3를 구현해 비용을 줄이고 성능을 높이는 패턴을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Apache Iceberg V3 is now production-ready, and adopting deletion vectors, row lineage, and new data types across your lakehouse requires careful planning. In this session, explore implementation patterns using Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, and Amazon S3 Tables. Learn when deletion vectors outperform copy-on-write, how row lineage enables compliance without extra pipelines, and how V3 incremental processing cuts batch costs. Leave with a practical migration strategy for your Iceberg upgrade.

title: Automating data pipelines with agentic AI and Apache Iceberg
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI와 Apache Iceberg로 데이터 파이프라인 자동화
summary_ko: 에이전틱 아키텍처를 활용해 Apache Iceberg 기반 데이터 파이프라인 구축과 운영을 자동화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Join this session to experience the power of agentic AI and Apache Iceberg coming together on AWS to build a self-correcting data pipeline. We will dive in to an agentic architecture for an Iceberg-based data pipeline - governed end-to-end through AWS Glue Data Catalog - where critical telemetry signals such as data loss, schema drift, cost spikes are not only detected and diagnosed but also remediated and verified - all in real time. Attendees will walk away with a blueprint on how to unify DataOps, MLOps, and FinOps for their data pipelines, with Glue Data Catalog as the metadata backbone tying governance, lineage, and discovery together across the pipeline.

title: Conversational AI to accelerate Apache Spark operations on Amazon EMR
title_ko: Amazon EMR에서 Apache Spark 운영을 가속하는 대화형 AI
summary_ko: AI 에이전트를 활용해 Amazon EMR의 Spark 작업 문제 해결과 최적화를 대화형으로 수행하는 방법을 체험합니다.
abstract: Customers manage dozens of Apache Spark applications on Amazon EMR — and every major upgrade, unexpected failure, or performance regression pulls engineers away into reactive firefighting. In this workshop, experience a fundamentally different approach with AI-powered agents that handle the undifferentiated heavy lifting of Spark modernization and incident resolution. You'll work hands-on with conversational agents such as the Apache Spark Upgrade Agent and the Apache Spark Troubleshooting Agent across real-world scenarios on EMR Serverless and EMR on EC2 to simplify the operational burden through natural language, automated code transformation, workload analysis and data quality validation.

title: Build a grounded AI support assistant on Amazon OpenSearch Service
title_ko: Amazon OpenSearch Service로 그라운딩된 AI 지원 어시스턴트 구축
summary_ko: 자체 데이터에 그라운딩되어 정확한 답변을 제공하는 AI 고객 지원 어시스턴트를 OpenSearch Service로 구축합니다.
abstract: You want to build an AI assistant: where do you even start? A model alone is not the answer. The hard part is grounding it in your own data so it gives real answers, remembers the conversation, and holds up as that data grows, and grounding is a search problem. In this hands-on workshop, you build a customer support assistant grounded in Amazon OpenSearch Service. Starting from a pre-deployed base, you create an OpenSearch Serverless collection, add hybrid search for relevance, and add agentic memory so your assistant retains context across the conversation. You connect your tools and data with the OpenSearch MCP server, the AWS Knowledge MCP, and the AWS MCP. You leave with working code, an architecture that scales itself, and a clear path from a blank page to an assistant that answers from real data.

title: Build agentic AI applications with the open data lakehouse architecture on AWS
title_ko: AWS 오픈 데이터 레이크하우스 아키텍처로 에이전틱 AI 애플리케이션 구축
summary_ko: 데이터 레이크와 웨어하우스 간 데이터 관리를 통합해 에이전틱 AI 애플리케이션을 구축하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Transform your organization's data landscape and eliminate silos in this hands-on workshop with the open data lakehouse architecture on AWS. Unify data management and design data interoperability across data lakes, data warehouses, and federated data sources. Through practical exercises, discover how to create a single source of truth while maintaining security and governance across your entire data estate. You'll implement real-time analytics, optimize query performance, and design scalable architectures. Perfect for data engineers, ML practitioners, and solution architects looking to modernize their data infrastructure for building agentic AI applications.

title: A practical guide to Apache Iceberg migration on AWS
title_ko: AWS에서의 Apache Iceberg 마이그레이션 실전 가이드
summary_ko: 기존 데이터를 Apache Iceberg로 이전하는 메커니즘과 실제 마이그레이션 전략을 실습으로 구현합니다.
abstract: Many organizations want to adopt Apache Iceberg but face a practical challenge: how do you migrate existing data lake tables — Hive-style, Apache Hudi, or Delta Lake — without disrupting production workloads? In this hands-on workshop, you'll learn and implement the full spectrum of migration techniques on AWS, from zero-copy in-place approaches to full data rewrites targeting both self-managed Iceberg tables in S3 and Amazon S3 Tables. Beyond the mechanics, you'll implement real-world migration strategies and learn how to choose among them based on downtime tolerance, writer constraints, and data volume. You'll leave with a repeatable playbook for migrating your data lake to Iceberg with minimal risk and zero data loss.

title: Experience catalog federation on AWS: build a multi-cloud open data lakehouse
title_ko: AWS 카탈로그 페더레이션 체험: 멀티 클라우드 오픈 데이터 레이크하우스 구축
summary_ko: 카탈로그 페더레이션으로 여러 클라우드의 데이터를 통합한 오픈 데이터 레이크하우스를 구축하는 실습 워크숍입니다.
abstract: Enterprise data teams have distributed data catalogs across multiple cloud providers, each with partial visibility and no shared query surface. This hands-on workshop demonstrates how catalog federation unifies cross-cloud data silos into an open data lakehouse architecture on AWS. Using Amazon S3 Tables as the storage foundation with Apache Iceberg as the open, engine-neutral table format for seamless interoperability and zero data duplication across AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks, you'll federate remote catalogs to build a unified lakehouse on AWS to run AI-assisted business analytics.

title: Power streaming analytics on AWS with AI-driven insights
title_ko: AI 기반 인사이트로 AWS 스트리밍 분석 강화
summary_ko: AWS에서 스트리밍 분석 파이프라인을 구축하고 AI로 실시간 인사이트를 도출하는 실습 세션입니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
abstract: Learn how to build a modern, streaming analytics solution for real-time data processing and power it with agentic AI capabilities to analyze events and extract patterns for actionable responses. This session will provide a hands-on experience on building a streaming solution using Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka for real-time data ingestion, using Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink for complex event processing, and Strands Agents on Amazon Bedrock Agent Core to take immediate action. Further evolve this solution to demonstrate the integration with Amazon S3 Tables for deeper analysis.

services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
abstract: Learn how to build a modern, streaming analytics solution for real-time data processing and power it with agentic AI capabilities to analyze events and extract patterns for actionable responses. This session will provide a hands-on experience on building a streaming solution using Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka for real-time data ingestion, using Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink for complex event processing, and Strands Agents on Amazon Bedrock Agent Core to take immediate action. Further evolve this solution to demonstrate the integration with Amazon S3 Tables for deeper analysis.

title: Ground your agents with AWS Context and Amazon SageMaker
title_ko: AWS Context와 Amazon SageMaker로 에이전트 그라운딩하기
summary_ko: AWS Context가 Amazon SageMaker의 에이전틱 경험을 더 정확하고 신뢰할 수 있게 만드는 방법을 보여줍니다.
abstract: Agents are only as good as the context they're given. In this session, see how AWS Context makes the agentic experience in Amazon SageMaker more accurate and useful by grounding agents in business metadata. We'll show how context-aware agents like SageMaker Data Agent break complex requests into structured, multi-step plans, generate validated SQL, Python, and PySpark against your real data, and keep humans in the loop with built-in checkpoints. You'll learn practical techniques to feed the right context to your agents, connect additional sources, and turn a capable assistant into one that truly understands your environment.

title: Accelerating Apache Spark 4.1 workloads with AWS Analytics
title_ko: AWS Analytics로 Apache Spark 4.1 워크로드 가속화
summary_ko: 최신 엔진 Apache Spark 4.1을 AWS Analytics에서 실행해 성능과 효율을 높이는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Apache Spark 4.1 is the latest engine upgrade, and AWS is the best place to run it. Learn best practices for building high-performing Spark 4.1 applications using Amazon EMR. Explore what's new, from the ANSI-compliant type system and Variant data type to Spark Connect and Python-first APIs, and how the AWS performance-optimized runtime amplifies these improvements at scale. See how the Spark Troubleshooting and Upgrade agent accelerates migration by automatically identifying deprecated APIs and recommending code fixes, and how AWS Glue and Apache Iceberg integrations simplify pipelines with open table formats.

title: Simplify Data Analytics operations with AI-powered Apache Spark agents on AWS
title_ko: AWS의 AI 기반 Apache Spark 에이전트로 데이터 분석 운영 간소화
summary_ko: AWS Glue, Amazon EMR 등을 위한 AI 기반 Spark 에이전트들로 분석 작업 운영을 간소화하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Running analytics workloads at scale carries a hidden operational tax: teams commonly lose significant engineering time to debugging failures, leave performance and cost improvements on the table, and spend months on each version upgrade. In this talk, we walk through a family of AI-powered agents for AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, and Amazon Athena. The Spark Troubleshooting Agent finds the root cause of a failure and recommends the code or config fix - cutting debugging time from hours to minutes. The Spark Upgrade Agent plans an upgrade, transforms the code, and validates both runtime and data quality - turning months into hours. We share what worked in production for both agents - the design choices, failure modes, and validation strategies that made them reliable - and distill lessons that generalize to any team applying LLMs to complex infrastructure.

title: Trace Lineage From AI Endpoints and Models to Data
title_ko: AI 엔드포인트와 모델에서 데이터까지 계보 추적하기
summary_ko: AI 엔드포인트, 모델, 학습 데이터를 하나의 계보 그래프로 연결해 출처를 증명하는 방법을 화이트보드로 설명합니다.
abstract: Every number in a dashboard and every answer from an AI agent rests on a chain of data you may not be able to see. Can you prove where it came from? In this chalk talk, we whiteboard one lineage graph connecting endpoints, models, jobs, and tables across your pipelines on Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena, anchored on the AWS Glue Data Catalog. We trace a production number back to the tables that fed it, work out what breaks before a schema change ships, and have an AI agent show the provenance of its own answer.

title: Building a semantic layer with AWS Glue Data Catalog and AWS Context
title_ko: AWS Glue Data Catalog와 AWS Context로 시맨틱 레이어 구축
summary_ko: AI 에이전트와 분석 엔진이 비즈니스 의미를 이해할 수 있도록 Glue Data Catalog와 AWS Context로 시맨틱 레이어를 구축합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan I
abstract: In this chalk talk, we dive into how AWS Context assembles semantic data from multiple semantic stores to create a semantic layer, which is then turned into a unified context layer through a knowledge graph. This enables AI agents and analytics engines to understand business meaning, relationships, and intent — not just schema and location. We'll work through architecture patterns for defining semantic data annotations, propagating semantics across lakehouse tables, and exposing discoverable, agent-ready metadata at query time.

title: Design an open, cost-effective and high-performant lakehouse with Apache Iceberg on
title_ko: Apache Iceberg로 개방적이고 비용 효율적인 고성능 레이크하우스 설계
summary_ko: 스키마 진화, 파티셔닝 등 Apache Iceberg 레이크하우스 설계의 트레이드오프를 화이트보드로 함께 논의합니다.
abstract: What does it take to build a lakehouse that's open, fast, and cost-effective? In this chalk talk, we unpack real architectural decisions behind Apache Iceberg on AWS—from Amazon S3 Tables (delivering up to 3x faster queries and 10x higher TPS) to unified metadata management with the AWS Glue Data Catalog across Athena, EMR, and Glue ETL. Bring your questions as we whiteboard trade-offs around schema evolution, ACID transactions, time-travel queries, and avoiding vendor lock-in. Leave with actionable patterns tailored to your workload.

title: Best practices for operating an Apache Iceberg lakehouse at scale
title_ko: 대규모 Apache Iceberg 레이크하우스 운영 모범 사례
summary_ko: 컴팩션, 스냅샷 만료 등 테이블 유지 관리 전략을 중심으로 대규모 Iceberg 레이크하우스 운영 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Operating an Iceberg lakehouse at scale means taming the operational overhead that grows with your data. In this chalk talk, we dive into table maintenance strategies—compaction, snapshot expiration, and orphan file cleanup—and discuss how Amazon S3 Tables automates these tasks. We'll whiteboard patterns for metadata management with AWS Glue Data Catalog, storage cost optimization through lifecycle-aware file pruning, and partition evolution without rewriting data. You will leave with battle-tested operational patterns for production Iceberg workloads.

title: Govern your context layer for AI agents with AWS Context
title_ko: AWS Context로 AI 에이전트를 위한 컨텍스트 레이어 거버넌스
summary_ko: 카탈로그, 용어집, 쿼리 등에서 시맨틱 데이터를 모으는 AWS Context로 에이전트 컨텍스트 레이어를 관리하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Learn how to carry your existing data permissions into a governed context layer your AI agents need to work accurately across structured and unstructured data. AWS Context assembles semantic data from your catalogs, glossaries, query logs, and access patterns into one governed context layer, honoring the governance contract placed on your data assets. Each user's identity flows through the agent so every answer is scoped to what they are authorized to see. We will whiteboard and interact on how identity propagates, how retrieval is filtered, and where permissions break.

title: Event-driven agents at scale: building agentic AI on Amazon MSK
title_ko: 대규모 이벤트 기반 에이전트: Amazon MSK 위에 에이전틱 AI 구축
summary_ko: Amazon MSK로 멀티테넌트 이벤트 기반 에이전트를 구축하는 재사용 가능한 패턴을 소개합니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
abstract: Production agents need to dispatch long-running actions, wait on external systems, fan results out to analytics, and re-enter the conversation when work finishes — not sit in a synchronous loop. In this session, we present reusable patterns for building multi-tenant, event-driven agentic systems on Amazon MSK: dispatch-and-resume for long-running tool calls, topic and partition design keyed to tenant and conversation, decoupling the agent loop from channels and analytics, and durability and replay so in-flight work survives deploys and retries. Learn a practical approach for designing agentic SaaS that stays reliable as load, tools, and channels grow.

title: Powering your agentic AI experience with AWS streaming and messaging
title_ko: AWS 스트리밍 및 메시징으로 에이전틱 AI 경험 강화
summary_ko: AWS 스트리밍과 메시징 서비스를 결합해 실시간 에이전틱 AI 패턴을 구현하는 방법을 배웁니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
abstract: Organizations are accelerating innovation with generative and agentic AI and getting there depends on a handful of real-time data primitives: durable, high-throughput ingestion; stream processing and enrichment; low-latency, event-driven delivery; and a scalable place to land and serve data. In this session, learn how these primitives come together to power the real-time patterns behind agentic AI and where each one fits: streaming into a real-time semantic layer for fresh retrieval context, event-driven agent invocation so agents act the instant something happens, and continuously sourcing agentic data stores with live data. Following a single transaction end to end, we'll show where each primitive breaks when the consumer is an agent, the design decisions you still own, and a reference architecture you can apply right away.

title: Accelerate lakehouse analytics with Apache Iceberg materialized views
title_ko: Apache Iceberg 구체화 뷰로 레이크하우스 분석 가속화
summary_ko: 한 번 계산해 여러 엔진에서 활용할 수 있는 개방형 Iceberg 구체화 뷰로 레이크하우스 분석을 가속하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Apache Iceberg Materialized Views on AWS store pre-computed query results as Iceberg tables on Amazon S3 or Amazon S3 Tables. These views are not only open, as in compute once and consume from any Iceberg-compatible engine – they accelerate your lakehouse analytics while reducing costs. Join this hands-on session to experience how Apache Iceberg Materialized Views on AWS simplify medallion architectures, lakehouse migrations, accelerate BI query transactions and complex joins.

title: Give your AI agents business context with AWS Glue Data Catalog
title_ko: AWS Glue Data Catalog로 AI 에이전트에 비즈니스 컨텍스트 제공하기
summary_ko: AWS Glue Data Catalog를 AI 에이전트를 위한 신뢰 계층으로 활용해 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 제공하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: An AI agent pointed at a data catalog that has schema but no meaning will guess — and in a regulated environment, guessing is a compliance liability. In this builders' session, learn how to turn the AWS Glue Data Catalog into a trust layer for AI agents. Enrich the catalog with business context — Skill Assets, golden queries, business glossary terms, ownership, and access restrictions — then connect an MCP-compatible AI agent and watch its answers shift from hallucination to governed, data-literate reasoning. Use semantic search to discover data by business meaning, add queryable metadata forms at scale, and leave with architecture patterns to roll this out across your existing catalog. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: Build a well-governed natural language-to-SQL agentic solution for Amazon Redshift
title_ko: Amazon Redshift를 위한 거버넌스 기반 자연어-SQL 에이전틱 솔루션 구축
summary_ko: 거버넌스가 적용된 텍스트-SQL 에이전트를 Amazon Redshift용으로 구축하는 실습 세션입니다.
abstract: The Amazon Redshift MCP Server enables AI agents to generate and execute SQL using natural language, but going from demo to production means answering critical security questions on preventing query hallucination, prompt injection, unbounded scans, and inadvertent PII exposure by the LLM. In this session, you will build a well-governed text-to-SQL agentic solution for Amazon Redshift with security gates that validate every AI-generated query before execution including schema allow-listing to constraining LLM context, authorized tables, columns and rows, SQL AST validation and enforced read-only access.

title: Make your vector search faster, more relevant, and cost-efficient
title_ko: 벡터 검색을 더 빠르고, 관련성 높고, 비용 효율적으로 만들기
summary_ko: 어휘 검색과 벡터 검색을 결합한 하이브리드 검색 등 벡터 검색 성능과 비용을 최적화하는 방법을 논의합니다.
services: Vector Engine for Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
abstract: You have a vector workload running and questions piling up: How do I raise relevance? How do I control cost as I scale? Which ranking technique fits my data? We give you a quick tour of vector capabilities in Amazon OpenSearch Service, then spend the rest of the session working through your problems. Topics on the table include hybrid search combining lexical and vector results, ranking with reciprocal rank fusion, maximal marginal relevance, and filtering strategies, when to reach for Automatic Semantic Enrichment or neural sparse vectors instead of building your own embedding pipeline, and cost optimization techniques including quantization, tiered storage, GPU-accelerated indexing, and auto-optimization. Come with a workload in mind and leave with tuning direction for your specific situation.

title: Build orchestration agents for AWS Glue ETL
title_ko: AWS Glue ETL을 위한 오케스트레이션 에이전트 구축
summary_ko: MCP 서버를 활용해 작업 구성을 추론하고 ETL 파이프라인을 구성하는 AWS Glue 오케스트레이션 에이전트를 만듭니다.
abstract: What happens when you give an AI agent the keys to your ETL infrastructure? In this builder session, you'll build an agentic workflow using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that accepts natural language instructions and autonomously orchestrates ETL jobs on AWS Glue. Using MCP servers, your agent will reason job configurations, construct parameters, execute transformations, interact with the Glue Data Catalog, handle retries on failure, and surface results—all from a single conversational prompt.

title: Build conversational AI agents for query federation with Amazon Athena
title_ko: Amazon Athena로 쿼리 페더레이션을 위한 대화형 AI 에이전트 구축
summary_ko: Amazon Athena와 MCP 서버를 통합해 여러 데이터 소스를 대화형으로 쿼리하는 AI 에이전트를 구축합니다.
abstract: Stop copying data just to query it. In this hands-on workshop, you’ll use MCP server integration with Amazon Athena for fast conversational analytics where agents translate natural language to federated SQL queries across custom databases and a multi-vendor data store – without moving or copying data. You’ll learn how federated queries eliminate complex ETL pipelines, enable cross-source joins in a single SQL statement, and integrate with your lakehouse on AWS for unified governance.

title: Build event-driven applications with AWS Streaming and Messaging
title_ko: AWS 스트리밍 및 메시징으로 이벤트 기반 애플리케이션 구축
summary_ko: Amazon SQS 등 AWS 메시징과 스트리밍 서비스로 정교한 이벤트 기반 시스템을 설계하는 방법을 배웁니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
abstract: Dive deep into AWS messaging services in this hands-on workshop where you'll build a real-world, event-driven application. Learn to architect sophisticated event-driven systems using Amazon SQS, SNS, MSK, and Amazon MQ. Through guided exercises, implement critical features including fan-out architectures, FIFO queues, and hybrid patterns while optimizing for security, cost, and performance. Gain practical insights into how architectural decisions impact scalability, latency, and operational complexity in production systems.

title: Getting Started with Apache Iceberg: The AI-Ready open lakehouse advantage
title_ko: Apache Iceberg 시작하기: AI 준비형 오픈 레이크하우스의 장점
summary_ko: Amazon S3 Tables 기반 Apache Iceberg로 진정한 이식성을 갖춘 AI 준비형 레이크하우스를 시작하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: In the agentic AI era, the same modern lakehouse is also your AI-ready foundation: the quality, openness, and organization of your data is what separates successful AI outcomes. Apache Iceberg on Amazon S3 Tables gives you that true portability and engine interoperability to build your AI-ready data foundation. Welcome to this hands-on workshop, where you will build an open lakehouse on AWS to serve analysts and agents both, while tackling real-world data challenges including a medallion architecture, table maintenance, change data capture and GDPR compliance.

title: Unified observability with Amazon OpenSearch Service
title_ko: Amazon OpenSearch Service로 통합 관측성 구현
summary_ko: 분산된 관측성 스택을 Amazon OpenSearch Service로 통합하는 과정을 직접 실습합니다.
abstract: Most teams run observability across fragmented tools: one for metrics, another for logs and traces, each with its own cost model and blind spots. In this session, you work hands-on to consolidate your observability stack on Amazon OpenSearch Service. You integrate Amazon Managed Prometheus for metrics, configure native OpenTelemetry ingestion for traces and logs, and see how a single pane of glass eliminates the context-switching that slows down investigations. Then you optimize for cost and scale: warm tiering, direct query for infrequently accessed data, and O-series instances for log-heavy workloads. Finally, you use AI-powered investigation to perform natural-language root-cause analysis across your unified telemetry and monitor your agents' behavior in production. You leave with a working observability setup that scales, costs less, and investigates faster.

title: Cloud agent work needs infrastructure. We built it. (sponsored by Asana)
title_ko: 클라우드 에이전트 작업에는 인프라가 필요합니다. 우리가 만들었습니다 (Asana 후원)
summary_ko: 에이전트가 수행하는 업무로 개발 방식이 바뀌는 가운데 Asana가 구축한 에이전트 작업 인프라를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Organizations need an operating layer where humans and agents can run critical workflows together. That’s Asana. As software development shifts toward work performed by agents in the cloud, engineering teams need the same connected approach at enterprise scale. Command brings Asana’s operating layer to engineering, giving developers one surface for project management and coding work—connecting planning, assignment, and execution across the organization. Command works with coding agents teams already use, including Codex, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. See the challenges Command solves for product and engineering teams and how it works against real engineering workflows. This presentation is brought to you by Asana, an AWS Partner.

title: Modernize legacy applications into cloud native event-driven systems
title_ko: 레거시 애플리케이션을 클라우드 네이티브 이벤트 기반 시스템으로 현대화
summary_ko: 레거시 애플리케이션과 종속성을 리버스 엔지니어링해 이벤트 기반 클라우드 네이티브 시스템으로 전환하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Join us to learn how to plan and automate your application modernization using agentic tools. We show how to reverse-engineer your applications and dependencies from existing code, then generate a event-driven cloud native target architecture. See how teams move from monoliths to event-driven microservices, deployed as containers or serverless applications, in weeks, and make your applications agent-ready in the process.

title: Bring Oracle Databases to AWS Without Starting Over (sponsored by Oracle)
title_ko: 처음부터 다시 시작하지 않고 Oracle 데이터베이스를 AWS로 (Oracle 후원)
summary_ko: Oracle AI Database@AWS로 기존 Oracle 데이터베이스를 간단하게 AWS로 옮기는 방법을 설명합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Organizations want the flexibility and innovation of AWS, but they cannot afford to rearchitect the mission-critical Oracle Database applications their businesses depend on. This session explains how Oracle AI Database@AWS provides a simpler path from on-premises Oracle Exadata and RAC environments to AWS with minimal to no database or application changes. Explore how customers can maintain full database capabilities and architectural compatibility, connect Oracle data to AWS applications with low latency, and unify data with AWS analytics, machine learning, and agentic AI services. We will also examine the operational value of familiar AWS tools, collaborative support, integrated security, and simplified purchasing. Attendees will learn how migration can reduce infrastructure constraints while creating a stronger foundation for innovation across Oracle and AWS. This presentation is brought to you by Oracle, an AWS Partner.

title: Operationalize enterprise event routing with Amazon EventBridge
title_ko: Amazon EventBridge로 엔터프라이즈 이벤트 라우팅 운영하기
summary_ko: Amazon EventBridge가 제공하는 확장성, 안정성, 개발자 경험을 바탕으로 엔터프라이즈 이벤트 라우팅을 운영하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Scaling event-driven architectures across multiple AWS accounts has long meant managing fragmented buses, cross-account routing complexity, and developer friction. Explore how Amazon EventBridge delivers the scale, reliability, and developer experience that modern event-driven applications demand. It simplifies event routing across accounts and teams. Whether you're consolidating existing event infrastructure or designing a new event-driven platform, you'll leave with a clearer picture of how to reduce operational complexity and ship faster.

title: Serverlesspresso: Build an event-driven app from the ground up
title_ko: Serverlesspresso: 이벤트 기반 앱을 처음부터 구축하기
summary_ko: 커피 주문 시나리오를 시뮬레이션하며 확장 가능하고 장애에 강한 서버리스 이벤트 기반 앱을 처음부터 설계합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano I
abstract: Build a fully event-driven, serverless coffee-ordering web application using AWS Lambda, Amazon EventBridge, and Lambda durable functions. Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures as you simulate customers placing orders and baristas managing them in real time. Discover how durable functions simplify complex workflow orchestration by checkpointing progress, automatically recovering from failures, and pausing execution while waiting on long-running tasks—all without managing additional infrastructure or writing custom state management code. You must bring your laptop to participate.

abstract: Build real-time features using AWS AppSync Events in this hands-on builders' session. Working in small groups with guidance from AWS experts, you'll implement in-app notifications and live updates, configure WebSocket connections, and design data persistence strategies. Using provided code samples, you'll gain practical experience creating responsive, event-driven applications that push updates to connected clients instantly. By the end of this 60-minute session, you'll have working real-time patterns you can apply directly to your own applications. Bring your laptop and come ready to code!

title: Building enterprise-scale event buses with Amazon EventBridge

room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Discover how Amazon EventBridge enhanced Custom event bus simplifies enterprise-scale event routing across accounts and teams. In this hands-on builders' session, you will create a central Custom event bus that connects multiple domains, so teams can publish and consume events without depending on each other. Bring existing producers onboard by publishing events in open formats, configure Subscribers for each application independently to receive only the events it needs, recover from missed events with point-in-time replay, and keep related events in sequence with ordered delivery. Work in small groups with AWS experts. Bring your laptop and come ready to build!

abstract: Secure your APIs with confidence and build them faster. In this builders' session, dive into Amazon API Gateway authorization strategies including Amazon Cognito user pools, Amazon Verified Permissions, Lambda custom authorizers, IAM authorizers, and machine-to-machine scenarios. Through hands-on exercises, implement each strategy and understand their trade-offs. Once secured, ship faster—use Kiro CLI, OpenAPI, and MCP servers to go from spec to deployed API in minutes. title: Routing events at scale with Amazon EventBridge
title_ko: Amazon EventBridge로 대규모 이벤트 라우팅
summary_ko: 사용자 지정 인프라 없이 멀티 계정 이벤트 라우팅을 Amazon EventBridge로 중앙화하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
abstract: Amazon EventBridge simplifies event routing for distributed applications. In this chalk talk, we show how to centralize multi-account event routing without custom infrastructure, using the enhanced custom event bus. We will discuss routing policies, event discovery with schema registry, and access controls that let platform teams govern while app teams move independently. We also explore rate limiting and backpressure so your applications gracefully handle traffic spikes and protect downstream systems without losing events. Along the way, we highlight new multi-account patterns the enhanced custom event bus enables.

title: Amazon API Gateway: Migration strategies and agent-ready APIs
title_ko: Amazon API Gateway: 마이그레이션 전략과 에이전트 친화적 API
summary_ko: OpenAPI를 활용한 레거시 API 플랫폼 마이그레이션 전략과 AI 에이전트가 활용할 수 있는 API 설계를 논의합니다.
abstract: Unlock the full potential of Amazon API Gateway for modern workloads. In this chalk talk, we discuss migration strategies from legacy API platforms using OpenAPI extensions, schema validation, and Infrastructure as Code. Then we tackle the agentic era: how do you design APIs that AI agents can discover, authenticate against, and call reliably? We explore custom authorizers, mutual TLS, and exposing your endpoints as MCP-compatible tool definitions. Bring your questions—we'll work through them on the whiteboard.

room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: In this builders' session, design and deploy a workflow that chains AI service calls—document analysis, content generation, and decision routing—using AWS Step Functions and Lambda durable functions for checkpoint and recovery. Working in small groups, you'll implement error handling, human approval gates, and cost controls for AI-powered pipelines. Walk away with reusable patterns for production-ready GenAI workflows. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: How event driven architectures go wrong and how to fix them
title_ko: 이벤트 기반 아키텍처가 실패하는 이유와 해결 방법
summary_ko: 팀들이 흔히 겪는 비용이 큰 이벤트 기반 아키텍처 안티패턴을 분석하고 해결책을 제시합니다.
abstract: Event-driven architectures promise decoupling and scalability, but production systems reveal hard-won lessons. In this chalk talk, we dissect the most expensive anti-patterns teams encounter such as unbounded fan-out, missing dead-letter queues, chatty event schemas that drive up costs, and orchestration gaps that silently drop work. We whiteboard fixes using Amazon EventBridge, AWS Step Functions, and proven enterprise integration patterns, then walk through designs that keep event-driven systems reliable, cost-effective, and observable at scale.

title: Building event-driven, multi-agent swarms on serverless
title_ko: 서버리스 기반 이벤트 기반 멀티 에이전트 스웜 구축
summary_ko: 이벤트를 통해 독립적인 에이전트 무리를 조율하는 멀티 에이전트 스웜을 서버리스로 구축하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
abstract: Multi-agent AI systems need communication that is decoupled, observable, and scalable. In this chalk talk, we show how to coordinate swarms of independent agents through event choreography on Amazon EventBridge. Each agent reacts to events and emits new ones rather than being told what to do by a central controller. We discuss how to handle multi-agent failure modes like cascading hallucinations and runaway event loops (circular delegation), and how to prevent independent agents from taking conflicting actions.

title: Reliable data processing with AWS serverless services
title_ko: AWS 서버리스 서비스로 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터 처리
summary_ko: AWS Step Functions Distributed Map을 활용한 대규모 병렬 배치 처리 등 서버리스 데이터 처리 패턴을 다룹니다.
abstract: In this chalk talk, learn how to optimize your serverless data processing workflows at scale. We cover AWS Step Functions Distributed Map for massive parallel batch processing and AWS Lambda durable functions for durable execution workflows. See how to combine these with Lambda event source mappings for stream and queue processing. We discuss cost optimization strategies and when to choose each approach for your data workload.

title: A closer look at AWS Lambda durable functions
title_ko: AWS Lambda 내구성 함수 자세히 살펴보기
summary_ko: 체크포인트와 리플레이 기반 실행 등 AWS Lambda 내구성 함수의 동작 원리와 활용법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Lambda durable functions let you write reliable, long-running workflows as sequential code. We start with how durable execution works: checkpointing, replay-based recovery, and the programming model. Next, we explore production patterns including sagas, fan-out/fan-in, and human-in-the-loop waits. Finally, we cover observability, a decision framework to help you choose when to use durable functions versus AWS Step Functions, and operational considerations like concurrency, cost, and versioning.

title: Coding high-throughput data pipelines with AWS Lambda durable functions
title_ko: AWS Lambda 내구성 함수로 고처리량 데이터 파이프라인 코딩하기
summary_ko: Lambda 내구성 함수를 사용해 고처리량 데이터 파이프라인을 라이브 코딩으로 구축합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Processing large datasets usually means hand-wiring queues, coordinators, and state tracking. In this code talk, we live-build a high-throughput data pipeline with Lambda durable functions instead. You'll see the fan-out/fan-in pattern in code: split a large dataset across parallel durable executions, isolate and retry the branches that fail without reprocessing the ones that succeeded, and offload checkpoints to S3 so a job too big for a single invocation survives restarts. We'll tune concurrency to protect a downstream database from overload, then compare the durable-functions approach with other design patterns on both developer velocity and cost. Leave with patterns you can apply to your own data workloads immediately.

title: Coding an AI agent from scratch with AWS Lambda durable functions
title_ko: AWS Lambda 내구성 함수로 AI 에이전트를 처음부터 코딩하기
summary_ko: Lambda 내구성 함수를 활용해 AI 에이전트를 처음부터 직접 구현하는 라이브 코딩 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: AI agents need multi-step reasoning, tool execution, human approvals, and long-running waits, all while keeping resilient state across failures. In this code talk, we build an AI agent from scratch using Lambda Durable Functions. You'll see how to implement a tool-use loop, add retries with exponential backoff, pause for human approval without paying for idle time, and recover cleanly from a mid-execution failure. We'll experiment with agent suspend and resume live, and watch it resume from a checkpoint deterministically. Leave with production-ready patterns for building stateful AI agents using familiar programming constructs.

title: Coding event-driven retry patterns that prevent outages
title_ko: 장애를 예방하는 이벤트 기반 재시도 패턴 코딩
summary_ko: 지터 재시도, 서킷 브레이커 등으로 썬더링 허드와 연쇄 장애를 막는 재시도 패턴을 코드로 구현합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: In this code talk, you'll instrument an event-driven integration layer with the patterns that contain failure: exponential backoff with jitter, circuit breakers, poison-pill isolation, and replay-from-archive - all live, in code. See how jittered retries prevent thundering herds, how circuit breakers protect healthy services from impaired ones, and how idempotency makes every replay safe. By the end, you'll have hands-on patterns for EventBridge and Step Functions that shrink your blast radius from total outage to graceful degradation.

summary_ko: 지터 재시도, 서킷 브레이커 등으로 썬더링 허드와 연쇄 장애를 막는 재시도 패턴을 코드로 구현합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: In this code talk, you'll instrument an event-driven integration layer with the patterns that contain failure: exponential backoff with jitter, circuit breakers, poison-pill isolation, and replay-from-archive - all live, in code. See how jittered retries prevent thundering herds, how circuit breakers protect healthy services from impaired ones, and how idempotency makes every replay safe. By the end, you'll have hands-on patterns for EventBridge and Step Functions that shrink your blast radius from total outage to graceful degradation.

title: Composing the right orchestration for serverless workflows
title_ko: 서버리스 워크플로를 위한 올바른 오케스트레이션 구성
summary_ko: Step Functions와 Durable Functions를 조합하는 하이브리드 패턴 등 서버리스 오케스트레이션 선택 기준을 다룹니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Both AWS Lambda durable functions and AWS Step Functions handle retries, long-running execution, and failure recovery - so how do you choose? In this session, we cut through the confusion with a clear decision framework across three scenarios: human-in-the-loop approvals, long-running AI agent workflows, and multi-service sagas. We'll also show a hybrid pattern where Durable Functions handle inner business logic while Step Functions orchestrate at the macro level - code-level flexibility inside, visual observability outside. Leave with a practical framework and a real production example to guide your next serverless workflow decision.

title: Orchestrating AI agents with AWS serverless services
title_ko: AWS 서버리스 서비스로 AI 에이전트 오케스트레이션
summary_ko: AWS Step Functions와 Lambda 내구성 함수로 AI 에이전트를 안정적으로 오케스트레이션하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Production AI agents need orchestration that handles non-deterministic behavior, multi-hour workflows, human approvals, and multi-agent coordination. Learn how AWS Step Functions and AWS Lambda durable functions provide the reliability layer that agents demand. We cover patterns for durable execution, human-in-the-loop controls, event-driven agent communication, and the scale-to-zero economics that make serverless the natural home for agentic workloads.

title: Beyond Batch: Modernize with Event-Driven Architecture & Serverless
title_ko: 배치를 넘어: 이벤트 기반 아키텍처와 서버리스로 현대화
summary_ko: 모놀리식 배치 애플리케이션을 이벤트 기반 서버리스 아키텍처로 분해하는 과정을 소그룹 실습으로 진행합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: In this builders' session, transform a batch-oriented data processing pipeline into a real-time, event-driven architecture using Amazon EventBridge, AWS Lambda, and AWS Step Functions. Working hands-on in small groups, you'll decompose a monolithic batch process into discrete event-driven steps, implement file-processing triggers, and design fan-out patterns for parallel execution. Learn when to keep batch and when to go event-driven, and leave with a working modernization pattern. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: Building event-driven architectures in the age of AI agents
title_ko: AI 에이전트 시대의 이벤트 기반 아키텍처 구축
summary_ko: 비결정적 생산자와 다단계 추론을 가진 AI 에이전트를 고려한 이벤트 기반 아키텍처 설계 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Event-driven architectures have powered Serverless applications for a decade. Now AI agents bring non-deterministic producers, multi-step reasoning chains, and agent-to-agent coordination via events. Learn how the patterns you already know, such as queues, events, and retries, evolve when your consumers are autonomous agents rather than just microservices.

title: Duck, Duck, Iceberg: Query Your Lake From Your Laptop (sponsored by Fivetran)
title_ko: Duck, Duck, Iceberg: 노트북에서 데이터 레이크 쿼리하기 (Fivetran 후원)
summary_ko: Fivetran Managed Data Lake로 Iceberg 테이블을 자동 관리하고 DuckDB로 노트북에서 바로 쿼리하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Vendor lock-in and rigid compute options prevent data teams from scaling efficiently, especially with AI agents added to the mix - Apache Iceberg fixes this. Join this session to see how a Fivetran Managed Data Lake automatically ingests data from your sources to open formats and also handles the table maintenance without manual overhead. Your data in your S3 bucket under your ownership. But landing data is just half the story though so we’ll also demonstrate querying the exact same dataset across multiple compute engines to show how open formats let you pair every workload with its ideal cost and performance profile. This presentation is brought to you by Fivetran, an AWS Partner.

title: Where do agents fit? A capability-first approach to agentic AI
title_ko: 에이전트는 어디에 들어맞는가? 에이전틱 AI를 위한 역량 우선 접근법
summary_ko: 비즈니스 역량을 먼저 정의하고 에이전트 적용 지점을 결정하는 역량 우선 에이전틱 AI 아키텍처 방법론을 소개합니다.
abstract: Not every workflow needs an agent, and forcing agentic AI where it doesn't fit adds nondeterminism, cost, and failure modes a deterministic design would have avoided. This chalk talk introduces a capability-first methodology for architects and engineering leaders evaluating agentic paths in their workflows, manual or software-driven. At its core is the scoring framework that scores the inherent nature of the work across key dimensions to reveal where agents genuinely fit. You'll walk away with a repeatable rubric your teams can adopt immediately to decide whether agency is required in your workflows.

title: Where do agents fit? A capability-first approach to agentic AI
title_ko: 에이전트는 어디에 들어맞는가? 에이전틱 AI를 위한 역량 우선 접근법
summary_ko: 비즈니스 역량을 먼저 정의하고 에이전트 적용 지점을 결정하는 역량 우선 에이전틱 AI 아키텍처 방법론을 소개합니다.

title: What SOA taught us about building agents in production
title_ko: SOA가 프로덕션 에이전트 구축에 대해 가르쳐 준 것
summary_ko: 서비스 지향 아키텍처(SOA)의 검증된 패턴을 프로덕션 AI 에이전트 설계에 적용하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: You’ve taken AI agents from prototype to production, and now you own the hard parts: orchestration sprawl, brittle integrations, and behavior hard to test or observe. The patterns that hold up in production look a lot like ones SOA builders already know. This session explores what emerged: multi-agent orchestration mirroring service meshes, tool-use protocols (MCP) formalizing what APIs did for services, evaluation frameworks echoing contract testing, and hard-won lessons about agent observability and trust boundaries. You leave with concrete patterns from the SOA playbook, updated for the agentic era.

title: Architectural patterns for predictable multi-agent costs at scale
title_ko: 대규모 멀티 에이전트 비용을 예측 가능하게 만드는 아키텍처 패턴
summary_ko: 모니터링만으로는 부족한 멀티 에이전트 비용을 토큰 경제성을 고려한 아키텍처 패턴으로 관리하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Agents consume several times more tokens than chat interactions, and multi-agent coordination pushes that higher. Monitoring alone isn't enough to manage costs, token economics must be considered when building agents. In this chalk talk, we'll whiteboard architectural patterns that improve token economics for multi-agent applications, covering orchestration design decisions (orchestrator-subagent, generator-verifier, shared state) and how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore's temporal policies and cost optimization features improve cost-determinism. We'll illustrate these patterns with practical examples, then open the whiteboard for attendees to share their challenges and solutions.

title: Keeping Your Lakehouse Fast: Optimization Methods for Performance & Cost (sponsored by Cloudera)
title_ko: 레이크하우스를 빠르게 유지하기: 성능과 비용 최적화 방법 (Cloudera 후원)
summary_ko: 어려운 과제인 테이블 최적화를 통해 레이크하우스의 성능을 유지하고 비용을 절감하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: A common challenge with large-scale Apache Iceberg tables is keeping performance and costs under control as use and volumes grow. Optimizing tables is the solution, but it’s a tough problem to solve. As data volumes grow, querying effectively requires deliberate tuning and optimization strategies. Streaming ingestion, small files, delete files, aging metadata can gradually increase query latency and costs. In this session, you’ll learn the core optimization techniques that every Iceberg developer should understand, including partitioning, compaction, clustering, cleaning, and data skipping. You'll also learn how these techniques improve query planning and when to apply them. At the end of the session, you’ll see how these best practices can be automated using Cloudera Lakehouse Optimizer to improve performance and reduce costs. This presentation is brought to you by Cloudera, an AWS Partner.

title: Accelerating Fusion Innovation with AMD EPYC on AWS HPC, Analytics, and Agentic AI (sponsored by AMD)
title_ko: AWS HPC, 분석, 에이전틱 AI에서 AMD EPYC로 핵융합 혁신 가속 (AMD 후원)
summary_ko: 시뮬레이션, 데이터 처리, AI 연구 워크플로를 AMD EPYC 기반 AWS에서 통합해 핵융합 연구를 가속한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Learn how Pacific Fusion is leveraging AMD EPYC-powered AWS infrastructure to build a scalable platform for high-performance computing, advanced analytics, and agentic AI. By unifying simulation, data processing, and AI-driven research workflows, Pacific Fusion can accelerate scientific discovery while optimizing cost and resource utilization. Discover how AWS elasticity and AMD EPYC performance enable researchers to rapidly scale from compute-intensive simulations to data-rich analytics and intelligent automation, helping transform scientific data into actionable insights and accelerating the path toward commercially viable fusion energy. This presentation is brought to you by AMD, an AWS Partner.

title: Build deeper into AWS with a traffic layer you own (sponsored by HAProxy Technologies)
title_ko: 직접 소유한 트래픽 레이어로 AWS를 더 깊이 활용하기 (HAProxy Technologies 후원)
summary_ko: 서비스마다 다른 구성과 장애 도메인을 가진 트래픽 계층을 HAProxy로 통합해 직접 제어하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Most teams on AWS accumulate separate systems for load balancing, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and Kubernetes routing. Each brings its own config model and failure domain, another hop in the request path, and a configuration that does not travel. This session makes the case for one layer, on Graviton, benchmarked at over 2 million HTTPS requests per second, with no traffic leaving your VPC for inspection, managed and observed from one control plane. Because that layer runs unchanged in every environment you add, it becomes the one part of your architecture that never has to move. This presentation is brought to you by HAProxy Technologies, an AWS Partner.

title: Powering Agentic AI with Real - Time Market Data Transformation for LSEG (sponsored by AMD)
title_ko: LSEG의 실시간 시장 데이터 변환으로 에이전틱 AI 구현 (AMD 후원)
summary_ko: 5세대 AMD EPYC 기반 Amazon EC2와 AWS Outposts로 LSEG가 AI 준비형 인프라를 현대화한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Traditional 1:4 CPU-to-GPU architectures are evolving as agentic AI increases demand for orchestration, analytics, retrieval, and database processing. Join AWS, AMD, and LSEG to learn how organizations are building AI-ready infrastructure with Amazon EC2 and AWS Outposts powered by 5th Gen AMD EPYC™ processors. Hear how LSEG modernized a 7,500-system estate supporting 120 million financial instruments, achieved sub-4ms latency targets, and accelerated its cloud-native transformation. Discover how customers are improving price-performance, lowering infrastructure costs by more than 30%, and creating a scalable foundation for AI, analytics, and mission-critical workloads. This presentation is brought to you by AMD, an AWS Partner.

title: Make streaming data AI-ready before it goes stale (sponsored by Confluent)
title_ko: 스트리밍 데이터가 오래되기 전에 AI에 활용 가능하게 만들기 (Confluent 후원)
summary_ko: Confluent, IBM, AWS가 스트리밍 데이터를 즉시 AI에 활용할 수 있도록 지원하는 방법을 알아봅니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Real-time data loses value when it gets stuck in pipelines. In this session, learn how Confluent, IBM and AWS are helping make streaming data immediately usable for analytics and AI. See how Confluent Tableflow turns Kafka topics into Apache Iceberg tables and registers them in the AWS Glue Data Catalog—eliminating the need for custom streaming pipelines. Discover how this integration enables data engineers to reduce ingestion complexity, strengthen governance and put real-time data to work for analytics and AI with Amazon Athena. This presentation is brought to you by Confluent, an AWS Partner.

title: From Databases to Agentic AI: Powering Innovation with AMD EPYC on AWS (sponsored by AMD)
title_ko: 데이터베이스에서 에이전틱 AI까지: AWS의 AMD EPYC로 혁신 가속 (AMD 후원)
summary_ko: AMD EPYC 기반 Amazon EC2 인스턴스로 데이터베이스부터 에이전틱 AI까지 다양한 워크로드를 운영하는 고객 사례를 살펴봅니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Today's organizations need infrastructure that can efficiently support everything from mission-critical databases to next-generation AI applications. Join AMD and AWS to explore how customers are leveraging Amazon EC2 instances powered by AMD EPYC processors across Amazon RDS, analytics, Agentic AI, HPC, and cloud-native applications. Learn how AMD-powered AWS infrastructure delivers compelling price-performance, scalability, and operational efficiency while helping organizations accelerate innovation, optimize costs, and meet growing compute demands. This presentation is brought to you by AMD, an AWS Partner.

title: Rethinking the boundary between messaging and streaming
title_ko: 메시징과 스트리밍의 경계 다시 생각하기
summary_ko: 재생, 순서 보장, 고처리량 등 요구가 겹치면서 흐려지는 메시징과 스트리밍의 경계와 선택 기준을 다룹니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Modern event-driven architectures still separate cleanly into "queues" and "streams," but real workloads no longer do. Requirements like replay, ordering, high throughput and more, increasingly appear across both patterns, making the wrong service choice costly to unwind. This session explores the architectural spectrum across messaging and streaming systems, drawing on services such as Amazon SQS, Amazon EventBridge, and Amazon MSK. Throughout the talk we will build a real world architecture and will provide guidance when to choose messaging, streaming or a hybrid approach, and which trade-offs matter most.

title: Building multi-tenant RAG: Isolation, cost, and scale
title_ko: 멀티테넌트 RAG 구축: 격리, 비용, 확장
summary_ko: 수천 테넌트를 지원하는 프로덕션 RAG 아키텍처에서 데이터 격리, 비용, 확장성을 다루는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Customers building multi-tenant RAG platforms must balance tenant data isolation, cost, and operational scale. This chalk talk examines a production architecture serving thousands of tenants on Amazon Bedrock and compares multiple approaches. We whiteboard isolation patterns, tenant routing, per-knowledge-base scaling and limits, managed embedding models, and multimodal document parsing. We will discuss the tradeoffs that determine when to build your own retrieval stack and when to use a fully managed knowledge base.

title: Building multi-tenant RAG: Isolation, cost, and scale
title_ko: 멀티테넌트 RAG 구축: 격리, 비용, 확장
summary_ko: 수천 테넌트를 지원하는 프로덕션 RAG 아키텍처에서 데이터 격리, 비용, 확장성을 다루는 방법을 살펴봅니다.

title: One agent to thousands: Building for scale with Newforma
title_ko: 하나의 에이전트에서 수천 개로: Newforma의 확장 사례
summary_ko: 비결정적인 에이전트에 결정적 거버넌스를 적용하며 대규모로 확장한 Newforma의 경험을 공유합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: When every team builds agents independently, you get the same ungovernable sprawl that drove the shift from artisanal EC2 to container platforms. Agents are non-deterministic workloads that require deterministic governance, and this tension drives every platform decision, from dual orchestration for known vs. emergent topologies, to policy-based boundaries around soft reasoning, to defense layers that compose without coupling. We walk through how Newforma operationalized this architecture on AWS, and attendees leave understanding how to layer orchestration, policy, and defense into an enterprise agent platform that scales safely.

title: The cost of over-engineering: When your architecture fights you
title_ko: 과잉 엔지니어링의 대가: 아키텍처가 발목을 잡을 때
summary_ko: 과도한 분해가 만드는 분산 모놀리스와 이벤트 스파게티 등 과잉 설계의 문제와 해결 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Not every workload needs microservices, event-driven patterns, or serverless. Over-decomposed architectures create distributed monoliths, event spaghetti, and operational nightmares that cost more and move slower than the monolith they replaced. In this chalk talk, examine real-world anti-patterns: services split too small, queues added without purpose, and abstractions that add latency without value. We’ll whiteboard decision frameworks for right-sizing architecture, including the signals that tell you when decomposition earns its complexity and when it doesn’t. Bring your diagrams and discuss where simplification improves speed, reduces cost, and strengthens reliability. Leave able to right-size your own architecture with confidence.

title: The cost of over-engineering: When your architecture fights you
title_ko: 과잉 엔지니어링의 대가: 아키텍처가 발목을 잡을 때
summary_ko: 과도한 분해가 만드는 분산 모놀리스와 이벤트 스파게티 등 과잉 설계의 문제와 해결 방법을 다룹니다.
