title: How Southwest Airlines migrated 4,500 agents in just 2.5 weeks
title_ko: Southwest Airlines는 어떻게 4,500명의 상담원을 단 2.5주 만에 마이그레이션했나
summary_ko: Southwest Airlines가 4,500명 규모 컨택 센터 상담원을 신속히 이전하며 얻은 교훈과 향상된 분석 역량을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: In just 2.5 weeks from decision to go-live, Southwest migrated 4,500 agents across 17 business units to Amazon Connect Customer without losing a single call. Join this session to hear their key lessons learned from the migration, and how the move unlocked more comprehensive analytics capabilities, giving leadership real-time visibility into previously hidden metrics. Discover what’s next for Southwest, including how they’re implementing agentic AI throughout the customer experience.

title: Taking Every Interaction from Mundane to Magic: Agentic CX with Connect Customer
title_ko: 모든 상호작용을 평범함에서 마법으로: Connect Customer로 구현하는 에이전틱 CX
summary_ko: Amazon Connect Customer 부사장과 U.S. Bank 경영진이 에이전틱 AI로 고객 경험을 혁신하는 가능성과 실제 사례를 보여줍니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: Every brand is racing to put AI in front of its customers, the biggest opportunity in a generation, but also a risk. In 2026, deflection is dead. Even the customers you help are quietly leaving, because being processed isn't the same as being known. In this session, the VP, Amazon Connect Customer, and SVP, Client Operations Technology, U.S. Bank, show what's possible when serving customers is AI-first by design: your brand shows up before they ask, and every customer feels like your only customer. If you own the customer relationship, this is the one session you can't afford to miss.

title: How PulsedIn Scaled Hiring with Amazon Connect Talent
title_ko: PulsedIn은 Amazon Connect Talent로 어떻게 채용을 확장했나
summary_ko: 채용 비용을 늘리지 않고 증가하는 채용 수요를 감당하기 위해 PulsedIn이 Amazon Connect Talent를 활용한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: What if companies could meet growing hiring demands without increasing recruiting costs? PulsedIn faced a critical challenge: growing demand for nurses, limited recruiting capacity, and candidates who often worked outside traditional business hours. Using Amazon Connect Talent, PulsedIn is bringing AI-led interviews to healthcare recruiting, giving candidates the flexibility to interview on their own schedules while helping recruiters manage growing hiring demand. This approach aims to remove hiring bottlenecks, increase recruiting capacity, and support business growth without adding recruiters at the same rate. Hear directly from PulsedIn’s leadership about why they chose Amazon Connect Talent, how it's transforming their recruiting process, and what they've learned along the way.

title: AgentX: Agentic customer service transformation (sponsored by Capgemini) (BIZ104-S)
title_ko: AgentX: 에이전틱 고객 서비스 혁신 (후원: Capgemini)
summary_ko: Bayer와 Capgemini가 고객 중심·비즈니스 주도 방식으로 상담원과 관리자에게 가치를 주는 에이전틱 고객 서비스를 구축한 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Capgemini and Bayer developed AgentX, an AWS-native agentic AI solution that empowers customer service agents with GenAI insights and turns customer interactions into actionable business intelligence. AgentX combines knowledge retrieval, real-time agent assistance, automated summaries, governance controls, predictive analytics, and AI-enabled workflows with human oversight. It helps agents work faster and more consistently, supporting higher-quality interactions and a better customer experience. Built using Amazon Connect, Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda and other AWS services, AgentX provides a reusable, scalable foundation for AI-enabled customer service. Discover how Bayer and Capgemini use a customer-centric, business-driven approach to create value for agents, supervisors and business leaders. This presentation is brought to you by Capgemini, an AWS Partner.

title: Shaping the Future of Guest Support at lululemon with an AI-powered experience
title_ko: AI 기반 경험으로 만드는 lululemon 고객 지원의 미래
summary_ko: lululemon이 기존 운영 개선을 넘어 AI 기반으로 미래형 게스트 지원 경험을 설계한 과정을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: What if you could design Guest Support for the future, not just improve the operation you have today? At lululemon, that question shifted the conversation. Rather than patching together fragmented tools and manual planning processes, the team envisioned the experience they wanted to create for guests and their people, then worked backward to build it. The result was a unified, AI-powered experience launched globally, giving employees more time to build meaningful connections with guests. This session explores how lululemon built a fundamentally different future for Guest Support and the principles leaders can use to do the same at their organization.

title: How Flybuys Cut Costs by 24% and Scaled AI Agents Across 10M Members
title_ko: Flybuys는 어떻게 비용을 24% 줄이고 1,000만 회원에게 AI 에이전트를 확장했나
summary_ko: Flybuys가 회원 경험을 장악하고 모든 상호작용의 가시성을 확보하며 비용 절감과 AI 에이전트 확장을 이룬 과정을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: 10 million members. Limited visibility into support interactions. High costs. Flybuys needed a new path. In 7 months, they migrated to Amazon Connect Customer, bringing operations in-house, and deploying AI agents that now handle 100% of member interactions. The result of the migration has been a 24% cost reduction while improving customer satisfaction. Join this session to hear how Flybuys took control of their member experience, unlocked deep visibility across every interaction, and are now moving quickly to scale agentic AI across voice and digital channels.

title: How EchoStar Turned CX and IT Into One Team to Ship AI Experiences
title_ko: EchoStar는 어떻게 CX와 IT를 한 팀으로 만들어 AI 경험을 출시했나
summary_ko: DISH의 모회사 EchoStar가 대화형 AI 도입을 조직 혁신의 기회로 삼아 CX와 IT 조직을 통합한 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Most companies treat conversational AI as a technology rollout. EchoStar, the company behind DISH, treated it as a chance to reset how CX and IT work together. Instead of handing specs back and forth, the two teams now build side by side in Amazon Connect Customer, shaping and testing each experience before it goes live. CX owns the customer experience. IT owns data, security, and standards. Changes that took six to eight weeks now ship in about one week - roughly 6× faster. Hear from Echostar's CX and IT leaders on how they transformed their operating model, and leave with a framework to start the same shift.

title: Customer Care Reimagined: How a leading bank connects AI end to end
title_ko: 고객 관리의 재구상: 선도 은행은 어떻게 AI를 엔드투엔드로 연결하나
summary_ko: 한 선도 은행이 고립된 AI 도입 대신 고객 여정 전체에 AI를 연결해 고객 관리를 재구상한 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Discover how a leading bank is reimagining Customer Care by connecting AI across the end-to-end journey. Instead of isolated pilots, they built joined-up capabilities on Amazon Connect Customer and Amazon Bedrock, delivered as incremental releases with governance from day one. Hear how four AI capabilities, from real-time colleague assistance to automated coaching across 100% of interactions, are already live and making a measurable difference for colleagues and customers. We will share the reusable architecture, lessons learned, and what comes next as these capabilities reach customer-facing journeys.

title: Citizens Bank: Building AI-Native CX from Vision to Production
title_ko: Citizens Bank: 비전에서 프로덕션까지 AI 네이티브 CX 구축하기
summary_ko: Citizens Bank 사례를 통해 금융기관이 Amazon Connect Customer로 에이전틱 고객 경험을 설계하고 운영에 적용하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Orange Theater
abstract: Financial services customers expect fast, personalized service, but compliance, security, and regulatory requirements make automation a high-stakes challenge. Discover how Amazon Connect Customer enables financial institutions to design agentic customer experiences, where AI self-service blends autonomous reasoning with deterministic guardrails for identity verification, fraud checks, and regulatory disclosures. Learn how business teams, not only engineers, build and refine these experiences, automating complex interactions like account servicing, disputes, and payments while maintaining full compliance and governance. See how Citizens Bank lifted containment by 30 points, elevated CSAT, and transformed their contact center without compromising trust.

title: Uncover the Opportunity. Build the AI Agent. Scale It Live. (sponsored by NiCE)
title_ko: 기회를 발견하고, AI 에이전트를 만들고, 실시간으로 확장하라 (후원: NiCE)
summary_ko: CX 데이터에서 에이전틱 분석으로 자동화 효과가 큰 지점을 찾아내고 AI 에이전트로 구현·확장하는 과정을 시연합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Your CX data already knows where automation will pay off. See Agentic Analytics pinpoint the opportunity, then watch that recommendation become a working AI agent — built, tested, and scaled live. ​ This presentation is brought to you by NiCE, an AWS Partner.

title: Build the Agentic Workplace: What's New on the Slack Developer Platform (sponsored by Salesforce)
title_ko: 에이전틱 워크플레이스 구축: Slack 개발자 플랫폼의 새로운 기능 (후원: Salesforce)
summary_ko: 사람과 AI 에이전트가 함께 일하는 업무 운영체제로 진화하는 Slack 개발자 플랫폼의 신기능을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Slack is becoming a multiplayer work operating system, where humans and AI agents build together, not just chat. This session shows AWS developers how to ship on the modern Slack Platform: Code Channels, a new space where agents like Claude Code, Devin, and Cursor collaborate with teams in real time; the Slack Agent Kit for building first-class agents; deep bidirectional MCP support, including the Slackbot MCP Client; Real-Time Search (RTS) for grounding agents in live workspace context; and Block Kit for rich, interactive UI. Leave with a clear path to build your first agentic app on Slack. This presentation is brought to you by Salesforce, an AWS Partner.

title: From Zero to 20,000 Desktops: Getting Started with Amazon Quick
title_ko: 데스크톱 0대에서 20,000대로: Amazon Quick 시작하기
summary_ko: 한 기업이 Amazon Quick 도입에 투자한 이유와 기존 업무를 방해하지 않고 AI를 일상 워크플로에 통합한 방법을 공유합니다.
abstract: Your team is drowning in context-switching: toggling between email, documents, data tools, and chat just to complete a single task. Productivity tools promise to help, but most add complexity instead of removing it. In this fireside chat, hear from customers who faced that exact challenge and deployed an AI work companion across 20,000+ users in under 90 days. Learn what convinced their leadership to invest, how they integrated AI into daily workflows without disrupting existing tools, and what the first 90 days of adoption actually looked like. Walk away with a practical roadmap for bringing Amazon Quick AI assistant to your workforce at scale.

title: Getting Started with Amazon Quick: How a Customer Went from Curious to Deployed
title_ko: Amazon Quick 시작하기: 한 고객이 관심 단계에서 배포까지 간 과정
summary_ko: 한 고객이 Amazon Quick을 조직 전반의 일상 업무에 도입한 사례와 실제 동작하는 모습을 라이브로 보여줍니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Your team spends hours on work that should take minutes: summarizing meetings, drafting documents, finding answers buried across systems, pulling data from multiple platforms. You know AI should help, but you need to see it work in a real environment before you commit. In this session, see how a customer put Amazon Quick into daily workflows across their organization and watch live as it composes documents, analyzes data, summarizes conversations, and connects to enterprise systems. Hear what problems they were solving, what changed for their teams after deployment, and what surprised them about adoption. Leave with a clear picture of the problems Quick solves and how to evaluate whether it fits your organization.

title: What's New in Amazon Connect Customer
title_ko: Amazon Connect Customer의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 사일로화된 시스템과 분산된 데이터를 넘어 하나의 고객 여정을 제공하는 Amazon Connect Customer의 최신 기능을 소개합니다.
abstract: Your customers don't experience departments — they experience one journey. But siloed systems, fragmented data, and manual processes between teams create gaps they absolutely feel. This session introduces new Amazon Connect Customer capabilities that close those gaps end to end. Come see how these capabilities work together to deliver the seamless experience your customers expect and the certainty your business demands.

title: Agentic Integration: How AI Agents Replace Static CRM Connectors
title_ko: 에이전틱 통합: AI 에이전트는 어떻게 정적 CRM 커넥터를 대체하나
summary_ko: MCP 기반 Amazon Connect Customer가 정적인 CRM 커넥터 대신 AI 에이전트 중심으로 통합 방식을 바꾸는 방법을 다루는 칠크 토크입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan I
abstract: Every enterprise has dozens of integrations connecting their CRM, ticketing, and backend systems to their customer experience platform, and every one of them is static, brittle, and expensive to maintain. In this chalk talk, we explore how Amazon Connect Customer, powered by Model Context Protocol (MCP), shifts integration from point-to-point connectors to intelligent, agentic orchestration. The AI agent reasons across multiple systems in real time, assembling unified customer context that no single system holds alone. We whiteboard the architecture: how MCP connections work, how each new system compounds the intelligence available to every interaction, and how to evaluate which integrations to migrate first. Bring your integration pain (Salesforce, ServiceNow, homegrown systems) and we'll design the agentic alternative on the whiteboard.

title: Agentic Integration: How AI Agents Replace Static CRM Connectors
title_ko: 에이전틱 통합: AI 에이전트는 어떻게 정적 CRM 커넥터를 대체하나
summary_ko: MCP 기반 Amazon Connect Customer가 정적인 CRM 커넥터 대신 AI 에이전트 중심으로 통합 방식을 바꾸는 방법을 다루는 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: Every enterprise has dozens of integrations connecting their CRM, ticketing, and backend systems to their customer experience platform, and every one of them is static, brittle, and expensive to maintain. In this chalk talk, we explore how Amazon Connect Customer, powered by Model Context Protocol (MCP), shifts integration from point-to-point connectors to intelligent, agentic orchestration. The AI agent reasons across multiple systems in real time, assembling unified customer context that no single system holds alone. We whiteboard the architecture: how MCP connections work, how each new system compounds the intelligence available to every interaction, and how to evaluate which integrations to migrate first. Bring your integration pain (Salesforce, ServiceNow, homegrown systems) and we'll design the agentic alternative on the whiteboard.

title: Trust at Scale: Unlocking Enterprise Agentic AI (sponsored by Qlik)
title_ko: 대규모 신뢰: 엔터프라이즈 에이전틱 AI의 잠재력 열기 (후원: Qlik)
summary_ko: 기업이 신뢰, 거버넌스, 선택권을 희생하지 않고 에이전틱 AI를 확장하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Agentic AI dies at scale. It is easy to get one agent working on one dataset for one team. The challenge is trusting its answers across hundreds of thousands of users, regions, languages, regulators, and constantly changing data. AWS provides global infrastructure, security, data residency, and compliance controls to scale AI. Qlik provides trusted governed data, business context, and intelligence that agents can rely on. See how Amazon Bedrock and the Qlik MCP Server bring trusted Qlik intelligence to production agents and any LLM including Amazon Quick. Learn how enterprises can scale agentic AI without sacrificing trust governance or choice. This presentation is brought to you by Qlik, an AWS Partner.

title: Stop building agents that stop short of enterprise execution (sponsored by IBM)
title_ko: 엔터프라이즈 실행까지 가지 못하는 에이전트는 그만 만드세요 (후원: IBM)
summary_ko: IBM Bob과 watsonx Orchestrate로 에이전틱 AI 기반 애플리케이션 개발·현대화와 엔터프라이즈 실행을 구현하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: AI value doesn’t come from creating more agents. It comes from putting agents to work—securely, reliably, and across the systems where business gets done. In this session, see how IBM Bob helps developers build and modernize applications with agentic AI, while watsonx Orchestrate coordinates agents, tools, and workflows across the enterprise. Discover how IBM helps teams move from code and intent to governed action—with the visibility and control needed to scale.​ This presentation is brought to you by IBM, an AWS Partner.

title: Self-Healing Enterprise-Wipro & AWS Moving from System of Record to System of Action (sponsored by Wipro)
title_ko: 자가 치유 엔터프라이즈: Wipro와 AWS가 기록 시스템에서 실행 시스템으로 전환하기 (후원: Wipro)
summary_ko: 장애나 변화에 스스로 대응하는 실행 시스템으로 전환하기 위한 Wipro와 AWS의 자가 치유 엔터프라이즈 접근법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: For decades, enterprises have invested in technologies that digitize, automate and optimize work. Yet when disruptions occur, decisions still depend on emails, escalations, meetings and manual coordination across teams. The next phase of enterprise transformation is about creating enterprises that can sense change, assess impact, coordinate responses and drive outcomes at speed. Wipro and AWS demonstrate how intelligent agents, enterprise systems and human expertise come together to create a Self-Healing Enterprise, one that can proactively identify issues, orchestrate actions across functions and continuously adapt while keeping humans accountable for critical business decisions. Through a realistic business disruption scenario, see how organizations can evolve beyond visibility and automation towards systems of action that improve resilience, responsiveness and operational efficiency. This presentation is brought to you by Wipro, an AWS Partner.

title: MCP is Just An MVP. Context Layers Are The Sequel. (sponsored by Atolio)
title_ko: MCP는 MVP일 뿐, 컨텍스트 레이어가 그 후속편이다 (후원: Atolio)
summary_ko: MCP만으로는 부족한 대규모 에이전트-시스템 연결을 컨텍스트 레이어로 확장 가능하게 운영하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: MCP lets agents connect to systems. It's a minimum viable product, not a complete way to run that connection at scale. Raw database access hit the same wall decades ago, before warehouses and data lakes brought structure and governance at scale. Point-to-point agent connections hit it again: costs climb with every added tool call, latency stacks with every cross-system hop, and permissions rarely travel with retrieved data, making synthesized knowledge a sharper security risk than raw SQL ever posed. This session traces that history, breaks down each failure mode, and maps what a sovereign context layer built for agents solves. This presentation is brought to you by Atolio, an AWS Partner.

title: Beyond Evals: Setting up your agents and your enterprise for success (sponsored by LangChain)
title_ko: 평가를 넘어서: 에이전트와 기업의 성공을 위한 준비 (후원: LangChain)
summary_ko: LangChain 내부와 현장에서 관찰한 에이전트 평가 모범 사례를 분석하고 에이전트를 성공적으로 운영하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: We are witnessing models and agents continually becoming more capable, all while the process of meaningfully evaluating them continues to be a challenge. In this session, we will dissect eval best practices observed both in the field and internally at LangChain. This session will go beyond just your technical evaluation toolkit and provide practical organizational and process takeaways and a better understanding of what future capabilities are unlocked downstream of good evaluation. This session will be especially relevant to teams deploying agents in cross-functional domains. This presentation is brought to you by LangChain, an AWS Partner.

title: Building AI Agents with Vercel and AWS (sponsored by Vercel)
title_ko: Vercel과 AWS로 AI 에이전트 구축하기 (후원: Vercel)
summary_ko: Vercel과 AWS를 함께 활용해 AI 에이전트를 개발하고 배포하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: This session explores how Vercel and AWS work together to support the development and deployment of AI agents. You’ll learn about first party connectivity to AWS databases and services through the Vercel Marketplace, along with the backend capabilities agents need, including APIs, durable workflows, queues, cron jobs, and MCP servers. You’ll see how these building blocks, together with the EVE framework, can simplify agent development, followed by a live demo showing how to build an agent using Vercel and AWS. This presentation is brought to you by Vercel, an AWS Partner.

title: Keep sleeping at 3am: Elastic watches your Prometheus metrics so you don't have to (sponsored by Elastic)
title_ko: 새벽 3시에도 푹 주무세요: Elastic이 Prometheus 메트릭을 대신 지켜봅니다 (후원: Elastic)
summary_ko: 자율형 AI SRE인 Elastic Nightshift가 실제 Kubernetes 장애를 탐지하고 해결하는 과정을 시연합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: When your kubernetes cluster fires at 3am, who's investigating? In this session we'll show Elastic Nightshift — our autonomous AI SRE — detecting a real Kubernetes incident and working it end to end: from alert to root cause to remediation, with its reasoning made transparent at every step. Nightshift draws on native Prometheus and PromQL metrics in Elastic. Kubernetes logs, out-of-the-box EKS dashboards and workflows, and ES|QL subqueries that correlate metrics with logs and traces in a single investigation. We'll also show how the 30x faster columnar metrics engine and full telemetry retention give Nightshift the complete context it needs to work like your best engineer This presentation is brought to you by Elastic, an AWS Partner.

title: Connect Decisions Fireside Chat: Samsung and TE Connectivity on agentic supply chains
title_ko: Connect Decisions 노변담화: Samsung과 TE Connectivity가 말하는 에이전틱 공급망
summary_ko: Samsung과 TE Connectivity가 에이전틱 AI로 공급망 중단을 예방하고 신속히 해결하는 경험을 대담 형식으로 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Only 25% of organizations feel ready to prevent disruptions, and 85% take two weeks or more to resolve urgent ones. In this fireside chat, supply chain leaders from Samsung and TE Connectivity join AWS to discuss the challenges enterprises face across industries such as automotive and consumer electronics manufacturing. Samsung plans demand across hundreds of thousands of product and market combinations every week. Hear how Connect Decisions AI agents take on the planning work itself, reasoning across sales history, market signals and product relationships to make and explain decisions at that scale. TE Connectivity will share how Connect Decisions AI agents works across 200,000 SKUs to surface stockouts and cash tied up in inventory that its ERP does not see. Get a firsthand view of what it takes, hurdles included, and walk away with a practical path forward.

title: Deploy AI planning teammates without changing how your team works
title_ko: 팀의 일하는 방식을 바꾸지 않고 AI 계획 팀원 배치하기
summary_ko: 기존 업무 방식을 바꾸지 않고 AI 팀원이 팀의 계획 업무 흐름에 자연스럽게 녹아드는 접근법을 시연합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Most planning tools force your team to change how they work. See the opposite approach. Watch AI teammates plug into the workflows your planners already follow, connect to the systems you already run, and improve as they learn your business. You will see a live product walkthrough, learn where AI takes work off your team's plate, and leave with a clear picture of how to add planning capacity without retraining people or rebuilding your stack.

title: You cannot write the eval for a failure you have not seen yet (sponsored by Arize AI)
title_ko: 아직 보지 못한 실패에 대한 평가는 작성할 수 없다 (후원: Arize AI)
summary_ko: LLM-as-a-judge의 한계를 넘어 예상하지 못한 에이전트 실패를 발견하고 평가하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: LLM-as-a-judge works beautifully when you already know what you're looking for. You write the rubric, validate it against human labels, and it catches the failure you designed it to catch. But agents in production don't fail the way you anticipated. They fail as they meet new tools, new users, and environments that shifted underneath them, and every new failure arrives after the rubric was written. This talk argues the evaluation layer itself must become agentic. Instead of specifying a metric, you describe the behavior you want, and a judge with tool access inspects the trace, finds the spans that matter, classifies what went wrong, and generates labels you can monitor against. We'll cover why this became viable only recently, where it fails, and how to keep an agentic judge honest against human labels, so you know when to reach for one and how to validate it. This presentation is brought to you by Arize AI, an AWS Partner.

title: Engineering AI Agents You Can Trust in Production (sponsored by Workato)
title_ko: 프로덕션에서 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 에이전트 엔지니어링 (후원: Workato)
summary_ko: 데모에선 잘 되지만 프로덕션에서 실패하는 에이전트의 원인을 짚고 신뢰할 수 있는 에이전트를 구축하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Your agent nails the demo, then breaks in production. More often than not, the model isn't what failed, it's everything around it. We'll walk through a methodology for making agent actions reliable, recoverable, and observable in production. You'll leave with patterns you can build yourself, drawn from lessons learned over 100+ enterprise MCP deployments. This presentation is brought to you by Workato, an AWS Partner.

title: Accelerating AI adoption and realized value with Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick으로 AI 도입과 실질적 가치 실현 가속화하기
summary_ko: 경영진 후원이 AI 도입에 미친 변화와 리더들이 얻은 속도·집중력, 그리고 같은 추진력을 만드는 방법을 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Most AI investments stall because leaders hand off adoption instead of leading it. 3M did the opposite. It put Amazon Quick in the hands of its top 75 executives first, so the people who set strategy saw the value before they asked their teams to adopt it. With governed access to enterprise data, senior leaders now use Quick to make decisions faster, bring their teams onto shared workflows and turn AI from a personal tool into a team-wide advantage. Learn what executive sponsorship changed, what leaders gained in speed and focus and how to build the same momentum in your organization.

title: Empowering 155,000 people without compromising trust: Amazon Quick
title_ko: 신뢰를 훼손하지 않고 155,000명에게 힘을 실어주기: Amazon Quick
summary_ko: Allianz가 승인 절차를 거쳐 6주 만에 Amazon Quick 도입을 확정하고 대규모로 확산한 과정을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Allianz needed to empower 155,000 employees with AI without sacrificing trust. With operations across dozens of regulated markets, the security, privacy, and works council requirements were non-negotiable. Every stakeholder asked the same question: how do you move fast and still earn the trust of those guarding your company's security? Hear how Allianz partnered with AWS to deploy the capabilities that make Amazon Quick enterprise-ready: protection of confidential information, structured approval workflows for agentic actions, custom branding per business unit, and multi-language support. Learn how Allianz navigated the full approval process and moved from "not yet" to "go" in six weeks.

title: From Pilot to Enterprise Scale with Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick으로 파일럿에서 엔터프라이즈 규모까지
summary_ko: 기존 엔터프라이즈 시스템 통합의 과제와 Amazon Quick 도입을 지속적으로 확산하기 위한 활동을 공유합니다.
abstract: EchoStar evaluated 11 AI assistants before selecting Amazon Quick, which was then deployed to 8,000 employees with training and pre-populated skills. Next in EchoStar’s plans are integrating Quick with a third party gateways for observability and governance. Come and hear how this was done, uptake and innovations improving the efficiency of employees and teams. Discover some of the challenges integrating into existing enterprise systems, the continued activities needed to keep advancing high value usage and what are the appropriate metrics to track. Walk away with a repeatable framework for taking Amazon Quick from pilot to production and enterprise efficiency.

title: AI Assistant for Public Sector: Governance Without Compromise with Amazon Quick
title_ko: 공공 부문을 위한 AI 어시스턴트: Amazon Quick으로 타협 없는 거버넌스
summary_ko: 기존 솔루션의 한계와 Amazon Quick의 기본 거버넌스 모델이 별도 개발 없이 공공 부문 요건을 충족한 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Orange Theater
abstract: Public sector organizations serve diverse populations with strict boundaries: students and administrators, citizens and case workers, patients and providers. They need AI that works across these groups without compromising data isolation, compliance, or governance. Multi-tenant environments demand security frameworks most AI assistants were not built to meet. Hear from a higher education customer who faced these constraints and displaced their incumbent tool in favor of Amazon Quick's governance-first architecture: tenant-level data isolation, role-based access controls across distinct user populations, and compliance frameworks built for regulated environments. Learn why existing solutions fell short, how Quick's native governance model met their requirements without custom engineering, and what the transition looked like from decision to deployment.

title: One AI Assistant, Every Data Source: Unifying Access with Amazon Quick
title_ko: 하나의 AI 어시스턴트로 모든 데이터 소스를: Amazon Quick으로 접근 통합하기
summary_ko: Amazon Quick으로 여러 데이터 소스를 통합 구성한 방법과 팀의 도입 과정, 의사결정 속도와 품질의 변화를 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Your data lives in one platform. Your reports live in another. Your documents live somewhere else. Every time someone needs an answer, they spend time figuring out where to look before they can act. Decisions slow down. Teams duplicate work because they cannot find what already exists. New employees take months to become productive because institutional knowledge is trapped in systems they do not know how to navigate. Hear from a customer who solved this by giving their team a single AI assistant that connects across all their enterprise systems. Instead of training people on where to find information, they ask Amazon Quick and get answers grounded in their real business data, regardless of where it lives. Learn how they configured the integration, how their teams adopted it, and what changed about the speed and quality of decision-making across the organization.

title: From AI Tasks to Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflows with Amazon Quick
title_ko: AI 작업에서 자율 멀티 에이전트 워크플로까지 Amazon Quick으로
summary_ko: 먼저 자동화할 워크플로를 선정하고 컴플라이언스를 충족하는 에이전트 간 핸드오프를 설계한 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: The workflows that matter most in financial services span multiple systems, require multiple types of expertise, and today rely on people as the coordination layer. One person pulls data, another reviews it for compliance, a third routes it for approval. That coordination tax is where your team's time disappears. Amazon Quick changes that equation. Instead of one AI assistant doing one task, specialized agents each handle their piece and hand off to the next automatically. The human stays in the loop for judgment calls, not for data gathering and routing. Hear from a customer who moved from standalone AI use cases to compound, multi-agent workflows with Amazon Quick. Learn how they identified which workflows to orchestrate first, how they designed agent handoffs that satisfy compliance, and what it means now that the coordination layer runs autonomously.

title: How a Brand Turned AI Governance Into a Strategic Advantage with Amazon Quick
title_ko: 한 브랜드는 어떻게 Amazon Quick으로 AI 거버넌스를 전략적 강점으로 바꿨나
summary_ko: 정책보다 빠른 직원들의 AI 도입 속에서 거버넌스를 확장의 걸림돌이 아닌 전략적 강점으로 만든 사례를 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: AI adoption rarely waits for governance. When employees adopt AI faster than policy keeps pace, scale becomes a liability. Cox Automotive, the world’s largest automotive services and technology provider and home to brands including Autotrader, Kelley Blue Book, Manheim, vAuto and Dealertrack, defined a governance strategy to empower adoption. Hear how Cox Auto alongside AWS is building an agentic control plane spanning agent identity, ownership, security, cost accountability and more – and why Amazon Quick fit the everyday AI needs of its 29,000 person workforce. Leave with a practical seven pillar framework that simplifies safe and smart adoption in the enterprise.

title: Your Business Is Multiplayer. Your AI Should Be Too. (sponsored by PromptQL)
title_ko: 비즈니스는 멀티플레이어, AI도 그래야 합니다 (후원: PromptQL)
summary_ko: 한 사람과만 일하는 AI를 넘어 팀, 파트너, 이해관계자와 함께 협업하는 멀티플레이어 AI를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Your company runs on a network of teams, partners and stakeholders. Yet most AI works with one person at a time and forgets everything between sessions, so the work and the context stay trapped in private chats. This session introduces a different model: multiplayer AI built on shared context. When teams and their AI draw on one governed, continuously updated source of organizational knowledge, work moves across people without starting over, answers stay consistent, and each person's permissions are respected. Come see what it takes to make your AI as multiplayer as your business already is.

title: Build and Ship an AI-Powered App with Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick으로 AI 기반 앱 만들고 배포하기
summary_ko: 실습형 빌더 세션에서 Amazon Quick을 사용해 완전히 동작하는 애플리케이션을 설계, 반복 개선, 게시합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Builders' Session
abstract: In this hands-on builder session, you'll use Amazon Quick to design, iterate on, and publish a fully functional application through natural-language conversation. You'll connect to a live data source (pre-provisioned via MCP), shape your app interactively with generative AI, persist state across users, and publish something your team or customers can use immediately. Whether you're accelerating decision-making, automating operational workflows, or putting insights directly in the hands of end users, this session shows how Quick Apps collapses the gap between having an idea and shipping a solution. Bring your laptop and be ready to build.

title: Embed Amazon Quick Chat Agents in Enterprise Applications
title_ko: 엔터프라이즈 애플리케이션에 Amazon Quick 채팅 에이전트 임베드하기
summary_ko: Amazon Quick 에이전트와 대시보드를 엔터프라이즈 앱에 임베드하는 완전 서버리스 프로덕션 솔루션을 배포합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Builders' Session
abstract: Deploy a fully serverless, production-ready solution that embeds Amazon Quick agents and dashboards into your enterprise web applications. Using AWS CDK, configure Amazon Cognito OAuth 2.0 authentication, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, and WAF to create a secure embedding architecture. Implement the Quick Embedding SDK, configure domain security and token validation, and deploy a working chat agent accessible from any enterprise application — turning Quick into the conversational AI layer that meets users where they already work.

title: One Context Layer, Every Surface: Enterprise Knowledge for Agents That Work Anywhere
title_ko: 하나의 컨텍스트 레이어, 모든 접점: 어디서나 작동하는 에이전트를 위한 엔터프라이즈 지식
summary_ko: 엔터프라이즈 지식을 통합 인덱스로 연결하는 컨텍스트 레이어를 처음부터 설계하는 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: Your AI agents are only as smart as the data they can reach. In most enterprises, that data is scattered across dozens of systems, siloed, ungoverned, and invisible to the agents that need it most. In this chalk talk, we architect a context layer from the ground up: connecting enterprise knowledge into a unified index, then enriching that foundation with a knowledge graph that maps organizational relationships, business rules, and domain context, giving agents permission-scoped, relationship-aware intelligence at runtime. Then we take that intelligence to where users work: browser, desktop, mobile, collaboration tools, and productivity suites. Each surface independently governed yet sharing one agent identity, one memory, and one set of guardrails. Bring your architecture. We'll whiteboard the end-to-end path together.

title: Building & Governing Apps on Quick
title_ko: Quick에서 앱 구축 및 거버넌스
summary_ko: 문장 하나로 앱을 만드는 시대에 생성된 앱을 거버넌스하고 적절한 사용자에게 배포하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Anyone can generate apps from a sentence - the hard part is governing them and getting them in front of the right users. This chalk talk whiteboards the full lifecycle of Amazon Quick Apps: building them from natural language with no separate hosting, wiring in data and actions through MCP, and the three sharing paths - private, public URLs, and enterprise sharing gated behind admin approval workflows.

title: Security → Zero-Trust Identity & Data Protection in Amazon Quick
title_ko: 보안 → Amazon Quick의 제로 트러스트 ID 및 데이터 보호
summary_ko: AI 도입을 가로막는 보안 검토를 넘기 위해 Amazon Quick의 제로 트러스트 ID와 데이터 보호 체계를 심층적으로 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan I
abstract: Security reviews stall AI rollouts more than any capability gap, and agentic AI raises the bar. This chalk talk goes past "is it secure?" to the architecture that gets a CISO to yes for Amazon Quick. We'll whiteboard the full identity path in Quick: SSO through providers like Okta and Ping, with end-user identity propagated to the data so authorization is enforced per user, in real time, across 1P AWS and 3P sources. Then we extend that trust to Quick agents: agent identity, deterministic policy checks on every tool call, and data protection, including Purview DLP, default guardrails, deny-by-default, and full SIEM auditability.

title: Bring Your Own Ontology: Ground Amazon Quick in Enterprise Knowledge with AWS Context
title_ko: 자체 온톨로지 가져오기: AWS Context로 Amazon Quick을 엔터프라이즈 지식에 연결하기
summary_ko: 지식 그래프와 통합해 Amazon Quick이 기업 고유의 컨텍스트에 근거해 답하도록 만드는 방법을 보여줍니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan I
abstract: Enterprise questions rarely have answers in a single document. Your business runs on connections — customers to products, teams to processes, risks to regulations — but vector search doesn't see any of that. In this chalk talk, we show how to ground Amazon Quick in your enterprise context by integrating it with a knowledge graph built from your domain knowledge. We'll walk through how we built this pattern using GraphRAG for real customers and the results they achieved. Then we'll open the whiteboard — bring your toughest use case and we'll sketch your ontology live, showing how Quick would traverse it to deliver dramatically better answers.

title: Architect AI-powered analytics with Amazon Quick across your data platforms
title_ko: 데이터 플랫폼 전반에서 Amazon Quick으로 AI 기반 분석 아키텍처 설계하기
summary_ko: Amazon Quick을 정형 데이터 소스 및 데이터 플랫폼과 연결하는 아키텍처 패턴을 다이어그램으로 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan III
abstract: As organizations adopt AI-powered analytics, they need architectures that connect BI and conversational AI experiences to their existing data platforms. In this session we'll diagram architectural patterns for connecting Amazon Quick to structured data sources and integrating with third-party catalogs and semantic layers. We'll compare the available connectivity approaches, including data sources and MCP-based action connectors, and discuss when to use each. Considerations will span production use cases like BI dashboards, embedded analytics, text-to-SQL Q&A, and agentic workflows. Together we'll tackle real-world integration challenges including authentication, performance optimization, and governance. This session is ideal for architects and technical leaders looking to build AI-powered analytics across their data platforms.

title: Secure and Scalable Multi-Tenant Deployment Patterns for Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick을 위한 안전하고 확장 가능한 멀티 테넌트 배포 패턴
summary_ko: 사업부, 자회사, 파트너 생태계로 Amazon Quick을 확산할 때 필요한 안전하고 확장 가능한 멀티 테넌트 배포 패턴을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan III
abstract: As organizations scale their adoption of Amazon Quick across business units, subsidiaries, and partner ecosystems, deploying a secure multi-tenant architecture becomes critical. This chalk talk explores proven deployment patterns that balance tenant isolation, governance, and operational efficiency when rolling out Amazon Quick at enterprise scale. We will walk through two primary isolation strategies: multi-account separation using AWS Organizations for environment-level boundaries (dev/staging/prod), and namespace-based logical isolation within a single account for user-cohort segmentation.

title: Build production agent skills on Amazon Quick: automate your own work
title_ko: Amazon Quick에서 프로덕션 에이전트 스킬 구축: 내 업무 자동화하기
summary_ko: AI 지원을 받아 스킬을 처음부터 작성하고 엔지니어링 관행을 적용해 Amazon Quick에서 프로덕션 스킬을 구축합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano I
abstract: Agent skills turn repeatable work into instructions an agent carries out reliably. In this hands-on workshop, you build production skills on Amazon Quick. You author skills from scratch with AI-powered assistance and apply engineering best practices as you build. You put your agents and skills to work automating real business use cases, measure the impact of what you built, and leave able to build and refine skills and agents that automate your own work.

title: Build AI-Powered Analytics with Conversational BI on Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick의 대화형 BI로 AI 기반 분석 구축하기
summary_ko: 데이터 수집부터 대화형 소비까지 Amazon Quick으로 완전한 AI 기반 분석 파이프라인을 직접 구성합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano IV
abstract: Construct a complete AI-powered analytics pipeline, from data ingestion to conversational consumption. Use Amazon Quick's Data Catalog to discover data, query it live without moving it into SPICE, then enrich and import metadata with semantics inherited to build natural-language Q&A. In this hands-on workshop, you start with seven raw banking tables: no catalog, no definitions. An agent inspects the data and builds the catalog for you. You ask questions in plain English and get answers. An agent generates a dashboard showing which top customers are slipping. Another agent, aware of the bank's compliance rules, checks every offer before it ships. Then you automate the full response as a Quick Flow and wrap it in a custom app your team can use. You leave with a working banking command center that agents built, and that you can rebuild in your own account using conversational analytics.

title: Build agentic automations for business processes with Amazon Quick Automate
title_ko: Amazon Quick Automate로 비즈니스 프로세스용 에이전틱 자동화 구축하기
summary_ko: 금융 서비스 사례를 통해 Amazon Quick Automate로 엔터프라이즈급 자동화를 구축하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano I
abstract: In this session, learn how to build an enterprise-grade automation using Amazon Quick Automate. Through a financial services example, explore how specialized AI agents work together to handle complex interactions across web pages and business applications. You'll create a production-ready automation featuring custom agents that leverage knowledge and tools to transform a merchant onboarding process. Using Quick Automate's chat based authoring and visual studio, you'll configure a workflow with multiple agents, integrate with multiple tools, test and debug the workflow, and then deploy it using robust enterprise controls. Walk away knowing how to develop agentic automations for real-world use cases.

title: Build Multi-Agent Workflows with Amazon Quick, MCP & AgentCore
title_ko: Amazon Quick, MCP, AgentCore로 멀티 에이전트 워크플로 구축하기
summary_ko: 전문화된 에이전트들이 협업해 복잡한 비즈니스 프로세스를 자동화하는 멀티 에이전트 시스템을 Amazon Quick 안에서 설계·구축합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano IV
abstract: Design and build a multi-agent system inside Amazon Quick where specialized agents collaborate to automate complex business processes. Connect to enterprise systems through MCP servers on Bedrock AgentCore, implement inter-agent communication, configure OAuth 2.0 authentication, and deploy autonomous workflows using Quick Flows. Modeled after production deployments running 12+ coordinated agents across ERP, finance, and procurement, you'll leave with a working multi-agent solution you can replicate in your own environment.

title: Customize workspaces and build guided workflows using AI in Connect Customer
title_ko: Connect Customer에서 AI로 워크스페이스 맞춤화 및 가이드형 워크플로 구축하기
summary_ko: Amazon Connect Customer에서 상담원과 비즈니스 사용자 경험 전체를 AI 기반으로 구축하는 워크숍입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: In this workshop, you build the complete agent and business user experience in Amazon Connect Customer. First, you create persona-specific workspaces using the no-code UI builder, customizing page layouts, applications, and views so frontline agents, back-office workers, and supervisors each see only the information, tools, and guidance they need. Then, you create AI-powered guided workflows using natural language: describe the experience you want, and AI generates the step-by-step workflow automatically. You test and validate end-to-end in the Agent Workspace, seeing how custom layouts and AI-built guides work together to accelerate resolution. Walk away with persona-tailored workspaces and working guided workflows built in minutes instead of days.

title: Beyond English: Architecture Patterns for Multilingual AI Voice Agents
title_ko: 영어를 넘어: 다국어 AI 음성 에이전트를 위한 아키텍처 패턴
summary_ko: Amazon Connect의 에이전틱 음성 기능으로 다국어 음성 에이전트를 구축하는 아키텍처 패턴을 공유하는 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: Deploying AI voice agents beyond English introduces unique challenges: accent handling, language detection, code-switching between languages mid-conversation, and cultural nuances in conversation flow. In this chalk talk, we share architecture patterns for building multilingual voice agents using Amazon Connect Agentic Voice. We cover real-world scenarios from deployments like Spanish and English coexistence, German with regional dialects, and Italian conversational AI. We discuss when speech-to-speech models work natively, when to fall back to TTS pipelines, how to handle polyglot but non-native accent scenarios, and practical approaches to knowledge base localization. Bring your language challenge and we'll design your multilingual architecture on the whiteboard.

title: Build It or Bring It: Getting AI Agents into CX Faster
title_ko: 직접 만들까, 가져올까: AI 에이전트를 CX에 더 빠르게 도입하기
summary_ko: Amazon Connect Customer에서 새 AI 에이전트를 구축하거나 기존 에이전트를 가져와 CX에 빠르게 적용하는 두 가지 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan I
abstract: Getting agentic AI from prototype to production in your customer experience application is slow, and the gap is widening. In this chalk talk we give you two levers to close it on Amazon Connect Customer. Build new AI agents on the agentic CX designer canvas, describing what you want in natural language and applying enterprise guardrails to reach production-grade quickly. Or bring the agents your business has already built, anywhere, and orchestrate them through Connect Customer using the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. We demonstrate both, then whiteboard how they fit together architecturally. Come ready to challenge the design and share where you would use each.

title: AI Agent Teams at Scale
title_ko: 대규모 AI 에이전트 팀
summary_ko: 항공편 취소나 정전처럼 수천 명의 고객에게 동시에 영향을 주는 사건을 AI 에이전트 팀으로 대응하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Pompeian IV
abstract: When one event impacts hundreds, or even thousands, of customers simultaneously (a cancelled flight, a power outage, a system failure), contact centers cannot scale human agents fast enough. In this hands-on workshop, you orchestrate parallel AI agent teams using Amazon Connect Customer. You configure AI agents that fan out across dozens of affected customers at once: rebooking flights, issuing credits, and scheduling callbacks, all while a single human orchestrator monitors progress, approves exceptions, and intervenes only where needed. Walk away with a working parallel orchestration pattern and the configuration to deploy 1-to-many AI response at scale. This is not 1-to-1 AI coaching. This is 1-to-many crisis orchestration.

title: Easy Self-Service AI: Design Agents with the Agentic CX Designer
title_ko: 손쉬운 셀프 서비스 AI: Agentic CX Designer로 에이전트 설계하기
summary_ko: 프롬프트 엔지니어링 전문 지식 없이 Agentic CX Designer로 AI 셀프 서비스 에이전트를 설계하는 실습 워크숍입니다.
abstract: Creating AI-powered self-service shouldn't require prompt engineering expertise - and in this hands-on workshop, you'll prove it. Go from a blank canvas to a deployed, production-ready AI agent in under two hours using Amazon Connect Customer’s agentic CX designer. Design conversational flows on the visual canvas, blending generative AI responses with deterministic business logic for scenarios like payment processing and identity verification. Connect your agent to external data sources, pass context seamlessly across conversation turns, then test and evaluate your agent's performance using built-in analytics and simulation tools. You'll leave with a working multi-channel AI agent, a repeatable design pattern you can apply to your own use cases, and confidence that your team can build and validate self-service experiences without specialized AI skills - no coding required.

summary_ko: 기기 안전 리콜 상황을 가정해 Connect Customer로 고객에게 선제적으로 옴니채널 AI 아웃리치를 수행하는 워크숍입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Pompeian IV
abstract: Every organization is building AI agents for inbound, but who's automating outreach? In this workshop, you become a carrier responding to a device safety recall. Instead of posting a notice and waiting for calls, you build a system that identifies affected customers, prioritizes them by risk and value, and uses an AI agent to reach them before they ever pick up the phone. Walk away with a working proactive outreach engine and the architecture to deploy anticipatory engagement at scale.

title_ko: 다시 시작할 필요 없이: Connect Customer의 채팅, 음성, 영상, 화면 공유
summary_ko: 채팅에서 음성, 영상, 화면 공유로 컨텍스트 손실 없이 이어지는 단일 고객 대화를 직접 구축합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Pompeian IV
abstract: Your customer is halfway through an application in your app, and stuck. Today they abandon it, call you, and start explaining from scratch. In this hands-on workshop you build a single unbroken conversation that escalates in richness without losing context. A customer opens chat inside your application. When they stall on a form, the agent co-browses the page and sees the blocking field, then uses agent assist to answer a policy question with cited sources. The conversation carries into an in-app call, context intact, no phone number and no repeated details. Documents are reviewed over screen share, identity is confirmed over video, and because it's a joint application the co-applicant and a product specialist join the same call. Walk away with an escalation pattern combining persistent context, WebRTC channels and AI-assisted agents, for any high-consideration interaction.

title: Build End-to-End Testing & Self-Healing Framework for Agentic AI
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI를 위한 엔드투엔드 테스트 및 자가 치유 프레임워크 구축
summary_ko: 프로덕션 에이전틱 여정의 신뢰성을 검증하는 엔드투엔드 테스트와 자가 치유 프레임워크를 구축합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano I
abstract: Organizations are accelerating their deployment of agentic journeys yet a critical gap remains - how reliable are they in handling self-service queries? This workshop delivers a hands-on framework for the complete testing and operational lifecycle of agentic on Amazon Connect Customer. First, build a layered testing strategy using native Testing & Simulation - functional, integration, and regression tests to validate self-service customer journeys, wired to dashboard-driven observability. Then, implement automated operational responses such as threshold-based alerting that triggers pre-approved remediations. You will leave with a reusable testing playbook and an implementable pattern for closed-loop operational automation - reducing manual validation effort and moving toward self-managing AI agents at scale.

title: Decision Frameworks, Evaluation, and Cost Management with Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick의 의사결정 프레임워크, 평가 및 비용 관리
summary_ko: 처음부터 평가와 비용 관리를 내재한 의사결정 프레임워크를 화이트보드로 설계하는 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: Moving from one agent to enterprise-wide automation means choosing the right path — Flows, Automate, Custom Agents, persistent agents — and the right trigger model. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard a decision framework that bakes in evaluation and cost management from the start, not as afterthoughts. We'll connect orchestration across 25+ connectors, skills, and workstreams to measurable outcomes and dollars. Bring your automation backlog — you'll leave with a decision matrix, eval harness, and ROI story.

title: Self-Tuning Demand Forecasts: How Agentic AI Puts Business Users in the Driver's Seat
title_ko: 스스로 조정하는 수요 예측: 에이전틱 AI가 비즈니스 사용자에게 주도권을 주는 방법
summary_ko: Amazon Connect Decisions의 지능형 에이전트가 수요 예측을 자동 조정하고 비즈니스 사용자가 이를 주도하는 방식을 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan III
abstract: Amazon Connect Decisions is redefining how organizations approach demand forecast tuning. Traditionally, improving forecast accuracy meant navigating complex data engineering pipelines and hyperparameter optimization — work that was time-intensive, technically demanding, and largely inaccessible to business users. In this chalk talk, we unpack how Amazon Connect Decisions takes an agentic approach to solve this: intelligent agents continuously self-tune demand forecast models by incorporating business user feedback directly into the refinement loop, removing the undifferentiated heavy lifting. Walk through a live demonstration of self-tuning in action, learn how this business-first approach shifts forecast ownership to the people who understand the demand signals best, and discuss how Amazon Connect Decisions is shaping the future of agentic supply chain solutions.

title: Fix Data Gaps Fast: Agentic Onboarding with Amazon Connect Decisions
title_ko: 데이터 공백을 빠르게 해결: Amazon Connect Decisions의 에이전틱 온보딩
summary_ko: Amazon Connect Decisions가 AI 팀원을 활용해 공급망 데이터 온보딩의 공백을 신속히 해소하는 과정을 시연합니다.
abstract: 81% of enterprises report AI initiatives delayed or abandoned due to data and governance gaps — and 80–90% of new enterprise data is unstructured. The bottleneck isn't the model; it's the data. In this session, see how Amazon Connect Decisions uses agentic AI teammates to eliminate that gap. Watch a supply chain planner go from zero to a running demand forecast — connecting raw CSVs with no pre-cleaning, letting AI intelligently map and type-convert data, catching and fixing quality issues conversationally, and encoding tribal knowledge from a Word doc into live decision rules. No ETL code, no JIRA tickets, no months-long implementation. Onboarding in weeks, not months.

title: Building a Knowledge & Context Engineering Foundation for AI Agents
title_ko: AI 에이전트를 위한 지식 및 컨텍스트 엔지니어링 기반 구축
summary_ko: AWS가 Amazon Connect용 에이전틱 전문가 팀원으로 지식·컨텍스트 엔지니어링 문제를 내부적으로 해결한 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Every enterprise building agentic AI hits the same wall: AI agents can't deliver trusted guidance without governed knowledge behind them. In this session, learn how AWS solved this internally with an agentic specialist teammate for Amazon Connect powered by a structured knowledge governance framework. We'll show how specialist reasoning is captured, validated, and scaled across 92 domains to 30K+ field members, and demonstrate the live workflow from governed knowledge delivery to human escalation. Walk away with a repeatable reference architecture for making your own AI agents production-ready and trustworthy.

title: Building a Knowledge & Context Engineering Foundation for AI Agents
title_ko: AI 에이전트를 위한 지식 및 컨텍스트 엔지니어링 기반 구축

title: Engineering the Context that Makes Enterprise AI Work (sponsored by Impetus Technologies Inc)
title_ko: 엔터프라이즈 AI를 작동하게 하는 컨텍스트 엔지니어링 (후원: Impetus Technologies)
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 준비된 컨텍스트 없이 프로덕션에 가지 않도록 하는 Impetus의 컨텍스트 엔지니어링 딜리버리 수명 주기를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Every enterprise has access to the same AI models. The real differentiator is context. Discover Impetus’ Context Engineering Delivery Lifecycle, a proven methodology than ensures no AI agent reaches production without a signed-off context bundle, evaluation record, and explainability trace. Learn how to engineer enterprise data, domain knowledge, industry ontologies, business rules, and governance into a robust context layer agents need to deliver accurate, trusted outcomes. Get practical insights on building AI systems on AWS that are grounded, explainable, reliable, and ready to scale. This presentation is brought to you by Impetus Technologies Inc, an AWS Partner.

title: Build It, Govern It, Ship It: CI/CD for AI Agents with the NVIDIA Agent Toolkit (sponsored by NVIDIA)
title_ko: 구축, 거버넌스, 배포: NVIDIA Agent Toolkit으로 AI 에이전트 CI/CD 구현하기 (후원: NVIDIA)
summary_ko: AWS에서 NVIDIA Agent Toolkit을 사용해 에이전트를 일반 소프트웨어처럼 CI/CD 파이프라인으로 구축·관리·배포하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Shipping an AI agent once is easy. Shipping it again, cheaper, better, and still within policy, is the hard part. In this session we treat an agent like any other software, using the NVIDIA Agent Toolkit on AWS: every part it’s built from, its skills, tools, models, and policies, goes through a pipeline before an agent can use it. We pull a skill from a public registry, test whether it actually helps with NVIDIA SkillEvaluator, and publish it to a private registry alongside AWS Agent Registry, pinned by version and digest. Then we route each call to the right model across NVIDIA NIM and Amazon Bedrock with NeMo Switchyard, and turn what the run’s checks caught into the next policy rule. Leave knowing how to make each release of your agent cheaper, better, and safer than the last. This presentation is brought to you by NVIDIA, an AWS Partner.

title: Build, Govern, Optimize: Trustworthy, Cost-Aware Agents with the NVIDIA Agent Toolkit (sponsored by NVIDIA)
title_ko: 구축, 거버넌스, 최적화: NVIDIA Agent Toolkit으로 신뢰할 수 있고 비용을 고려한 에이전트 만들기 (후원: NVIDIA)
summary_ko: 노트북을 지참해 AWS에서 멀티 에이전트 시스템의 전체 수명 주기를 NVIDIA Agent Toolkit으로 직접 다뤄 봅니다.
abstract: Bring a laptop and take one multi-agent system through its whole lifecycle on AWS: discover, build, deploy, govern, and optimize. You’ll compose it from versioned parts in an open registry alongside AWS Agent Registry, declare it once, and run it with Strands Agents on your laptop, Amazon EKS, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. You’ll govern it with one policy enforced at the model boundary, at every tool call, and at the kernel, using NeMo Guardrails, NeMo Relay, and OpenShell beside Amazon Bedrock Guardrails and AgentCore Policy. Then you’ll optimize it, routing each call across NVIDIA NIM and Amazon Bedrock with NeMo Switchyard and putting every change through CI/CD before it ships. You’ll leave with a working reference deployment in your own AWS account. This presentation is brought to you by NVIDIA, an AWS Partner.

title: Evaluate, Disclose, Safeguard: A Production-Readiness Framework for AI Agents
title_ko: 평가, 공개, 보호: AI 에이전트를 위한 프로덕션 준비 프레임워크
summary_ko: Amazon Connect에서 AI 에이전트의 평가, 공개, 안전장치를 아우르는 프로덕션 준비 프레임워크를 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Every organization is building AI agents, but few have made it to production. You can't prove it works, you can't prove it's responsible, and compliance won't sign off. In this chalk talk, we walk through a production-readiness framework for AI agents on Amazon Connect. First, evaluation: measuring resolution with the Connect Simulation API to score AI agents on the same bar as human agents. Second, responsible AI: disclosure patterns that build trust, escalation triggers for sensitive journeys, and harm avoidance for regulated industries. Third, safeguards: defense-in-depth governance for agents that process refunds and access sensitive data, including asymmetric PII, MCP tool authorization for human confirmation, and automated escalation when confidence drops. Leave with a checklist: what to measure, what to disclose, what to block, and when to ship.

title: Evaluate, Disclose, Safeguard: A Production-Readiness Framework for AI Agents
title_ko: 평가, 공개, 보호: AI 에이전트를 위한 프로덕션 준비 프레임워크
summary_ko: Amazon Connect에서 AI 에이전트의 평가, 공개, 안전장치를 아우르는 프로덕션 준비 프레임워크를 살펴봅니다.

title: Token-efficient retrieval for production AI agents (sponsored by Exa)
title_ko: 프로덕션 AI 에이전트를 위한 토큰 효율적 검색 (후원: Exa)
summary_ko: 에이전트 비용을 좌우하는 컨텍스트를 줄이기 위해 웹 데이터를 토큰 효율적으로 검색·제공하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Most agent bills aren't driven by the model, they're driven by the context it's given. Raw web pages, HTML boilerplate, and 10 blue links padded with irrelevant text quietly multiply token spend and degrade answer quality. This lightning talk walks through how Exa engineered retrieval to hand LLMs exactly the text they need: neural search that returns precise passages instead of whole pages, highlight extraction tuned to the query, and context-budgeting techniques that cut input tokens dramatically without hurting accuracy. Using real production traces, we'll show how token-efficient retrieval changes the economics of agents at scale on AWS, and give you a practical checklist you can apply to any RAG or agent pipeline this week. This presentation is brought to you by Exa, an AWS Partner.

title: ​Every Candidate, Every Time: AI-Led Interviews with Connect Talent
title_ko: 모든 지원자를 매번 공정하게: Connect Talent의 AI 주도 면접
summary_ko: 직무 요건을 평가 기준과 질문으로 변환하고 AI 에이전트가 자연스러운 면접을 진행하는 방법을 보여주는 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: ​​Who you hire is the most important decision you make, and the hardest to get right at scale. Built on Amazon Connect and grounded in Amazon’s hiring science, Amazon Connect Talent runs AI-led interviews that evaluate every candidate consistently. In this chalk talk, we show how role requirements become evaluation criteria and questions, how AI agents hold a natural conversation while covering each competency and gathering evidence, and how responses are scored against a rubric tied to specific evidence. See a single job posting become a scored, evidence-backed evaluation. Leave knowing how to tell hiring science from gut feel, and why that shows up in better hires and a fairer experience for every candidate.​​

title: Design, Simulate, Ship: End-to-End AI Agents on Connect Customer
title_ko: 설계, 시뮬레이션, 배포: Connect Customer의 엔드투엔드 AI 에이전트
summary_ko: 아이디어에서 프로덕션 준비 에이전틱 고객 경험까지 한 세션 안에 Amazon Connect Customer로 구현하는 워크숍입니다.
abstract: Most AI agent projects stall between pilot and production. In this workshop, you go from an idea to a production-ready agentic customer experience in a single session using Amazon Connect Customer. No months-long timeline.

title: Building Smarter Self-Service Experiences with AI
title_ko: AI로 더 스마트한 셀프 서비스 경험 구축하기
summary_ko: AI를 활용해 기존 자료를 빠르게 실시간 셀프 서비스 경험으로 전환하는 방법을 탐구하는 빌더 세션입니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Great customer self-service starts with the knowledge your team already has, but getting it into customers' hands can be a challenge. In this builder session, explore how AI can help you transform existing resources into live self-service experiences quickly and easily. Learn how teams are reducing time-to-launch without heavy engineering lifts.

title: Build an AI agent that understands customer intent
title_ko: 고객 의도를 이해하는 AI 에이전트 구축하기
summary_ko: 고객의 최근 행동과 감정 상태 등 맥락을 파악해 의도를 이해하는 AI 에이전트를 만드는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Today's AI agents start every session cold. They don't know what the customer was just browsing, whether they're frustrated or exploring, or whether this is a service moment or a buying moment. So they waste the first few turns asking what your data already knows. In this hands-on builders' session, you close that gap. You unify customer data into Profiles, then turn it into real-time signals about what each customer needs. You wire those signals into an AI agent with calculated attributes and event triggers, so when the customer makes contact the agent already understands why they're there and responds with the right answer and the right offer. You leave with a working prototype ready for your own environment.

title: Configure Security & Governance Controls for Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick의 보안 및 거버넌스 제어 구성하기
summary_ko: 엔터프라이즈 요건을 충족하는 모니터링, 감사, 컴플라이언스 제어를 시나리오 기반으로 구성하는 방법을 익힙니다.
abstract: Implement comprehensive security and administrative controls for Amazon Quick. Practice configuring identity integration, access policies, and data governance frameworks. Learn to establish monitoring, auditing, and compliance controls that meet enterprise requirements. Work through scenarios covering user management, content governance, and security best practices for Quick Suite environments in production.

title: Agentic Memory: Build AI Agents That Learn from Every Interaction
title_ko: 에이전틱 메모리: 모든 상호작용에서 학습하는 AI 에이전트 구축
summary_ko: Amazon Connect Customer AI 에이전트를 위한 영속 메모리 시스템 아키텍처를 설계하는 방법을 다루는 칠크 토크입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan I
abstract: Today's AI agents forget everything after each conversation ends. A customer calls back about the same issue for the third time, and the agent starts from zero. In this chalk talk, we explore how to architect persistent memory systems for Amazon Connect Customer AI agents, enabling them to remember customer preferences, recall prior issue context, and adapt resolution strategies over time. We walk through three memory patterns: episodic (past interactions), semantic (customer knowledge graphs), and procedural (learned resolution paths). We whiteboard real architectures using Customer Profiles, Bedrock knowledge bases, and DynamoDB to build agents that reduce repeat contacts and deliver personalized experiences, without retraining models. Bring your memory challenge and we'll design the persistence layer on the whiteboard.

title: Agentic Memory: Build AI Agents That Learn from Every Interaction
title_ko: 에이전틱 메모리: 모든 상호작용에서 학습하는 AI 에이전트 구축
summary_ko: Amazon Connect Customer AI 에이전트를 위한 영속 메모리 시스템 아키텍처를 설계하는 방법을 다루는 칠크 토크입니다.

title: Teaching Quick to Remember and Connect with Memory and Knowledge Graphs
title_ko: 메모리와 지식 그래프로 Quick이 기억하고 연결하게 만들기
summary_ko: 지속 학습 메모리와 지식 그래프라는 두 기본 요소로 Amazon Quick이 무상태 한계를 벗어나는 방법을 보여줍니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan III
abstract: Every conversation with an AI assistant starts from scratch. Your agent doesn't remember what worked yesterday, can't tell you who owns a project without searching again, and repeats the same mistakes because failures are never captured. In this chalk talk, we show how Amazon Quick breaks out of statelessness with two primitives: a continuous-learning memory layer where a background agent extracts reusable knowledge after each session and scores it with a probabilistic confidence model, and a personal knowledge graph that connects people, projects, decisions, and evidence across your tools so the agent has a map of your world before it reads a single document. We'll whiteboard the architecture and the tradeoffs that shaped it, then open it up — bring your hardest questions about memory staleness, confidence calibration, graph noise, or making agents that actually get better over time.

title: Zero to multimodal in 60 mins: Building Live Sync on Connect Customer
title_ko: 60분 만에 멀티모달까지: Connect Customer에서 Live Sync 구축하기
summary_ko: 기본 원리부터 시작해 Connect Customer에서 멀티모달 Live Sync 경험을 처음부터 구축해 보는 칠크 토크입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: What does it take to synchronize a live voice conversation with a real-time visual interface — and make it feel like magic? In this chalk talk, we'll answer that question by building one from scratch. Starting from first principles, we'll construct a fully functional voice AI agent that leverages the patented Live Sync on Amazon Connect Customer: the signaling that keeps voice and visual in lock-step, the state machine that drives bi-directional interaction, and the rendering layer that turns conversational intent into on-screen UI in real time. No slides, no hand-waving — just building, live, from zero to a working multimodal agent in 60 minutes. At the end, we'll deploy what we built and every phone in the room becomes a live demo.

title: Zero to multimodal in 60 mins: Building Live Sync on Connect Customer
title_ko: 60분 만에 멀티모달까지: Connect Customer에서 Live Sync 구축하기
summary_ko: 기본 원리부터 시작해 Connect Customer에서 멀티모달 Live Sync 경험을 처음부터 구축해 보는 칠크 토크입니다.

title: Cutting manual accounts payable work
title_ko: 수작업 매입채무 업무 줄이기
summary_ko: 새로운 퍼스트파티 애플리케이션이 구매 주문과 송장을 실시간 단일 뷰로 제공해 매입채무 업무를 줄이는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Enterprise customers pay for cloud services across dozens of payer accounts and countries through procurement/accounts payable platforms like SAP Ariba and Coupa and track it all in spreadsheets and email threads. Purchase orders run out unnoticed. Payments land on the wrong invoices. Disputes take months. In this session, see how a new first-party application gives Accounts Payable teams one live view of purchase orders, invoices and payments matched against billing records no console login required.

title: Amazon Linux: Securing and scaling your workloads on AWS
title_ko: Amazon Linux: AWS에서 워크로드 보안 및 확장하기
summary_ko: Amazon Linux 2027(AL2027)을 소개하고 보안 강화, 최적화, 주요 기능을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Amazon Linux powers the majority of workloads on AWS, from containers and AI/ML to enterprise applications and managed services. In this session, we introduce Amazon Linux 2027 (AL2027), cover its security enhancements, optimizations, and key features. Learn how AL2027 addresses the needs of modern AI/ML and container workloads, and what the roadmap means for your infrastructure planning. Whether you are planning a migration or evaluating your OS strategy, this session is for you.

title: Amazon EC2: New silicon, new instances, new possibilities
title_ko: Amazon EC2: 새로운 실리콘, 새로운 인스턴스, 새로운 가능성
summary_ko: 새 AWS Graviton 프로세서부터 최신 Intel, AMD, Mac 인스턴스까지 EC2의 최신 혁신을 살펴봅니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Amazon EC2 continues to push the boundaries of cloud compute. Join this session to explore the latest innovations — from new AWS Graviton processors to the newest Intel, AMD, and Mac instances built for demanding workloads. Hear how customers are using EC2 to accelerate application development, high-performance computing, and AI inference on the CPU. Learn how the AWS Nitro System delivers strong isolation and performance, and leave with practical guidance to match the right EC2 instance to your workload.

title: EC2 instances from launch to fleet orchestration
title_ko: EC2 인스턴스: 시작부터 플릿 오케스트레이션까지
summary_ko: 1,000여 개 인스턴스 유형과 다양한 구매 모델, 플릿·용량 도구를 활용해 EC2를 효과적으로 운영하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Amazon EC2 now offers over 1,000 instance types, five purchasing models, and a growing set of fleet and capacity tools. How do you bring it all together? This session is your comprehensive guide to AWS compute today. We cover the full EC2 portfolio from Graviton5 to accelerated instances, walk through On-Demand, Spot, Savings Plans, and Capacity Reservations, and show how EC2 Fleet, Auto Scaling, and Capacity Manager help you run the right instances at the right price. Whether you're new to EC2 or a seasoned practitioner, leave with a clear map of modern compute on AWS.

title: Agentic AI on AWS with Intel and Databricks (sponsored by Intel)
title_ko: Intel 및 Databricks와 함께하는 AWS 기반 에이전틱 AI (후원: Intel)
summary_ko: Intel과 Databricks가 AWS 워크로드의 가격 대비 성능을 최적화하기 위해 협력하는 방식을 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Intel and Databricks are collaborating to optimize price-performance for workloads running on AWS. This session covers optimizations for ISVs running Photon/Spark on Databricks leveraging custom Amazon EC2 instances powered by Intel® Xeon® processors, delivering advanced AI capabilities and high core density. This presentation is brought to you by Intel, an AWS Partner.

title: The AWS Console in the age of agentic compute
title_ko: 에이전틱 컴퓨팅 시대의 AWS 콘솔
summary_ko: 모델 테스트부터 용량 계획까지 에이전틱 개발 시대에 AWS 콘솔이 컴퓨팅 관리를 돕는 방식을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: From model testing to capacity planning, compute can be complex and costly to get wrong. As development moves into an agentic era, see how AWS Console innovations provide a trusted tool to support your workflow, verify instances, save costs, govern with confidence. Move faster. Stay in control.

title: Unlock your AWS Graviton potential using Graviton Savings Dashboard and AI skills
title_ko: Graviton Savings Dashboard와 AI 스킬로 AWS Graviton 잠재력 끌어내기
summary_ko: Graviton Savings Dashboard와 AI 스킬을 활용해 Graviton 전환의 절감 효과를 실습으로 분석합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Builders' Session
abstract: How much can you save by migrating to Graviton? In this builder session, explore two complementary ways to answer it, hands-on. The Graviton Savings Dashboard is an AWS Quick visualization of your Graviton usage, realized savings, and migration opportunities. The Graviton Savings Assessment is an open-source skill any AI coding agent runs against your cost and usage data to produce a prioritized migration plan. Use both tools against a sample fleet, identify migration candidates, and see how quickly cost data becomes a migration strategy. Walk away with actionable insights and a deployment kit for your own accounts.

title: Unlock your AWS Graviton potential using Graviton Savings Dashboard and AI skills
title_ko: Graviton Savings Dashboard와 AI 스킬로 AWS Graviton 잠재력 끌어내기
summary_ko: Graviton Savings Dashboard와 AI 스킬을 활용해 Graviton 전환의 절감 효과를 실습으로 분석합니다.

title: Agents at the Gate: Governing AI in EC2 Image Builder
title_ko: 관문의 에이전트: EC2 Image Builder에서 AI 거버넌스하기
summary_ko: Image Builder 작업을 Kiro, Claude Code로 실행되는 재사용 가능한 에이전트 스킬로 분해하고 거버넌스를 적용하는 빌더 세션입니다.
abstract: EC2 Image Builder pipelines sprawl fast, and frontier agents that run for hours unattended need guardrails. In this builders' session, decompose Image Builder operations into reusable agent skills run via Kiro, Claude Code. Author AWSTOE components and orchestrate workflows, then harden images and scan for CVEs. Mid-build, a WaitForAction step pauses the pipeline and hands the image to AWS Security Agent to pentest; what it finds decides whether the build ships, bounded by severity, iteration caps, and human approval. Leave with a reusable skill library and governance pattern.

title: Agents at the Gate: Governing AI in EC2 Image Builder
title_ko: 관문의 에이전트: EC2 Image Builder에서 AI 거버넌스하기
summary_ko: Image Builder 작업을 Kiro, Claude Code로 실행되는 재사용 가능한 에이전트 스킬로 분해하고 거버넌스를 적용하는 빌더 세션입니다.
