title: AWS Nitro System deep dive: Security, isolation, and innovation
title_ko: AWS Nitro System 심층 분석: 보안, 격리, 혁신
summary_ko: 6세대 Nitro System과 형식 검증을 도입한 AWS Nitro Isolation Engine 등 보안·격리 혁신을 살펴봅니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: The AWS Nitro System underpins every modern Amazon EC2 instance — purpose-built hardware and firmware delivering security, performance, and continuous innovation. In this deep dive, explore the Nitro architecture from custom silicon and modular design to networking and storage offload. Learn how the sixth-generation Nitro System introduces the AWS Nitro Isolation Engine, bringing formal verification to cloud isolation and extends Nitro-level isolation to containers. Discover how Nitro enables enhanced networking and confidential computing.

title: Run your largest SAP HANA on AWS: EC2 High Memory deep dive
title_ko: 가장 큰 SAP HANA를 AWS에서 실행하기: EC2 High Memory 심층 분석
summary_ko: EC2 High Memory 인스턴스를 구동하는 Nitro 설계와 고객들의 대규모 SAP HANA 프로덕션 확장 사례를 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Running SAP HANA at scale requires infrastructure that matches the size and criticality of your Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) workloads. EC2 High Memory instances deliver capacity from 256 GB to 32 TB, backed by the AWS Nitro architecture for consistent performance and hardware-level isolation. In this session, we deep dive into the Nitro design powering these instances and hear how customers are scaling production ERP to 32 TB on AWS. Walk away with architectural guidance and real-world deployment patterns for running your largest HANA workloads in a scale-up configuration.

title: Delivering next-generation quantum hardware on Amazon Braket
title_ko: Amazon Braket에서 차세대 양자 하드웨어 제공하기
summary_ko: 차세대 양자 디바이스를 Amazon Braket에 도입하는 과정과 하드웨어 통합 방식을 심층적으로 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: In this session, we discuss bringing next-generation quantum devices to Amazon Braket and dive deep on how our hardware and software capabilities unlock fault-tolerant quantum computing for our customers. We share early results and outline how organizations can begin preparing today for the fault-tolerant era.

title: Graviton5: Migrate your workloads, cut costs, get better performance
title_ko: Graviton5: 워크로드 마이그레이션으로 비용 절감과 성능 향상
summary_ko: 데이터베이스, 웹 앱, ML 추론 등 실제 벤치마크로 Graviton5 마이그레이션 효과를 살펴봅니다.
abstract: AWS Graviton5 delivers up to 25% better compute performance than the previous generation, features caches up to five times larger, and offers some of the fastest memory performance available in the cloud. But what do those improvements actually mean for your workloads? In this session, we go beyond the spec sheet into real-world benchmarks across databases, web applications, and ML inference. Hear from a customer who migrated production workloads across multiple Graviton generations and the compounding performance and cost gains they achieved. Walk away with concrete performance data and a practical framework to evaluate Graviton5 for your own migration.

title: Modernizing HPC on AWS: Migration at scale with PCS
title_ko: AWS에서 HPC 현대화: PCS를 통한 대규모 마이그레이션
summary_ko: Amazon Leo 등 조직들이 AWS PCS로 HPC 워크로드를 대규모로 이전한 사례를 공유합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: AWS Parallel Computing Service (PCS) is helping teams modernize their HPC infrastructure by making it easier to migrate off legacy schedulers without disrupting engineering velocity. In this session, hear how organizations have moved to PCS at scale, including how Amazon Leo migrated 400 engineers and achieved 20% cost savings and 50% faster jobs. Walk away with practical migration patterns, performance tuning strategies, and architecture decisions that apply whether you're running simulations, modeling, or other compute-intensive workloads.

title: 50k daily iOS builds with virtualization on Amazon EC2 Mac
title_ko: Amazon EC2 Mac 가상화로 하루 5만 건의 iOS 빌드 처리하기
summary_ko: 한 대형 자동차 제조사가 CI/CD 인프라를 AWS로 이전해 EC2 Mac에서 대량의 iOS 빌드를 처리한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: A leading automotive manufacturer migrated its CI/CD infrastructure from on-premises to AWS to support over 130,000 daily builds (50k + iOS) across 1,300+ microservices. To accelerate iOS mobile app development, the team adopted Amazon EC2 Mac instances with virtualization using OpenAI Tart virtualization toolset, enabling ephemeral macOS VMs that boot in seconds with pre-configured toolchains. This approach reduced average build times from 90 to 35 minutes, a 61% improvement, while eliminating hardware management overhead. The platform now scales to 50,000+ daily iOS builds, serving 3,000+ developers with cost-optimized, reliable, and secure pipelines across hundreds of AWS accounts worldwide.

title: Beyond the simulator: Quantum chemistry workflows on real hardware
title_ko: 시뮬레이터를 넘어: 실제 하드웨어에서의 양자 화학 워크플로
summary_ko: 양자 화학 계산 워크플로를 로컬, 고전 시뮬레이터, 실제 양자 하드웨어에서 차례로 실행해 보는 워크숍입니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Get hands-on experience running quantum computing experiments using the Kvantify SDK; the same workflow used by researchers. In this workshop, participants will set up and execute computational workflows, testing them locally, on a classical simulator via Amazon Braket, and finally on a real quantum processing unit (QPU). Through practical exercises in enzyme engineering and battery development, learners will see how quantum computing accelerates discovery in life sciences and materials science, bridging the gap from simulation to real quantum hardware.

title: Cut cost migrating agentic AI workloads to Graviton5 on EKS AutoMode
title_ko: EKS Auto Mode에서 Graviton5로 에이전틱 AI 워크로드를 이전해 비용 절감하기
summary_ko: Amazon EKS Auto Mode의 AWS Graviton5로 이전해 성능 저하 없이 에이전틱 AI 인프라 비용을 줄이는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano IV
abstract: Learn how to cut agentic AI infrastructure costs by migrating to AWS Graviton5 on Amazon EKS Auto Mode — with no compromise on latency or reliability. This hands-on workshop covers the full playbook: building multi-architecture container images, designing ARM64 NodePools, configuring IAM Roles for Service Accounts for secure agent-to-AWS communication, and tuning Graviton-optimized inference runtimes for predictable tail latency. Run live cost benchmarks against x86 equivalents to see exactly where Graviton5 pays back, and instrument with CloudWatch Container Insights to confirm performance parity. Walk away with a reusable pattern, a reproducible benchmark methodology, and a clear migration path you can apply to your own workloads the same week.

title: Cut cost migrating agentic AI workloads to Graviton5 on EKS AutoMode
title_ko: EKS Auto Mode에서 Graviton5로 에이전틱 AI 워크로드를 이전해 비용 절감하기
summary_ko: Amazon EKS Auto Mode의 AWS Graviton5로 이전해 성능 저하 없이 에이전틱 AI 인프라 비용을 줄이는 방법을 배웁니다.

title: Assess your workloads with SELinux compatibility on Amazon Linux 2027
title_ko: Amazon Linux 2027에서 SELinux 호환성으로 워크로드 평가하기
summary_ko: SELinux 거부가 발생하는 앱을 배포하고 감사 로그를 분석해 근본 원인을 진단·해결하는 방법을 익힙니다.
abstract: AL2027 preview enforces SELinux by default. In this session, deploy an application that hits SELinux denials, learn to read audit logs, diagnose the root cause, and write a custom policy that resolves it. You will leave with the practical skills to adopt AL2027's security defaults.

title: Maximizing EC2 NVMe local storage
title_ko: EC2 NVMe 로컬 스토리지 극대화하기
summary_ko: EC2 스토리지 최적화 인스턴스의 최신 고성능 Nitro SSD를 데이터 집약적 워크로드에 활용하는 방법을 알아봅니다.
abstract: Discover how to leverage the latest high-performance Nitro SSDs in EC2 storage-optimized instances for data-intensive workloads. This technical session explores new capabilities for monitoring and managing NVMe instance storage, including enhanced performance metrics like latency, IOPS, and throughput to optimize and troubleshoot your workloads. We will also dive into the new AWS Local Instance Storage (LIS) CSI driver for simplified NVMe volume management in Amazon EKS. Learn best practices for storage performance monitoring and integrating the LIS CSI driver in containerized applications.

title: Optimize smarter: EKS performance with APerf and AI-powered analysis
title_ko: 더 스마트하게 최적화: APerf와 AI 기반 분석으로 EKS 성능 개선하기
summary_ko: APerf로 실행 중인 애플리케이션을 프로파일링하고 AI 분석으로 EKS 워크로드의 리소스 비효율을 찾아 개선합니다.
abstract: Your EKS workload is running, but is it actually efficient? Profile a live application with APerf to see what's consuming CPU cycles: syscall overhead, worker imbalances, inefficient library calls. Issues invisible in dashboards but obvious in a flame graph. APerf Analyzer MCP generates prescriptive guidance, configuration adjustments, and instance recommendations grounded in actual workload behavior. Implement fixes, redeploy, validate. Tasks escalate: fix a worker imbalance, eliminate a blocking call, resolve a writeback burst. Choose Python, Java, or Node.js. A live leaderboard tracks progress—who will finish first?

title: Optimize smarter: EKS performance with APerf and AI-powered analysis
title_ko: 더 스마트하게 최적화: APerf와 AI 기반 분석으로 EKS 성능 개선하기

title: Optimize a .NET application for Graviton 5 using AWS Transform
title_ko: AWS Transform으로 .NET 애플리케이션을 Graviton5에 최적화하기
summary_ko: Windows .NET Framework 앱을 AWS Transform으로 평가·현대화한 뒤 Graviton에서 성능을 벤치마크합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: Take a Windows .NET Framework application, run AWS Transform (assess, approve and modernize), and benchmark on Graviton. Compare against the original x86 baseline, inspect what the Transform build missed, fix the result with Kiro and deploy it on Graviton 5. Covers .NET Framework to modern .NET migration and how to apply the method to your own applications. (edited)

title: Storage performance in EC2 instances: What matters to your workload
title_ko: EC2 인스턴스의 스토리지 성능: 워크로드에 중요한 것
summary_ko: 지연 시간이 일관된 혼합 읽기/쓰기 성능이 실제 애플리케이션 성과를 좌우하는 이유를 살펴보는 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: Peak SSD IOPS and throughput dominate benchmarks, but production workloads tell a different story. In this chalk talk, we explore why latency-consistent mixed read/write performance drives real application outcomes across database, analytics, and distributed file system workloads. We'll walk through how workload profiles map to different performance dimensions (throughput vs. IOPS vs. latency consistency), how real-world write mixes reveal true storage performance, and how emerging AI workloads are creating demand for an entirely new storage performance profile.

title_ko: EC2 인스턴스의 스토리지 성능: 워크로드에 중요한 것

title: Latest trends: Network/EBS intensive workloads on Amazon EC2 instances
title_ko: 최신 동향: Amazon EC2의 네트워크/EBS 집약적 워크로드
summary_ko: 네트워크·EBS 집약적 인스턴스 패밀리의 최신 Graviton 및 Intel 인스턴스와 관련 네트워킹·EBS 기술을 소개합니다.
abstract: EC2 network 'n' and EBS-optimized 'b' instances deliver the highest, most consistent network and EBS performance in the cloud. Join us for a tour of the latest Graviton and Intel instance types in these families, plus the networking and EBS technologies that unlock peak performance for your workloads. Learn how customers leverage these instances for new workloads associated with AI/ML training and inference, and traditional network-intensive workloads such as security & network virtual appliances, and EBS-intensive workloads such as SQL, NoSQL, and in-memory databases.

title: Reduce EKS cluster compute costs with EC2 Flex instances
title_ko: EC2 Flex 인스턴스로 EKS 클러스터 컴퓨팅 비용 절감하기
summary_ko: EC2 Flex 인스턴스를 활용해 성능 손실 없이 EKS 클러스터 비용을 손쉽게 절감하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Container orchestration promises to improve resource utilization, but often we find ourselves with nodes that over-provision CPU, and therefore overspend. This might happen when our workloads have a high memory footprint, or when the number of replicas is driven by resilience targets and not actual load. In this session, we'll learn how easy it is to save cost in these situations without losing performance by taking advantage of EC2 Flex instances (e.g., C8i-flex, M8i-flex, R8i-flex). You'll migrate existing EKS cluster nodes, monitor relevant metrics, and measure the actual cost improvement.

title: Select and launch the right EC2 instance for your workload and budget
title_ko: 워크로드와 예산에 맞는 EC2 인스턴스 선택 및 시작하기
summary_ko: CPU, 메모리, 네트워크, 스토리지 등 워크로드 특성에 맞춰 EC2 인스턴스를 고르는 실용적 프레임워크를 배웁니다.
abstract: With hundreds of EC2 instance types spanning compute, memory, storage, and accelerator families, choosing the right one can be overwhelming. In this session, learn a practical framework for matching your workload characteristics—CPU, memory, network, and storage requirements—to the optimal instance type and size. We cover cost-performance tradeoffs across On-Demand, Spot, and Savings Plans, share real-world selection patterns for common workloads, and demo tools that simplify decision-making. Leave with a repeatable process to right-size from day one.

title: Build an agentic AI system on Amazon EKS with CPU-only inference
title_ko: CPU 전용 추론으로 Amazon EKS에 에이전틱 AI 시스템 구축하기
summary_ko: EKS Auto Mode에서 모든 모델을 CPU 인스턴스로 서빙하는 멀티 에이전트 AI 시스템을 구축하는 워크숍입니다.
abstract: In this workshop, build a multi-agent AI system on Amazon EKS with EKS Auto Mode that serves every model on CPU instances. Deploy four inference components: a fine-tuned intent router and a fine-tuned embedding model for vector search (both ONNX, trained on CPU), a cross-encoder re-ranker for retrieval quality, and a quantized generative analyst served with llama.cpp and grounded by RAG context from OpenSearch. Amazon Bedrock generates the synthetic training data, judges every answer through a faithfulness gate, and answers the edge cases the small models cannot. You'll finish by running the control test that puts a frontier LLM in the same seat, so you know whether the small model is good enough on your workload. By the end, you'll have a working multi-agent system on standard compute, using open-source tooling you can adapt.

title_ko: EC2 Flex 및 T 인스턴스: 더 낮은 비용으로 최신 성능 얻기
summary_ko: Flex 및 T 인스턴스의 특징과 이들 인스턴스에 가장 적합한 워크로드를 심층적으로 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Many workloads do not fully use all of the compute resources of a given instance, and we offer Flex and T instances to help cost-optimize for such workloads while getting the latest generation performance. In this session, we will dive deep into both Flex and T instances, which workloads are most suitable for these instances, high-level design, and ways customers can monitor the performance experience with these instances.

title: Build a cost-optimized multi-agent system on Amazon EC2 CPUs and GPU
title_ko: Amazon EC2 CPU와 GPU로 비용 최적화된 멀티 에이전트 시스템 구축하기
summary_ko: CPU와 GPU EC2 인스턴스에 워크로드를 나눠 처리하는 프로덕션 수준의 멀티 에이전트 시스템을 구축합니다.
abstract: In this hands-on workshop, you build a production-ready multi-agent system that splits workloads between CPU and GPU EC2 instances — the best of both worlds. Starting with an autonomous customer-support pipeline, you deploy reasoning agents on GPU and orchestration, tool-calling, and retrieval agents on CPUs. You profile each stage, measure latency and cost per agent call, and implement routing policies that dynamically assign tasks to the optimal compute tier. By the end, you have a hybrid deployment with a live cost dashboard showing 30–45% savings vs. GPU-only baselines.

title: GenAI chip selection: From training to inference
title_ko: 생성형 AI 칩 선택: 학습부터 추론까지
summary_ko: 모델 학습, 실시간 추론, 에이전틱 워크로드에 맞는 AI 칩을 고르는 실용적 의사결정 트리를 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Every GenAI workload hits the same question: GPU, Trainium, Graviton, or Inferentia—and when do you use each? In this chalk talk, we walk through a practical decision tree covering model training, real-time inference, and agentic AI workloads. We then go deep on inference cost optimization: right-sizing GPU instances, offloading pre/post-processing to Graviton, using Spot for batch inference, prompt caching, and moving production inference to Inferentia2. Expect opinionated guidance, real customer math from teams that cut inference costs without sacrificing latency, and a whiteboard framework you can take back to your team on Monday.

Then fix code guided by profiling data.

title: Optimize AI value: Compare token economics on AWS silicon
title_ko: AI 가치 최적화: AWS 실리콘의 토큰 경제성 비교
summary_ko: AI 파이프라인을 GPU에만 의존하지 않고 Trainium과 Graviton 등 AWS 실리콘으로 토큰당 비용을 비교·최적화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Most enterprises run their entire AI pipeline on GPU and can overpay. AWS's silicon portfolio (Trainium & Graviton) along with NVIDIA GPU, Intel, and AMD all offer radically different economics for different workloads, and the cheapest token rarely delivers the cheapest business outcome. This session delivers a decision framework for matching silicon to workload: training and inference on Trainium, RAG pipelines on Graviton, real-time agents on GPU, batch on Intel/AMD. Includes Bedrock vs. self-host crossover analysis, volume thresholds, and the architecture patterns to put the savings into practice.

summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 신뢰할 수 없는 코드를 안전하게 실행할 수 있도록 EC2에 격리된 샌드박스를 배포하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: AI agents write, execute, and iterate on code autonomously. Every session needs an isolated sandbox to run untrusted code safely. This session explores how customers deploy agent sandboxes on EC2 across distinct patterns, each offering different trade-offs between isolation, latency, and performance across our instance families. We cover isolation trade-offs, cost per sandbox-second, and capacity planning at scale. Attendees leave with a decision model for selecting the right pattern based on their scale, security posture, and operational maturity.

title_ko: Amazon Lightsail로 파트너 비즈니스 구축하기
summary_ko: Lightsail의 기능과 파트너들이 제공하는 대표 활용 사례를 살펴보며 파트너 비즈니스 구축 방안을 다룹니다.
abstract: Amazon Lightsail is a simple, low-cost cloud platform designed for small and medium business workloads. In this chalk talk, we start with an overview of what Lightsail offers and common use cases partners are delivering today. We then introduce the Lightsail Partner Program and the benefits available to partners who build their practice on Lightsail. Bring your scenarios. We'll work through partner economics, discuss real use cases, and how Lightsail helps partners tackle onboarding and scaling challenges. You'll leave with a clearer understanding of how to leverage Lightsail to build your partner business.

title: From hardware to application: new EC2 monitoring capabilities
title_ko: 하드웨어에서 애플리케이션까지: 새로운 EC2 모니터링 기능
summary_ko: 하드웨어, 인스턴스, 애플리케이션 계층 전반의 EC2 상태 모니터링과 새로운 기능을 다루는 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: This chalk talk covers EC2 health monitoring across hardware, instance, and application layers, including new functionality like EC2 Application Status Checks. Application Status Checks enable you to detect application health impairments by monitoring your applications via configurable paths and ports for HTTP/S. You will learn how to use EC2 health signals to build operational automation for your workloads and integrate these signals with Auto Scaling Groups and Kubernetes.

title: Democratizing precision time on EC2: make clocks work for you
title_ko: EC2 정밀 시간의 대중화: 시계를 제대로 활용하기
summary_ko: Amazon Time Sync 등 정밀 시간 기능으로 분산 시스템에서 벽시계 시간을 신뢰성 있게 활용하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Distributed systems builders have avoided relying on wall clock time for anything critical. Times are changing. Amazon Time Sync now delivers microsecond accuracy on EC2, making clock precision a feature, not a bug, in your system design. We whiteboard how customers in databases, AI, financial services, and media approach design in new ways, and share our open source ClockBound work on the clock error bound as a standard interface for your applications.

title: Growing role of CPUs in AI: Inference and agents AI on EC2
title_ko: AI에서 커지는 CPU의 역할: EC2의 추론과 에이전트 AI
summary_ko: 프로덕션 AI 시스템에서 CPU가 중요한 역할을 하는 두 가지 패턴인 추론과 에이전트를 EC2에서 살펴봅니다.
abstract: CPUs play a critical and growing role in production AI systems. This session explores two CPU-intensive AI patterns on EC2. First, AI inference: serving language model predictions at scale using Graviton and x86 instances, with real-world cost and latency tradeoffs. Second, agentic AI: running sandboxed environments where autonomous agents compile code, execute tools, and interact with external systems, requiring fast, isolated, ephemeral compute. We share production architectures, performance benchmarks across instance families, and practical guidance on matching your AI workload to the right EC2 CPU. Walk away with a decision framework for running AI beyond GPUs.

title: Accelerating semiconductor design, simulation and verification on AWS
title_ko: AWS에서 반도체 설계, 시뮬레이션, 검증 가속화하기
summary_ko: 프런트엔드 시뮬레이션과 백엔드 검증 등 반도체 설계 단계별로 적합한 인스턴스를 선택하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: EDA workflows demand different compute across frontend, backend, and production phases. This session covers how AWS EC2 instances map to each design phase. Learn how to select instances for throughput-heavy frontend simulation versus memory-intensive backend verification, and hear how ISVs are qualifying tools on AWS Graviton and other CPU processors to unlock better price-performance for chip design workload.

title: Compute innovation with the AWS Nitro System
title_ko: AWS Nitro System으로 이룬 컴퓨팅 혁신
summary_ko: AWS Nitro System이 EC2 인스턴스 구축 방식을 바꾸고 컴퓨팅 혁신 속도를 높인 과정을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: The AWS Nitro System has fundamentally changed how we build and deliver EC2 instances, accelerating our pace of compute innovation while improving security and performance for customers. This session explores the Nitro architecture and the latest innovations it enables: multi-host for smaller metal sizes, reduced blast radius, higher performance, how Nitro has helped us in accelerating the pace of innovation, and delivering Flex instances. We'll dive deep into how the Nitro System continues to push the boundaries of what's possible in cloud compute.

title: Maximize EKS efficiency: Auto Mode, Graviton, and Spot best practices
title_ko: EKS 효율 극대화: Auto Mode, Graviton, Spot 모범 사례
summary_ko: EKS Auto Mode, Graviton, Spot을 활용해 인프라 운영 부담을 줄이고 효율을 높이는 모범 사례를 다룹니다.
abstract: Achieving optimal compute efficiency on Amazon EKS demands more than choosing the right instance. It requires an intelligent infrastructure layer that continuously optimizes on your behalf. In this chalk talk, learn how teams use EKS Auto Mode to eliminate infrastructure toil with up to 40% faster node boot times, over 40% faster scale-out, and up to 70% faster consolidation. Discover how pairing Auto Mode with AWS Graviton5 (M9g, C9g) and EC2 Spot can reduce total cluster spend by up to 40%. You'll leave with actionable strategies for multi-architecture scheduling, right-sizing, and Spot diversification.

title: Maximize EKS efficiency: Auto Mode, Graviton, and Spot best practices
title_ko: EKS 효율 극대화: Auto Mode, Graviton, Spot 모범 사례
summary_ko: EKS Auto Mode, Graviton, Spot을 활용해 인프라 운영 부담을 줄이고 효율을 높이는 모범 사례를 다룹니다.

title: Choosing a game server instance without guessing
title_ko: 추측 없이 게임 서버 인스턴스 선택하기
summary_ko: 감에 의존하지 않고 자신의 게임에서 직접 측정한 지표로 게임 서버 인스턴스를 선택하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Most game studios pick server instances by vibes. This chalk talk replaces that with a number you measure on your game: cost per player at your tick rate. At the whiteboard we answer three questions: what does one tick cost, how many players fit, and what does a player cost? You’ll see how to time the whole tick in Unreal Engine and Unity, load a server with bots or thin clients against a failure rule set up front, and repeat across instances. Then we share what we measured on modern Amazon EC2 instances across AWS Graviton, AMD, and Intel: where clock speed pays, and where price decides.

title: Building optimized enterprise HPC systems for CAE and CFD
title_ko: CAE 및 CFD를 위한 최적화된 엔터프라이즈 HPC 시스템 구축
summary_ko: Amazon EC2 HPC 인스턴스로 비용, 대기 시간, 처리량을 최적화하는 엔터프라이즈 HPC 시스템 설계 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: High-fidelity Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations require significant compute infrastructure. We’ll discuss how organizations are migrating CAE and CFD workloads from on premises to AWS, combining scalable HPC infrastructure with cloud-native engineering applications to accelerate product development. Learn how to architect your enterprise HPC system to optimize cost, queue wait times, and throughput with Amazon EC2 HPC-optimized instances, Savings Plans, and Amazon FSx.

title: Drug discovery and materials use cases with Amazon Braket and Q-CTRL
title_ko: Amazon Braket과 Q-CTRL을 활용한 신약 개발 및 소재 사례
summary_ko: 강상관 전자 시뮬레이션과 NMR 스펙트럼 등 신약·소재 분야의 난제를 양자 컴퓨팅으로 접근하는 사례를 소개합니다.
abstract: Classically hard problems such as simulating strongly correlated electrons and 1D NMR spectra, critical to material and drug discovery, can be sped up on quantum computers but until now had not been demonstrated. Q-CTRL shows how Fire Opal on Amazon Braket enables simulating 1D NMR spectra for spin systems up to 34 qubits and achieved a 3,000x speedup on the Fermi-Hubbard model at 120 qubits, demonstrating practical quantum advantage. This chalk talk unpacks how AWS hybrid workflows enabled these outcomes and what enterprises should do now to capture ROI with quantum.

title: AI agents for HPC operations
title_ko: HPC 운영을 위한 AI 에이전트
summary_ko: AWS PCS와 AI 에이전트로 워크로드 배치를 자동화하고 장애를 탐지·복구하는 HPC 운영 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Managing HPC infrastructure shouldn’t slow down science and engineering. Learn how AI-powered agents with AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS) automate workload placement, detect and recover from failures, and simplify day-to-day cluster operations. Through practical examples, we’ll show how intelligent automation reduces operational overhead, improves resource utilization, and enables platform teams to spend less time managing infrastructure and more time supporting research and innovation.

title: Bringing better Amazon EC2 price performance to your pipeline with AWS Graviton
title_ko: AWS Graviton으로 파이프라인에 더 나은 EC2 가격 대비 성능 적용하기
summary_ko: 애플리케이션 포트폴리오를 프로파일링해 Arm64 전환 후보를 찾고 의존성을 점검하는 과정을 라이브로 보여주는 코드 토크입니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Which workload should move to AWS Graviton first? And what actually changes in your pipeline? In this code talk, we answer both live. We profile an application portfolio to find strong Arm64 candidates, check dependency and library compatibility, and update a working CI/CD pipeline to build multi-architecture container images for x86 and Arm64, so you see exactly what changes and why. Then we deploy the workload and run a side-by-side load test to compare price performance. You'll leave with a repeatable workload-selection checklist and pipeline patterns you can apply to your own AWS Graviton adoption with minimal disruption.

title: Bringing better Amazon EC2 price performance to your pipeline with AWS Graviton
title_ko: AWS Graviton으로 파이프라인에 더 나은 EC2 가격 대비 성능 적용하기
summary_ko: 애플리케이션 포트폴리오를 프로파일링해 Arm64 전환 후보를 찾고 의존성을 점검하는 과정을 라이브로 보여주는 코드 토크입니다.

title: Java to Graviton: three migration tools, one decision tree
title_ko: Java에서 Graviton으로: 세 가지 마이그레이션 도구와 하나의 의사결정 트리
summary_ko: AWS Transform 등 세 가지 도구로 Java 워크로드를 x86에서 Graviton으로 이전하는 방법과 도구 선택 기준을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Three tools belong in your toolbelt for moving Java from x86 to AWS Graviton. AWS Transform custom runs across hundreds of repos and integrates with CI/CD. The open-source Java skill runs locally in your coding agent, no AWS credentials needed, with final validation on Graviton hardware. The APerf MCP server measures x86 vs. Graviton performance before and after you migrate so you can rightsize. Each fits a different team size, repo count, and timeline. Watch all three run live on one codebase, see where each succeeds and hands off, and leave with a decision framework for when to use each.

title: Canva's migration to AWS Graviton: from 2% to 54% in 10 months
title_ko: Canva의 AWS Graviton 마이그레이션: 10개월 만에 2%에서 54%로
summary_ko: Canva가 대규모 컴퓨팅 플릿의 Graviton 비중을 10개월 만에 54%까지 끌어올린 마이그레이션 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Canva shifted its massive compute fleet from 2% to 23% Graviton adoption in just two months, then scaled to 54% over the following eight months, delivering meaningful cost savings and performance improvements along the way. This session covers the technical blockers the team encountered and overcame and the strategies that made rapid migration possible at enterprise scale. Walk away with practical, battle-tested patterns for planning and executing large-scale Arm migrations, whether you're just getting started or looking to accelerate an existing effort.

title: Building better quantum computers with digital twins
title_ko: 디지털 트윈으로 더 나은 양자 컴퓨터 만들기
summary_ko: 오류가 많은 현재 양자 하드웨어를 개선하기 위해 디지털 트윈을 활용하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Quantum computers could revolutionize fields like pharmacy and logistics, but today's hardware is too error-prone for practical use. To design better error-correction strategies, simulating how real quantum hardware operates is essential, yet computationally intractable. In this talk, we demonstrate quantum processor digital twins developed by Quantum Elements and powered by AWS HPC infrastructure - that faithfully mimic real hardware at experimental scale. Attendees will leave understanding why error correction matters and how classical compute accelerates the path to useful quantum computing.

title: Building better quantum computers with digital twins
title_ko: 디지털 트윈으로 더 나은 양자 컴퓨터 만들기
summary_ko: 오류가 많은 현재 양자 하드웨어를 개선하기 위해 디지털 트윈을 활용하는 방법을 다룹니다.

title: Your next Quantum developer might be an AI agent
title_ko: 다음 양자 개발자는 AI 에이전트일지도 모릅니다
summary_ko: AI가 양자 코드를 생성하고 하드웨어 인식 회로를 합성해 시뮬레이터와 QPU에서 벤치마크하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: AI is changing who can build quantum applications. See how AI assistants including Kiro, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Jupyter AI, and Classiq help developers move from natural-language prompts to optimized quantum workloads on Amazon Braket. Learn how AI generates code, synthesizes hardware-aware circuits, benchmarks on simulators and QPUs, and integrates with HPC resources. Through real examples, you'll see how AI-native workflows reduce complexity, accelerate experimentation, and make quantum development accessible to more builders.

title: PyTorch optimizations: Faster AI and lower costs with AWS Graviton
title_ko: PyTorch 최적화: AWS Graviton으로 더 빠른 AI와 더 낮은 비용
summary_ko: Arm 기반 하드웨어를 위한 최신 PyTorch 최적화와 Graviton에서 이를 최대한 활용하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Small language models are a great fit for CPUs: cheap to run, simple to deploy, and good enough for many real workloads. In this session we explore the latest PyTorch optimizations for Arm-based hardware and how to get the most out of them on AWS Graviton, from the kernel performance that decides inference speed to lower cost per token and more users per instance. We cover real benchmark results on live instances and what it looks like to run small models on Arm today. Whether you are tuning a model, sizing instances for production, or just curious about what the community has been shipping, come get a grounded view of where things stand.

title: Unlock cost efficiency with Graviton savings tools
title_ko: Graviton 절감 도구로 비용 효율성 확보하기
summary_ko: 최대 40% 향상된 가격 대비 성능을 제공하는 Graviton의 절감 효과를 플릿 전반에서 빠르게 찾아내는 도구를 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: While AWS Graviton delivers up to 40% better price-performance, uncovering those savings across your fleet shouldn't take weeks of manual analysis. Building a concrete migration plan for a specific environment is where teams get stuck. The Graviton Savings Dashboard is an Amazon Quick visualization of your Graviton usage, realized savings, and migration opportunities over time. The Graviton Savings Assessment is an open-source skill that any AI coding agent can run against your accounts to produce a prioritized migration roadmap on demand. This lightning talk demonstrates both tools against a real-world scenario, showing how to analyze compute usage, visualize potential savings, and turn efficiency insights into actionable migration plans you can use to accelerate your Graviton adoption.

title: Building zero-trust personal AI with EC2 confidential computing
title_ko: EC2 기밀 컴퓨팅으로 제로 트러스트 개인 AI 구축하기
summary_ko: Bee가 EC2 기밀 컴퓨팅으로 개인정보 보호를 암호학적으로 보장하는 개인 AI 어시스턴트를 구축한 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Learn how Bee built a personal AI assistant where privacy is cryptographically guaranteed - not policy-promised. Bee processes user data exclusively within hardware-isolated EC2 Confidential VMs powered by AWS Nitro, where no one - including Amazon - can access unencrypted data. We'll dive into NitroTPM attestation that lets devices verify server integrity before sharing keys, Sigstore transparency logs for auditability, mutual TLS with embedded attestation proofs, and key lifecycle management within encrypted VM memory. A practical blueprint for building zero-trust AI on Amazon EC2.

title: EC2 Spot: Capacity patterns and strategies from the team that runs it
title_ko: EC2 Spot: 운영 팀이 직접 전하는 용량 패턴과 전략
summary_ko: EC2 Spot 팀 엔지니어들이 내부에서 관찰한 용량 동작 방식과 효과적인 Spot 활용 전략을 공유합니다.
abstract: In this chalk talk, two engineers from the EC2 Spot team share what they see from the inside: how capacity behaves across regions, instance families, and time of day, including why Graviton-based Spot is consistently available and how seasonal patterns create predictable opportunities. Bring your Spot architecture questions. We'll whiteboard real diversification strategies, walk through anonymized examples from our most successful customers, and discuss what separates workloads that scale effortlessly on Spot from those that struggle.

title: EC2 Spot: Capacity patterns and strategies from the team that runs it
title_ko: EC2 Spot: 운영 팀이 직접 전하는 용량 패턴과 전략

title: Scaling EC2 Spot with a focus on capacity, GPUs, and allocation
title_ko: 용량, GPU, 할당에 초점을 맞춘 EC2 Spot 확장
summary_ko: EC2 Spot 제품 리더가 데이터로 입증된 다각화 전략과 GPU 및 할당 모범 사례를 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Today, organizations run ML training, inference, and large-scale simulations on Spot across CPU and GPU instance families. But scaling Spot successfully requires understanding how capacity actually behaves. In this session, the EC2 Spot product leader shares what the data reveals: which diversification strategies consistently deliver high fill rates, how allocation strategies differ for CPU vs. GPU workloads, and when tools like Spot Placement Score and EC2 Capacity Manager make the difference. You'll leave with a modern playbook covering instance diversification, multi-Region/AZ deployment, checkpointing for long-running jobs, and capacity rebalancing patterns the largest Spot customers use today.

title: Auto Scaling meets Capacity Reservations: Patterns that work
title_ko: Auto Scaling과 용량 예약의 만남: 효과적인 패턴
summary_ko: Auto Scaling과 용량 예약을 매끄럽게 함께 운영해 예약 활용도를 높이는 전략을 화이트보드로 설명합니다.
abstract: Capacity Reservations hold your instances. Auto Scaling right-sizes your fleet. Together, they give you both availability and cost efficiency. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard how to make them work seamlessly. We'll walk through strategies that keep reservation utilization high during scale-in, mixed-instance policies that balance cost and availability, and fallback patterns for Capacity Blocks transitions. Bring your scaling architecture and we'll work through it on the board.

title: Auto Scaling meets Capacity Reservations: Patterns that work
title_ko: Auto Scaling과 용량 예약의 만남: 효과적인 패턴
summary_ko: Auto Scaling과 용량 예약을 매끄럽게 함께 운영해 예약 활용도를 높이는 전략을 화이트보드로 설명합니다.

title: Best practices for scaling self-managed GPU workstations
title_ko: 자체 관리형 GPU 워크스테이션 확장 모범 사례
summary_ko: 부분 GPU부터 전체 GPU까지 사용자 페르소나에 맞게 EC2 G 인스턴스를 매칭하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Artists, engineers, and scientists need GPU-powered virtual workstations, but managing VDI at scale means navigating instance selection, capacity, and cost. In this chalk talk, learn how to match EC2 G instances to user personas, from fractional GPU for task workers to full GPU for power users running 3D modeling, compositing, or subsurface visualization. Explore the decision framework covering instance types, DCV streaming, storage, security, and fleet orchestration. Whether supporting a VFX render farm's artist desktops, an oil company's subsurface workstations, or an automotive design studio, leave with guidance balancing performance, cost, and simplicity.

title: Right Compute, right time, right price: A decision framework for HPC and AI at scale
title_ko: 적합한 컴퓨팅을 적시에 적정 가격으로: 대규모 HPC 및 AI를 위한 의사결정 프레임워크
summary_ko: 단일 인스턴스를 넘어 대규모 HPC·AI로 확장할 때 중요한 아키텍처와 프로비저닝 결정을 다룹니다.
abstract: Large-scale HPC and AI workloads share the same hard problem: getting the right compute, at the right time, at the right price. In this chalk talk, we cover the architecture and provisioning decisions that matter when you move beyond a single instance. Architecture side: cluster design for distributed AI training and tightly coupled HPC simulation, networking trade-offs and where CPUs (x86, Graviton) fit alongside GPUs in production pipelines. Provisioning side: Capacity Blocks for predictable GPU bursts, On-Demand Capacity Reservations for sustained workloads, Spot for fault-tolerant jobs, and Savings Plans for steady-state fleets. We share real customer examples leveraging Amazon EC2 across HPC and AI/ML. Bring your hardest capacity and cost questions.

title: Graviton5 for data workloads
title_ko: 데이터 워크로드를 위한 Graviton5
summary_ko: 데이터 접근·처리 속도가 병목인 데이터 워크로드에서 Graviton5가 성능을 높이는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Data workloads are bottlenecked by how fast they can access and process information — whether that data lives on local storage, in memory, or behind a lightweight service. New Graviton5 instance families are purpose-built for each tier.

title: Simplifying how you use AWS: automating common patterns on your behalf
title_ko: AWS 사용 간소화: 일반적인 패턴을 대신 자동화하기
summary_ko: AWS가 작성한 로직을 격리되고 기본적으로 안전한 환경에서 실행해 공통 작업을 자동화하는 새로운 접근 방식을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Getting the most out of AWS often means manually setting up the same optimizations, integrations, and best-practice patterns across your applications. What if AWS could handle more of that for you - automatically and securely - so you benefit from AWS capabilities without the setup overhead? In this chalk talk, we explore emerging approaches for running AWS-authored logic in isolated, secure-by-default environments alongside your applications, implementing common patterns on your behalf and simplifying how you consume AWS services. We'll whiteboard how this model works, where it fits in your architecture, and how it changes the effort required to adopt AWS best practices.

title: Everything you've wanted to know about performance on EC2 instances
title_ko: EC2 인스턴스 성능에 대해 알고 싶었던 모든 것
summary_ko: 최고의 컴퓨팅 성능을 끌어내기 위해 알아야 할 EC2의 저수준 세부 사항과 튜닝 방법을 폭넓게 다룹니다.
abstract: Getting the best compute performance is an art, and knowing low-level details helps a lot. This talk covers everything you've wanted to know: memory topology, accessing hardware counters, hyperthreading side-effects, and how to properly run performance tests and optimize your latency for production.

title: Everything you've wanted to know about performance on EC2 instances
title_ko: EC2 인스턴스 성능에 대해 알고 싶었던 모든 것
summary_ko: 최고의 컴퓨팅 성능을 끌어내기 위해 알아야 할 EC2의 저수준 세부 사항과 튜닝 방법을 폭넓게 다룹니다.
abstract: Getting the best compute performance is an art, and knowing low-level details helps a lot. This talk covers everything you've wanted to know: memory topology, accessing hardware counters, hyperthreading side-effects, and how to properly run performance tests and optimize your latency for production.

title: Build hybrid quantum-classical solutions for science and engineering on Amazon Braket
title_ko: Amazon Braket에서 과학·공학을 위한 하이브리드 양자-고전 솔루션 구축하기
summary_ko: Amazon Braket과 AWS PCS를 결합해 하이브리드 양자 컴퓨팅 솔루션을 구축하는 전문가 수준 워크숍입니다.
abstract: Take the next step into hybrid quantum computing. This expert-level workshop combines Amazon Braket and AWS Parallel Computing Service to build hybrid quantum-classical resources that enable scientific and engineering research in fields like physics and chemistry. You learn how to structure hybrid programs, manage classical resources, and interpret results from real quantum devices. Expect hands-on exercises, detailed guidance, and examples you can use as a foundation for your own projects.

title: Automating macOS at scale: AMI build, TCC, and provisioning on EC2 Mac
title_ko: 대규모 macOS 자동화: EC2 Mac에서 AMI 빌드, TCC, 프로비저닝
summary_ko: EC2 Mac 인스턴스를 프로덕션 준비 상태로 만들기 위한 AMI 빌드, TCC 권한, 프로비저닝 자동화를 다룹니다.
abstract: Automating macOS in the cloud brings challenges Linux and Windows don't. Going from a fresh EC2 Mac instance to a production-ready fleet means clearing non-obvious hurdles: building AMIs with EC2 Image Builder and Packer, pre-approving TCC permissions, bootstrapping Systems Manager, and working with Apple's security model. In this interactive chalk talk, we'll walk through the real friction points teams hit: image pipelines, the TCC dialog problem, remote access, MDM enrollment, and fleet provisioning. Bring your toughest macOS automation questions; most of the session is open Q&A.

title: Learn how to build a Genomics PCS pipeline on AWS
title_ko: AWS에서 유전체 분석 PCS 파이프라인 구축하기
summary_ko: Graviton과 GPU 혼합 플릿을 사용해 AWS PCS에서 실제 유전체 변이 호출 Slurm 파이프라인을 구축·실행합니다.
abstract: Build and run a real genomics variant-calling Slurm pipeline on AWS PCS using a mixed Graviton + GPU fleet. This session will cover PCS queue design, Slurm partition strategy, FSx for Lustre, and result aggregation to Amazon S3. By the end, you’ll create a reproducible, production-grade HPC workflow for life-sciences workloads.

title: Hands-on: Harden your AI agents with Nitro Confidential Computing
title_ko: 실습: Nitro 기밀 컴퓨팅으로 AI 에이전트 보안 강화하기
summary_ko: 에이전틱 AI 앱을 구축하고 공급망·자율성 위협을 식별해 Nitro 기밀 컴퓨팅으로 보호하는 워크숍입니다.
abstract: Agentic AI systems autonomously orchestrate tools, integrate third-party components, and make decisions, introducing risks from compromised dependencies and agents deviating from intended behavior. Protecting prompts, agent memory, retrieval context, and model weights requires strong isolation and verifiable trust. In this workshop, you will build agentic AI apps, identify threats from untrusted supply chains and uncontrolled autonomy, and mitigate them using AWS Confidential Computing on EC2 with cryptographic attestation, isolated execution, open weight models, and Amazon Bedrock.

title: From zero to HPC: Build production clusters with AWS PCS
title_ko: 제로에서 HPC까지: AWS PCS로 프로덕션 클러스터 구축하기
summary_ko: 설정 부담 없이 AWS Parallel Computing Service로 완전 관리형 HPC 컴퓨팅 환경을 구축하는 실습 세션입니다.
abstract: Master AWS Parallel Computing Service at re:Invent. Build fully managed compute environments with zero setup. This hands-on session covers job submission, resource optimization, and intuitive interfaces to accelerate workflows for researchers and engineers. Scale faster without the complexity.

title: Orchestrating Physical AI workloads on AWS: Compute and pipeline patterns
title_ko: AWS에서 피지컬 AI 워크로드 오케스트레이션: 컴퓨팅 및 파이프라인 패턴
summary_ko: AWS Batch 병렬 시뮬레이션과 Amazon EKS 등을 결합한 피지컬 AI 아키텍처 패턴을 화이트보드로 설명하는 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: Physical AI projects — robotics, autonomous systems, digital twins — require complex multi-stage pipelines spanning simulation, training, evaluation, and edge deployment. Each stage demands different compute and orchestration. In this chalk talk, we'll whiteboard architecture patterns combining AWS Batch for parallel simulation, Amazon EKS with Karpenter for heterogeneous GPU/Trainium training, and SageMaker Hyperpod showcasing managed resiliency. We'll compare when to use EKS vs. Batch vs. ParallelCluster, discuss cost optimization with Capacity Blocks and Spot, and solve attendee architectures live on the whiteboard.

title: Orchestrating Physical AI workloads on AWS: Compute and pipeline patterns
title_ko: AWS에서 피지컬 AI 워크로드 오케스트레이션: 컴퓨팅 및 파이프라인 패턴

title: The cloud holodeck: Stream NVIDIA Omniverse, scale headless sim on AWS
title_ko: 클라우드 홀로덱: AWS에서 NVIDIA Omniverse 스트리밍과 헤드리스 시뮬레이션 확장
summary_ko: RTX급 GPU가 필요한 인터랙티브 시뮬레이션과 대규모 렌더링을 AWS에서 NVIDIA Omniverse로 스트리밍·확장하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Interactive simulation needs RTX-class GPUs engineers lack; rendering millions of frames needs a fleet nobody wants to babysit. Amazon DCV streams a full NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim workstation from EC2 G instances to any browser, while AWS Batch runs the same scenes headless across GPU fleets for scale. The AWS Visual Asset Management System is the control plane: launching jobs, tracking runs, and versioning outputs. Walk through the architecture behind a cloud viewport and a thousand-run batch job.

title: Getting the capacity you need: EC2 Launch APIs and Intelligent Auto Scaling deep dive
title_ko: 필요한 용량 확보하기: EC2 Launch API와 지능형 Auto Scaling 심층 분석
summary_ko: 대상 추적, 예측 조정, 자동 튜닝으로 워크로드를 자동·지능적으로 확장하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Getting the right compute at the right time is a two-part challenge: launching instances effectively and scaling them intelligently. This deep dive covers both. First, we explore RunInstances—EC2's oldest and most important API—sharing launch best practices, how flexibility helps you get the capacity you need, and how EC2 Fleet incorporates advanced strategies into your calls. Then we go under the hood of EC2 Auto Scaling, and the intelligence that also scales DynamoDB, WorkSpaces, EMR, SageMaker AI, and Aurora. Learn how to use target tracking, predictive scaling, and auto-tuning to automatically and intelligently scale your workloads.

title: Getting the capacity you need: EC2 Launch APIs and Intelligent Auto Scaling deep dive
title_ko: 필요한 용량 확보하기: EC2 Launch API와 지능형 Auto Scaling 심층 분석
summary_ko: 대상 추적, 예측 조정, 자동 튜닝으로 워크로드를 자동·지능적으로 확장하는 방법을 배웁니다.

title: AI-driven optimizations for HPC configurations on AWS
title_ko: AWS에서 AI 기반 HPC 구성 최적화
summary_ko: 과거 워크로드 데이터로 최적의 HPC 구성을 예측하는 AWS의 AI 활용 방법과 의사결정 지원 방식을 소개합니다.
abstract: Choosing the right HPC configuration often requires extensive benchmarking across instance types, MPI implementations, core counts, and application-specific settings. Learn how AWS uses AI to predict optimal HPC configurations from historical workload data, helping engineers make informed decisions before launching large-scale jobs. We’ll cover the models behind these recommendations and demonstrate how AI reduces trial and error while improving performance, cost efficiency, and time to solution.

title: Aperf: An all-in-one tool for performance data collection and analysis
title_ko: Aperf: 성능 데이터 수집과 분석을 위한 올인원 도구
summary_ko: AWS가 만든 오픈소스 Aperf로 성능 디버깅 과정을 가속하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Aperf is an open-source project created by AWS to accelerate the performance debugging process by enabling experienced users to deep dive into extensive data and less experienced users to identify issues without specialized knowledge. During this session, we'll present its key features and run a demo showing the analysis workflow, from installation, data collection, and then analysis. Finally, we'll open the conversation to collect feedback and feature requests from the audience.

title: Nine Seconds to Zero: Protecting AWS from AI Agent Disasters
title_ko: 9초 만에 제로로: AI 에이전트 재해로부터 AWS 보호하기
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 일으킨 사고를 Amazon Bedrock으로 라이브 재현하고 각 실패 지점을 분석해 안전한 구조로 재구축합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: In April 2026, an AI coding agent deleted a company's entire production database in nine seconds, without being asked. The agent was confidently wrong and had the permissions to act on it. In this session, we recreate that incident live using Amazon Bedrock, walk through every failure in the chain, then rebuild the architecture with six hardening layers: Bedrock Guardrails, human approval gates, least-privilege IAM, deletion protection, isolated backups, and real-time monitoring. Walk away with a concrete checklist for designing AI-assisted systems that plan for when the AI is wrong, not just when it performs perfectly.

title: Rebuilding a Platform's Foundation on DynamoDB Streams and Lambda
title_ko: DynamoDB Streams와 Lambda로 플랫폼 기반 재구축하기
summary_ko: AWS Well-Architected 다섯 가지 원칙 전반의 공백을 이벤트 기반 아키텍처로 해소하며 플랫폼 기반을 재구축한 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Our platform had single points of failure baked into its original design. In this session, I walk through how we closed those gaps across all five AWS Well-Architected pillars: moving event-driven workloads onto DynamoDB Streams and Lambda, cutting costs through smarter data tiering, and building the observability needed to trust the new design under real operational pressure.

title: Context Over Code: Making AI-Native Development Work at Scale
title_ko: 코드보다 컨텍스트: AI 네이티브 개발을 대규모로 작동시키기
summary_ko: AI 코딩 어시스턴트 도입 후 드러난 진짜 문제인 컨텍스트 관리로 AI 네이티브 개발을 대규모로 정착시키는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: AI coding assistants generate code quickly, but that's not the problem most teams need solved. After rolling out an AI coding companion to 150+ engineers, we learned the real unlock was rethinking how we work, not how fast we type. This session covers our path from AI code companion to AI-Driven Development Lifecycle: building a Context Store with Bedrock Knowledge Bases and MCP to surface decades of institutional knowledge, implementing steering and verification patterns, and managing the organizational change that makes AI-native development stick. You'll leave with a framework for scaling AI beyond individual productivity.

title: The judgment gap: when Terraform scans clean but fails the audit
title_ko: 판단의 공백: Terraform 스캔은 통과했는데 감사에서 실패할 때
summary_ko: 규칙 기반 스캐너가 잡지 못하는 SOC 2 등 컴플라이언스 요건의 해석 공백을 메우는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Checkov, trivy, and Prowler check rules someone already wrote. SOC 2 CC6.1 is a sentence open to interpretation. Between them sits the judgment gap, where AI-generated Terraform for S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, and Lambda often lands. We map the gap on the whiteboard together: take real controls from SOC 2 and PCI DSS, set them against what scanner rules verify, and mark what is left over. Then we discuss what closes the remainder: better authoring-side skills, human review, multi-model review, or accepting the risk. Bring a control your team owns; we trace where its enforcement lives, or does not.

title: Lambda for every scale and workload shape
title_ko: 모든 규모와 워크로드 형태를 위한 Lambda
summary_ko: Honeycomb이 대규모 Lambda 기반 맵리듀스 백엔드를 운영하며 얻은 비용·성능 최적화 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Honeycomb spends millions of dollars a year on Lambda. Every cold query runs through a map-reduce backend that used to mean one tier, Lambda Functions, regardless of shape. We outgrew Lambda Functions, not Lambda: Managed Instances now absorbs steady-state baseline traffic at roughly 7.5x lower cost than Functions, MicroVMs takes spikes of load tolerating 1.5 seconds of added latency, and Functions still catches bursty spillover. We'll walk through the observability and benchmarks that drove each cutover, and the routing logic deciding which tier a query lands on before it executes. You'll learn how to scale your serverless workloads multiple orders of magnitude without linear cost.

title: Hidden trade-offs in distributed architectures
title_ko: 분산 아키텍처의 숨은 트레이드오프
summary_ko: 비동기 이벤트 기반 아키텍처를 설계할 때 간과하기 쉬운 세부 트레이드오프와 그 대응 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Asynchronous event-driven architectures enable loosely coupled, scalable, and resilient systems. But the devil is in the details, and hidden complexity emerges when components interact under real-world pressure. Consistency, latency, failure handling, and cost aren't determined by architecture diagrams but by the trade-offs behind the integration patterns and services you choose. Through a real-world case study using AWS Lambda, Amazon DynamoDB, DynamoDB Streams, and AWS Step Functions, you'll investigate unexpected system behavior and uncover the trade-offs behind it. You'll leave with a sharper intuition to see beyond cloud abstractions and make more intentional architectural decisions for resilient systems.

title: Why Enterprise RAG Fails: Document AI and  Ontology Patterns on AWS
title_ko: 엔터프라이즈 RAG가 실패하는 이유: AWS의 문서 AI와 온톨로지 패턴
summary_ko: RAG 실패의 실제 원인인 문서 처리 문제를 짚고 AWS에서 문서 AI와 온톨로지 패턴으로 해결하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Most teams blame embeddings, vector databases, or foundation models when RAG systems underperform. In practice, failures often originate earlier in the pipeline where business meaning is lost during document ingestion. This session explores production Document AI patterns on AWS, including layout-aware extraction, ontology-driven classification, semantic chunking, metadata enrichment, and retrieval optimization. Using financial services examples, we demonstrate how domain ontologies improve extraction accuracy, retrieval relevance, and explainability. Attendees will learn practical architecture patterns, implementation tradeoffs, and a framework for building scalable, trustworthy RAG systems for enterprise workloads.

title: What Building an SRE Agent Taught Us About Agents at Scale
title_ko: SRE 에이전트를 만들며 배운 대규모 에이전트 운영의 교훈
summary_ko: 수천 개 세션에 걸쳐 에이전트를 안전하고 저렴하게 운영하는 데 필요한 개발 노하우를 SRE 에이전트 구축 경험으로 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Orange Theater
abstract: Anyone can wire up an agent, but operating one safely and cheaply across thousands of sessions is where developer craft begins. Grounded in a production SRE agent we built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and the Strands Agents SDK, this session dissects engineering around agentic models: session isolation, context management, and least privilege identity. What broke, and how we fixed it: an agent with too much access, context bloat that wrecked cost, a crash during a tool call that forced durable recovery. You will see where architectures leak, how to evaluate on production traces, and tradeoffs behind resilient agent infrastructure.

title: A DevOps Approach to Recover at Scale from Disaster or Ransomware
title_ko: 재해나 랜섬웨어로부터 대규모로 복구하기 위한 DevOps 접근법
summary_ko: 리전 장애나 랜섬웨어 공격 후 클라우드 워크로드를 완전히 복구하기 위한 DevOps 기반 접근법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Recovering your cloud workload completely after a regional event or ransomware attack is not a checklist; it demands a culture of resilience that turns individual craft into reliable recovery. That culture is built through DevOps. Clear communication, team empowerment, and frequent experimentation and measurement are what separate teams that recover from teams that hope. This session covers the technical requirements for recovering cloud workloads at scale, and the DevOps practices that make those requirements actually work under pressure. You'll leave with practical knowledge to drive full recovery in the face of the worst disasters.

title: Your Users Aren't Waiting to Build AI Agents. Are You Ready?
title_ko: 사용자들은 AI 에이전트 구축을 기다리지 않습니다. 준비되셨나요?
summary_ko: 로우코드·비주얼 도구로 직접 AI 에이전트를 만드는 현업 사용자들을 지원하고 관리하기 위한 준비 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: The spreadsheet wizards and automation tinkerers in your organization are already reaching for low-code and visual builder tools to assemble AI agents on their own. Call it citizen agent building: either governance sprawl, or your fastest path to scale. This interactive chalk talk gives platform, security, and data leaders a reference pattern that puts low-code builders on top and Amazon Bedrock beneath, so the security, data residency, and governance enterprises need come from the foundation rather than from each agent. Amazon Bedrock makes governance possible; your architecture makes it the default.

title_ko: 사용자들은 AI 에이전트 구축을 기다리지 않습니다. 준비되셨나요?

title: Giving Your AI Agent a Wallet: The Architecture of Spend Control
title_ko: AI 에이전트에게 지갑 주기: 지출 통제 아키텍처
summary_ko: API, 데이터, 다른 에이전트에 비용을 지불하는 AI 에이전트를 안전하게 운영하기 위한 지출 통제 아키텍처를 다룹니다.
abstract: AI agents can now hold a wallet and pay for APIs, data, and even other agents. The demo takes a few hours; making it safe to ship takes much longer. At the whiteboard, using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments, x402 micropayments, and Cedar policy, we design an agent that spends under a hard budget, then break it together. We work through where guardrails belong, why session limits aren't enough, custodial versus non-custodial tradeoffs, and human-in-the-loop without human-in-the-way. Bring your edge cases. You leave with a reference architecture and a checklist for bounded agent autonomy.

title: Giving Your AI Agent a Wallet: The Architecture of Spend Control
title_ko: AI 에이전트에게 지갑 주기: 지출 통제 아키텍처
summary_ko: API, 데이터, 다른 에이전트에 비용을 지불하는 AI 에이전트를 안전하게 운영하기 위한 지출 통제 아키텍처를 다룹니다.
abstract: AI agents can now hold a wallet and pay for APIs, data, and even other agents. The demo takes a few hours; making it safe to ship takes much longer. At the whiteboard, using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments, x402 micropayments, and Cedar policy, we design an agent that spends under a hard budget, then break it together. We work through where guardrails belong, why session limits aren't enough, custodial versus non-custodial tradeoffs, and human-in-the-loop without human-in-the-way. Bring your edge cases. You leave with a reference architecture and a checklist for bounded agent autonomy.

title: Agentic commerce in production: multi-agent orchestration on AgentCore
title_ko: 프로덕션 에이전틱 커머스: AgentCore 기반 멀티 에이전트 오케스트레이션
summary_ko: 상담과 판매를 분리한 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 기반 프로덕션 멀티 에이전트 커머스 시스템을 소개합니다.
abstract: A single agent that both advises and sells gets fragile fast. This session shows a production multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Strands Agents, running for real Shopify merchants, where an orchestrator coordinates two specialists: a wellness advisor in a regulated domain and a commerce agent that owns decision and checkout. We walk the decisions that matter: orchestration topology, intent routing and handoffs, shared versus isolated memory across agents, where the action boundary and per-agent guardrails live, and the latency and token cost that coordination multiplies. A demo follows one conversation from advice to checkout. You leave with an orchestration pattern, and the code to implement it directly in your online store.

title: Beyond the GPU count: Engineering inference at scale
title_ko: GPU 개수를 넘어: 대규모 추론 엔지니어링
summary_ko: GPU 수량 외에 대규모 추론 성능과 비용을 좌우하는 엔지니어링 요소들을 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: You have enough GPUs in your server to cover your software requirements. But is that all you need to consider? In a world where everyone is fighting for GPUs, picking the wrong server type is one of the most expensive mistakes an engineering team makes at scale. This session shares lessons running GPU inference across AWS and bare metal connected privately. You'll see how EKS Hybrid Nodes provides a single scheduling plane, failure modes, and how to use AI to accelerate decisions without replacing engineering judgement. Leave with a cloud and bare metal architectural pattern and a GPU selection framework covering workload fit and server tradeoffs.

title: Beyond the Docs: Operating Scoped VPC Endpoints in Real Environments
title_ko: 문서를 넘어: 실제 환경에서 범위 지정 VPC 엔드포인트 운영하기
summary_ko: 단순해 보이는 범위 지정 VPC 엔드포인트 정책이 실제 프로덕션 트래픽에서 겪는 문제와 해법을 다루는 인터랙티브 칠크 토크입니다.
abstract: Scoped VPC endpoint policies look simple, until production traffic proves otherwise. In this interactive chalk talk, we'll walk through real-world failures we've encountered while deploying account- and org-scoped endpoint policies and trace the identity flows, auth chains, and hidden dependencies behind them. Together, we'll explore a key lesson: endpoint policies evaluate the request that's actually made, not the request you think you're making. Bring your questions and experiences as we whiteboard the assumptions that lead to outages and learn how to spot them before they impact production.

title: Think Beyond DevOps: SRE, SOC, and Compliance in One AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: DevOps를 넘어서: 하나의 AWS DevOps Agent로 SRE, SOC, 컴플라이언스 통합하기
summary_ko: AI로 릴리스가 빨라지는 환경에서 AWS DevOps Agent 하나로 SRE, 보안 위협 탐지, 컴플라이언스를 함께 다루는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: As AI speeds up releases, continuous security control assurance and detecting threats in millions of telemetry signals get harder. We transformed AWS DevOps Agent into one agent for SRE, SOC and compliance, effectively addressing AI-era cloud security challenges in production. With AWS Config Conformance Packs for compliance-as-code and security MCP for finding triage, it produces point-in-time compliance and well-architected assessments, and drives alarm-triggered agentic SOC investigations within a controlled agent space, automating responses and keeping human-in-the-loop on high-risk mitigations only. You'll learn the methodology to design an agentic compliance and SOC solution that ports seamlessly into your own environment.

title: Think Beyond DevOps: SRE, SOC, and Compliance in One AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: DevOps를 넘어서: 하나의 AWS DevOps Agent로 SRE, SOC, 컴플라이언스 통합하기
summary_ko: AI로 릴리스가 빨라지는 환경에서 AWS DevOps Agent 하나로 SRE, 보안 위협 탐지, 컴플라이언스를 함께 다루는 방법을 소개합니다.

title: Ship Reliable AI Agents with Strands Evaluation and AgentCore Evaluations
title_ko: Strands Evaluation과 AgentCore Evaluations로 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 에이전트 배포하기
summary_ko: 매번 달라질 수 있는 에이전트 동작을 Strands Evaluation과 AgentCore Evaluations로 테스트해 프로덕션 신뢰성을 확보합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Your AI agent works in demos, but can you trust it enough for production? How do you test behavior that can vary on every run, and catch regressions when prompts, models, tools, or workflows change? In this 300-level Code Talk, we'll turn real-world agent failure modes into representative test cases, evaluate both answers and actions, and add risk-based quality gates into CI/CD. Using Strands Evaluation and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations, you'll leave this session able to design and implement an evaluation pipeline tailored to your own agents, backed by a public reference implementation you can adapt.

title: KYC in 90 Seconds: Real-Time Onboarding with AgentCore
title_ko: 90초 KYC: AgentCore로 구현하는 실시간 고객 온보딩
summary_ko: AI 에이전트로 컴플라이언스를 유지하면서 은행 계좌 개설 KYC 절차를 수초 단위로 단축하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Opening a bank account should take seconds, not days. This session shows how AI agents can speed up KYC while keeping the final decision under control, specialized agents that run on Agentcore Harness investigate identity, documents, fraud signals, and screening results, with checks running in parallel. AgentCore Gateway routes tool requests through Cedar policies before tools run, while deterministic rules decide whether a case moves forward or needs human review. The session follows a clean case, an ambiguous case, and a new risk event after onboarding. Attendees leave with a pattern for regulated agentic systems.

title: Stop Rolling Back AI Agents: Production Patterns That Work
title_ko: AI 에이전트 롤백은 이제 그만: 효과적인 프로덕션 패턴
summary_ko: 많은 조직이 배포한 AI 에이전트를 롤백하는 현실을 짚고 프로덕션에서 안정적으로 운영하기 위한 패턴을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: The demo shipped. The agent went live. Then someone pulled it back. 74% of organizations that have deployed an AI agent have rolled it back or shut it down, and the rate rises to 81% among those reporting fully mature guardrails. Getting agents into production got easier. Keeping them there without hurting customers did not. We'll walk through the failure patterns behind rollbacks: agents that fail silently, prompts treated as safety boundaries, and monitoring blind to non-deterministic failures. You'll leave with the patterns that prevent them: infrastructure-level guardrails, blast radius containment, and observability built for probabilistic systems.

title: Lights, Camera, Fargate—A Reality-TV Startup Hardened for Scale on AWS
title_ko: 조명, 카메라, Fargate: AWS에서 대규모 확장을 위해 강화된 리얼리티 TV 스타트업
summary_ko: 코딩 리얼리티 쇼 The Full Stack에서 6주 만에 만든 DataSwarm을 Fargate로 확장 가능하게 강화한 과정을 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: In six weeks on reality TV coding show The Full Stack, we built DataSwarm — a data-observability solution shipped as an open-source CLI with cloud-hosted data analysis and remediation. Great demo, wrong architecture. When real users arrived, the demo cracked. So we pivoted. Long-running agents moved off Lambda onto ephemeral ECS Fargate tasks. API keys swapped for firewalled Amazon Bedrock, feature-branched CI/CD with dev-to-prod promotion, and Next.js behind CloudFront, S3, and Lambda@Edge. We break down each tradeoff from first idea to first customer. Leave knowing how to tell demo-grade architectures from customer-grade ones — and when to make the jump.

title: The Agent Harness You Own on AWS for Regulated Industries
title_ko: 규제 산업을 위해 AWS에서 직접 소유하는 에이전트 하네스
summary_ko: 규제 산업에서 통제·감사·방어 가능한 에이전트를 AgentCore의 기본 요소로 구축하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: In regulated industries the model is easy; the governable, auditable, defensible agent is hard. AgentCore ships primitives, but the governance harness you own on top is the real work. We build the rails it does not give you: a fail-closed, blocklist-first permission gate where deny beats a broad allow; a hash-chained audit verifiable off-cloud; and a RACI gate binding every action to a named human. Each maps onto a managed AWS primitive — Identity, Guardrails, Evaluations, Lambda MicroVMs for isolation — naming where the primitive ends and your code begins. You leave with the rails.

title: Eval-Driven LLM Routing: Cut Costs Without Losing Accuracy
title_ko: 평가 기반 LLM 라우팅: 정확도 손실 없이 비용 절감하기
summary_ko: 프로덕션 평가 데이터셋과 정확도 KPI를 바탕으로 비용을 줄이는 평가 기반 LLM 라우팅 시스템 구축 방법을 보여줍니다.
abstract: This session shows how to build an eval-driven LLM routing system: harvest a production eval dataset, define accuracy KPIs using LLM-as-judge, set a non-negotiable accuracy floor as the practitioner's decision, benchmark candidate models, and generate a routing policy optimized for cost within that floor. Result: approximately 80% cost reduction at maintained accuracy. A reference architecture you can start implementing immediately.

title: From Fragmented Infra to Golden Path: An Internal Developer Platform on EKS
title_ko: 분산된 인프라에서 골든 패스로: EKS 기반 내부 개발자 플랫폼
summary_ko: 팀마다 반복하던 클러스터·파이프라인·접근 관리를 EKS 기반 내부 개발자 플랫폼으로 표준화한 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Every team wanted to ship faster, but each was reinventing the same wheels: clusters, pipelines, infrastructure, access. So we built an internal developer platform on Amazon EKS — one golden path that lets product teams go from idea to running service without becoming Kubernetes experts. This is the honest story of that journey. We'll show how we used EKS as the foundation, Crossplane to provision cloud infrastructure through Kubernetes APIs, and Argo CD to drive everything through GitOps. We'll walk through the challenges that nearly derailed us and share what actually moved the needle. You'll leave with a realistic map of the terrain: what worked, what hurt, and what we'd do differently.

title: Pit Crew AI: Building Multi-Agent Cloud Operations on AWS
title_ko: 피트 크루 AI: AWS에서 멀티 에이전트 클라우드 운영 구축하기
summary_ko: 보안, 안정성, 비용 등 프로덕션 운영을 지속적으로 관리하는 멀티 에이전트 클라우드 운영 체계를 AWS에서 구축합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: AI can generate code at racing speed, but production workloads still require continuous attention to security, reliability, cost, and operational risks. In this Code Talk, we build a multi-agent architecture on AWS inspired by a Formula 1 pit crew. Using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents, MCP, GitHub, Jira, and Infrastructure as Code, we evolve from a single agent to a team of specialized agents for security, cost optimization, reliability, and observability. Through a live demonstration, you’ll see how agents turn cloud findings into engineering tasks. Attendees will leave with reusable architectures, orchestration patterns, and examples for cloud operations on AWS.

title: The agent orchestration spectrum: Agents, Step Functions, or Lambda?
title_ko: 에이전트 오케스트레이션 스펙트럼: 에이전트, Step Functions, 아니면 Lambda?
summary_ko: 오케스트레이션 방식이 사용자 경험에 미치는 영향을 에이전트, Step Functions, Lambda로 라이브 코딩하며 비교합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: "Orchestration mode matters more for end user experience than just model choice. In this live-coding session, I build the same GenAI workload three ways: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AWS Step Functions, and AWS Lambda durable functions - and show what each costs in latency, dollars, and debuggability on a production content platform. Leave with a reusable decision framework to match orchestration to your workload."

title: Observable Agents with Lambda Durable Functions and OpenTelemetry
title_ko: Lambda Durable Functions와 OpenTelemetry로 관측 가능한 에이전트 만들기
summary_ko: 장기 실행 에이전트 워크플로에서 깨지는 표준 관측성을 OpenTelemetry로 복원하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: When AI agents run as long-lived, multi-invocation workflows on Lambda Durable Functions, standard observability breaks down. A single durable execution spanning five specialists producing independent telemetry, replays pollute logs with duplicates, and no tool can tell you which agents are failing across thousands of concurrent runs. We'll build a multi-agent purchasing coordinator with Lambda durable functions, instrument it with the OpenTelemetry plugin for one coherent trace across all invocations, and CloudWatch insights to answer fleet-wide queries with business context. Attendees leave with fully observable architecture and the investigation pattern from CloudWatch alarm to end-to-end traces and correlated log entries.

title: Answering CX questions 10x faster with Amazon Connect Customer and Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Connect Customer와 Amazon Quick으로 CX 질문에 10배 빠르게 답하기
summary_ko: 교차 계정 Lake Formation 접근 처리 등 Connect Customer와 Quick으로 CX 분석 속도를 높인 구현 과정을 소개합니다.
abstract: Amazon Connect Customer generates a deep set of signals from every customer interaction. Sentiment, intent, conversation analytics, resolution outcomes. It's all there and Connect Customer gives you built-in tools to explore it. But we wanted to go further. We wanted anyone in the organization to ask questions about customer interactions in plain language and get answers instantly. So we paired Connect Customer's analytics data lake with Amazon Quick. In this session, we walk through how we did it, including how we handled cross-account Lake Formation access, and show how our broader team now asks questions and reshapes queries on the fly. 10x faster from question to action.

title: Autonomous Remediation with OpenTelemetry and DevOps Agent
title_ko: OpenTelemetry와 DevOps Agent를 활용한 자율 복구
summary_ko: 메트릭, 로그, 트레이스를 OpenTelemetry로 연결하고 DevOps Agent가 장애를 자율적으로 진단·복구하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: You instrumented everything. You have metrics, logs, and traces. And when production breaks a human still has to piece it together, tab by tab, signal by signal, under pressure. That is not an observability problem, it’s an automation problem. We'll show you an architecture on AWS that closes it. OpenTelemetry captures signals across EKS, ECS, and Lambda. AWS DevOps Agent runs the investigation, finds the root cause, and prepares the fix. By the time a human looks at it, the pull request is ready. Come learn the triggers, investigation loop, and guardrails you need before letting an agent touch production.
