title: 5 Amazon ECS features that prevent common production incidents
title_ko: 프로덕션 장애를 예방하는 Amazon ECS 기능 5가지
summary_ko: 흔한 프로덕션 장애를 예방하는 Amazon ECS 기능 5가지와 각 기능이 막아주는 장애 사례를 살펴봅니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Five configuration mistakes cause the majority of Amazon ECS production incidents. All five are fixable in under a minute. AZ spread off means one zone failure takes your service down. Short health check grace periods kill containers that are still starting. Disabled circuit breakers let bad deploys roll forward across every task. Default dependency timeouts turn one slow call into a cascading outage. Placement constraints pack tasks onto too few hosts. In this lightning talk, see the incident each feature prevents, the specific attribute to verify, and the fix. Leave with a production-readiness checklist your team can use before every release.

title: How Hertz Made Karpenter Smarter with autonomous AI-Driven Optimization (sponsored by Cast AI)
title_ko: Hertz가 자율 AI 기반 최적화로 Karpenter를 더 똑똑하게 만든 방법 (Cast AI 후원)
summary_ko: Hertz가 Cast AI 에이전트를 활용해 Karpenter 기반 Kubernetes 컴퓨팅을 자율적으로 최적화한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Hertz used Cast AI agents to make Karpenter much smarter: the agents autonomously analyze every workload, rightsize it, then continuously instruct Karpenter how to rearrange nodes to cut waste. Hertz's platform engineering team deployed this across their multi-cluster EKS fleet entirely through Terraform. Sonal will show the real numbers: where the extra savings hid, how infrastructure-as-code took onboarding from pre-dev to production, and what it takes to automate cost optimization at fleet scale without babysitting it. This presentation is brought to you by Cast AI, an AWS Partner.

title: Multi-tenant compute modernization with Amazon EMR on EKS
title_ko: Amazon EMR on EKS를 활용한 멀티테넌트 컴퓨팅 현대화
summary_ko: 조직이 Amazon EMR on EKS로 멀티테넌트 데이터 처리 컴퓨팅 환경을 현대화하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: What does it take to run millions of diverse jobs a day across many tenants without costs spiraling or one bad workload taking down the fleet? In this chalk talk, we explore how organizations modernize a multi-tenant compute layer on EMR on EKS to serve batch analytics, streaming and ML workloads on Spark from one platform. We whiteboard the choices that make it possible: bin packing to mix heterogeneous tenant workloads efficiently, EKS provisioned control planes to sustain high job throughput per cluster, and Graviton to drive down cost per job. Bring your scaling challenges and we’ll design solutions together

title: Multi-tenant SaaS and agentic apps on Amazon EKS
title_ko: Amazon EKS 기반 멀티테넌트 SaaS 및 에이전틱 앱
summary_ko: Amazon EKS에서 테넌트 격리를 적용한 멀티테넌트 AI 에이전트 배포 환경을 직접 구축합니다.
abstract: Amazon EKS has become the runtime of choice for ISVs building agentic SaaS, offering the control, workload isolation, and networking flexibility that managed runtimes cannot. The challenge is multi-tenancy: how do you run agent workloads for hundreds of tenants on shared infrastructure without blast radius, cost leakage, or isolation drift? In this workshop, build a multi-tenant agent deployment on EKS with tenant isolation across namespaces and network policies, IRSA-backed credentials per agent workload, and per-tenant observability via OpenTelemetry. Each lab ends with an isolation proof. Leave with a reference architecture you can apply directly to your cluster.

title: Eliminate wasted compute capacity with Amazon ECS
title_ko: Amazon ECS로 낭비되는 컴퓨팅 용량 제거하기
summary_ko: Amazon EC2에서 컨테이너를 운영할 때 발생하는 유휴 용량 비용을 Amazon ECS 기능으로 줄이는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Running containers on Amazon EC2 often means paying for capacity you never use, from idle instances to fleets that drift out of shape as workloads change. This chalk talk shows how Amazon ECS Managed Instances tackles that waste through consolidation and infrastructure optimization, automatically right sizing instances to real demand and repacking workloads off underutilized capacity. See how the Amazon ECS scheduler can bin pack workloads efficiently and the latest consolidation features non disruptively increase cluster utilization to reduce costs. We'll work through practical scenarios on the whiteboard to see how these decisions play out and how instance selection and capacity provider design shape your monthly bill. Bring the cost and utilization challenges from your own clusters, because this session is driven by group discussion.

title: Enhanced container image access & distribution with Amazon ECR
title_ko: Amazon ECR로 향상된 컨테이너 이미지 액세스 및 배포
summary_ko: ECR 제품 팀이 컨테이너 이미지 배포의 현재와 향후 방향, 그리고 향상된 액세스 기능을 공유합니다.
abstract: Amazon ECR is trusted by millions to store and serve container images, but the way teams discover, trust, and consume container software is evolving fast. In this session, the ECR product team shares where container distribution on AWS is heading: making it easier to find the software you need, trust what you run, acquire it simply, and pull it privately and securely inside your own environment. Through practical examples, we'll explore new capabilities that help publishers reach customers at scale and help organizations govern and consume containers with confidence. Whether you publish container software or run it in production, you'll leave with a clear picture of how ECR is becoming the center of the container software supply chain.

title: Intelligent, right-sized compute on Amazon EKS
title_ko: Amazon EKS의 지능형 적정 규모 컴퓨팅
summary_ko: Amazon EKS에서 낭비를 줄이고 활용률을 높여 컴퓨팅을 지능적으로 적정 규모화하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
abstract: Running Kubernetes at scale is a constant trade-off between performance, availability, and cost. This session covers the year's advances in Amazon EKS compute: faster node provisioning and consolidation, finer control over how and when your data plane changes, and new capabilities that match capacity to what workloads actually use rather than what they request. Whether you run Karpenter directly or fully managed EKS Auto Mode, you will see how to cut waste, raise utilization, and get more predictable efficiency for demanding CPU, GPU, and AI/ML workloads. Expect practical patterns and live demos you can apply to your own clusters.

title: Defense-in-Depth for Containers on Amazon EKS: A Layering Story
title_ko: Amazon EKS 컨테이너 심층 방어: 보안 계층의 진화
summary_ko: EKS 보안이 계층별로 어떻게 발전해 왔는지 따라가며 컨테이너 심층 방어 전략을 설명합니다.
abstract: On a default Amazon EKS cluster, a single pod is a compromise away from the whole cluster - shared node credentials, flat networking, implicit trust, open egress. In this code-first session we start there, then trace how EKS security grew layer by layer as the threat model matured. We rebuild an over-privileged workload live, adding one control at a time: scoped pod identity, admin and DNS network policies, and private certificate trust with zero-downtime CA rotation. We finish by running a lateral-movement attempt against the hardened workload and watching it fail at multiple layers — the whole point of defense-in-depth.

title: Accelerate platform engineering on Amazon EKS
title_ko: Amazon EKS로 플랫폼 엔지니어링 가속화
summary_ko: Amazon EKS에 허브 앤 스포크 아키텍처를 배포하고 개발자 셀프서비스를 구현해 플랫폼 엔지니어링을 가속합니다.
abstract: Build an Internal Developer Platform on Amazon EKS using managed capabilities — ArgoCD, AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK), and kro. In this hands-on workshop, deploy a hub-and-spoke architecture, enable developer self-service for cloud resources, and choose your delivery path: ship a polyglot application, or deploy AI agents as first-class Kubernetes resources with the Open Agentic Platform (model gateway, agent identity, and MCP tools). Implement progressive delivery with GitOps automation, and measure platform success with DORA metrics. Walk away with a production-ready blueprint featuring multi-environment promotions via Kargo and canary deployments with Argo Rollouts.

title: Accelerate platform engineering on Amazon EKS
title_ko: Amazon EKS로 플랫폼 엔지니어링 가속화
summary_ko: Amazon EKS에 허브 앤 스포크 아키텍처를 배포하고 개발자 셀프서비스를 구현해 플랫폼 엔지니어링을 가속합니다.
abstract: Build an Internal Developer Platform on Amazon EKS using managed capabilities — ArgoCD, AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK), and kro. In this hands-on workshop, deploy a hub-and-spoke architecture, enable developer self-service for cloud resources, and choose your delivery path: ship a polyglot application, or deploy AI agents as first-class Kubernetes resources with the Open Agentic Platform (model gateway, agent identity, and MCP tools). Implement progressive delivery with GitOps automation, and measure platform success with DORA metrics. Walk away with a production-ready blueprint featuring multi-environment promotions via Kargo and canary deployments with Argo Rollouts.

title: Amazon EKS: Infrastructure as code, GitOps, or CI/CD
title_ko: Amazon EKS: IaC, GitOps, 아니면 CI/CD?
summary_ko: Amazon EKS 환경에서 IaC, GitOps, CI/CD 기반 보안 소프트웨어 공급망 자동화 옵션을 비교합니다.
abstract: Explore diverse architectures for deploying workloads including agents on Amazon EKS. Learn about secure software supply chain automation options including CI/CD pipelines, IaC (using Terraform & CDK), and GitOps patterns with Argo CD. Discover how Amazon EKS Capabilities, a suite of fully-managed platform features for deployments and resource orchestration eliminate operational overhead for building on Kubernetes. You will understand how these approaches complement each other from developer, architect, and operator perspectives. Get insights on selecting the right deployment strategy based on team structure and skill sets, and learn how to effectively combine DevOps and GitOps patterns to match your needs.

title: Amazon EKS: Infrastructure as code, GitOps, or CI/CD
title_ko: Amazon EKS: IaC, GitOps, 아니면 CI/CD?
summary_ko: Amazon EKS 환경에서 IaC, GitOps, CI/CD 기반 보안 소프트웨어 공급망 자동화 옵션을 비교합니다.
abstract: Explore diverse architectures for deploying workloads including agents on Amazon EKS. Learn about secure software supply chain automation options including CI/CD pipelines, IaC (using Terraform & CDK), and GitOps patterns with Argo CD. Discover how Amazon EKS Capabilities, a suite of fully-managed platform features for deployments and resource orchestration eliminate operational overhead for building on Kubernetes. You will understand how these approaches complement each other from developer, architect, and operator perspectives. Get insights on selecting the right deployment strategy based on team structure and skill sets, and learn how to effectively combine DevOps and GitOps patterns to match your needs.

title: Cloud-native Java on Amazon EKS
title_ko: Amazon EKS 기반 클라우드 네이티브 Java
summary_ko: Amazon EKS에서 실행되는 클라우드 네이티브 Java 애플리케이션을 구축하고 최적화하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Learn how to build cloud-native Java applications based on best practices, and discover ways you can optimize application performance for fast startup and efficient resource usage in containerized environments. In this builders’ session, gain hands-on experience as you learn how to reduce memory overhead, lower cold start latency, and achieve sub-second startup times when building Java applications on Amazon EKS. You will also learn how to use Amazon Bedrock to analyze profiling and thread dump data to uncover performance patterns and generate optimization insights.

title: Optimize analytics workloads on Amazon EKS for performance and cost
title_ko: Amazon EKS 분석 워크로드의 성능 및 비용 최적화
summary_ko: Spark 등 분석 워크로드를 위해 Amazon EKS의 성능과 비용을 최적화하는 방법을 실습으로 배웁니다.
abstract: The analytics landscape is undergoing a shift as global data volumes grow at unprecedented rates. This rapid growth, combined with rising demand for real-time analytics, is driving organizations to modernize and optimize their data processing pipelines and analytics workloads. EKS’s cost-performance and scalability make it the best place to run these workloads. In this workshop, you will learn hands-on how to optimize EKS for Spark & Kafka workloads using different Karpenter configurations, Spot and Graviton instances, and NVMe volumes. You will also explore observability best practices and granular cost visualization per job. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: Inside Amazon EKS: the resilient foundation for critical workloads
title_ko: Amazon EKS 내부: 핵심 워크로드를 위한 복원력 있는 기반
summary_ko: EKS Auto Mode와 Application Recovery Controller 통합 등 핵심 워크로드를 지탱하는 EKS의 복원력 구조를 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Real-time financial systems, large-scale AI, and mission-critical platforms run on Kubernetes, and they demand a robust engineering foundation. This session goes under the hood of what makes Amazon EKS the backbone for the most demanding workloads. See how cellular isolation contains blast radius and EKS Provisioned Control Planes eliminate downtime during peak operational periods, backed by an industry-leading SLA as clusters scale into large fleets. Learn how EKS Auto Mode integrates with Application Recovery Controller zonal shift to protect the control plane and running pods during an impaired Availability Zone, keeping critical applications available with no extra configuration.

title: ML, automotive, and robotics simulations at scale on AWS Batch
title_ko: AWS Batch로 ML, 자동차, 로보틱스 시뮬레이션을 대규모로 실행
summary_ko: AWS Batch로 대규모 시뮬레이션을 실행하고 결과를 공유 데이터 레이크로 흘려보내는 아키텍처를 배웁니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Simulation and ML workloads share a hard problem: they must burst to enormous scale, run to completion reliably, and do it without a standing fleet draining budget between runs. This session shows how AWS Batch orchestrates large-scale simulation and training pipelines end to end. See how AWS Batch schedules and scales compute on demand, so jobs run when needed and nothing sits idle otherwise. Learn how simulation outputs flow through a shared data lake into GPU-accelerated training, closing the loop between data and models. Discover the orchestration and scheduling patterns that keep a real customer's high-throughput pipeline efficient.

title: Deep dive into networking architectures for Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes
title_ko: Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes 네트워킹 아키텍처 심층 분석
summary_ko: 인터랙티브 칠크 토크에서 Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes를 위한 하이브리드 네트워킹 아키텍처를 깊이 탐구합니다.
abstract: Join this interactive chalk talk to explore hybrid networking design patterns for Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes. We’ll cover different IPAM and routing strategies for hybrid pod networks, including Cilium BGP control-plane integration with your on-premises infrastructures. We’ll also explore various load balancing and Kubernetes services networking options for your hybrid nodes. Additionally, we’ll deep dive into the new Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes gateway, demonstrating how it simplifies pod-to-pod communication, webhook connectivity, and AWS service integration across cloud and on-premises environments - without requiring changes to your existing network infrastructure.

title: Deep dive into networking architectures for Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes
title_ko: Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes 네트워킹 아키텍처 심층 분석
summary_ko: 인터랙티브 칠크 토크에서 Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes를 위한 하이브리드 네트워킹 아키텍처를 깊이 탐구합니다.
abstract: Join this interactive chalk talk to explore hybrid networking design patterns for Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes. We’ll cover different IPAM and routing strategies for hybrid pod networks, including Cilium BGP control-plane integration with your on-premises infrastructures. We’ll also explore various load balancing and Kubernetes services networking options for your hybrid nodes. Additionally, we’ll deep dive into the new Amazon EKS Hybrid Nodes gateway, demonstrating how it simplifies pod-to-pod communication, webhook connectivity, and AWS service integration across cloud and on-premises environments - without requiring changes to your existing network infrastructure.

title: Scale, optimize and deploy inference with Karpenter and EKS Auto Mode
title_ko: Karpenter와 EKS Auto Mode로 추론 확장, 최적화 및 배포
summary_ko: 활용률을 높게 유지하는 NodePool과 중단 설정 등 Karpenter와 EKS Auto Mode 기반 추론 운영 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Accelerated workloads make node provisioning challenging. Picking the wrong instance, scheduling constraint, or disruption policy impacts GPU utilization and drives up costs. This deep dive covers how Amazon EKS provisions and scales accelerated compute for real inference workloads, whether you run managed Auto Mode or self-managed Karpenter. See how both select across GPU and accelerator families and honor topology-aware scheduling. Learn the NodePool and disruption settings that keep utilization high without hurting latency-sensitive serving. Discover how Dynamic Resource Allocation and GPU sharing squeeze more inference out of every device, plus accelerator-aware node repair that keeps long-running jobs healthy.

title: Breaking down batch inference with Ray Data on Amazon EKS
title_ko: Amazon EKS에서 Ray Data로 배치 추론 분석하기
summary_ko: Amazon EKS에서 Ray Data를 활용한 엔드투엔드 배치 추론 아키텍처를 함께 구축합니다.
abstract: Batch inference is more than running a model over a large dataset. In this interactive chalk talk, we build an end-to-end batch inference architecture on Amazon EKS one component at a time. We examine when to use Spark with Ray Serve and when Ray Data can unify preprocessing and inference. Along the way, we address data sharding, storage and data movement, GPU scheduling, autoscaling, batch sizing, checkpointing, retries, observability, security, isolation, and cost. Attendees will leave with a practical decision framework and a production architecture for operating reliable, scalable batch inference with Ray Data and the KubeRay Operator.

title: Scale financial Risk and Quant Research with AWS Batch and Amazon ECS
title_ko: AWS Batch와 Amazon ECS로 금융 리스크 및 퀀트 리서치 확장
summary_ko: AWS Batch와 Amazon ECS로 퀀트 리서치와 리스크 계산을 대규모로 실행하는 프로덕션 아키텍처를 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Financial institutions run millions of simulations overnight to price options, stress-test portfolios, and satisfy regulators. Scaling those workloads means balancing queue depth against compute cost. AWS Batch on Amazon ECS eliminates that tradeoff — containers scale elastically, Spot instances cut compute cost, and job orchestration handles retries and memory tuning without custom scripts. In this chalk talk, walk through a production architecture where a quantitative hedge fund runs its entire research compute on AWS Batch. Then open the whiteboard and discuss how to apply these patterns to your own pricing engines, VaR calculations, or scenario analysis workloads.

title: Customize and serve models at scale on Amazon EKS
title_ko: Amazon EKS에서 대규모로 모델 커스터마이징 및 서빙
summary_ko: Amazon EKS에서 모델을 커스터마이징하고 프로덕션 규모로 서빙할 때의 복잡성을 해결하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Serving and customizing models in production often involves running expensive GPUs at high utilization, maintaining low latency as traffic spikes, and scaling to demand without over-provisioning. Increasingly teams are doing it on Amazon EKS. This session covers how to efficiently run GPU workloads, select the right accelerator for each workload, and apply optimization techniques that increase utilization and lower costs. Explore model customization through fine-tuning and RAG, and serving and autoscaling patterns that keep inference fast and efficient. See how hybrid workloads span cloud and on-premises GPUs with EKS Hybrid Nodes and where AWS is investing next.

title: Move Fast With AI Agents Without Betting the Business (sponsored by MontyCloud)
title_ko: 비즈니스를 걸지 않고 AI 에이전트로 빠르게 움직이기 (MontyCloud 후원)
summary_ko: 거버넌스가 적용된 워크플로를 가치 단위로 삼아 위험 없이 AI 에이전트를 빠르게 도입하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: You are under pressure to put AI agents to work fast, without betting the business. Everyone is racing to build agents, but no one is governing them. MontyCloud is an AI-native, autonomous CloudOps platform built on one conviction. As agents become easy to create, value moves to trusted execution. Walk away with a blueprint for turning insights into governed workflows, and governed workflows into trusted outcomes. See a live demo where any agent, model, or tool acts only with the right context, identity, policy, approvals, and cost controls. Learn why the unit of value is the governed workflow. This presentation is brought to you by MontyCloud, an AWS Partner.

title: Enterprise-Grade Outcomes. Within Reach for Growing Businesses. (sponsored by Accenture)
title_ko: 성장 기업도 손에 넣을 수 있는 엔터프라이즈급 성과 (Accenture 후원)
summary_ko: Accenture Edge for AWS가 성장 중인 기업이 엔터프라이즈급 클라우드 성과를 내도록 돕는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Discover how Accenture Edge for AWS helps growing organizations (under $3B in annual revenue) achieve the same transformative outcomes as larger enterprises through pre-built, outcome-driven solutions designed for speed, simplicity, and value. We are taking enterprise-grade talent and tools and making them accessible and approachable. Translation: Big outcomes at lower costs thanks to pre-configured solutions. Hear real examples of customers that accelerated cloud adoption, reduced costs, strengthened security, and modernized faster with Accenture and AWS. This presentation is brought to you by Accenture, an AWS Partner.

title: Accelerating cost optimization on AWS
title_ko: AWS 비용 최적화 가속화
summary_ko: AWS에서 비용 최적화 성과를 더 빠르게 달성하기 위한 도구와 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Finding and implementing cost optimization recommendations sustainably require constant monitoring and action. Join this session to learn how you can accelerate your optimization outcomes while maintaining flexibility in how savings are distributed across your organization. See how you can also measure, share and continuously improve your results.

title: Autonomous operations: reducing MTTR at scale, feat. BMG Bank
title_ko: 자율 운영: 대규모 MTTR 단축 (BMG Bank 사례)
summary_ko: BMG Bank 사례를 통해 AWS DevOps Agent가 이벤트를 자동 조사해 대규모 환경의 MTTR을 줄인 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Operations teams face a growing volume of production incidents, but investigating root cause manually is slow and doesn't scale. At Banco BMG, one of Brazil's most established financial institutions with more than 9 million customers, roughly 350 operational events occurred daily, each investigation taking hours. In this lightning talk, see how AWS DevOps Agent began investigating these events autonomously, reducing root cause identification from hours to minutes. Learn to integrate the agent with your observability tools, correlate telemetry, logs, and code, and turn every investigation into compounding efficiency that lowers MTTR.

title: How 2 Billion Records Became One Data Product at Verisk (sponsored by Senzing)
title_ko: Verisk에서 20억 건의 레코드가 하나의 데이터 제품이 된 방법 (Senzing 후원)
summary_ko: Verisk가 Senzing 엔터티 해석으로 20억 건의 레코드를 통합된 보험 데이터 제품으로 만든 사례를 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Every insurance data product, underwriting or claims, hinges on one question: is this the same person or organization across systems? Verisk answers it once, at scale, treating the answer as a data product. This session unpacks how Verisk used AI-powered entity resolution on AWS to turn fragmented, siloed, acquisition-inherited data into one reusable identity asset, a proprietary entity ID appended across policies, claims, and enrichment data, not another MDM project. A five-person team built this across 2 billion records and 400 million identities with sub-second response. That data commands premium value, and identity became infrastructure, not a cleanup project. This presentation is brought to you by Senzing, an AWS Partner.

title: From Workloads to Agents: Rethinking Cloud Resilience (sponsored by Cohesity)
title_ko: 워크로드에서 에이전트로: 클라우드 복원력 다시 생각하기 (Cohesity 후원)
summary_ko: HUB International의 경험을 바탕으로 AI 에이전트 시대에 맞는 클라우드 데이터 복원력 전략을 재조명합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: Under the shared responsibility model, you own the security and recoverability of your entire cloud estate - and that estate now includes AI agents. In this session, HUB International will share their experiences.​ Agents are becoming core infrastructure, executing actions across interconnected systems at machine speed. Yet most organizations can't recover agent memory, credentials, or configurations any better than they could recover a corrupted server a decade ago. Join us to see how Cohesity's resilience platform extends AWS-native protections to agents and infrastructure alike, so risk doesn't outrun your ability to recover. This presentation is brought to you by Cohesity, an AWS Partner.

title: Give Your Best Engineers Back to the Roadmap, Not the Pager (sponsored by NeuBird)
title_ko: 최고의 엔지니어를 호출기가 아닌 로드맵에 돌려주세요 (NeuBird 후원)
summary_ko: 엔지니어링 시간의 40%를 차지하는 장애 대응을 AI로 줄여 엔지니어가 제품 개발에 집중하게 하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Forty percent of engineering time goes to firefighting instead of the roadmap you funded. The problem isn’t a lack of dashboards or headcount, it’s that these engineers are forced to act as the glue across these fragmented tools. Between incidents, an autonomous Production Ops Agent keeps working. It deepens its model of your environment, right sizes observability spend, and turns every incident into a captured fix nobody has to relearn. This session shows how NeuBird AI has helped teams recover 200 plus engineering hours a month and cut incident costs 60 percent or more, not by hiring more people or buying more dashboards, but by giving one agent the job of running production so your senior engineers can go back to building it. This presentation is brought to you by NeuBird, an AWS Partner.

title: From AI-Assisted Engineering to Autonomous Operations (sponsored by Dynatrace)
title_ko: AI 지원 엔지니어링에서 자율 운영으로 (Dynatrace 후원)
summary_ko: 선도 기업들이 실시간 데이터와 AI를 활용해 AI 지원 엔지니어링에서 자율 운영으로 나아가는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: As enterprise AI matures, the opportunity extends far beyond software development. Join United Airlines, AWS, and Dynatrace to discover how insights powered by AI, full stack cloud observability, and runtime intelligence are helping engineering and operations teams improve reliability, accelerate delivery, and reduce operational complexity. Learn how leading organizations are using real-time data to automate investigations, predict issues before customer impact, and move toward autonomous operations. The session will cover real-world adoption lessons, AI governance considerations, and practical steps to balance automation with accountability while unlocking greater value from AI across the software lifecycle at scale. This presentation is brought to you by Dynatrace, an AWS Partner.

title: Manage cloud costs and AI spend with AWS Cost Management
title_ko: AWS Cost Management로 클라우드 비용과 AI 지출 관리하기
summary_ko: AI가 팀의 클라우드 비용 관리를 돕는 방식과 AWS Cost Management로 AI 지출을 관리하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Join this breakout to learn how AI is helping teams manage cloud costs more effectively, and why managing the cost of AI itself is becoming just as important. We cover AWS FinOps enhancements across both dimensions. On the "AI for FinOps" side, learn how your team can operate more efficiently through automation and agentic workflows. On the "FinOps for AI" side, see how you can access and manage your AI spend with granular cost data and governance. Walk away with a repeatable governance model as you scale AI with confidence.

title: Stop fighting fires: operations that prevent incidents
title_ko: 불끄기는 그만: 인시던트를 예방하는 운영
summary_ko: 단순 지표를 넘어 적절한 운영 신호를 수집하고 장애를 사전에 예방하는 운영 방식을 배웁니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: The best incident is the one that never happens, yet most teams stay stuck firefighting. Learn to collect the right operational signals beyond just observability and use AI to spot problems before they page anyone. We'll cover auto-healing and remediation with traditional techniques and AI agents that catch misconfiguration before production. You'll discover how early-warning systems spot issues before customers do, and how agentic investigation turns past incidents into ranked recommendations that prevent future ones. Walk away with actionable steps to start building proactive operations.

title: Best practices for agentic-driven operations
title_ko: 에이전트 기반 운영의 모범 사례
summary_ko: 에이전트가 텔레메트리를 추론하고 조치를 순서대로 수행하는 방식 등 에이전트 기반 운영의 모범 사례를 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: AI agents are moving from assistants to operators, but how do they actually work within your operational workflows? Understand the architecture of agents that detect anomalies, diagnose root cause across distributed systems, and execute remediation like rollbacks, scaling, and traffic shifts. Learn how agents reason over telemetry, sequence actions, and determine when to escalate. Explore best practices for shaping agent behavior through guardrails, approval gates, and feedback loops as core design elements. Leave with a framework for evaluating where agents should act autonomously versus where human judgment remains essential.

title: Improving operations with agentic AI
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI로 운영 개선하기
summary_ko: 에이전틱 AI가 관측성 도구 전반에 걸쳐 작동하며 운영 효율을 높이는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Your operational telemetry is growing faster than your team. Learn how agentic AI can work across your observability stack, correlating metrics, logs, and traces to detect issues, identify root cause, and initiate remediation without waiting for a human to connect the dots. Explore patterns for agents that triage alerts, reduce noise, surface actionable insights, and execute operational runbooks. See how to integrate agents into your monitoring and incident response workflows, from signal detection through resolution. Leave with practical approaches to reduce mean time to recovery, eliminate repetitive toil, and give your team time to focus on reliability improvements that matter.

title: Observability and operations in the AI era
title_ko: AI 시대의 관측성과 운영
summary_ko: 생성형 AI가 깨뜨린 기존 모니터링의 전제를 짚고 AI 시대에 맞는 관측성과 운영 방식을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Generative AI broke the assumptions traditional monitoring was built on, and teams struggle to keep non-deterministic systems predictable, explainable, and affordable. This session opens on that challenge, then shows how the newest observability capabilities give you visibility into model quality, cost, and agent behavior across your AI stack, using traces, spans, and confidence scoring, illustrated with real customer patterns.

title: Turn security logs into actionable intelligence
title_ko: 보안 로그를 실행 가능한 인텔리전스로 전환하기
summary_ko: CloudTrail, S3 액세스 로그 등 원시 보안 텔레메트리를 실행 가능한 보안 인사이트로 전환하는 방법을 실습합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Security teams drown in logs but struggle to investigate fast. In this hands-on session, turn raw security telemetry from CloudTrail, S3 access logs, and VPC flow logs into actionable intelligence with Amazon CloudWatch. We'll centralize logs in the CloudWatch Unified Data Store, then query across sources to investigate real scenarios: after-hours data access, credential misuse, and exfiltration patterns. You'll build a security dashboard that surfaces who did what, from where, and when. Walk away with reusable queries and dashboards you can deploy in your own accounts, moving from reactive log search to proactive security visibility.

title: Cut through Kubernetes signal overload with unified observability
title_ko: 통합 관측성으로 Kubernetes 신호 과부하 해소하기
summary_ko: EKS 클러스터의 OpenTelemetry 지표와 로그를 통합 관측성 환경으로 보내 신호 과부하를 줄이는 방법을 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Kubernetes at scale buries teams in high-cardinality signals that traditional pipelines truncate or split across separate backends, so the answer you need is never in one place. In this hands-on builders session, you send OpenTelemetry metrics and logs from an EKS cluster into Amazon CloudWatch, deploy Container Insights, and decide which signals actually matter. You use automatic resource enrichment to build your own dashboards and alerts, deciding what to alert on and why rather than running pre-made scripts. You leave knowing how to cut through high-cardinality noise and set up alerts that drive action.

title: Keep your open source observability, move to managed scale
title_ko: 오픈소스 관측성은 유지하고 관리형 규모로 이전하기
summary_ko: 기존 오픈소스 관측성 도구의 계측과 수집 방식을 유지하면서 AWS 관리형 서비스로 확장하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Teams standardized on Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenSearch should not have to abandon their tools to get scale and lower operational overhead. In this hands-on builders session, you will learn about instrumentation and collection powered by OpenTelemetry, and explore that telemetry into managed open source services: ship metrics to PromQL in Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, logs and traces in Amazon OpenSearch Service, and correlate all signals in Amazon Managed Grafana. Own your telemetry pipelines end-to-end with open standards and AWS managed services.

title: Turn raw telemetry into answers with OpenTelemetry
title_ko: OpenTelemetry로 원시 텔레메트리를 답으로 바꾸기
summary_ko: 지표, 로그, 트레이스에 OpenTelemetry를 설정해 원시 텔레메트리에서 운영상의 답을 얻는 방법을 실습합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: Raw telemetry arrives noisy, unlabeled, and hard to query, so teams waste time cleaning data before they can act. In this hands-on builders session, you set up OpenTelemetry for metrics, logs, and traces from a live sample application, then use Amazon CloudWatch pipeline processors to enrich and normalize the data in flight. You build the enrichment rules, explore results with natural language query, and leave with a reusable pattern for turning raw signals into analysis-ready telemetry.

title: I didn't know my AI agent was doing that!
title_ko: 내 AI 에이전트가 그런 일을 하는 줄 몰랐어요!
summary_ko: Amazon CloudWatch로 실행 중인 AI 에이전트의 동작을 관측하고 예상치 못한 행동을 찾아내는 방법을 실습합니다.
abstract: AI agents are non-deterministic - they can burn tokens, stall, or drift into wrong behaviour with no warning, and teams often have no visibility until something breaks. In this hands-on builders session, you will use Amazon CloudWatch to observe live agents from both the console and your IDE: trace what an agent actually did, spot failures, and surface anomalous behaviour. Working with real agents - a production agent and a custom chatbot - you build the detection and alerting yourself and leave able to apply it to the agents you run in production.

room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Security teams cannot manually hunt through every log for the one event that matters, and threats move faster than analysts can query. In this hands-on builders session, you will build automated detection and response on your security telemetry: metric filters and anomaly detectors that flag suspicious activity, findings routed to alarms that page the right people, and automated remediation that acts before an analyst logs in. After tuning detections to cut false positives, walk away with a pipeline that watches your logs so your team does not have to.

title: FinOps for AI: Cost allocation strategies for Amazon Bedrock
title_ko: AI를 위한 FinOps: Amazon Bedrock 비용 할당 전략
summary_ko: 최신 비용 관리 기능을 활용해 Amazon Bedrock 사용 비용을 팀과 워크로드별로 할당하는 방법을 실습합니다.
abstract: As AI adoption accelerates, organizations need visibility into who is consuming Amazon Bedrock resources and how spend maps to business outcomes. In this builders' session, you'll get hands on with the latest cost management capabilities for Amazon Bedrock. You'll tag API calls for granular cost attribution, set real-time budgets to control Gen AI spend, and track costs as they happen in the Billing and Cost Management console. You'll then query new product metadata in CUR2 and visualize cost-per-million-token trends in CUDOS. Walk away with a practical framework for aligning AI spend to business outcomes.

title: Embed FinOps into your CI/CD pipelines
title_ko: CI/CD 파이프라인에 FinOps 내재화하기
summary_ko: 인프라 변경으로 인한 비용 초과를 CI/CD 파이프라인 단계에서 미리 감지하고 통제하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: Cost overruns from infrastructure changes often go undetected until after deployment, making shift-left cost governance a critical capability for platform and DevOps engineers. This builders' session guides attendees through constructing a working cost estimation gate integrated directly into a CI/CD pipeline. Using AWS CodePipeline, the AWS Pricing Calculator, and CloudFormation change sets, attendees build a pipeline stage that evaluates infrastructure cost impact at pull request time and enforces configurable spend thresholds before deployment proceeds. Bring a laptop to complete hands-on exercises with expert guidance in a small-group setting.

title: From pod to multi-region: Resilient workloads on Amazon EKS
title_ko: 파드에서 멀티 리전까지: Amazon EKS의 복원력 있는 워크로드
summary_ko: Pod Disruption Budget과 토폴로지 분산부터 멀티 리전까지 Amazon EKS 복원력의 각 계층을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Building resilient workloads on Amazon EKS requires thinking in layers, from pod-level reliability to multi-region failover. In this chalk talk, explore each layer: Pod Disruption Budgets and Topology Spread Constraints, Karpenter and EKS Auto Mode for fast node recovery, EFS vs EBS for stateful workloads, AWS Backup for cross-region protection, and Route 53 with ARC for region switching. Debate active-active vs active-passive tradeoffs and validate RTO/RPO targets with Resilience Hub.

title: Orchestrate failover and failback for effective Disaster Recovery
title_ko: 효과적인 재해 복구를 위한 페일오버와 페일백 오케스트레이션
summary_ko: AWS 서비스를 활용해 풀스택 리전 페일오버와 페일백을 라이브 코딩으로 구현합니다.
abstract: Failing over one app is easy — orchestrating failover and fail back across interdependent apps is where DR plans break. Real recovery requires dependency-aware orchestration across your entire stack. In this code talk, we live-code full-stack Region failover using Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) Region switch: building sequenced workflows so databases switch before app tiers, validating steps with health checks, rehearsing with practice runs, and safely reversing the sequence for fail back. Leave ready to replace your paper DR plan with coded, repeatable recovery and measured RTO to prove it.

By the end, you'll know how to turn raw patch data into audit-ready answers on demand.

Walk away with a step-by-step approach to strengthen the resilience posture of your critical applications, from identifying their business impact all the way to test and automate their recovery.

title: Catch it before production: Instrument your AI agents
title_ko: 프로덕션 전에 잡아내기: AI 에이전트 계측하기
summary_ko: 실행 중인 AI 에이전트를 엔드투엔드로 계측해 문제를 프로덕션 이전에 발견하는 방법을 실습합니다.
abstract: You need visibility into your AI workloads before they reaches production, not after they fails, yet most teams have no telemetry on their agents at all. In this workshop, you instrument a live AI agent end to end, capturing token cost, latency, tool calls, and reasoning traces. You make the instrumentation decisions, build the dashboards and anomaly alerts. Leave with a working setup you can apply to your own agentic workloads.

title: Observe AI agents beyond your perimeter
title_ko: 경계 밖의 AI 에이전트 관측하기
summary_ko: 네이티브 OpenTelemetry 내보내기와 Amazon CloudWatch로 외부 환경에서 실행되는 AI 에이전트까지 관측합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Your developers are burning tokens on AI coding agents with zero visibility. Claude Code and OpenAI Codex run on laptops, outside your perimeter, with no telemetry reaching your observability backend. In this session, we fix that. Using native OpenTelemetry export and Amazon CloudWatch's OTLP endpoint with a single bearer token, with no collectors, no sidecars, no credential wiring, we ship metrics (token usage, cost, productivity), logs (tool decisions, errors), and traces (agent reasoning chains) directly from developer machines. Then we build a live dashboard with per-team cost attribution and anomaly alerting, all queryable with PromQL. Walk out ready to deploy in minutes.

title: Custom SRE agents: From prompt to proactive ops with DevOps agent
title_ko: 커스텀 SRE 에이전트: DevOps Agent로 프롬프트에서 선제적 운영까지
summary_ko: 간단한 프롬프트를 선제적 운영 자동화로 바꾸는 커스텀 SRE 에이전트를 AWS DevOps Agent로 만드는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: In this builder session, learn how to create custom SRE agents that turn a simple prompt into automated, environment-specific operational workflows. Using pre-configured tools and integrations, you'll define agents tailored to your priorities, whether that's anomaly detection, performance optimization, cost analysis, or resiliency recommendations. See how agents combine real-time observability data with structured reasoning to surface actionable improvements without manual investigation. Walk away with hands-on experience designing an agent that monitors your operational patterns and proactively recommends next steps, so your team spends less time diagnosing and more time shipping.

title: Orchestrate multi-layer disaster recovery for critical workloads
title_ko: 핵심 워크로드를 위한 다층 재해 복구 오케스트레이션
summary_ko: ARC가 인프라와 애플리케이션 계층의 재해 복구를 하나의 오케스트레이션으로 통합하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Your AZ recovery plan and your Region failover plan were probably built by different teams, tested at different times, and have never run together. The result: untested failover paths that turn outages into incidents. Explore how to build a unified recovery framework with Amazon Application Recovery Controller. From zonal autoshift for rapid single-AZ mitigation, to Region switch for cross-Region failover, learn how ARC unifies both layers into a single orchestrated approach. Then discover how to run automated resilience tests that continuously validate your recovery posture before a real event forces the question.

title: Where's the slowdown? Build observability from frontend to databases
title_ko: 어디가 느린 거죠? 프런트엔드부터 데이터베이스까지 관측성 구축
summary_ko: 프런트엔드에서 데이터베이스까지 애플리케이션 전 구간의 풀스택 관측성을 구축해 성능 병목을 찾아냅니다.
abstract: When an application slows down, the cause can hide anywhere from the frontend to the database, and siloed tools make teams guess. In this workshop, you will build full-stack observability across application, infrastructure, and database layers, bringing RDS and Aurora signals and database logs into one store and correlating them with audit activity. You decide what to trace and build the dashboards that connect a symptom to its root cause. Leave with skills to trace any slowdown across layers in a single pane.

title: Trust but verify: Building the audit loop for AI agents in production
title_ko: 신뢰하되 검증하라: 프로덕션 AI 에이전트를 위한 감사 루프 구축
summary_ko: Amazon Bedrock 기반 AI 에이전트의 행동을 기록하고 검증하는 엔드투엔드 감사 루프를 구축합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: An AI agent can answer every request successfully and still make the wrong decision. In this builders’ session, you will build an end-to-end audit loop on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using Amazon CloudWatch for traces, AgentCore Evaluations to apply an LLM-as-a-judge against business rules, and AWS DevOps Agent to investigate alarms. Then watch a customer service agent refund a customer without required human approval, while traces show zero errors. Reconstruct the decision, and see the loop automatically surface what error monitoring misses.

title: AI-Powered FinOps: Cloud Cost Optimization in Practice
title_ko: AI 기반 FinOps: 클라우드 비용 최적화 실전
summary_ko: AI 기반 도구를 활용해 FinOps를 운영 규율로 정착시키고 클라우드 비용을 최적화하는 방법을 실습합니다.
abstract: Embed FinOps as an operational discipline using AI-powered cost optimization. This hands-on workshop demonstrates how to shift left on cloud financial management by integrating cost discipline throughout development. Explore AWS services for automated optimizations, rightsizing, and savings plans. Gain experience with AI/ML and container workload cost allocation, multi-cloud reporting, and AI-powered spend analysis. Implement automated strategies using real workload data. Laptop required

abstract: AI agents are non-deterministic, multi-step, and make autonomous decisions and traditional APM isn't enough. Explore observability patterns for agentic workloads: reasoning chain tracing, token cost attribution, guardrail monitoring, and multi-agent coordination. We'll whiteboard architectures in real time. Bring your toughest production agent monitoring questions and leave with actionable patterns.

title: Resilience starts where your assumptions end, feat. Autodesk
title_ko: 복원력은 가정이 끝나는 곳에서 시작된다 (Autodesk 사례)
summary_ko: Autodesk의 복원력 테스트 여정을 통해 숨은 가정을 검증하고 시스템 복원력을 높인 경험을 공유합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: The challenge most companies face is knowing where they stand with resilience, being willing to validate their assumptions safely, and disciplined enough to continuously improve without slowing delivery. In this session, we walk through Autodesk's journey with resilience testing and automated recovery failover as proof that investing in validation pays off, and you leave with a repeatable lifecycle for turning your own assumptions into proven capabilities. Discover how the next-generation AWS Resilience Hub handles the tedious work like mapping dependencies, assessing posture, and preconfiguring resilience tests, leaving your teams to focus on closing the gap between the system you think you operate and the one you actually do.

title: Building a Cost Governance framework for AI that scales
title_ko: 확장 가능한 AI 비용 거버넌스 프레임워크 구축
summary_ko: AI 워크로드를 아키텍처부터 청구서까지 매핑하며 확장 가능한 비용 거버넌스 체계를 설계합니다.
abstract: AI spend starts with model tokens but often misses costs from agent runtimes, memory, data, and supporting services. In this chalk talk, we'll map an AI workload from architecture to bill, then apply a practical framework to measure, attribute, optimize, and govern its cost and value. Using AWS FinOps Agent as an example, we'll examine how its architecture creates costs across Amazon Bedrock and supporting services, and how to govern those costs. Bring your AI cost challenge and leave with a model that helps FinOps and engineering teams assign ownership, find waste, and set effective controls.

title: Automate savings with AWS Billing and Cost Management services
title_ko: AWS Billing and Cost Management 서비스로 절감 자동화
summary_ko: 약정 구매 등 비용 절감 활동을 AWS Billing and Cost Management로 자동화하는 접근 방식을 논의합니다.
abstract: Managing Savings Plans well is a continuous job. In this chalk talk, we discuss approaches to making commitment purchases more intelligent and less manual. We will cover how you can build a purchasing cadence that incorporates your organization's demand patterns through automation and the right level of human oversight. We'll also cover Automation, a feature within AWS Compute Optimizer that enables you to apply optimization recommendations to your AWS resources, which can help you reduce costs and improve performance. Bring your questions and challenges.

title: Simplify multicloud: manage and monitor VMs in one place
title_ko: 멀티클라우드 단순화: VM을 한곳에서 관리하고 모니터링하기
summary_ko: 여러 클라우드와 온프레미스의 모든 인스턴스를 하나의 운영 체계에서 관리하는 방법을 화이트보드로 설계합니다.
abstract: As your compute spreads across multiple clouds and on-premises, every environment ends up with its own agents, tooling, and consoles. Patching, access, and monitoring happen a different way in each one, and no single view shows what is running or how it behaves. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard how to bring every instance under one operational model with AWS Systems Manager, no matter where it runs, and then get metrics and logs from all of them into Amazon CloudWatch. We work through the tradeoffs and patterns that hold at scale. Leave able to run and observe your whole fleet as one.

title: AIOps strategy: foundations before capabilities
title_ko: AIOps 전략: 기능보다 기반이 먼저
summary_ko: AI 기반 운영을 도입하기 전에 갖춰야 할 데이터와 프로세스 기반을 중심으로 AIOps 전략을 다룹니다.
abstract: Most teams turn on AI-driven operations before thinking about how they will scale. This chalk talk works through an AIOps strategy at the whiteboard, using real support-case patterns showing that most critical failures are catchable before they reach production. We discuss areas your strategy should consider that will allow you to scale to additional capabilities more quickly and where Frontier Agents could help. Leave with a foundational framework and a maturity discussion for your team.
