title: Modernize confidently with production intelligence
title_ko: 프로덕션 인텔리전스로 자신 있게 현대화하기
summary_ko: 프로덕션 환경에서 얻은 인텔리전스를 현대화 의사결정에 반영해 위험을 줄이는 방법을 논의합니다.
abstract: Static code analysis tells you what to modernize. It doesn't tell you what breaks when you do. Runtime dependencies, real traffic patterns, and operational risk stay invisible until cutover, when surprises are most expensive. AWS DevOps Agent adds the missing ingredient: production intelligence fed directly into your AWS Transform modernization plan. The result is assessments grounded in reality and migrations that stay safe through execution. In this chalk talk, we discuss how to incorporate production intelligence from DevOps Agent into an automated migration pipeline by Transform Custom. Bring your modernization challenges to discuss.

title: Tag once, find anything: scale resource tracking across accounts
title_ko: 한 번 태깅하고 무엇이든 찾기: 여러 계정에 걸친 리소스 추적 확장
summary_ko: 여러 계정에서 태깅을 깔끔하게 유지하는 자동화를 구축해 리소스 추적을 대규모로 확장합니다.
abstract: Inconsistent tags make it hard to see what runs where. In this code talk, we build automation that keeps tagging clean at scale: a tagging schema that defines the keys and values that matter, an AWS Config rule that flags non-compliant resources, and an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook that remediates them automatically or with approval. We also query untagged resources across thousands of resources and multi accounts. Leave with working code you can adapt for cost allocation, access scoping, and AI-assisted root-cause analysis.

title: Recover and prove your full stack without disrupting production
title_ko: 프로덕션 중단 없이 풀스택 복구 및 검증하기
summary_ko: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery로 서버를 복제하고 프로덕션 영향 없이 풀스택 복구를 검증하는 과정을 보여줍니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Meeting your recovery time and point objectives is non-negotiable. For your critical workloads, that means orchestrated, tier-aware recovery within minutes, with a plan you've actually tested. Most teams haven't, because testing often means disrupting production. So, the plan stays on the shelf and RTOs stay theoretical. In this session, see AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery replicate servers into low-cost staging and recover the full stack in the right order, in minutes, then rehearse the same failover without production noticing. Learn how to run non-disruptive recovery drills against your own environment and prove your RTOs before an incident does it for you.

title: Evolve your observability for the agentic era
title_ko: 에이전틱 시대에 맞게 관측성 발전시키기
summary_ko: 평가 기반 루프로 실행 중인 AI 에이전트의 품질 저하를 잡아내는 등 에이전틱 시대의 관측성을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Your agent passed every test last week. Today the same prompt returns a different, pricier answer, and nobody can say why. Agents drift as models and prompts change beneath them, and a green dashboard won't catch it. This session covers what evaluations ("evals") are: automated checks that score an agent's output for quality, accuracy, and cost. You'll learn how an eval-driven loop catches that drift on live traffic, traces it to the change that caused it, compares models and prompts, and attributes spend down to the agent and user, so regressions get blocked before they reach production. Then see how Amazon CloudWatch Omni does this across AWS and other clouds, covering your agents and applications in one place.

title: Elevate your observability with OpenTelemetry on AWS
title_ko: AWS에서 OpenTelemetry로 관측성 향상하기
summary_ko: AWS에서 OpenTelemetry를 활용해 더 풍부한 데이터와 통합된 관측성을 구현하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: Getting full visibility across your stack shouldn't mean stitching together disconnected tools and proprietary formats. When you standardize on OpenTelemetry with AWS, you get rich, unified telemetry from metrics, logs, and traces across your containers, Kubernetes clusters, AI workloads, and everything in between. Collect deep telemetry using OTLP ingestion, PromQL querying, and automatic enrichment with Amazon CloudWatch's native OpenTelemetry. No fragmented data. No vendor lock-in. Just one telemetry foundation that gives you the context you need to understand what's happening across your entire environment. Learn how to achieve richer data, unified observability, and a production-ready architecture that scales with you.

title: Wrong, Not Broken, & Why your Observability should know the difference
title_ko: 고장이 아니라 틀린 것: 관측성이 그 차이를 알아야 하는 이유
summary_ko: 에이전트와 시스템에서 장애가 아닌 잘못된 결과를 식별하는 관측성 기법을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: When an agent fails, it rarely throws an error. It gives the wrong answer, and diagnosis takes hours. The cause may be the model, the prompt, or bad downstream data, with evidence scattered across tools. Learn techniques to identify issues across agents and services and correlate them into one incident. We look ahead to AI agents investigating incidents alongside engineers, using open-standard telemetry accessible to engineers and agents with purpose-built tools and system context. See how CloudWatch Omni addresses each, and leave with agent development techniques, reference architectures for agentic observability, and ways to optimize observability with OpenTelemetry.

title: High latency! Is it the code, the container, or the host?
title_ko: 지연 시간이 높아요! 코드일까, 컨테이너일까, 호스트일까?
summary_ko: 애플리케이션 지연의 원인이 코드, 컨테이너, 호스트 중 어디인지 관측성 데이터로 가려내는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Your app is slow, but is it the code, the container, or the underlying host? When your stack spans clouds, hybrid, and on-prem, correlating application performance to infrastructure health means jumping between tools and guessing at root cause. Join this session as we walk through how to map application signals such as traces, errors, and latency directly to the infrastructure, regardless of where it runs. You'll see how to pinpoint whether the problem is your app or the compute it sits on, without stitching dashboards together manually.

title: Logging strategy for agentic investigations
title_ko: 에이전틱 조사를 위한 로깅 전략
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 장애를 조사할 수 있도록 로그를 중앙화하는 CloudWatch 로깅 설계를 화이트보드로 그립니다.
abstract: Most logging strategies get built one team at a time. Each team picks its own destination and format, so an AI agent investigating an incident has to search across accounts and reason over a dozen schemas. In this chalk talk, we'll whiteboard a CloudWatch logging design that centralizes logs and enriches them on ingest with service context, so your agents start every investigation with what they need. We'll debate what to transform at ingest versus keep raw, and which logs earn hot storage. Bring the log setup you run today and we'll redraw it with you.

title: Best practices for building an observability strategy in the age of AI
title_ko: AI 시대의 관측성 전략 수립 모범 사례
summary_ko: AI 시대에도 변하지 않는 것과 진화해야 하는 관측성 전략의 요소, 그리고 모범 사례를 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Most observability strategies were built for a pre-AI world and are no longer enough. Your data foundation remains critical, but the way you use that data is changing fast. In this chalk talk, we explore what stays the same, what must evolve, and what's new as AI reshapes observability. We'll cover the shift from static dashboards to dynamic experiences, from reactive alarms to AI-driven insights, and the new questions you need to answer, like how well your agents are performing. Join us as we share what AWS is learning as we embrace AI-led observability.

title: Best practices for building an observability strategy in the age of AI
title_ko: AI 시대의 관측성 전략 수립 모범 사례
summary_ko: AI 시대에도 변하지 않는 것과 진화해야 하는 관측성 전략의 요소, 그리고 모범 사례를 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Most observability strategies were built for a pre-AI world and are no longer enough. Your data foundation remains critical, but the way you use that data is changing fast. In this chalk talk, we explore what stays the same, what must evolve, and what's new as AI reshapes observability. We'll cover the shift from static dashboards to dynamic experiences, from reactive alarms to AI-driven insights, and the new questions you need to answer, like how well your agents are performing. Join us as we share what AWS is learning as we embrace AI-led observability.

title: Learnings from resilience testing in AWS
title_ko: AWS의 복원력 테스트에서 얻은 교훈
summary_ko: AWS가 내부적으로 수행해 온 복원력 테스트와 그 과정에서 얻은 교훈을 공유합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: In this talk, we'll describe some of the resilience testing we've been doing in AWS. We'll talk a bit about the Game Day Region, why it exists, and how we use it. We'll talk about the types of test we run, the philosophy behind them, and some takeaways that you, our customers, can also apply.

title: Optimize container observability to reduce cost
title_ko: 비용 절감을 위한 컨테이너 관측성 최적화
summary_ko: 지표 카디널리티 제어와 샘플링 설계 등으로 컨테이너 관측성 비용을 줄이는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: At scale, container environments generate metrics and logs that increase both cost and noise for engineering teams. This session explores architectural strategies for managing observability data across containerized workloads using OpenTelemetry. Learn how to control metric cardinality, design sampling policies that preserve critical signals, and evaluate managed backend tradeoffs. You'll leave with a framework for building cost-aware container observability.

title: Optimize container observability to reduce cost
title_ko: 비용 절감을 위한 컨테이너 관측성 최적화
summary_ko: 지표 카디널리티 제어와 샘플링 설계 등으로 컨테이너 관측성 비용을 줄이는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: At scale, container environments generate metrics and logs that increase both cost and noise for engineering teams. This session explores architectural strategies for managing observability data across containerized workloads using OpenTelemetry. Learn how to control metric cardinality, design sampling policies that preserve critical signals, and evaluate managed backend tradeoffs. You'll leave with a framework for building cost-aware container observability.

title: Instrument a service with OpenTelemetry
title_ko: OpenTelemetry로 서비스 계측하기
summary_ko: 관측성이 전혀 없는 서비스를 OpenTelemetry로 계측해 완전한 가시성을 확보하는 과정을 실습합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: In this live demo, we take an uninstrumented service from zero observability to correlated metrics, logs, and traces in minutes using Open Telemetry and Amazon CloudWatch. Walk through the shortest path to production-grade instrumentation: SDK configuration, collector setup, signal routing, and surfacing the first actionable insight.

title: Agentic AI Needs Agentic Infrastructure: Autonomy on Amazon EKS (sponsored by ScaleOps)
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI에는 에이전틱 인프라가 필요하다: Amazon EKS의 자율성 (ScaleOps 후원)
summary_ko: 스스로 추론하고 행동하는 소프트웨어를 위해 Amazon EKS 인프라를 자율적으로 최적화하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Enterprises now ship software that reasons and acts on its own. The infrastructure underneath still waits for a human to edit YAML. This session makes the case that autonomous workloads demand autonomous infrastructure, and shows what it looks like on Amazon EKS today: agents held to fractional GPU allocations that track real consumption, pod requests that stay honest as behavior drifts, and Karpenter consolidating nodes fed by accurate signals. You'll hear how enterprises run this in production with ScaleOps, and where autonomous resource management goes next. Leave with a blueprint for infrastructure that manages itself. This presentation is brought to you by ScaleOps, an AWS Partner.

title: Trusting an Autonomous Agent With Your Production Environment (sponsored by NeuBird)
title_ko: 자율 에이전트에게 프로덕션 환경을 맡기기 (NeuBird 후원)
summary_ko: 사람 중심의 장애 분류에서 자율 AI 에이전트 기반 운영으로 안전하게 전환하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: The biggest barrier to autonomous operations isn't capability, it's trust.Handing an incident to an autonomous agent raises a fair question. How do you know it is not guessing from raw log lines. This session shows how NeuBird AI reasons over your live environment and shows the causal chain behind every root cause, not a coincidence in the metrics. We’ll examine the guardrails that make production deployment safe: VPC-native execution, zero external data retention, complete auditable reasoning paths, and human-gated action approvals. Learn how to safely transition from human-driven triage to trusted, autonomous production operations on your own terms. This presentation is brought to you by NeuBird, an AWS Partner.

title: Drive AI at full speed: The enterprise blueprint (sponsored by HashiCorp)
title_ko: AI를 전속력으로: 엔터프라이즈 청사진 (HashiCorp 후원)
summary_ko: Terraform과 Vault를 Kubernetes 등과 함께 활용해 엔터프라이즈 AI를 빠르고 안전하게 확장하는 청사진을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: AI gave teams a faster car. It did not fix the roads. As teams create more applications, infrastructure and complexity, the challenge shifts from moving faster to operating smarter. Enterprises need context to understand what is happening, agency to act across the tools they already use, and control to keep speed from becoming chaos. In this session, see how Terraform and Vault together with Kubernetes, Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore and IBM Concert to standardize delivery, secure access and connect application context to action across hybrid environments. This presentation is brought to you by HashiCorp, an AWS Partner.

title: Monitor and optimize costs for Amazon Bedrock
title_ko: Amazon Bedrock 비용 모니터링 및 최적화
summary_ko: API 호출에 태그를 지정해 세분화된 비용을 할당하는 등 Amazon Bedrock 비용을 모니터링하고 최적화하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: As AI adoption accelerates, organizations need visibility into who is consuming Amazon Bedrock resources and how that spend maps to business outcomes. In this lightning talk, see how to tag API calls for granular cost attribution, set real-time budgets to control AI spend, and track costs as they happen in the Billing and Cost Management console. Walk away with a practical framework for aligning AI spend to business outcomes.

title: Build a per-tenant observability stack for Agentic SaaS
title_ko: 에이전틱 SaaS를 위한 테넌트별 관측성 스택 구축
summary_ko: AI 에이전트 기반 SaaS에서 테넌트별로 분리된 관측성 스택을 직접 구축합니다.
abstract: Multi-tenant ISVs need per-tenant observability that traditional dashboards can't deliver — aggregated metrics hide the tenant causing the problem, and shared traces don't tell you whose agent misbehaved. In this session, build a per-tenant observability stack for agents. You'll instrument agent invocations with tenant-aware traces and session replay, build tenant-scoped dashboards that surface noisy neighbors and latency outliers, and configure alerting that fires on per-tenant thresholds rather than aggregate signals. By the end, you'll have an observability setup that scales with your tenant count without a separate data pipeline — and patterns to extend it as your agent architecture grows.

title: 5 Questions Terraform, OpenTofu, and CloudFormation Can't Answer (sponsored by Spacelift, Inc.)
title_ko: Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation이 답하지 못하는 5가지 질문 (Spacelift 후원)
summary_ko: IaC 도구만으로는 답하기 어려운 인프라 변경 관리의 5가지 질문과 이를 해결하는 오케스트레이션 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Every infrastructure change is one run: code, an engine, a plan, an apply. That run is still a wall of unstructured log text, and the questions about your estate go unanswered. Five to ask of your IaC: Did Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, or Ansible run it, and does it matter? Where does the time go, and can OpenTelemetry tracing show you? What happens outside the engine: providers, state, policy-as-code, drift, queue time? What about unmanaged resources, the half of your AWS account no run ever touched? Who gets self-service, and can an AI agent be trusted with an apply? This presentation is brought to you by Spacelift, Inc., an AWS Partner.

title: How Infor Uses AWS Agentic AI to Transform Cloud Operations at Scale
title_ko: Infor가 AWS 에이전틱 AI로 대규모 클라우드 운영을 혁신한 방법
summary_ko: Koch Industries 계열사 Infor가 AWS 에이전틱 AI로 대규모 클라우드 운영을 혁신한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Infor (a Koch Industries company) runs one of the largest enterprise footprints on AWS. As that footprint grew, manual release gates, incident investigations, and periodic security assessments couldn't keep pace. Hear how Infor is adopting AWS agentic AI to reshape operations: DevOps Agent for incident triage and release readiness, Continuum for continuous security validation, and the Well-Architected Agentic AI Lens for production guardrails. Leave with a blueprint for agentic AI at scale.

title: Autonomous SRE: AWS DevOps Agent in Financial Services
title_ko: 자율 SRE: 금융 서비스에서의 AWS DevOps Agent
summary_ko: 대형 금융 기관이 AWS DevOps Agent를 배포해 자율 SRE 운영을 구현한 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: In this session, learn how a large financial institution deploys AWS DevOps Agent as an autonomous SRE teammate to reduce incident investigation time from hours to minutes and free engineering teams from reactive firefighting. Explore the architecture spanning CloudWatch, Splunk, GitHub, and Slack integrations, and see how the agent correlates telemetry across data sources to identify root causes and generate mitigation plans. Walk away with practical patterns for deploying agentic operations in regulated, compliance-sensitive environments.

title: Take Action on Operational Issues with AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 운영 문제에 대한 조치 실행
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent가 장애 조사를 넘어 실제 해결 조치까지 수행하는 방식을 보여줍니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: There's a big difference between an agent that gives you a remediation plan and one that can carry it out. In this session, see how AWS DevOps Agent goes beyond investigation to take action on operational issues across AWS, multicloud, and on-prem environments. Learn how directed actions and defense-in-depth controls govern what the agent can do, with layered opt-in, per-action approval, and built-in guardrails that keep operations safe

title: Diagnose Complex Workloads with AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 복잡한 워크로드 진단하기
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent를 활용해 복잡한 워크로드의 문제를 조사하는 실용적인 기법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Follow an investigation of a complex workload using AWS DevOps Agent. Trace an application-level symptom through multiple layers of your environment across AWS, multicloud, and on-prem environments. See how DevOps Agent analyzes telemetry, correlates signals across layers, identifies likely root causes, and delivers targeted remediation. Learn practical techniques for investigating workloads and reducing the manual effort of diagnosing problems across distributed environments.

title: Resolve Incidents and Validate Releases with AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 인시던트 해결 및 릴리스 검증
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent가 여러 시스템에 걸친 인시던트를 조사하고 릴리스를 검증하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
abstract: Follow an issue from detection to resolution. In this builder's session, see how AWS DevOps Agent investigates incidents across AWS, multicloud, and on-premises environments, analyzing telemetry and correlating signals to pinpoint root causes and deliver targeted remediation. Then use the AWS DevOps Agent release management agent to review the code changes for production readiness before they reach your customers. Every review is informed by production intelligence that AWS DevOps Agent continuously builds from your environment.

title: Catch bad agent behavior before your users do
title_ko: 사용자보다 먼저 에이전트의 잘못된 행동 잡아내기
summary_ko: 같은 프롬프트에도 다르게 동작하는 비결정적 AI 에이전트의 잘못된 행동을 사전에 탐지하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: AI agents are non-deterministic. The same prompt can call the wrong tool, pick up bad context, or quietly degrade and you won't know until users feel it. Amazon CloudWatch Omni gives agents a first-class observability home built on open standards. Instrument an agent and trace every LLM call, tool invocation, and reasoning step. Run built-in evaluators to score response quality, then compare configurations against golden datasets. Correlate agent behavior with the services it depends on and investigate in natural language. Leave able to evaluate, debug, and operate agents with confidence.

title: Observe AI agents and workloads end to end
title_ko: AI 에이전트와 워크로드를 엔드투엔드로 관측하기
summary_ko: Amazon CloudWatch의 차세대 기능인 CloudWatch Omni로 AI 에이전트와 워크로드를 엔드투엔드로 관측하는 실습입니다.
abstract: Get hands-on with Amazon CloudWatch Omni, the next evolution of CloudWatch that monitors your AI stack end to end, from the agent all the way down to the self-hosted inference workload serving it, converging application and agent observability into one AI-powered solution. Instrument an agent, trace its execution, and run evaluations against golden datasets. When something degrades, explore auto-discovered topology and golden metrics to pinpoint where latency or errors creep in. Navigate from alarm to the responsible inference workload, and let Omni's AI-powered investigation trace the root cause.

title: Observe your applications and agents in one place
title_ko: 애플리케이션과 에이전트를 한곳에서 관측하기
summary_ko: 기존 모니터링 도구의 한계를 넘어 애플리케이션과 AI 에이전트를 하나의 환경에서 관측하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: Traditional monitoring tools weren't built for the complexity of modern agentic and distributed applications. Teams juggle siloed dashboards, fragmented logs, and disconnected signals with no unified way to troubleshoot across agents, applications, and infrastructure. Amazon CloudWatch Omni is an AI-powered observability experience organized around your teams and the applications they run, combining OpenTelemetry interoperability with CloudWatch scale. See how you can troubleshoot applications faster and manage agents with confidence using automatic service discovery, dependency mapping, built-in evaluations, and natural-language investigation — all from the Omni UI, your IDE, or your favorite tools.

title: Build full-stack observability for agents and apps
title_ko: 에이전트와 앱을 위한 풀스택 관측성 구축
summary_ko: 실제 시나리오에서 에이전트의 호출 체인을 추적하며 에이전트와 앱의 풀스택 관측성을 구축합니다.
abstract: When your applications include AI agents that reason, plan, and act autonomously, observability has to evolve too. Disconnected tools and siloed signals slow teams down right when speed matters most. In this chalk talk, we walk through real scenarios and trace an agent's chain of thought across services, correlating agent failures with infrastructure, and using natural-language investigation to cut resolution time. We diagram how service discovery, dependency mapping, evaluations, and IDE-native telemetry come together so you can ship agents with confidence.

title: Monetizing your applications with AWS
title_ko: AWS로 애플리케이션 수익화하기
summary_ko: 완성된 애플리케이션을 AWS를 통해 수익을 내는 제품으로 전환하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: In this session, learn how to transform your finished application into a revenue-generating SaaS product. Learn about analyzing your cloud infrastructure, choose pricing models, and instrumenting code for usage metering. You'll see how to manage the complete billing lifecycle, from subscription management and invoicing to tax calculation and payment processing. Walk away with a clear path to accelerate your time-to-market and start charging customers.

title: Find the waste hiding in your accelerator fleetÂ
title_ko: 가속기 플릿에 숨은 낭비 찾기
summary_ko: 가장 비싼 리소스인 GPU와 AI 가속기 플릿에서 활용되지 않는 낭비를 찾아 줄이는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: GPU and AI accelerators are the most expensive resources your teams run â€” and the hardest to observe when shared across teams. Most platform owners can't tell which workload is using which device, whether it's working or idle, or what a stalled run is costing per hour. When something degrades, teams find out after a crash or a surprise bill.Â This lightning talk explores how to spot what's sitting idle, pinpoint a failing device without sacrificing the healthy ones around it, and prioritize fixes by how much spend you can recover.

title: Troubleshoot Workloads End to End with AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 워크로드 엔드투엔드 문제 해결
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent가 워크로드 문제를 엔드투엔드로 조사하고 해결하는 과정을 보여줍니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Application issues can originate anywhere across the stack, from compute and container environments to networking, data, and AI services. In this session, see how AWS DevOps Agent investigates issues end to end across AWS, multicloud, and on-prem environments, analyzing telemetry and correlating signals across layers to pinpoint root causes and deliver targeted remediation. Learn how teams troubleshooting complex workloads can resolve issues faster and spend less time moving between tools and data sources.

title: Investigate Incidents Across Teams with AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 팀 간 인시던트 조사하기
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent가 팀이 이미 사용하는 도구와 채널에서 여러 팀에 걸친 인시던트를 조사하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Production incidents typically involve multiple teams, but tooling and investigations are often siloed. In this chalk talk, explore how AWS DevOps Agent meets teams where incident response already happens. See how engineers can interact with the agent directly from tools like Slack, consolidating investigation activity, findings, and recommended actions alongside team communication. Bring your multi-team incident patterns and discuss approaches to faster, more connected incident response across AWS, multicloud, and on-prem environments.

title: Build better, review faster: AI-Powered Well-Architected reviews
title_ko: 더 잘 만들고 더 빠르게 검토하기: AI 기반 Well-Architected 리뷰
summary_ko: AWS Well-Architected Agent를 구성해 지속적이고 자동화된 아키텍처 검토를 수행하는 방법을 실습합니다.
abstract: Periodic reviews can't keep pace with infrastructure that changes daily. In this hands-on workshop, stand up the AWS Well-Architected Agent for continuous, goal-driven reviews across a multi-account environment. Configure agent profiles, cross-account role chaining, and business goals that prioritize across Cost Optimization, Security, Resilience, and Performance pillars. See how the agent enriches Trusted Advisor, Compute Optimizer, and Resilience Hub signals with cross-pillar trade-off analysis. Run pre-deployment reviews against CloudFormation, CDK, and Terraform, then remediate through AI-generated SOPs. Wire recommendations into CI/CD via the Well-Architected API. For architects, platform engineers, and operations leads who want always-on architectural governance in their delivery lifecycle.

title: Allocate shared AWS infrastructure costs to your business units
title_ko: 공유 AWS 인프라 비용을 사업부별로 할당하기
summary_ko: 실제 사용량에 기반해 공유 AWS 인프라 비용을 사업부에 할당하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Shared Amazon S3 buckets, Amazon EKS clusters, and network resources improve efficiency but can obscure which applications and business units drive spend. In this session, learn how to attribute shared costs based on actual usage. Follow a practical example using AWS Split Cost Allocation Data for S3 and EKS and Flexible Cost Allocation for networking. Then use AWS Cost Categories and Data Exports to combine each business unit’s share of storage, compute, and networking spend into a unified view. Walk away with a repeatable approach to showback and chargeback across your shared AWS environment.

title: Take control of how AWS credits are allocated across your accounts
title_ko: 계정 간 AWS 크레딧 할당 방식 제어하기
summary_ko: AWS 크레딧을 정확한 금액으로 나누어 여러 계정에 원하는 대로 할당하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: In this lightning talk, learn how to split any credit into precise amounts and transfer them to the accounts that need them. We walk through real-world workflows in the Console and API, show how split credits work seamlessly with sharing and pausing for full lifecycle control, and demonstrate how to replace monthly chargeback spreadsheets with a 5-minute workflow. Walk away with a playbook for giving every team a predictable credit budget as your organization scales.

title: Operationalizing resilience with AWS Resilience Hub
title_ko: AWS Resilience Hub로 복원력 운영화하기
summary_ko: 차세대 AWS Resilience Hub가 애플리케이션 복원력을 평가하고 지속적으로 운영에 반영하도록 돕는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: You can’t validate resilience by manually reviewing every service, dependency, and failover plan, especially as systems grow. In this session, learn how the next generation of AWS Resilience Hub helps teams assess and prove the operational resilience of their end-to-end services. Through a real-world example, follow a finding from assessment to remediation, validation and re-assessment, using DevOps Agent to investigate. See how to automate quarterly DR tests with your own test templates and finally, learn how to turn those results into failover audit reports, leadership summaries, and a custom resilience score your organization can track over time.

title: Recovering AWS Graviton workloads with orchestrated Disaster Recovery
title_ko: 오케스트레이션된 재해 복구로 AWS Graviton 워크로드 복구하기
summary_ko: 재해 복구 전문가와 함께 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery로 Graviton 워크로드를 복구하는 방법을 화이트보드로 설계합니다.
abstract: You moved to AWS Graviton for better price-performance, but is your disaster recovery keeping pace? A recovery that lands on the wrong architecture, or brings tiers up out of order, turns a routine failover into an outage. In this chalk talk, whiteboard with disaster recovery experts how AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS) now protects Graviton-based (arm64) Linux servers and recovers them onto Graviton instances, keeping the architecture intact end to end with nothing extra to configure. Then design a recovery plan that brings your application back tier by tier, in the right order, with wait times and critical-server gates. Bring your toughest arm64 and recovery-order questions, and leave with a DR design you can drill on Monday.

title: Building eval-driven observability for AI agents
title_ko: AI 에이전트를 위한 평가 기반 관측성 구축
summary_ko: LangGraph, Strands 등으로 만든 멀티 에이전트 앱에 평가 기반 관측성을 구축하는 실습입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Multi-agent systems fail in ways your dashboards cannot show: one agent hands off bad context, another retries, and the API still returns 200. In this live coding session, start with a multi-agent app on LangGraph, Strands, and CrewAI, and instrument it with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference. Trace it from the first prototype run, evaluate agents on demand with LLM-as-judge evaluators, A/B test prompt and model variants before promoting to production, pull production traces into a versioned dataset, reproduce the failure locally, and ship the fix. All from your IDE, without switching tools.

title: Scaling operations with MCP, ACP, and A2A
title_ko: MCP, ACP, A2A로 운영 확장하기
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent를 활용해 MCP, ACP, A2A 세 가지 프로토콜로 운영을 확장하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Operational complexity doesn't scale linearly but your approach to managing it can. In this chalk talk, we'll use AWS DevOps Agent to explore three protocols shaping how operations teams work at scale: MCP (connecting to operational data and actions), ACP (delegating tasks to purpose-built agents), and A2A (coordinating across autonomous agents). We'll discuss how protocol choice affects decision-making, when to extend capabilities vs. delegate, and how to design architectures that grow with your operational footprint. Leave with a clear mental model for when to reach for each protocol and how they fit together.

title: Optimize AI apps on Amazon Bedrock for cost, latency, and control
title_ko: Amazon Bedrock 기반 AI 앱의 비용, 지연 시간, 제어 최적화
summary_ko: AI 앱을 계측해 성능 저하를 탐지하고 Amazon Bedrock 앱의 비용, 지연 시간, 제어를 최적화하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: As AI workloads scale, engineers face complex trade-offs between cost, latency, and response quality. This code talk explores advanced optimisation techniques for production AI applications on Amazon Bedrock: prompt engineering, model selection, caching, and context window management. Through live coding, attendees examine the reasoning behind each design decision, observe cost impact via AWS Billing and Cost Management, and learn to instrument apps to detect performance regressions. Understanding the tokenomics of your AI stack is essential to operating efficiently at scale.

title: Go headless: managed harness to custom DevOps orchestration
title_ko: 헤드리스로 전환: 관리형 하네스에서 커스텀 DevOps 오케스트레이션으로
summary_ko: AI 에이전트를 위한 프로덕션급 오케스트레이션을 관리형 하네스에서 커스텀 DevOps 방식으로 구현하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Your AI agents need production-grade orchestration, but should you own the loop or let AWS handle it? We build one on-call responder three ways: an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness for a managed loop with built-in memory and tool routing, AgentCore Runtime for full control, and AWS DevOps Agent as a batteries-included DevOps harness. Then we build the shape most teams land in: your own orchestrator, DevOps Agent composed in headless over remote MCP and A2A. Bring your challenges and leave with patterns for building composable, robust pipelines that automate complex DevOps workflows end-to-end.

title: When agents run code: sandboxes for reliable DevOps
title_ko: 에이전트가 코드를 실행할 때: 신뢰할 수 있는 DevOps를 위한 샌드박스
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent의 임시 샌드박스 구조를 살펴보고 에이전트가 코드를 안전하게 실행하는 방식을 설명합니다.
abstract: LLMs hallucinate. Code doesn't. When your AI agent investigates a production incident, some answers demand computation, not just reasoning. In this code talk, we crack open the sandbox in AWS DevOps Agent: an ephemeral, investigation-scoped Linux environment where the agent writes and runs code inside a Lambda MicroVM with read-only AWS access and zero lateral blast radius. We'll discuss how networking allowlists, pre-installed packages, and executable skills give you deterministic, auditable results for log parsing, metric correlation, and multi-source analysis. Bring your problems and we'll whiteboard the isolation boundaries live.

title: Rethink release management for the agentic coding era
title_ko: 에이전틱 코딩 시대의 릴리스 관리 다시 생각하기
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent가 참여하는 GitOps 릴리스 워크플로를 라이브 코딩으로 구현합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: GitOps was designed for human-speed change. Agentic coding tools now generate pull requests faster than any team can review and safely release. Your release process is the new bottleneck. In this code talk, we'll live-code a GitOps release workflow where AWS DevOps Agent acts as an intelligent release manager, validating the results through a release pipeline at every promotion gate. Instead of manual approvals, DevOps Agent uses production intelligence (runtime dependencies, service health, deployment risk) to make real-time go/no-go decisions. Learn how to wire DevOps Agent into your GitOps reconciliation loop so releases match the velocity of agentic code generation without sacrificing safety.

title: Build-time context for faster agentic incident response
title_ko: 더 빠른 에이전틱 인시던트 대응을 위한 빌드 타임 컨텍스트
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 기능 개발 시점에 운영 컨텍스트를 함께 남겨 이후 인시던트 대응을 빠르게 하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: AI agents can fix production issues, but only with the right context. In this talk, an AI agent builds a feature and, in the same pull request, creates the context it needs on call: instrumentation, alarms, dashboards, and skills, all as code. Then you break the live app. Watch an agent use those skills with Amazon CloudWatch Omni and AWS DevOps Agent to triage, find the root cause, and ship the fix. Leave with patterns that give agents the context to operate what they build.

title: Correlate database query latency to user impact
title_ko: 데이터베이스 쿼리 지연 시간과 사용자 영향 연관 짓기
summary_ko: 트레이스와 쿼리를 연결해 데이터베이스 지연이 사용자 경험에 미치는 영향을 파악하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Diagnosing performance degradation across distributed applications requires more than isolated database or application metrics. It demands correlated, end-to-end telemetry. This code talk demonstrates a scenario that unifies database performance signals with application-layer telemetry using OpenTelemetry and Amazon CloudWatch. Learn how to implement trace-to-query correlation, design log aggregation patterns for accelerated root cause analysis, and build metric relationships that surface bottlenecks across the full stack. You'll be able to connect a slow database query to its downstream user impact.

title: Pinpoint latency in microservices with distributed tracing
title_ko: 분산 추적으로 마이크로서비스 지연 지점 정확히 찾기
summary_ko: 컨테이너 기반 마이크로서비스를 OpenTelemetry로 계측하고 분산 추적으로 지연 원인을 찾아냅니다.
abstract: Diagnosing latency across a high-scale Amazon EKS environment is complex when pods scale dynamically and trace context fails to propagate across service boundaries. In this code talk, we instrument containerized microservices with OpenTelemetry, propagate context across service hops, and correlate spans, metrics, and logs in Amazon CloudWatch. Live coding shows how a single slow request reveals the exact container and code path responsible for degradation, using targeted span attributes and exemplars to make Kubernetes-scale traces navigable. You'll also see the trade-offs behind sampling strategies and collector deployment topologies that affect overhead, fidelity, and cost at production scale.

title: Build a fully managed open source observability stack on AWS
title_ko: AWS에서 완전관리형 오픈소스 관측성 스택 구축
summary_ko: AWS 관리형 서비스로 완전한 오픈소스 관측성 아키텍처를 라이브 코딩으로 구축합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: You want open standards without the operational burden of self-managing backends. In this code talk, we live-code a complete open source observability architecture: instrument a service with OpenTelemetry (auto and manual), configure the OTel Collector pipeline, and route metrics to Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, logs and traces to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Walk through each integration decision from SDK selection to collector topology, and leave with a working, production-ready stack built entirely on open source standards with zero infrastructure to manage.

title: Close the gap between code and production
title_ko: 코드와 프로덕션 사이의 간극 좁히기
summary_ko: 관측성 데이터를 개발 워크플로에 연결해 코드와 프로덕션 사이의 간극을 줄이는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Why is it so hard to connect a production alert to the code change that caused it? Metrics and traces reveal something is wrong but stop short of the function responsible. Developers guess which deployment introduced the regression, manually correlating dashboards with recent commits. Meanwhile, AI coding agents that could help write fixes are blind to runtime behavior. In this code talk, we'll explore how to close the gap between observability signals and the code your team owns, what new signals make that connection possible, how developers and AI agents can consume them, and what changes when observability reaches the code level.

title: Multicloud in the Real World: Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing (sponsored by Oracle)
title_ko: 실전 멀티클라우드: 금융, 헬스케어, 제조 (Oracle 후원)
summary_ko: Oracle AI Database@AWS를 활용한 금융, 헬스케어, 제조 분야의 멀티클라우드 실제 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Oracle AI Database@AWS gives organizations a new way to bring mission-critical Oracle data closer to their applications, analytics, and AI services in AWS. This session shares a clear overview of the multicloud value proposition, including application proximity, operational simplicity, enterprise performance, security, and access to AWS services. Three Oracle industry leaders will explore what that value looks like in practice. Hear how financial institutions can strengthen fraud detection, risk management, and customer experiences; how healthcare organizations can generate trusted clinical and operational insights; and how manufacturers can improve forecasting, supply chain decisions, asset performance, and operational efficiency. Leave with a practical understanding of Oracle AI Database@AWS and concrete examples of how multicloud can support industry-specific AI and business outcomes. This presentation is brought to you by Oracle, an AWS Partner.

title: Escaping IIoT Pilot Purgatory: Why Your Database Breaks at Scale (sponsored by Tiger Data)
title_ko: IIoT 파일럿의 늪 탈출: 규모가 커지면 데이터베이스가 무너지는 이유 (Tiger Data 후원)
summary_ko: 산업용 IoT 프로젝트가 파일럿 단계에서 멈추는 원인인 데이터베이스 확장 문제와 해결 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Seventy-four percent of industrial IoT projects stall somewhere between pilot and production. The hard part is that the pilot worked. That is exactly what makes the failure so difficult to diagnose. Pilots succeed because a few hundred sensors over a few weeks fits comfortably in almost any database. Production does not. Storage costs compound faster than the budget that approved them, ingest hits a cliff with no warning, and the real-time dashboard that sold the project turns into a loading screen. See where industrial systems and typical AWS pipelines reach their limits and how to scale beyond them. We’ll explore a proven architecture using AWS IoT Core, Amazon Kinesis, AWS Lambda, and a single Postgres database to support more than one million connected devices reporting every second. This presentation is brought to you by Tiger Data, an AWS Partner.

title: Powering Interactive Agents with Live Context (sponsored by Materialize)
title_ko: 실시간 컨텍스트로 인터랙티브 에이전트 구동하기 (Materialize 후원)
summary_ko: 운영 데이터를 실시간 컨텍스트로 변환해 인터랙티브 AI 에이전트에 제공하는 방법을 배웁니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: How do you keep an agent's understanding of the world fresh enough for it to act on? Interactive agents need current context about the customers, orders, inventory, accounts, and other entities they reason about. But assembling that context from constantly changing operational systems is complex, forcing teams to choose between stale data, expensive recomputation, or complex pipelines. This talk will show how to build continuously updated context in SQL that is trustworthy enough for agents to rely upon. You'll learn how to transform operational data into agent-ready representations, keep attributes and relationships up to date as the underlying data changes, and propagate those changes to search indexes and embeddings when needed. Attend if you're deploying AI agents to production and want to give them fresher, more complete context and tighten their read-act-react loop. This presentation is brought to you by Materialize, an AWS Partner.

title: Single Agent to Global Scale: One Postgres, Any Workload, Run by Agents (sponsored by YugabyteDB)
title_ko: 단일 에이전트에서 글로벌 규모로: 에이전트가 운영하는 하나의 Postgres (YugabyteDB 후원)
summary_ko: 에이전트가 생성하고 운영하는 Postgres를 단일 워크로드에서 글로벌 규모까지 확장하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: An agent needs a Postgres database for perhaps twenty minutes. A payments platform needs one that never goes down across three regions. Most teams cover that range with different products, several vendors, and scores of on-call operators. Yugabyte delivers it as a single stack on AWS. YugabyteDB is distributed PostgreSQL built for global scale and resilience that also scales down to fractional instances. YugabyteDB AMP puts agents in charge of the fleet, handling provisioning, migration, and on-demand tuning. Meko gives agent teams the shared context they run on. See what it takes to run every Postgres workload on one foundation. This presentation is brought to you by YugabyteDB, an AWS Partner.

title: Autonomous DBOps: Agentic AI for maintaining databases
title_ko: 자율 DBOps: 데이터베이스 유지 관리를 위한 에이전틱 AI
summary_ko: 에이전틱 AI 솔루션을 활용해 데이터베이스 유지 관리 작업을 자동화하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Maintaining performance for Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS often requires manual effort, such as tuning queries, managing indexes, and handling alerts. In this builders' session, learn how to leverage agentic AI solutions implementing LLM-powered autonomous agents to monitor, diagnose, and optimize relational databases in real time. We will demonstrate how AI agents can analyze slow query logs, recommend or apply tuning actions, and trigger intelligent alerts using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Cloudwatch, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Systems Manager. Bring your laptop to participate.

title_ko: 자율 DBOps: 데이터베이스 유지 관리를 위한 에이전틱 AI

title: Optimize your Amazon Aurora resources to reduce costs
title_ko: 비용 절감을 위한 Amazon Aurora 리소스 최적화
summary_ko: Aurora 비용 구성 요소를 깊이 살펴보고 리소스를 최적화해 비용을 줄이는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Amazon Aurora is a cloud-native managed relational database that lets you create, manage, and scale your database resources with ease. In this session, dive deep into Aurora cost components and see how you can use cost-focused features and tooling to optimize costs for your workload without sacrificing performance or scale. Learn how the Aurora I/O-Optimized configuration can help you achieve cost savings for I/O-intensive workloads, and discover how Database Savings Plans can provide additional cost reductions through flexible commitment-based pricing.

abstract: Amazon Aurora is a cloud-native managed relational database that lets you create, manage, and scale your database resources with ease. In this session, dive deep into Aurora cost components and see how you can use cost-focused features and tooling to optimize costs for your workload without sacrificing performance or scale. Learn how the Aurora I/O-Optimized configuration can help you achieve cost savings for I/O-intensive workloads, and discover how Database Savings Plans can provide additional cost reductions through flexible commitment-based pricing.

title: HA and DR design patterns for Amazon RDS for SQL Server and Oracle
title_ko: Amazon RDS for SQL Server 및 Oracle의 고가용성과 재해 복구 설계 패턴
summary_ko: Amazon RDS for SQL Server와 Oracle에서 비즈니스 연속성을 위한 HA 및 DR 기능과 설계 패턴을 배웁니다.
abstract: Explore high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) design patterns for SQL Server and Oracle databases on Amazon RDS. In this session, learn about the features offered by Amazon RDS for business continuity, including Multi-AZ deployments, read replicas, and cross-region replication. Discover the customizations that Amazon RDS enables for HA and DR while also allowing you to bring your own license (BYOL) for SQL Server. Also learn how globally resilient solutions architected with Amazon RDS minimize downtime and meet stringent business continuity requirements for mission-critical workloads.

title: Safer, simpler, faster upgrades with managed blue/green deployments
title_ko: 관리형 블루/그린 배포로 더 안전하고 간단하며 빠른 업그레이드
summary_ko: 관리형 블루/그린 배포를 활용한 데이터베이스 업그레이드 솔루션을 직접 설계합니다.
abstract: Blue/green deployments for Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS simplify the process of upgrading and performing maintenance on your databases. In this chalk talk, you will architect a blue/green database upgrade solution to support major or minor engine version upgrades and perform schema changes with minimal and predictable downtime. Active participation is encouraged as you architect a solution to meet your requirements. In open discussion, learn the trade-offs involved in database management when using blue/green deployments and how to design the most effective upgrade solution to meet your needs.

title: Cost optimization for Amazon DynamoDB
title_ko: Amazon DynamoDB 비용 최적화
summary_ko: Amazon DynamoDB 비용을 모델링하고 측정하며 Database Savings Plans 등 절감 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Developers love building on powerful, serverless Amazon DynamoDB, and as their production tables grow in size and traffic, they want to discover what mechanisms and optimizations can be applied to reduce costs. Cost optimization can be done both in the design phase and during operations. In this session, learn how to model and measure costs, explore Database Savings Plans to reduce spend on predictable workloads, and discover cost optimization tools that can help you along the way.

title_ko: Amazon DynamoDB 비용 최적화
summary_ko: Amazon DynamoDB 비용을 모델링하고 측정하며 Database Savings Plans 등 절감 방법을 살펴봅니다.

title: Build stateful agentic AI workflows with Aurora, MCP, and AgentCore
title_ko: Aurora, MCP, AgentCore로 상태 저장형 에이전틱 AI 워크플로 구축
summary_ko: 레퍼런스 애플리케이션의 다섯 단계를 따라 Aurora, MCP, AgentCore로 상태 저장형 에이전트 워크플로를 구축합니다.
abstract: How do you take an AI agent from a local prototype to a governed application that recovers from failure? In this session, follow a reference application through five phases: querying business data with SQL, connecting agents to Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, adding hybrid retrieval, deploying to production, and enabling durable workflows. See how Aurora PostgreSQL unifies relational data, pgvector embeddings, full-text search, and workflow state. Explore Strands Agents on Bedrock AgentCore, verify identity and enforce row-level security for data access, and govern tool calls with AgentCore Policy. Code walkthroughs show recovery from saved steps, idempotency to prevent duplicate actions, and audit records that make outcomes traceable.

title_ko: Aurora, MCP, AgentCore로 상태 저장형 에이전틱 AI 워크플로 구축

title: Build a digital asset tokenization issuance solution
title_ko: 디지털 자산 토큰화 발행 솔루션 구축
summary_ko: 프로덕션 수준의 엔드투엔드 하이브리드 디지털 자산 토큰화 발행 솔루션을 구축하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: The emergence of digital assets and stablecoins requires bridging traditional message-based finance protocols such as SWIFT and ISO 20022 to programmable settlement rails while preserving institutional security, auditability, and governance. In this session, learn how to build a production-ready end-to-end hybrid settlement architecture on AWS that ingests financial messages, normalizes them into canonical settlement instructions, and executes tokenized asset transfers on-chain. Explore hardware-backed signing with AWS KMS, on-chain signer governance, and three settlement patterns: issuance, redemption, and transfer, with full audit trails, idempotent transaction handling, and EIP-712 typed signing. Bring your laptop to participate.

title: Optimize cost & performance in Amazon RDS for SQL Server
title_ko: Amazon RDS for SQL Server의 비용 및 성능 최적화
summary_ko: 성능과 비용 효율을 모두 갖춘 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 환경을 배포하고 최적화하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Cost and performance are top of mind for customers, and these topics go hand in hand. In this chalk talk, learn how to deploy a performant and cost-effective Amazon RDS for SQL Server solution that fits your needs. Explore RDS monitoring tools and native SQL Server features that can be leveraged to pinpoint query inefficiencies, optimize workloads, and right-size your database instances for both cost and peak performance.

title: Architect Oracle Database@AWS for resiliency and scale
title_ko: 복원력과 확장성을 위한 Oracle Database@AWS 아키텍처 설계
summary_ko: Oracle Database@AWS의 기본 및 재해 복구 환경을 위한 아키텍처 패턴을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Dedicated Exadata infrastructure inside AWS data centers gives Oracle workloads full feature compatibility alongside cloud native flexibility, but architecting for resiliency at scale demands deliberate design choices. In this session, explore architecture patterns for primary and disaster recovery deployments on Oracle Database@AWS, including strategies for multi-terabyte migration and managing petabyte-scale Oracle estates. Join a live whiteboarding discussion where AWS experts cover ODB@AWS deployment options, DR configurations, and operational design choices. Architect with validated best practices drawn from real customer deployments.

title: Optimizing prediction market and trading infrastructure
title_ko: 예측 시장 및 트레이딩 인프라 최적화
summary_ko: AWS 전문가들이 예측 시장과 트레이딩 시스템을 위한 저지연 인프라 아키텍처 패턴을 깊이 다룹니다.
abstract: Centralized exchanges, decentralized exchanges, and prediction markets share a critical challenge: managing the tension between resiliency and latency. AWS customers have solved this at scale on low-latency platforms trading digital assets 24/7. In this session, AWS specialists dive deep into architecture patterns and real-world examples addressing each challenge. Learn best practices for designing resilient, low-latency trading infrastructure using the latest AWS capabilities built for these markets.

title: Scaling ElastiCache globally: 500+ clusters & 1.3 trillion ops/day
title_ko: ElastiCache 글로벌 확장: 500개 이상의 클러스터와 하루 1.3조 건의 작업
summary_ko: inDrive가 온프레미스 모놀리식 캐시에서 대규모 글로벌 ElastiCache 환경으로 발전한 과정을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Managing ride-hailing demand across 1,100+ cities and 8+ million daily transactions in real time requires scalable, resilient, sub-millisecond in-memory data operations. In this session, learn how inDrive evolved from a monolithic on-premises Redis OSS cluster to over 500 distributed Amazon ElastiCache clusters spanning 8 AWS Regions, executing 1.3 trillion operations daily. Discover how inDrive eliminated bottlenecks in single-CPU utilization, network saturation, and hotspot shards, and how a zero-downtime migration to the Valkey engine on ElastiCache improved performance and reduced costs. Learn a production-tested blueprint for scaling data-intensive systems across multiple AWS Regions.

title: Agents on call: Autonomous DB ops on Amazon Aurora with Expedia Group
title_ko: 온콜 중인 에이전트: Expedia Group의 Amazon Aurora 자율 DB 운영
summary_ko: Expedia Group이 에이전틱 AI로 Amazon Aurora 데이터베이스 운영을 자율화한 여정을 배웁니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Expedia Group manages thousands of database instances across hundreds of AWS accounts. When incidents strike at this scale, every second counts. In this session, learn how a customer-driven vision for agentic AI evolved into a joint design partnership for autonomous database operations on Amazon Aurora. Discover how agents diagnose incidents across fleet-scale telemetry and deliver actionable recommendations to engineers. This joint initiative demonstrates how AI agents reduce incident response time and serves as a blueprint for teams seeking to automate database operations at scale. Learn how AWS is building the underlying capabilities to make autonomous operations real.

title: A practitioner’s guide to data for agentic AI
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI를 위한 데이터 실무자 가이드
summary_ko: 엔드투엔드 에이전틱 AI를 배포하는 데 필요한 데이터 준비와 아키텍처 역량을 익힙니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: In this session, gain the skills needed to deploy end-to-end agentic AI applications using your most valuable data. This session focuses on data management using processes like Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and provides concepts that apply to other methods of customizing agentic AI applications. Discover best practice architectures using AWS database services like Amazon Aurora, DynamoDB, and Neptune, along with analytical, data processing and streaming experiences found in SageMaker. Learn data lake, governance, and data quality concepts and how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and other features tie solution components together.

title: 10x Faster Vector Indexes: GPU Acceleration in Amazon OpenSearch with NVIDIA cuVS (sponsored by NVIDIA)
title_ko: 10배 빠른 벡터 인덱스: NVIDIA cuVS로 Amazon OpenSearch GPU 가속 (NVIDIA 후원)
summary_ko: NVIDIA cuVS GPU 가속으로 Amazon OpenSearch에서 수십억 규모 벡터 인덱스 구축 속도를 크게 높이는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: At billion-vector scale, vector index construction can become a performance and cost bottleneck for retrieval, RAG, and AI workloads. Amazon OpenSearch Service Vector Acceleration uses NVIDIA cuVS to accelerate index construction, delivering up to 10x faster builds at a quarter of the indexing cost while preserving the OpenSearch experience. This 300-level session goes under the hood of the architecture: how eligible builds are offloaded to managed GPU workers, how cuVS and CAGRA accelerate graph construction through the Faiss backend, and how the graph is converted into an HNSW index for CPU-based search. We will examine how segment size, quantization, and ingestion patterns affect GPU utilization, build speed, and efficiency. Attendees will leave with guidance for identifying good-fit workloads, optimizing ingestion, and modeling performance and cost benefits for their own deployments. This presentation is brought to you by NVIDIA, an AWS Partner.

title: Building the data architecture that survives agentic analytics (sponsored by Edelbyte)
title_ko: 에이전틱 분석을 견디는 데이터 아키텍처 구축 (Edelbyte 후원)
summary_ko: 예측 가능한 사람의 쿼리와 달리 에이전트가 만드는 대량의 분석 쿼리를 견딜 수 있는 데이터 아키텍처를 다룹니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Human queries are bounded, repeatable, and predictable, so techniques like caching, sampling, and precomputation keep them fast and affordable. AI agents are none of those. One prompt becomes dozens of novel, complex queries at machine speed, so caching an agent's curiosity is nearly impossible. At a leading automotive R&D group, 1,400 engineers and their agents query 200 petabytes of vehicle telemetry, with 600 terabytes ingested daily, to engineer higher-quality, more reliable vehicles and reach production faster. This session shows the AWS architecture behind it and how it delivers real-time analytics with full retention at the scale agents have made standard. This presentation is brought to you by Edelbyte, an AWS Partner.

title: SQL Server to Amazon RDS: lessons from Xero's 900 database migration
title_ko: SQL Server에서 Amazon RDS로: Xero의 데이터베이스 900개 마이그레이션 교훈
summary_ko: Xero가 900개 SQL Server 데이터베이스를 Amazon RDS로 이전하며 전환을 조율한 방법과 교훈을 공유합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: What does it take to migrate the databases behind 5 million small businesses without anyone noticing? Xero, the global cloud accounting platform, moved 900 SQL Server databases to Amazon RDS for SQL Server with near-zero downtime. In this session, Xero shares how the team orchestrated cutovers, approached schema migration, and used managed patching, automated backups, and capacity planning in Amazon RDS to return engineering time to product development. The session covers the migration planning and decision points most relevant to engineering teams running large SQL Server fleets on aging self-managed infrastructure.

title: Amazon Aurora HA and DR design patterns for global resilience
title_ko: 글로벌 복원력을 위한 Amazon Aurora HA 및 DR 설계 패턴
summary_ko: Aurora의 고가용성과 재해 복구 기능을 살펴보고 글로벌 복원력을 위한 설계 패턴을 알아봅니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Amazon Aurora is a serverless relational database with unparalleled high performance and availability at global scale for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and DSQL. Aurora provides managed high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) capabilities in and across AWS Regions. In this session, explore the Aurora HA and DR capabilities and discover design patterns that enable the development of resilient applications. Learn how to establish in-Region and cross-Region HA and DR using Aurora features including Multi-AZ deployments and Aurora Global Database, and how Aurora DSQL multi-Region clusters provides the highest level of availability and application resilience.

title: Essentials for migrating from Oracle to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
title_ko: Oracle에서 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL로 마이그레이션하기 위한 핵심 사항
summary_ko: Oracle에서 Aurora PostgreSQL로 성공적으로 마이그레이션하기 위해 꼭 알아야 할 핵심 사항을 다룹니다.
abstract: Migrating from Oracle to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition can be a transformative journey, offering significant cost savings and performance benefits. However, this transition requires careful planning and execution. In this session, discover the essential things you need to know to ensure a smooth and successful migration from Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL and the optimal architectures to enable such a migration. Learn best practices and pitfalls to avoid from seasoned experts who have helped many customers walk this path.

title: Amazon Aurora DSQL: A developer's perspective
title_ko: Amazon Aurora DSQL: 개발자 관점
summary_ko: 개발자 관점에서 Amazon Aurora DSQL로 애플리케이션을 개발하는 방법을 보여줍니다.
abstract: In this live coding session, we'll show you how to work with Amazon Aurora DSQL from a developer's perspective. We'll develop a sample application to highlight some of the ways developing for Aurora DSQL is different than PostgreSQL. We'll cover authentication and connection management, optimistic concurrency transaction patterns, primary key selection, analyzing query performance, and best practices.

title: AI agents for PostgreSQL replication and partitioning
title_ko: PostgreSQL 복제 및 파티셔닝을 위한 AI 에이전트
summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 핵심 개념인 복제와 파티셔닝을 관리하는 AI 에이전트를 직접 구축합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Recent PostgreSQL releases introduced transformative capabilities for logical replication and partitioning, including filtering, parallel apply, sequence replication, and improved planning for partition-heavy workloads. These features are powerful, but tuning them for a specific environment remains complex. In this session, learn to build agents for these core PostgreSQL concepts on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL: one that analyzes workloads to recommend optimal logical replication configuration, and a partitioning agent that evaluates query patterns and table bloat to guide table partitioning strategy.

title_ko: PostgreSQL 복제 및 파티셔닝을 위한 AI 에이전트
summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 핵심 개념인 복제와 파티셔닝을 관리하는 AI 에이전트를 직접 구축합니다.

title: Deep dive into Amazon Aurora DSQL and its architecture
title_ko: Amazon Aurora DSQL과 아키텍처 심층 분석
summary_ko: Amazon Aurora DSQL의 설계와 이를 가능하게 한 핵심 혁신 기술을 깊이 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Amazon Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database that uses decades of Amazon innovation and operational excellence. In this session, dive into the design and key innovative technologies that make Aurora DSQL the ideal choice for new applications and applications that require the highest level of resilience. Learn how active-active architecture in Aurora DSQL delivers single- and multi-Region resiliency and virtually unlimited scale

title: Build agentic GraphRAG apps with Amazon Neptune
title_ko: Amazon Neptune으로 에이전틱 GraphRAG 앱 구축
summary_ko: 오픈소스 도구와 Amazon Neptune을 활용해 에이전틱 GraphRAG 애플리케이션을 구축합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: GraphRAG combines knowledge graphs with RAG to produce explainable responses grounded in semantic relationships between concepts, entities, and underlying content. Agentic GraphRAG takes this further, allowing agents to autonomously decide which GraphRAG tools to use to achieve information goals. In this session, build an agentic GraphRAG application using the open source AWS GraphRAG Toolkit. You will transform unstructured and semi-structured data into a catalog of domain-specific GraphRAG tools to enable agents to answer multi-faceted questions that require context from multiple distinct knowledge sources to provide a contextually complete answer. Bring your laptop to participate.

title: Build agentic GraphRAG apps with Amazon Neptune
title_ko: Amazon Neptune으로 에이전틱 GraphRAG 앱 구축
summary_ko: 오픈소스 도구와 Amazon Neptune을 활용해 에이전틱 GraphRAG 애플리케이션을 구축합니다.

title: Vector search, agents, and image matching with Amazon DynamoDB
title_ko: Amazon DynamoDB로 벡터 검색, 에이전트, 이미지 매칭 구현
summary_ko: Amazon DynamoDB 단일 테이블 데이터 모델로 벡터 검색, 에이전트, 이미지 매칭을 구현하는 설계를 살펴봅니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: Amazon DynamoDB supports native vector search, enabling semantic queries, agentic recommendations, and image-based matching without additional infrastructure. In this session, explore how to design a single-table data model for a recipe database, bulk-load thousands of items with embeddings, and build three vector-powered features: semantic search, a smart recommendation agent, and image-based meal matching. Learn how to configure vector indexes, composite keys, and global secondary indexes on a fully serverless stack, and leave with reusable patterns to add vector search to your own DynamoDB workloads. Bring your laptop to participate.

title: Build explainable AI agent observability with DynamoDB and Neptune
title_ko: DynamoDB와 Neptune으로 설명 가능한 AI 에이전트 관측성 구축
summary_ko: DynamoDB와 Neptune을 활용해 에이전트의 판단 과정을 설명할 수 있는 관측성 시스템을 설계합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Unintended agent actions and incorrect outputs are difficult to investigate without a structured provenance layer. In this session, learn how to design an agent observability system using Amazon DynamoDB to capture the operational audit log and Amazon Neptune to model causal dependencies between retrieved facts and agent decisions. Explore the data model, instrumentation patterns, and graph query techniques that answer what data an agent retrieved, what it concluded, and how those conclusions shaped the final output, making every agent decision traceable and explainable. Bring your laptop to participate.

title: Building globally distributed applications with DynamoDB global tables
title_ko: DynamoDB 글로벌 테이블로 전 세계 분산 애플리케이션 구축
summary_ko: Amazon DynamoDB 글로벌 테이블을 활용해 여러 리전에 분산된 애플리케이션을 설계하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Failures happen. Regions degrade, Availability Zones go offline, and networks partition. In this session, learn how to architect Amazon DynamoDB applications that maintain availability and data integrity across a spectrum of failure modes, from single-AZ impairments to full-Region disruptions. Explore the DynamoDB primitives that underpin resilience, including global tables, multi-Region strong consistency, backup and restore, snapshots, and streaming, and how to compose them into patterns that meet strict RTO and RPO objectives. Using scenarios drawn from recent large-scale events, examine trade-offs between consistency, latency, and availability, and discover operational best practices for detecting, responding to, and recovering from failures.

title: Build agentic hybrid retrieval with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
title_ko: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL로 에이전틱 하이브리드 검색 구축
summary_ko: Aurora PostgreSQL에서 벡터와 키워드를 결합한 하이브리드 검색으로 에이전트 답변의 근거를 강화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: What if your agent's most convincing answer rests on the wrong evidence? Build agentic hybrid retrieval with Aurora PostgreSQL across more than 500,000 product listings in three connected hands-on labs. Debug SQL combining full-text search, pg_trgm fuzzy matching, and pgvector semantic search under shared filters. Repair reciprocal rank fusion, inspect Amazon Bedrock reranking, and compare retrieval settings against judged queries. Then build a Strands agent, connect its retrieval tools through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, and deploy it to AgentCore Runtime. Trace its searches to cited specifications and reviews, and test what happens when requirements change. Leave with reusable retrieval SQL and working agent code.

title_ko: Amazon Aurora 클러스터의 복원력 높이기
summary_ko: Aurora Global Database 등 Amazon Aurora 클러스터의 복원력을 높이는 기능을 배웁니다.
abstract: Amazon Aurora is a cloud-native relational database with unparalleled high performance and availability at global scale. Hundreds of thousands of organizations trust Aurora for their workloads today. In this session, learn about features such as Aurora Global Database and Amazon RDS Proxy, and discover best practices to achieve high availability for Aurora MySQL and Aurora PostgreSQL database clusters. The session includes a whiteboarding discussion on high availability and disaster recovery solutions to help maximize application resilience.

title: Migrate to Amazon DynamoDB with AI-powered schema design
title_ko: AI 기반 스키마 설계로 Amazon DynamoDB로 마이그레이션하기
summary_ko: 새로운 AI 기반 스키마 설계 도구로 시행착오를 줄이며 Amazon DynamoDB로 마이그레이션하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Amazon DynamoDB schema design is the number one barrier to adoption, requiring upfront knowledge of access patterns and partition strategies, which most teams learn through trial and error. New AI-powered schema design tools for DynamoDB change that. In this live coding session, follow along as a banking payment-processing application is migrated from a relational database to DynamoDB. The session covers workload analysis, optimized table design generation, cost and throughput tradeoff comparisons, and iterative refinement toward production-quality schemas, including reviewing AI-generated code, refining the implementation, migrating data, and demonstrating the complete end-to-end solution.

title_ko: MCP 기반 에이전틱 Neptune 그래프 추론으로 지능형 AI 구현
summary_ko: MCP와 Amazon Neptune 그래프 추론을 활용해 투자 분석용 생성형 AI 애플리케이션을 구축합니다.
abstract: Graph-based agentic reasoning empowers AI systems to dynamically interact with the rich context and relationships in an Amazon Neptune graph, enabling intelligent, flexible, and scalable AI solutions that extract valuable insights from complex, interconnected data. In this session, build a generative AI application for investment analysis spanning the full lifecycle, from raw unstructured data to autonomous AI agents, by combining Neptune, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Construct autonomous AI workflows that extract entities and relationships from raw EDGAR data, build a domain knowledge graph, surface actionable insights from graph relationships, and build an agent to find investment analysis trends. Bring your laptop to participate.

title: An insider’s look into architecture choices for Amazon DynamoDB
title_ko: Amazon DynamoDB 아키텍처 선택에 대한 내부자의 시선
summary_ko: 기본적인 데이터 구조 결정이 Amazon DynamoDB의 현재 아키텍처로 이어진 배경과 설계 선택을 설명합니다.
abstract: To overcome the performance and scale limitations of relational databases, AWS built Amazon DynamoDB to deliver single-digit millisecond performance at any scale - whether your application has tens of thousands or hundreds of millions of simultaneous users - for the most demanding applications on the planet. In this session, learn how some basic data structure decisions led to these characteristics. And how those same decisions provide immutable, point-in-time restore. Leave with a better understanding of why DynamoDB can operate at the scale it does, and a framework on how to use it for decisions in your own applications.

title: Financial data modeling with Amazon DynamoDB
title_ko: Amazon DynamoDB를 활용한 금융 데이터 모델링
summary_ko: 계좌, 거래 등 금융 비즈니스 엔터티를 Amazon DynamoDB에서 모델링하는 방법을 배웁니다.

abstract: Designing business applications for low latency, high throughput, high consistency, and high availability presents unique challenges at scale. In this session, learn how to model business entities including accounts, journals, and ledgers using Amazon DynamoDB to support workflows that process millions of requests per second. Explore distributed computing patterns that leverage multi-Region replication features in DynamoDB. Bring your laptop to participate.

title: Build governed agentic AI search with Aurora, RDS, & Bedrock AgentCore
title_ko: Aurora, RDS, Bedrock AgentCore로 거버넌스가 적용된 에이전틱 AI 검색 구축
summary_ko: 비즈니스 데이터에 기반해 답변하는 리테일 어시스턴트를 Aurora, RDS, Bedrock AgentCore로 구축합니다.
abstract: Build an agentic retail assistant that answers from business facts under explicit controls. Across four connected labs, combine Aurora PostgreSQL full-text search and pgvector with reciprocal rank fusion and Cohere Rerank on Amazon Bedrock. Connect search and inventory tools to specialists built with the Strands Agents SDK, then deploy them to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Runtime, Memory, Gateway, and Policy. Protect customer records with identity binding and PostgreSQL row-level security, and enforce Cedar policies on Gateway tool calls. Approve a store credit, query the audit records, and verify denied calls don't execute and retries don't duplicate credits. Patterns are reusable across Aurora and RDS for PostgreSQL.

abstract: Join this session to learn about Amazon Aurora DSQL's optimistic concurrency control (OCC). Explore building an application to understand the impact of OCC on your relational workloads, how it differs from traditional databases, and how to achieve the desired semantics in DSQL's OCC model.

abstract: Amazon DynamoDB is a popular choice for modern applications because it’s a serverless database that provides single-digit millisecond performance at any scale. Optimizing your usage of DynamoDB requires a different approach to data modeling than traditional relational databases. In this session, explore advanced techniques to help you get the most out of DynamoDB. Learn how to “think in DynamoDB” by learning the DynamoDB foundations and principles for data modeling. Further, learn practical strategies and DynamoDB features to handle difficult use cases in your application.

title: Dive deep into Amazon DynamoDB
title_ko: Amazon DynamoDB 심층 분석
summary_ko: 대규모에서도 일관된 성능을 내는 Amazon DynamoDB의 내부 아키텍처를 깊이 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: This session provides a deep dive into Amazon DynamoDB and shares insights into how DynamoDB is architected and how it’s able to deliver the scalability and response times that customers have come to expect. DynamoDB is used by over one million AWS customers, and powers hundreds of applications that exceed half a million requests per second. In this talk we explore the architecture of DynamoDB, and of several specific features. You will understand how we architected DynamoDB to deliver predictable low latency at any scale, and how best to develop your own applications to delight your customers.

title: Dive deep into Amazon DynamoDB using design puzzles
title_ko: 설계 퍼즐로 Amazon DynamoDB 깊이 파헤치기
summary_ko: 설계 퍼즐을 함께 풀며 Amazon DynamoDB가 대규모에서 어떻게 동작하는지 깊이 이해합니다.
abstract: In this session, dive deep into how Amazon DynamoDB works at scale by collaboratively solving a few design puzzles that may seem simple but are actually complex. Learn how to look beyond the obvious solution to find a more effective and scalable one with an understanding of how DynamoDB operates.

title: Reduce LLM inference cost with Amazon ElastiCache with Valkey
title_ko: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey로 LLM 추론 비용 절감
summary_ko: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey를 시맨틱 캐시 등으로 활용해 LLM 추론 비용을 줄이는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: Agents resend long, repeated prompts every turn. GPUs keep recomputing the same context. In this session, learn how to use Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey as a shared KV cache. It cuts cost per token and time to first token. See how inference engines such as vLLM store and reuse KV state across GPU servers with ElastiCache. Any server can skip repeated prefill, even after a restart. We cover the architecture and patterns that optimize cost or latency. We also share representative benchmarks and show when caching pays off.

title: Amazon DocumentDB for expert practitioners
title_ko: 전문가를 위한 Amazon DocumentDB
summary_ko: Amazon DocumentDB의 구현 세부 사항과 설계상 트레이드오프를 깊이 있게 다룹니다.
abstract: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is a fully managed database service for native document data model enterprise workloads. It removes the undifferentiated heavy lifting of operating a database so that teams can focus time on delivering value for customers. In this session, dive deep into the implementation details and trade-offs of features to improve compression and performance while lowering cost for various workloads.

room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: Building highly scalable, high-performance AI and data-driven applications requires intelligent caching strategies. In this session, learn how to build with Amazon ElastiCache to scale workloads across caching patterns such as session caching, KV-caching, and more. Dive deep into microsecond latency networking optimizations that enable sub-millisecond response times, and explore common performance pitfalls with practical solutions to keep applications running smoothly.

title: Advanced data modeling for Amazon ElastiCache
title_ko: Amazon ElastiCache 고급 데이터 모델링
summary_ko: Amazon ElastiCache의 데이터 구조와 고급 모델링 기법을 세부적으로 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: This session delves into the intricacies of Amazon ElastiCache data modeling using the purpose-built Valkey data types to optimize application performance and scalability. Explore the use of strings, sets, sorted sets, hashes, bitmaps, and geospatial indexes to model complex relationships and solve use cases such as caching, session store, feature store, real-time analytics, geospatial applications, and rate limiters.

title: Deep dive into Amazon Aurora and its innovations
title_ko: Amazon Aurora와 혁신 기술 심층 분석
summary_ko: 최신 Aurora 기능과 이를 뒷받침하는 혁신 기술을 깊이 살펴봅니다.
abstract: With an innovative architecture that decouples compute from storage and advanced features like Aurora Global Database and low-latency read replicas, Aurora reimagines what it means to be a relational database. Aurora is a built-for-the-cloud, serverless relational database that delivers unparalleled performance and availability at global scale for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and DSQL. In this session, dive deep into the newest Aurora features. Explore how Aurora supports agentic AI through vector search and MCP servers for agent access. Also, learn about Aurora DSQL, the fastest serverless distributed SQL database.

title: Evolve Amazon DynamoDB data models with no application impact
title_ko: 애플리케이션 영향 없이 Amazon DynamoDB 데이터 모델 발전시키기
summary_ko: 버전 관리와 하위 호환성 패턴으로 서비스 영향 없이 DynamoDB 데이터 모델을 변경하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Master advanced techniques for evolving Amazon DynamoDB data models without application interruption. Learn versioning strategies, backward compatibility patterns, and migration approaches for production applications. In this session, architect a solution that covers attribute addition and removal, data type changes, and index modifications while maintaining 24/7 availability. Explore real-world migration scenarios, rollback strategies, and handling distributed application dependencies. The best practices covered in this session are essential for teams managing large-scale DynamoDB applications requiring continuous evolution while serving millions of requests.
