title: Visual reasoning will be bigger than language reasoning
title_ko: 시각적 추론은 언어 추론보다 더 커질 것이다
summary_ko: AI의 시각적 추론 능력이 언어 추론을 넘어설 잠재력과 그 기술적 근거, 응용 가능성을 다룹니다.
abstract: Today’s vision-language models can describe images fluently, yet still struggle with the spatial and perceptual reasoning required for robotics. This talk argues that visual reasoning—reasoning through points, sketches, trajectories, depth maps, and other grounded representations—will become more important than language reasoning for physical agents. It traces progress from benchmarks exposing fundamental perception failures to methods that teach models to reason directly in visual space. These ideas culminate in robotics foundation models that convert visual plans into robot actions. The resulting systems are interpretable, steerable, deployable zero-shot on affordable hardware, and competitive with proprietary models trained on substantially more data. We showcase how these ideas are advancing the goal of accessible, general-purpose robotics to the broader research community.

title: How AI is Changing Everything (Computer Systems, Education, Driving, and More)
title_ko: AI는 어떻게 모든 것을 바꾸고 있나 (컴퓨터 시스템, 교육, 운전 등)
summary_ko: 컴퓨터 시스템, 교육, 자율 주행 등 다양한 분야에서 AI가 가져오는 변화를 폭넓게 조망합니다.
abstract: Reflecting on my roles as Head of Computer Science at MIT, Director of the MIT Education Exch(AI)nge, and Chief Scientist at Cambridge Mobile Telematics, I will discuss how the rise of generative AI is reshaping software, computer science itself, higher education, and the ways data- and AI-driven companies create value from data. In computer science, we are seeing explosive growth both in the range of problems AI can solve and in the new systems and tools required to make AI effective, efficient, and reliable. In higher education, we are rethinking fundamental questions about what students need to learn, as well as how we teach and assess our students. At CMT, we are applying new AI architectures to better understand mobility data, particularly road and driver risk. I will use concrete examples and results to explore the common theme of how to achieve the greatest impact from AI.

title: The Cogs of a Well-oiled Software Factory
title_ko: 잘 돌아가는 소프트웨어 팩토리의 톱니바퀴
summary_ko: 효율적인 소프트웨어 팩토리를 구성하는 도구, 프로세스, 자동화 요소와 그 운영 방식을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: The "Software Factory" is a new buzzword for a fully autonomous agent driven software development process. Many organizations are trying to set up such a factory, but this is easier said than done. In this talk, from my experience setting up such factories for ourselves and other businesses, I will explain some of the elements of a software factory (issue triage, spec generation, implementation, review, and testing), and some of the pain points that we have experienced at each step. I will also cover how to evaluate the effectiveness of each of these steps and how to build a self-improvement pipeline so the factory gets better and better with feedback from its human supervisors.

title: Data Environments for Agents
title_ko: 에이전트를 위한 데이터 환경
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 데이터를 안전하고 효과적으로 탐색·활용할 수 있는 데이터 환경 설계 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: AI agents increasingly query databases, modify files, and operate applications. Their effectiveness depends on the environments in which they act: what information they can discover, which alternatives they can explore, and what happens when they make mistakes. This session examines how data environments can help agents accomplish more while bounding the consequences of failure. Drawing on research from Columbia’s Data, Agents, and Processes Lab, we explore branching and recovery across databases and live execution state, data flow controls that enforce policies and guide agent behavior, and evaluations that reveal bottlenecks in finding and using information. Participants will leave with a framework for reasoning about the responsibilities of models, execution systems, and human interfaces when building agentic applications.

title: Recursive Self-Improvement on the Job
title_ko: 업무 중 재귀적 자기 개선
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 실제 업무를 수행하면서 스스로 성능을 반복적으로 개선하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: This talk will discuss RSI (recursive self-improvement) agents that proactively and continuously learn on the job. Agents onboard a new knowledge job just like human employees. Through RSI, we show that agents can outperform human testers on the same job across accuracy, efficiency, and cost. The talk will end with a discussion on the future of human-AI collaboration.

title: No torque sensors, no problem: learning safe physical interaction for humanoids
title_ko: 토크 센서 없이도 문제없다: 휴머노이드의 안전한 물리적 상호작용 학습
summary_ko: 토크 센서 없이 학습 기반으로 휴머노이드 로봇이 안전하게 물리적 상호작용을 하도록 만드는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: How do you make a humanoid robot safe to operate alongside people, without the torque sensors? Fauna Robotics Sprout is a humanoid robot that uses a position-command interface, yet it must regulate the forces it exchanges with the world. We show how Sprout learns compliant behavior that approximates classic impedance control, through mechanisms that control force at the joints and in task space. We describe how these controllers are trained and how they enable safer, whole-body interaction.

title: Building the machine that builds the machine
title_ko: 기계를 만드는 기계 만들기
summary_ko: AWS가 에이전트를 활용해 소프트웨어와 시스템 구축 과정 자체를 자동화하는 방법과 관련 출시 내용을 소개합니다.
abstract: At AWS, we're constantly looking for ways to automate parts of the building process with agents. An upcoming launch takes this to the extreme, releasing an application that was built entirely by autonomous agents without a human ever touching the code base. The agents built a first version over a weekend. But turning that into a robust application was a much longer journey than we expected. In this talk, we pull back the curtain on this upcoming launch and talk about the machine that builds the machine.

title: Beyond Next-Token Prediction: World Models for Human Health
title_ko: 다음 토큰 예측을 넘어: 인간 건강을 위한 월드 모델
summary_ko: 다음 토큰 예측을 넘어 인간 건강을 모델링하는 월드 모델의 개념과 헬스케어 응용 가능성을 다룹니다.
abstract: Next-token prediction has been effective for language, but is it the right learning objective for achieving clinical intelligence from longitudinal human health data? In this talk, we show that treating health records as flat token sequences limit the advancement of foundation models in healthcare. We then introduce a Health State–Action World Model that abstracts longitudinal records into learned representations of patient health states and clinical actions, and models how these states evolve under different interventions. This abstraction enables pretraining models to predict future health events, diagnoses, treatments, and responses to treatment. Across large-scale datasets, we show that moving from token-level prediction to state–action modeling enables clinical intelligence that cannot be achieved through token prediction alone, while generalizing strongly to unseen patients.

title: Japan Wrap-up Session
title_ko: 일본 랩업 세션
summary_ko: 일본어로 진행되며 re:Invent의 주요 발표와 전략적 업데이트를 종합적으로 정리해 드립니다.
abstract: This session will be delivered in Japanese and provides a comprehensive recap of the major announcements and strategic updates from the keynote sessions throughout the event. Experienced speakers will summarize the most impactful innovations and key messages from AWS leadership. Designed for a broad audience, from developers and engineers to business decision-makers, this session will help you identify and prioritize the announcements most relevant to your organization. It will also help you prepare to share what you learned at re:Invent with your teams when you return to the office

title: Developer Keynote
title_ko: 개발자 키노트
summary_ko: AWS 엔지니어들이 빠르게 변화하는 소프트웨어 개발 환경에서 개발자를 위한 최신 도구와 혁신을 소개합니다.
abstract: Building software has never moved faster, and it has never asked more of developers. In this keynote, AWS Engineers and Heroes from the community tackle what's still hard: going from idea to a live app in minutes, building agents that actually work, and trusting code you didn't write yourself. Expect live demos, hard-won lessons from the AWS team that built a new service with an AI software factory, and an honest look at how the developer's job is changing. Come see how AWS is making it easier to build anything you can imagine, then go build it.

title: CEO Keynote
title_ko: CEO 키노트
summary_ko: AWS CEO Matt Garman이 에이전틱 시대를 이끄는 AWS의 최신 혁신과 비전을 발표합니다.
abstract: Join AWS CEO Matt Garman for the re:Invent 2026 CEO Keynote as he shares the latest innovations powering the agentic era. From AI infrastructure and inference to data, agent platforms, and the software agents AWS is building, see how AWS gives you the depth, breadth, and integration to build what's next with new announcements and stories from customers already doing it.

title: Data & AI Keynote
title_ko: 데이터 & AI 키노트
summary_ko: 데모 수준에 머문 AI 에이전트를 프로덕션으로 확장하기 위한 데이터와 AI 분야의 최신 혁신을 소개합니다.
abstract: The future is already here...it's just not evenly distributed in production. Most teams have agents that shine in a demo and stall before they do real work. The ones who get to production changed three things: how agents reach their data, how they measure what agents are worth, and the limits they set. Join Swami Sivasubramanian and Andy Warfield to learn how to make these same shifts in your organization.

title: Partner Keynote
title_ko: 파트너 키노트
summary_ko: AWS 파트너를 대상으로 대규모 혁신을 함께 이끌기 위한 AWS의 전략과 새로운 지원 프로그램을 소개합니다.
abstract: AWS Partners, this one's for you. You're powering today's biggest transformations, and AWS is building alongside you to make co-selling and going to market simpler. This is your biggest moment of re:Invent, where you'll leave knowing where to invest and how to win in the agentic era. Join Dr. Ruba Borno and guests including AWS CEO Matt Garman for a game plan built on agent-run migrations with your data plugged in, your expertise embedded in customer tools, and more profitable business models, plus a Marketplace and Partner Central demo on reaching more buyers faster. Don't miss it.

title: Technical Innovations Keynote
title_ko: 기술 혁신 키노트
summary_ko: 예측 불가능하게 동작하는 에이전트 워크로드를 지원하기 위한 AWS 인프라의 기술 혁신을 소개합니다.
abstract: Agents don't follow a script. They change plans mid-task, reach for tools they didn't know they'd need, and create demand you can't predict. For two decades, the hardest workloads builders brought to AWS have pushed us to rethink everything from Graviton and Trainium to the shape of the data center network, to the way storage scales, and how we prove systems behave as intended. Join AWS's top engineers and scientists for an under-the-hood look at the technology that came out of that pressure, the kind of story you won't hear anywhere else. See how AWS infrastructure adapts as your work changes, freeing you to stop engineering around constraints and build anything you can imagine.

title: Aflac’s Modernization journey to a resilient and innovative future (sponsored by Kyndryl)
title_ko: Aflac의 회복탄력적이고 혁신적인 미래를 향한 현대화 여정 (Kyndryl 후원)
summary_ko: Aflac이 Kyndryl과 함께 레거시 시스템을 현대화해 회복탄력성과 혁신 역량을 확보한 여정을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Modernizing critical systems is never just about technology. In this executive panel, leaders from Aflac, Kyndryl, and AWS share the real-world experience behind Aflac’s transformation journey, from overcoming operational challenges and reducing downtime risk to enabling future innovation & continuous modernization. Learn how a strong customer-partner relationship helped balance transformation with business continuity, security, and regulatory requirements. Gain insights into managing large-scale transformation, avoiding common pitfalls, and building a roadmap that delivers measurable business value while preparing for the next generation of cloud and AI-driven innovation. This presentation is brought to you by Kyndryl, an AWS Partner.

title: Re-Engineer Enterprise Processes for Agentic AI on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (sponsored by Camunda)
title_ko: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore에서 에이전틱 AI를 위한 엔터프라이즈 프로세스 재설계 (Camunda 후원)
summary_ko: Camunda와 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore로 엔터프라이즈 비즈니스 프로세스를 에이전틱 AI에 맞게 재설계하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Enterprise AI is moving from experimentation to production, but legacy workflows designed without AI in mind keep agents disconnected from the processes, systems, and controls that determine successful business outcomes. Understand why reengineering now matters: organizations that preserve legacy workflows risk slowing AI adoption while others redesign operations for an AI first world. Discover how Camunda ProcessOS works with Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to discover, re-engineer, and improve end-to-end processes. See how Camunda’s agentic orchestration combines deterministic controls with dynamic AI agents, human approval, observability, and auditability. Learn why you need to re-engineer now, and stop adding agents to yesterday’s workflows. This presentation is brought to you by Camunda, an AWS Partner.

title: How IT leaders actually pulled off their cloud migrations
title_ko: IT 리더들은 실제로 클라우드 마이그레이션을 어떻게 해냈나
summary_ko: IT 리더들이 클라우드 마이그레이션을 성공적으로 완수한 실제 경험과 교훈을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: How did other organizations get their on-premises environments to AWS? In this panel, migration leaders from global organizations share exactly how they did it, including those moving off VMware and other aging infrastructure. You'll hear the real planning decisions, execution strategies, and lessons learned that made their transitions successful. They'll also share where they're headed next with modernization and innovation. Whether you're just getting started or pushing past roadblocks, you'll leave with proven strategies and practical insights to accelerate your own cloud migration.

title: How Deutsche Bahn made 10 years of cloud modernization pay off in AI
title_ko: Deutsche Bahn은 10년간의 클라우드 현대화를 어떻게 AI 성과로 연결했나
summary_ko: Deutsche Bahn이 10년간의 클라우드 현대화 투자를 AI 혁신의 기반으로 활용한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: You've invested in cloud. Maybe migrated. Maybe modernized. Your board wants AI yesterday, but 88% of companies use AI and only 1% believe they're at maturity. The gap isn't infrastructure. It's whether your organization can move fast enough. In this fireside chat, an AWS executive-in-residence sits down with Deutsche Bahn leadership to unpack how they built that speed: 550+ autonomous teams, AWS migration completed 18 months early, and enterprise-scale agentic AI now in production. You'll leave with: (1) what "AI-ready" requires beyond cloud, (2) a governance model for agents at scale, and (3) a framework for pilot to all-in.

title: Booking.com's playbook for cloud transformation at global scale
title_ko: 글로벌 규모 클라우드 전환을 위한 Booking.com의 플레이북
summary_ko: Booking.com이 글로벌 규모로 클라우드 전환을 추진하며 얻은 전략과 실행 플레이북을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Booking.com connects millions of travelers to over 28 million listings across 43 languages. Their cloud transformation had to match that scale. In this session, hear how Booking.com dissolved organizational silos, broke through bottlenecks, and compressed timelines to fundamentally change how they build, operate, and innovate. You'll learn the architectural decisions, migration frameworks, and repeatable patterns that scaled cloud adoption across the enterprise, and how embedding AI from the ground up now powers next-generation customer experiences. Leave with a playbook for turning cloud transformation into continuous, cloud-fluent competitive advantage.

title: Build Your Agentic Transformation Roadmap with AWS Transform
title_ko: AWS Transform으로 에이전틱 전환 로드맵 수립하기
summary_ko: AWS Transform을 활용해 레거시 현대화와 에이전틱 AI 도입을 위한 전환 로드맵을 수립하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan I
abstract: You want to adopt agentic AI, but with hundreds of applications at different maturity levels, knowing where to start is the real challenge. In this chalk talk, we'll work through a practical framework for turning AWS Transform's automated agentic readiness and modernization analyses into a phased transformation plan. You'll see how to interpret portfolio-level scores, prioritize applications by business value and technical debt, sequence work into actionable phases, and connect readiness gaps to concrete next steps. Bring your portfolio challenges — you'll leave with a prioritization approach you can apply immediately

title: Build Your Agentic Transformation Roadmap with AWS Transform
title_ko: AWS Transform으로 에이전틱 전환 로드맵 수립하기
summary_ko: AWS Transform을 활용해 레거시 현대화와 에이전틱 AI 도입을 위한 전환 로드맵을 수립하는 방법을 다룹니다.

title: Move code modernization at scale from one-time to continuous
title_ko: 대규모 코드 현대화를 일회성에서 지속적 활동으로 전환하기
summary_ko: 대규모 코드 현대화를 일회성 프로젝트가 아닌 지속적인 프로세스로 운영하는 방법과 도구를 소개합니다.
abstract: Technical debt doesn't stop accumulating when a modernization project ends. Across thousands of repos, outdated dependencies, framework drift, and security gaps compound daily. So why treat code modernization at scale as a one-time campaign? In this chalk talk, we'll explore how AWS Transform is evolving into always-on, autonomous remediation at portfolio scale. We'll dig into what continuous mode looks like in practice, what early enterprise customers are seeing, and how this changes the way your teams think about maintaining code health over time. Bring your questions.

title_ko: 대규모 코드 현대화를 일회성에서 지속적 활동으로 전환하기

Bring your questions.

title: End-to-end agentic modernization with United Airlines & Bank Hapoalim
title_ko: United Airlines와 Bank Hapoalim의 엔드투엔드 에이전틱 현대화
summary_ko: United Airlines와 Bank Hapoalim이 에이전틱 AI로 애플리케이션 현대화를 처음부터 끝까지 추진한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Legacy applications across mainframe, midrange, and distributed platforms have long resisted modernization efforts. A new approach that combines deterministic methods with agentic AI is changing that by delivering speed and accuracy. Learn how United Airlines modernized crew operations while maintaining FAR compliance, and how Bank Hapoalim analyzed a 3.2-million-line mortgage application and delivered an insurance module to production under a board-mandated deadline while reducing operational risk. Follow the end-to-end journey, from automated discovery and business rule extraction with AWS Transform through microservices engineering with Kiro to production deployment. Leave with a playbook for modernizing the applications everyone said were untouchable.

title: Using AI to scale legacy app modernization with Experian & Itaú
title_ko: Experian과 Itaú의 AI 기반 레거시 앱 현대화 확장
summary_ko: Experian과 Itaú가 AI를 활용해 레거시 애플리케이션 현대화를 대규모로 확장한 방법을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: A successful modernization approach only matters if it scales beyond the first pilot. Experian and Itaú share how they grew their approach with AWS Transform and Kiro from a single engagement into an enterprise-wide operating model. Experian compresses mainframe analysis from months to days, then standardizes modernization across 550+ workloads and multiple regions with a fully agentic reverse-engineering pipeline. Itaú expanded to 43 business domains, processing nearly 140 million lines of code in a single month. Leave with the operating models that scale modernization from one application to the entire portfolio, unlocking AI-driven capabilities along the way.

title: Building migration readiness when the timeline is tight
title_ko: 촉박한 일정 속에서 마이그레이션 준비 태세 갖추기
summary_ko: 마이그레이션 일정이 촉박할 때 조직과 기술 측면의 준비 태세를 빠르게 갖추는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Most organizations don't get years to plan a large-scale migration. Licensing changes, compliance requirements, or rising hardware costs can compress your timeline fast. This session covers how to build readiness quickly so your team can move hundreds of workloads with confidence. Learn how to assess your environment, build team capability, and match the right migration pathway to each workload. Hear Vanguard who moved hundreds of applications under real pressure with zero critical outages. Walk away with a practical framework for getting your organization ready to move at any speed.

title: Strategies for optimizing your migration: Lessons from ExxonMobil
title_ko: 마이그레이션 최적화 전략: ExxonMobil의 교훈
summary_ko: ExxonMobil의 대규모 클라우드 마이그레이션 경험을 바탕으로 비용과 일정을 최적화하는 전략을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Migrating to the cloud and running efficiently once you're there are two different disciplines. In this session, hear ExxonMobil's firsthand journey from a large-scale lift-and-shift migration to a disciplined, data-driven optimization practice, and the role the AWS Optimization and Licensing Assessment (OLA) played both before the move and after, for ongoing optimization. Parker Caputo (ExxonMobil) shares how his team used real utilization data to right-size 1300+ EC2 instances and realize over $2M in annualized savings without sacrificing performance. We'll then explore the tools and programs that make optimization an informed decision at any stage, and close on the layer most native tools can't see on their own: Microsoft licensing. Learn why licensing can represent 30–50% of Windows and SQL Server workload TCO, and how to optimize it as part of your cloud cost strategy.

title: On-premises to AWS readiness: foundational decisions before your migration
title_ko: 온프레미스에서 AWS로의 준비: 마이그레이션 전 기초 의사결정
summary_ko: 온프레미스에서 AWS로 이전하기 전에 내려야 할 네트워크, 보안, 계정 구조 등 기초 결정 사항을 다룹니다.
abstract: Successful migrations are shaped by decisions made well before the first workload moves. This session explores how choices in licensing, operating models, technology architecture, and organizational readiness influence migration outcomes, whether moving off VMware, aging infrastructure, or other on-premises environments. Learn how to assess dependencies and business constraints, align stakeholders, and build a plan that avoids common pitfalls and adapts as your environment evolves.

title: On-premises to AWS readiness: foundational decisions before your migration
title_ko: 온프레미스에서 AWS로의 준비: 마이그레이션 전 기초 의사결정
summary_ko: 온프레미스에서 AWS로 이전하기 전에 내려야 할 네트워크, 보안, 계정 구조 등 기초 결정 사항을 다룹니다.
abstract: Successful migrations are shaped by decisions made well before the first workload moves. This session explores how choices in licensing, operating models, technology architecture, and organizational readiness influence migration outcomes, whether moving off VMware, aging infrastructure, or other on-premises environments. Learn how to assess dependencies and business constraints, align stakeholders, and build a plan that avoids common pitfalls and adapts as your environment evolves.

title: How to assess your environment to migrate & modernize with confidence
title_ko: 확신을 갖고 마이그레이션·현대화하기 위한 환경 평가 방법
summary_ko: 기존 IT 환경을 체계적으로 평가해 마이그레이션과 현대화 계획을 자신 있게 수립하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Without a clear picture of what's running in your environment, teams carry forward outdated assumptions, inherit unplanned tech debt, and miss the fastest path to value. Assessment is the foundational step that sets everything else up for success. Learn how to go hands-on with AWS Transform, an agentic assessment experience that delivers results fast, or work with AWS specialists and partners who leverage this technology alongside decades of migration experience. Use assessment data to make informed decisions, optimize environments, and eliminate redundant licensing.

title: How to assess your environment to migrate & modernize with confidence
title_ko: 확신을 갖고 마이그레이션·현대화하기 위한 환경 평가 방법
summary_ko: 기존 IT 환경을 체계적으로 평가해 마이그레이션과 현대화 계획을 자신 있게 수립하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Without a clear picture of what's running in your environment, teams carry forward outdated assumptions, inherit unplanned tech debt, and miss the fastest path to value. Assessment is the foundational step that sets everything else up for success. Learn how to go hands-on with AWS Transform, an agentic assessment experience that delivers results fast, or work with AWS specialists and partners who leverage this technology alongside decades of migration experience. Use assessment data to make informed decisions, optimize environments, and eliminate redundant licensing.

title: Skip Refactoring and Simplify Operations with Nutanix on AWS (sponsored by Nutanix)
title_ko: Nutanix on AWS로 리팩터링 없이 운영 단순화 (Nutanix 후원)
summary_ko: Nutanix on AWS를 활용해 애플리케이션 리팩터링 없이 워크로드를 이전하고 운영을 단순화하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: Cloud migrations often stall when rewriting applications takes too long. As projects drag on, organizations are left managing a fragmented, expensive mix of on-premises and cloud silos. Nutanix Cloud Clusters on AWS addresses this friction by establishing a single control plane and a consistent operating model across environments. In this session, learn how to move workloads to AWS bare metal quickly without refactoring. Discover how to eliminate management silos, accelerate migration timelines, and simplify hybrid cloud operations. This presentation is brought to you by Nutanix, an AWS Partner.

title: No Data Left Behind: The AI-Ready Path Through AWS (sponsored by Qlik)
title_ko: 남겨지는 데이터 없이: AWS를 통한 AI 준비 경로 (Qlik 후원)
summary_ko: Qlik과 AWS로 모든 데이터를 통합·정제해 AI 활용에 적합한 상태로 준비하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Your enterprise data is scattered across SAP, mainframes, databases, and cloud platforms that were never designed to talk to each other — and every AI initiative depends on enabling that communication. This session shows how Qlik and AWS modernize that data without downtime, rewrites, or re-platforming risk: zero-footprint CDC, Qlik Open Lakehouse with Apache Iceberg and Amazon Athena, Spark Structured Streaming on Amazon EMR, and governed data products built for AI. You'll also get a bonus preview of Qlik's Studio AI Assistant on Amazon Bedrock and what's next for agentic workflows. This presentation is brought to you by Qlik, an AWS Partner.

title: How Delta Air Lines achieved always-on code modernization
title_ko: Delta Air Lines는 어떻게 상시 코드 현대화를 실현했나
summary_ko: Delta Air Lines가 코드 현대화를 지속적인 상시 프로세스로 전환한 방법과 성과를 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Every enterprise carries the same growing list: outdated dependencies, end-of-life runtimes, and security vulnerabilities that nobody has time to fix. In this session, learn how AWS Transform uses agentic AI to find these issues across your entire portfolio and fix them without waiting for a human to intervene. We'll cover how to maintain a living inventory of what needs upgrading, prioritize by risk, and automate remediation at scale. Hear how Delta Air Lines drove autonomous remediation across 100+ development teams, turning tech debt from a never-ending backlog into an always-on process.

title: Conversational AI at Scale: S&P Global Energy's 30+ Genie Agents (sponsored by Databricks)
title_ko: 대규모 대화형 AI: S&P Global Energy의 30개 이상 Genie 에이전트 (Databricks 후원)
summary_ko: S&P Global Energy가 Databricks Genie 에이전트 30여 개로 대화형 데이터 분석을 대규모로 운영한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: Evaluating complex financial data shouldn't start with schema research and SQL. In this session, Databricks will introduce Genie Agents, which let business and technical users ask questions in plain language and get back trusted answers, tables and visualizations. S&P Global Market Intelligence will then show how it built Genie into S&P Capital IQ Workbench on Databricks and AWS, running Genie Agents across about 90 core datasets. Learn how automated AI bundles (dataset documentation, SQL examples, business definitions, joins and synonyms) and entity resolution keep answers accurate, and how notebooks let technical teams check and extend the results. All of it is governed end to end by Unity Catalog. Hear how this cut data evaluation time by and shortened sales cycles. Leave with a blueprint for turning data products into conversational experiences customers trust. This presentation is brought to you by Databricks, an AWS Partner.

title: Cleared for Takeoff Hybrid Observability at the Busiest Airport (sponsored by SolarWinds)
title_ko: 이륙 허가: 가장 바쁜 공항의 하이브리드 관측성 (SolarWinds 후원)
summary_ko: SolarWinds를 활용해 세계에서 가장 바쁜 공항의 하이브리드 IT 환경을 관측하고 운영한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Managing over a thousand network nodes across terminals, baggage systems, and cloud infrastructure requires more than reactive troubleshooting. Join Cedric Reed, Network Administrator at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, and SolarWinds to discover how the world’s busiest airport replaced manual oversight with proactive observability. Learn how unified visibility across on-premises hardware and AWS Cloud eliminates noise, reduces downtime, and keeps critical systems online for millions of daily travelers. Discover how hop-by-hop visualization and real-time telemetry seamlessly monitor a vast network of surveillance systems covering the entire 7-mile campus to optimize operational resilience and passenger safety. This presentation is brought to you by SolarWinds, an AWS Partner.

title: Transforming business and SAP with Amazon Innovations
title_ko: Amazon의 혁신으로 비즈니스와 SAP 혁신하기
summary_ko: Amazon의 기술 혁신을 활용해 SAP 환경과 비즈니스 프로세스를 혁신하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: The SAP landscape is changing, with customers not just asking “How can you help us migrate and run our SAP applications in the cloud?”, but instead: “How can you help us transform our business, simplify our business processes, and leverage AI to serve our customers and employees?”. Join this session to learn how our marquee customers are combining SAP modernization with Amazon's extensive portfolio to revolutionize customer experiences. You'll hear how customers are redefining customer experience and transforming business processes including finance procurement, manufacturing, operation etc by leveraging Pan-Amazon services, and AWS AI services alongside SAP.

title: A Unified AWS Data and AI Strategy for SAP Customers
title_ko: SAP 고객을 위한 통합 AWS 데이터 및 AI 전략
summary_ko: SAP 고객이 SAP 데이터를 AWS 데이터·AI 서비스와 통합해 인사이트를 얻는 전략을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Explore how AWS and SAP customers can unlock value through converging data and AI strategies. From zero-copy integration with SAP Business Data Cloud and Amazon S3, to enterprise AI agents via Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, learn practical approaches to automate SAP processes and accelerate innovation at scale.

title: Accelerating AI-powered business transformation and SAP Modernization
title_ko: AI 기반 비즈니스 혁신과 SAP 현대화 가속화
summary_ko: AI를 활용해 SAP 현대화와 비즈니스 혁신을 빠르게 추진하는 전략과 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: The legacy ERP systems that once drove competitive advantage now creates technical debt and blocks innovation and yet modernizing it remains complex, costly, and risky. In this panel, discover how AWS AI services are changing the economics of SAP modernization, making it possible to transform business processes by through AI-powered automations, while delivering breakthrough performance, cost savings and innovation.

title: AWS migration agents fast-tracking SAP modernization
title_ko: SAP 현대화를 앞당기는 AWS 마이그레이션 에이전트
summary_ko: AWS 마이그레이션 에이전트를 활용해 SAP 시스템의 이전과 현대화를 신속하게 진행하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: AI agents built on AWS are fast-tracking SAP migration and modernization from months to days. Learn from our marquee customers how they are deploying agentic fleets on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore spanning SAP landscape, auto-resolving complex workflows same-day that previously took days across multiple teams, saving thousands of hours and millions in operational costs. A reusable framework means each new agent inherits production-grade infrastructure from day one. In this session, learn how AI-powered migration agents de-risk ECC-to-S/4HANA transitions, accelerate RISE with SAP adoption, and modernize ABAP and BW workloads.

title: AWS AI agents accelerate SAP migration and modernization on AWS
title_ko: AWS AI 에이전트로 AWS에서의 SAP 마이그레이션 및 현대화 가속
summary_ko: AWS AI 에이전트로 SAP 워크로드의 평가, 마이그레이션, 현대화 작업을 자동화하는 방법을 실습합니다.
abstract: The legacy ERP system that once gave you a competitive edge may now be limiting your ability to innovate. Modernizing SAP can be complex, expensive, risky, and every delay is a missed opportunity to innovate. In this Chalk Talk, you will learn how AI Agents can make it possible to upgrade to SAP's Cloud ERP safely and cost-effectively in weeks, not months. Whether you're running SAP ECC, moving to RISE with SAP, modernizing ABAP and PI/PO, or migrating SAP Business Warehouse (BW), discover how AI-powered agents can take on the heavy lifting for you

title: How FINRA automated dependency lifecycle management with AI agents
title_ko: FINRA는 AI 에이전트로 의존성 수명주기 관리를 어떻게 자동화했나
summary_ko: FINRA가 AI 에이전트를 활용해 소프트웨어 의존성 업데이트와 수명주기 관리를 자동화한 사례를 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: With 2,300 components and over 700,000 dependencies, FINRA uses Kiro and AWS Transform custom to deploy GenAI upgrade agents across Python, Java, and Angular. Learn how governed automation and monthly "Transform-a-thons" reclaimed 1,800 engineering hours across 25 teams in three months, and how to shift from reactive patching to predictable dependency lifecycle management. Discover how FINRA's move to continuous modernization reduces the effort of maintaining technical debt.

title: What's new with AWS Transform for migrations
title_ko: 마이그레이션을 위한 AWS Transform의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 마이그레이션을 위한 AWS Transform의 최신 기능과 에이전틱 마이그레이션 자동화 개선 사항을 소개합니다.
abstract: AWS Transform for migrations is evolving to help enterprises tackle migration challenges head on. With agentic AI capabilities working across the migration lifecycle, AWS Transform automates what previously slowed teams down with manual work. In this session, get a first look at the latest capabilities accelerating your enterprise migration. Whether you're planning a first migration or scaling across hundreds of workloads, walk away knowing how agentic AI is changing how infrastructure migration is done and how you can put it in practice.

title: Multicloud-to-AWS transformation: HealthEdge migrating 8,700 servers
title_ko: 멀티클라우드에서 AWS로의 전환: HealthEdge의 8,700대 서버 마이그레이션
summary_ko: HealthEdge가 멀티클라우드 환경의 서버 8,700대를 AWS로 이전한 전략과 교훈을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: Running workloads across multiple clouds and on-premises data centers creates compounding complexity: inconsistent tooling, duplicated licensing costs, and operational overhead that slows everything down. HealthEdge faced exactly this across Azure, GCP, and four data centers while serving 130 health plans daily, where security is paramount. Hear how they're consolidating 8,700 servers via AWS Transform, 1,600 databases, and thousands of cloud services onto AWS on a 2-year roadmap, raising their security bar, and building internal AWS expertise to drive a lasting culture change - all without disrupting the plans that depend on them.

title: Sovereign Transformations: From Legacy to an AI-Ready Estate You Own (sponsored by Concierto by Trianz)
title_ko: 주권적 전환: 레거시에서 직접 소유하는 AI 준비 환경으로 (Concierto by Trianz 후원)
summary_ko: 레거시 시스템을 데이터 주권을 유지하면서 AI 활용이 가능한 환경으로 전환하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Enterprises are caught in a catch-22. Legacy estates must modernize to become AI-ready, yet the fastest path to AI runs through shared inference services where your transformation intelligence leaks to competitors. Modernize to build advantage & hand it away. Concierto's Sovereign Transformations breaks the bind. The speakers present a sovereign, unified platform that migrates, modernizes, manages, & prepares enterprises for agentic AI entirely within customer boundaries. Dual-engine architecture combines deterministic rules with private AI inference under oversight, all in your VPC. Intelligence compounds as a proprietary asset, sharpening transformations. Built on 100+ enterprises in 19 countries, Concierto delivers versatility at scale. Sovereign Transformations is an architectural choice about protecting and growing your intelligence solely for your company's benefit.

title: 20-minute guide to automating post-migration validation
title_ko: 마이그레이션 후 검증 자동화를 위한 20분 가이드
summary_ko: 마이그레이션 완료 후 애플리케이션과 데이터 검증 작업을 자동화하는 방법을 짧게 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Migration teams spend weeks per wave coordinating connectivity tests, performance comparisons, application health checks, and compliance reviews across disconnected tools. This lightning talk examines how to move post-deployment validation from a manual, multi-tool process into an integrated part of the migration workflow. You will learn approaches for automating infrastructure checks at deployment time, incorporating Well-Architected compliance into wave execution, and running day-one modernization actions so workloads land production-ready. Ideal for migration engineers and cloud architects managing large rehost and network modernization programs.

title: Automating migration incentives using Agentic AI
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI로 마이그레이션 인센티브 자동화하기
summary_ko: 에이전틱 AI를 활용해 AWS 마이그레이션 인센티브 신청과 관리 절차를 자동화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: The biggest bottleneck in large-scale migrations isn't technical. It's the time between customer commitment and first workload moving. Agreements, partner funding approvals, and credit disbursement today require manual coordination across multiple teams and systems. AWS Transform automates the entire incentive lifecycle: one-click agreement acceptance, auto-populated partner fund requests, and threshold-based credit triggers that disburse automatically when tagged resources hit spend targets. In this session, learn how AWS Transform is removing administrative friction so incentives accelerate migrations instead of delaying them.

title: From CI/CD to CI/CD/CM: Continuous modernization for AI-generated code
title_ko: CI/CD에서 CI/CD/CM으로: AI 생성 코드를 위한 지속적 현대화
summary_ko: AI가 생성한 코드가 늘어나는 환경에서 CI/CD에 지속적 현대화(CM)를 더하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: AI coding agents help developers ship more code than ever, but every new line adds dependencies, frameworks, and runtimes that will age into tech debt. Periodic "modernization sprints" can't keep up. In this session, learn how AWS Transform – continuous modernization makes code health a standing part of your software lifecycle, alongside build and deploy. See how it scans thousands of repositories in hours to find end-of-life dependencies, non-standard frameworks, and gaps that slow down AI agents. Then see how it remediates across your portfolio and monitors it as new issues appear. Learn how to define a transformation once and reuse it across your organization, and how customers cut tech debt assessment effort by over 60%. Leave with a practical path to keep your codebases modern, secure, and ready for AI.

title: From SAP to Agentic AI: Building a unified data strategy on AWS
title_ko: SAP에서 에이전틱 AI까지: AWS에서 통합 데이터 전략 구축
summary_ko: SAP 데이터를 AWS에서 통합해 에이전틱 AI에 활용할 수 있는 데이터 전략을 구축하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: This chalk talk presents a unified architecture spanning SAP Business Data Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS-native services. Learn how AWS enables progressive modernization from zero-copy federation via BDC Connect, to Iceberg-based lakehouse architectures, to AI-powered analytics with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and QuickSight. We introduce the AWS for SAP MCP Server, accessing OData services as AI-ready tools via Model Context Protocol. Live demos showcase AI agents resolving supply chain exceptions, generating Customer 360 insights, and accelerating BW modernization.

title: Migrate SQL Server to Aurora PostgreSQL with AI-powered conversion
title_ko: AI 기반 변환으로 SQL Server를 Aurora PostgreSQL로 마이그레이션
summary_ko: AI 기반 스키마·코드 변환을 활용해 SQL Server를 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL로 이전하는 과정을 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano IV
abstract: Migrating SQL Server databases with stored procedures, triggers, and complex T-SQL constructs to Aurora PostgreSQL typically takes weeks of manual schema conversion and dependency resolution. In this workshop, you'll walk through the end-to-end workflow using AWS Transform's agentic AI: assess your SQL Server database, automate schema conversion, resolve dependencies, then hand off to your local IDE where you review, refine, and deploy converted database objects directly. You'll leave knowing how to reduce weeks of manual effort to hours while improving conversion accuracy and confidence.

title: Migrate SQL Server to Aurora PostgreSQL with AI-powered conversion
title_ko: AI 기반 변환으로 SQL Server를 Aurora PostgreSQL로 마이그레이션
summary_ko: AI 기반 스키마·코드 변환을 활용해 SQL Server를 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL로 이전하는 과정을 실습합니다.
abstract: Migrating SQL Server databases with stored procedures, triggers, and complex T-SQL constructs to Aurora PostgreSQL typically takes weeks of manual schema conversion and dependency resolution. In this workshop, you'll walk through the end-to-end workflow using AWS Transform's agentic AI: assess your SQL Server database, automate schema conversion, resolve dependencies, then hand off to your local IDE where you review, refine, and deploy converted database objects directly. You'll leave knowing how to reduce weeks of manual effort to hours while improving conversion accuracy and confidence.

title: Build a data-driven migration plan with AWS Transform
title_ko: AWS Transform으로 데이터 기반 마이그레이션 계획 수립

room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Builders' Session
abstract: You're planning a data center exit and need leadership to say yes. That means persuasive data, realistic cost estimates, and a proposal that makes financial sense. In this builders' session, you'll use AWS Transform's agentic AI capabilities paired with Discovery Agent data to assess your existing environment, generate cost estimates, and build a compelling business case for migration. You'll work through the end-to-end workflow from discovery and analysis to financial modeling, and leave ready to present a data-driven migration proposal to your stakeholders.

title_ko: EBA 클라우드 파티에서 에이전틱 AI로 마이그레이션·현대화 경주하기
summary_ko: 팀별 게임 형식의 EBA 클라우드 파티에서 에이전틱 AI로 마이그레이션과 현대화를 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Pompeian IV
abstract: Imagine compressing months of cloud migration and modernization into days, tackling legacy code, tight timelines, and cross-team coordination head-on. That's exactly what the Experience-Based Acceleration (EBA) method delivers. In this hands-on, gamified EBA workshop, cross-functional squads split into workstreams and race to migrate and modernize a legacy app and its databases, apply cloud best practices, and deploy the transformed architecture, all in the cloud. Experience firsthand how EBA shatters silos and compresses migration and modernization from months into days with AWS Transform and Kiro. You'll get repeatable playbook your team can run on Monday. Ready to play?

title: Drive multi-server migrations from discovery to cutover with AWS Transform
title_ko: AWS Transform으로 다중 서버 마이그레이션을 검색부터 전환까지 수행
summary_ko: AWS Transform을 사용해 여러 서버의 검색, 계획, 복제, 컷오버까지 마이그레이션 전 과정을 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano I
abstract: Migrating VMware or other on-premises environments to AWS involves dozens of coordinated steps, and most teams spend more time planning handoffs than actually moving workloads. In this workshop, you'll experience how AWS Transform's agentic AI orchestrates the full migration lifecycle: intelligent discovery, AI-driven wave planning, automated network translation, and server rehost execution. Specialized AI agents coordinate across each stage, making autonomous decisions while keeping you in control. You'll leave with hands-on experience using agentic AI to execute a real end-to-end multi-server migration. Laptop required.

title: Modernize legacy batch into event-driven with AWS Transform & Kiro
title_ko: AWS Transform과 Kiro로 레거시 배치를 이벤트 기반으로 현대화
summary_ko: AWS Transform과 Kiro를 활용해 레거시 배치 작업을 이벤트 기반 아키텍처로 전환하는 방법을 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Builders' Session
abstract: Batch processing has powered critical enterprise workloads for decades, from mainframes running COBOL and PL/I to distributed systems on legacy Java. The trade-off? Overnight batch cycles that business processes can no longer afford. In this session, reimagine batch as event-driven microservices using Domain-Driven Design. AWS Transform reverse-engineers business rules from legacy code across platforms with full traceability, and Kiro translates that understanding into microservices specifications, generates production code, and creates Infrastructure as Code for AWS deployment. Leave with a repeatable pattern for reimagining batch workloads as real-time, event-driven microservices built on business rules that took decades to refine. Laptop required.

title: Rebuild a legacy ETL pipeline as serverless with AWS Transform
title_ko: AWS Transform으로 레거시 ETL 파이프라인을 서버리스로 재구축
summary_ko: AWS Transform을 활용해 기존 ETL 파이프라인을 서버리스 아키텍처로 재구축하는 과정을 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Enterprise data teams maintain ETL pipelines built on legacy tools like stored procedures, custom bash scripts, IBM DataStage and others, that resist migration due to undocumented dependencies. In this builders' session, use AWS Transform Custom to discover and map an existing ETL pipeline, generate a modernization blueprint, and rebuild it as a serverless workflow using AWS Glue and Step Functions. Each attendee picks one legacy source module (stored procedures, bash/SQL scripts, or DataStage jobs etc) and works hands-on through discovery, transformation logic analysis, and deploying a modernized pipeline.

title: AWS fundamentals for the accidental SQL Server database administrator
title_ko: 얼떨결에 SQL Server DBA가 된 사람을 위한 AWS 기초
summary_ko: 갑자기 SQL Server 관리를 맡게 된 담당자를 위해 AWS에서 SQL Server를 운영하는 기본 지식을 안내합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan III
abstract: You became a DBA, and now someone's asking you to be a cloud architect too. With over 240 AWS services, knowing where to start is half the battle. In this chalk talk, we'll map your core DBA tasks to AWS equivalents, covering networking, security, high availability, and disaster recovery for SQL Server. We'll also explore how AI-powered tools like Kiro and AWS Transform can accelerate your ramp-up, from intelligent code generation to modernizing .NET and SQL Server workloads. You'll leave with a clear path to choosing, securing, and cost-optimizing the right services. Come with questions.

room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Migrating on-premises storage to AWS typically means weeks of manual assessment, business case building, and wave planning before a single byte moves. AWS Transform's agentic AI capabilities handle the full lifecycle, from automated assessment and business case generation to wave planning and execution, reducing that timeline to hours. In this lightning talk, see how to migrate storage from VMware estates, enterprise databases, and associated data with AI handling the complexity. Leave knowing how to start your first Transform project and accelerate time to results.

title: Migrate and modernize infrastructure from your IDE with agentic AI
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI로 IDE에서 인프라 마이그레이션 및 현대화
summary_ko: 개발자가 IDE 안에서 에이전틱 AI를 활용해 인프라를 마이그레이션하고 현대화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Migration and modernization involve dozens of manual steps across landing zones, networking, and containerization. What if you could drive the entire workflow from your IDE? In this code talk, you'll see how Kiro and AWS Transform work together as an agentic toolkit. First, generate a multi-account landing zone as infrastructure as code. Next, feed a VMware configuration export to the network agent and get Terraform modules or CDK constructs for VPCs, security groups, and production-ready network topology. Then point the containerization agent at a repo to produce ECR images and deploy to Amazon EKS.

title: Your playbook: turn your scattered databases into AI-ready infrastructure

summary_ko: 분산된 데이터베이스를 통합·현대화해 AI 활용에 적합한 데이터 인프라로 전환하는 플레이북을 제시합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Business-critical data scattered across Oracle, SQL Server, and VMware or Nutanix-hosted databases is the number one blocker to deploying agentic AI at scale. In this lightning talk, you'll get a practical playbook for database migration to AWS: real licensing challenges, cost optimization strategies, and modernization pathways that accelerate the path to cloud-native databases using AWS Transform and agentic AI. You'll leave with a clear migration framework that turns fragmented data estates into AI-ready infrastructure, no matter where your databases live today.

title: Best path forward: Rehost & replatform to containers with AWS Transform
title_ko: 최선의 경로: AWS Transform으로 컨테이너에 리호스트 및 리플랫폼
summary_ko: AWS Transform을 활용해 애플리케이션을 컨테이너 환경으로 리호스트·리플랫폼하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Not every app needs the same migration path, and figuring out which ones to rehost versus containerize is where teams get stuck. In this workshop, you'll use AWS Transform to plan a combined migration and modernization across your application portfolio, then execute a mix of container and rehost migrations deploying to Amazon ECS or EKS. You'll work through the full lifecycle. Learn how to order waves and coordinate cutover across a mixed portfolio. Leave with a realistic multi-wave plan you can apply to your own environment. Laptop required.

title: Reimagine legacy apps to be agentic AI ready with AWS Transform & Kiro
title_ko: AWS Transform과 Kiro로 레거시 앱을 에이전틱 AI에 맞게 재구상
summary_ko: AWS Transform과 Kiro로 레거시 애플리케이션을 에이전틱 AI를 활용할 수 있는 구조로 재설계합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano I
abstract: Enterprise core applications were built for stability, not agentic AI. Tightly coupled dependencies across mainframe and interconnected systems make it nearly impossible to add intelligent capabilities without rearchitecting. In this workshop, take a legacy application through the full modernization journey: scope it, reverse-engineer existing behavior with AWS Transform, classify logic into deterministic microservices and AI agents, design target layers with Kiro, build the agentic layer on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, then deploy and validate. Leave with hands-on experience rebuilding a legacy application into an architecture ready for agentic AI. Laptop required.

title: How to decompose Oracle and SQL Server into purpose-built databases
title_ko: Oracle과 SQL Server를 목적별 데이터베이스로 분해하는 방법
summary_ko: Oracle과 SQL Server의 모놀리식 데이터베이스를 워크로드별 목적형 데이터베이스로 분해하는 전략을 다룹니다.
abstract: A monolithic traditional RDBMS databases serves transactions, reporting, and search, but serves none of them well. In this chalk talk, we'll whiteboard how to decompose a proprietary database into purpose-built layers on AWS, including Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for transactional workloads, Aurora pgvector for semantic search and GenAI (RAG), and Amazon Redshift via zero-ETL for real-time analytics, for a smarter modernization approach. We'll walk through how this pattern eliminates licensing costs, removes ETL pipelines, and turns your operational data into an AI-ready platform. Come ready to whiteboard your decomposition use case.

title: British Airways: Using agentic AI to modernise Java services at scale

summary_ko: British Airways가 에이전틱 AI를 활용해 다수의 Java 서비스를 대규모로 현대화한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: You have hundreds of services stuck on aging infrastructure, and your engineers are spending more time maintaining them than building new experiences. British Airways faced the same challenge with 590 Github repositories and 200 business services on EC2. Using AWS Transform custom, they built an agentic AI platform that autonomously migrates services to ECS Fargate on Graviton, cutting costs by 48% without compromising business logic. They also extended it to improve test coverage and patch security vulnerabilities continuously. In this session, you'll learn how to build a repeatable transformation engine and give your engineers time back.

title: How LG U+ cut migration time 50% with AI-powered app refactoring
title_ko: LG U+는 AI 기반 앱 리팩터링으로 어떻게 마이그레이션 시간을 50% 단축했나
summary_ko: LG U+가 AI 기반 애플리케이션 리팩터링으로 클라우드 마이그레이션 기간을 절반으로 줄인 사례를 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Moving servers to the cloud without modernizing the applications on them just moves your technical debt to a new address. LG U+ needed to modernize applications before they could migrate them, and doing both sequentially would have taken too long. In this session, LG U+ shares how they ran AI-powered modernization and migration in parallel across 87 systems spanning 1,579 virtual servers and 107 physical servers. The result: roughly 20% migration velocity improvement and a 50% reduction in Java migration time through AI-assisted refactoring. You'll learn how to modernize at scale without slowing down the move.

title: Fanatics path to AWS: 5 data centers, 1,800 servers, 48% savings
title_ko: Fanatics의 AWS 이전기: 데이터센터 5곳, 서버 1,800대, 48% 비용 절감
summary_ko: Fanatics가 데이터센터 5곳과 서버 1,800대를 AWS로 이전해 비용을 48% 절감한 과정을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: If your migration is stuck because no one can agree on what moves first while licensing costs compound and dependencies stay undocumented, the problem isn’t willingness. It’s sequencing. Fanatics Commerce had 1800 servers across five data centers and projected 48% infrastructure savings on AWS. Their team shares the structured path: OLA for licensing clarity, DAP for dependency mapping, EBA for organizational alignment, MAP for execution. Walk away with: (1) a concrete OLA-to-MAP sequence, (2) an AI-assisted dependency mapping approach that surfaced connections no one had documented (3) a phased AWS Transform modernization strategy that earns engineering trust before scaling.

title: Refactor your monolith for multi-tenancy and agentic AI in one pass
title_ko: 모놀리스를 멀티테넌시와 에이전틱 AI에 맞게 한 번에 리팩터링
summary_ko: 모놀리식 애플리케이션을 멀티테넌트 SaaS 구조와 에이전틱 AI 활용에 맞게 한 번에 리팩터링하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Most ISV monoliths get modernized in three sequential passes: refactor, then multi-tenant, then agentic. Three trips through the same code, each longer than the last. In this chalk talk, we'll dig into the unified refactor pattern that makes tenancy and agentic bets in the same window. We'll explore how data partitioning decisions shift when agents are also a target, when Amazon EKS becomes the substrate for both migrations, and which patterns create more debt than they solve when combined wrong. Leave with a framework for the one refactor window you can afford. Bring your questions.

title: Build an AI testing safety net before you modernize
title_ko: 현대화 전에 AI 테스트 안전망 구축하기
summary_ko: 레거시 현대화를 시작하기 전에 AI로 테스트 케이스를 생성해 회귀를 막는 안전망을 구축하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Pompeian IV
abstract: Modernizing applications is risky without comprehensive test coverage, and most apps that need modernization don't have it. In this workshop, you'll build an AI-powered testing safety net before touching a line of production code. Starting with a deployed insurance application, you'll use Kiro to generate spec-driven tests from source code and Nova Act to discover UI tests through autonomous exploration. Then you'll apply AWS Transform to modernize the codebase and re-run your AI-generated test suite to prove functional equivalence. You'll leave knowing how to de-risk modernization by letting GenAI build your safety net first. Laptop required.

title: Analyze your portfolio, prioritize what to fix, and transform it
title_ko: 포트폴리오를 분석하고 개선 우선순위를 정해 전환하기
summary_ko: 애플리케이션 포트폴리오를 분석해 개선 우선순위를 정하고 현대화를 실행하는 방법을 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Pompeian IV
abstract: You know your portfolio needs modernization, but which apps go first, and based on what criteria? In this workshop, you'll run the full analyze-prioritize-transform cycle end to end. Using AWS Transform's Agentic Readiness Analysis and Modernization Analysis, you'll evaluate applications from two angles: whether agents can safely reach your logic (API exposure, identity, state, guardrails, observability) and how cloud-native mature your architecture is (compute, data, security, operations). You'll interpret scores, scale across a portfolio with the orchestrator, then close the loop by triggering a containerization transformation on the app that needs it most. Laptop required.

title: Transforming legacy core to agentic AI with Nissan & Bread Financial
title_ko: Nissan과 Bread Financial의 레거시 코어를 에이전틱 AI로 전환하기
summary_ko: Nissan과 Bread Financial이 레거시 핵심 시스템을 에이전틱 AI 기반으로 전환한 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Legacy mainframe applications were built for stability, scale, and batch-oriented processing, but they were never designed to power real-time, intelligent, agentic experiences. Modernization changes that. Discover how Nissan reimagined core operations into a cloud-native platform designed for responsiveness, adaptability, and AI-ready workflows. Hear how Bread Financial is evolving beyond credit-processing architectures to accelerate innovation by decomposing monolithic capabilities into bounded context services, creating a modern foundation for autonomous workflows. See how both used AWS Transform to extract business rules from decades-old applications and Kiro to forward-engineer production-ready code. Learn how modernized applications unlock the architecture that makes agentic AI possible.

title: Amazon EVS: How to deploy & operate your VMware stack in the cloud
title_ko: Amazon EVS: 클라우드에서 VMware 스택을 배포하고 운영하는 방법
summary_ko: Amazon Elastic VMware Service(EVS)로 기존 VMware 환경을 AWS에서 배포·운영하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: What if you could rapidly migrate your VMware-based workloads to the cloud without giving up control over how you build, configure, and operate your environment? Amazon EVS lets you run the latest VMware Cloud Foundation software within your Amazon VPC using EC2 bare-metal instances. Use the tools and processes your team already knows, now backed by AWS scale and flexibility. Retain control of your virtualization stack, from networking and storage to disaster recovery. We'll walk through deployment workflows and integration patterns with AWS Partners and native AWS services. Hear lessons from a customer who fast-tracked their migration with EVS.

title: What to do next after your cloud migration
title_ko: 클라우드 마이그레이션 이후 해야 할 일
summary_ko: 클라우드 마이그레이션을 마친 후 비용 최적화, 현대화, 운영 개선 등 다음 단계를 안내합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Rehosting gets workloads to AWS, but that's just the beginning. This session covers the first 90 days after cutover: stabilizing the environment, building observability so decisions are based on real utilization data instead of pre-migration assumptions, applying auto-scaling and right-sizing adjustments that accelerate ROI, and knowing when a workload is ready to modernize versus when to leave it alone. AWS specialists share the decisions and strategy to turn your freshly migrated environment into one worth the investment.

title: 5 steps to faster data center exits with AWS Transform
title_ko: AWS Transform으로 데이터센터를 더 빠르게 철수하는 5단계
summary_ko: AWS Transform을 활용해 데이터센터 철수를 앞당기는 5단계 접근 방식을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: 70% of applications still sit on-premises, and the longer they stay, the more tech debt compounds. AWS Transform uses agentic AI to compress the entire data center exit journey from assessment through execution. Start with AI-powered discovery that right-sizes thousands of servers, compares cost scenarios, and builds a business case that gets executive buy-in in days. Move into automated wave planning and landing zone deployment. Then see how network architectures convert into production-ready VPCs and workloads rehost to Amazon EC2 at scale. We follow one customer's real timeline from plan to exit and unpack what made it work.

title: Capital One's WorkSpaces Journey: 320 to 20,000 Desktops in 72hrs
title_ko: Capital One의 WorkSpaces 여정: 72시간 만에 320대에서 20,000대 데스크톱으로
summary_ko: Capital One이 Amazon WorkSpaces를 72시간 만에 2만 대 규모로 확장한 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Learn how to achieve enterprise-scale cloud desktop deployment from Capital One, who went from 320 manual provisions per day to 20,000 compliant desktops in 72 hours. Gain production-tested architectural patterns for meeting compliance requirements without slowing delivery. You'll also get a first look at the latest WorkSpaces innovations and our vision for the future of cloud desktops, including how we're expanding what's possible for IT teams managing modern workloads at scale. This session is for those migrating from VDI, scaling an existing fleet, or planning for what's next.

title: Observability patterns for Microsoft workloads migrating to AWS
title_ko: AWS로 이전하는 Microsoft 워크로드를 위한 관측성 패턴
summary_ko: AWS로 마이그레이션하는 Microsoft 워크로드를 모니터링하기 위한 관측성 패턴과 모범 사례를 다룹니다.
abstract: Migrating Microsoft workloads to AWS requires rethinking your monitoring strategy. Existing observability approaches may not translate seamlessly to the cloud, creating blind spots that lead to costly downtime and degraded end-user experiences. In this chalk talk, we'll explore how to strengthen your observability posture as you migrate .NET applications, SQL Server databases, and Windows services to AWS. We'll cover how to use AWS-native and open-source tooling to monitor workloads across VMs, containers, and serverless, giving you confidence to migrate faster while maintaining operational excellence. Bring your questions.

title_ko: AWS로 이전하는 Microsoft 워크로드를 위한 관측성 패턴

title: Architect and optimize your VMware environment on Amazon EVS
title_ko: Amazon EVS에서 VMware 환경 설계 및 최적화
summary_ko: Amazon EVS 기반 VMware 환경의 아키텍처를 설계하고 성능과 비용을 최적화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Dive deep into the architectural decisions that shape a resilient, high-performing VMware environment on Amazon EVS. Explore VCF 9 support, Windows Server license-included entitlements, networking designs, storage configurations tuned for performance and cost, and operational patterns for backup, patching, and disaster recovery. Hear from a customer running production workloads on EVS and leave with actionable architectures tailored to your VMware workloads.

title: Guide to deploying landing zones & modernized networks in hours
title_ko: 랜딩 존과 현대화된 네트워크를 몇 시간 만에 배포하는 가이드
summary_ko: AWS 랜딩 존과 현대화된 네트워크 구성을 자동화해 몇 시간 안에 배포하는 방법을 안내합니다.
abstract: Reimagine what migration looks like when landing zone setup and network translation go from weeks to hours. In this chalk talk, we show how AWS Transform's agentic AI compresses that timeline, from migration inventory to fully deployed, validated landing zones and modernized networks. See how production-ready account structures deploy through Control Tower with guardrails in place, and how firewall configurations become optimized VPCs, subnets, and security groups. Bring your questions and hear from the experts building these capabilities.

title: Build AI agents to operate desktop and mainframe apps on WorkSpaces
title_ko: WorkSpaces에서 데스크톱·메인프레임 앱을 조작하는 AI 에이전트 구축
summary_ko: Amazon WorkSpaces에서 데스크톱 및 메인프레임 애플리케이션을 직접 조작하는 AI 에이전트를 구축합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano IV
abstract: You rely on desktop and mainframe applications for critical workflows, but these interfaces remain inaccessible to AI agents. Your Robotic Process Automation efforts have struggled to keep pace as applications and configurations constantly change. Amazon WorkSpaces lets AI agents securely operate the same desktop and mainframe applications your employees use, without any application modernization. WorkSpaces supports Model Context Protocol (MCP), so it works with any agent framework. In this workshop, connect to a pre-provisioned WorkSpace, build a custom agent, run agents that complete desktop workflows, and monitor agent sessions with CloudWatch and CloudTrail. Bring laptop to participate.

title: Unlocking SAP Data with AI: From Zero-ETL to Agentic Automation
title_ko: AI로 SAP 데이터 활용하기: Zero-ETL에서 에이전틱 자동화까지
summary_ko: Zero-ETL 통합으로 SAP 데이터를 AWS에 연결하고 에이전틱 AI로 업무를 자동화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano I
abstract: Critical business data remains locked inside SAP ERP and BW systems, limiting real-time insights and AI-driven automation. In this hands-on workshop, learn how to break down data silos using a modern, cost-effective architecture without expensive ETL pipelines. Explore a unified analytics strategy spanning Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS-native services that enables end-to-end SAP data modernization. Then, build with the AWS for SAP MCP Server, enabling agentic AI to orchestrate across SAP, Salesforce, and AWS without writing code.

title: Modernize SAP business processes with agentic AI on AWS
title_ko: AWS에서 에이전틱 AI로 SAP 비즈니스 프로세스 현대화
summary_ko: AWS의 에이전틱 AI를 활용해 SAP 기반 비즈니스 프로세스를 자동화하고 현대화하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Enterprise processes span SAP for ERP, Salesforce for CRM, and ServiceNow for ITSM, connected by aging, brittle integrations that are slow to change. Agentic AI offers a better path: replacing point-to-point integrations with agents that reason across applications. In this workshop, you modernize an SAP-centric business process by orchestrating Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents over Model Context Protocol, including the AWS for SAP MCP Server. You implement cross-application use cases spanning finance, supply chain, and operations then leave with a deployable reference architecture for moving from custom integrations to agent-orchestrated workflows.

title: From Legacy to Agentic: Modernization Beyond the Code (sponsored by SoftServe)
title_ko: 레거시에서 에이전틱으로: 코드를 넘어선 현대화 (SoftServe 후원)
summary_ko: 코드 변환을 넘어 프로세스와 조직까지 포괄하는 레거시에서 에이전틱 AI로의 현대화 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Global Impact Theater
abstract: What if modernization started beyond the code? SoftServe is reimagining application modernization by working backwards from business needs and desired outcomes to determine what should change and why. In this session, see how SoftServe Agentic Application Modernization combines this outcome-driven approach with CAST Software, AWS Transform, Kiro, AI-DLC and specialized AI agents to accelerate discovery, assessment, transformation, and validation. Learn how SoftServe provides the AI foundation to orchestrate and govern these agents, turning modernization into an intelligent, repeatable journey that enables AI for organizations, connects business intent with technology decisions and execution on AWS. This presentation is brought to you by SoftServe, an AWS Partner.

title: Adding agentic AI to your legacy app without a rewrite
title_ko: 재작성 없이 레거시 앱에 에이전틱 AI 추가하기
summary_ko: 기존 레거시 애플리케이션을 다시 작성하지 않고 에이전틱 AI 기능을 통합하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Full legacy application rewrites take years. Agentic AI lets you deliver value now. In this code talk, we build an AI agent that wraps an existing legacy application without changing the core system. You'll see how the agent understands user intent, calls existing application functions, and helps users complete business tasks through a modern conversational experience. Ask questions as we go from legacy to AI-assisted workflow in real time. You'll leave ready to put agentic AI in front of your legacy application today.
