title: The Neuron Stack: Enabling open source ML solutions on AWS Trainium
title_ko: Neuron 스택: AWS Trainium에서 오픈소스 ML 솔루션 지원하기
summary_ko: AWS Neuron 소프트웨어 스택이 Trainium에서 오픈소스 ML 프레임워크와 모델을 지원하는 방식을 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | White Theater
abstract: The Neuron software stack has evolved into an open source-first architecture. Developers can read, modify, and contribute to the components that compile, optimize, and execute ML workloads on Trainium. This session covers how Neuron enables open source ML solutions on Trainium. We show what's open source, how it integrates with upstream projects like PyTorch and distributed training frameworks, and how developers use these tools without modifications. Attendees leave understanding the Neuron stack, which parts are open source, and how to use and contribute to them.

title: Defense in depth for Strands AI agents with Cedar, AgentCore, and Rex
title_ko: Cedar, AgentCore, Rex로 Strands AI 에이전트 심층 방어하기
summary_ko: Cedar 정책, AgentCore, Rex를 조합해 Strands AI 에이전트에 다층 보안을 적용하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: AI agents that generate and execute code on remote systems need more than a single permission check - they need policy enforcement at every trust boundary. In this builders' session, you’ll configure Cedar policies at two distinct enforcement points for a Strands pre-built operations agent : AgentCore Policy on AgentCore Gateway and Trusted Remote Execution (REX) on the target remote host. You’ll see why both are necessary, how they compose, and how the agent gracefully adapts when it hits either boundary.

title: CLI Agent Orchestrator: Open source multi-agent AI for developer CLIs
title_ko: CLI Agent Orchestrator: 개발자 CLI를 위한 오픈소스 멀티 에이전트 AI
summary_ko: 여러 CLI 기반 AI 에이전트를 조율하는 오픈소스 CLI Agent Orchestrator의 구조와 활용법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Complex projects outgrow a single AI agent's context and capability. CLI Agent Orchestrator (CAO), an awslabs open source project, coordinates 8 CLIs including Amazon Kiro CLI, Claude Code, and Codex into a multi-agent powerhouse via the Model Context Protocol and tmux. It provides a centralised harness with shared skills, memory, and integration with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent. In this builders' session you'll install CAO, launch a supervisor and specialist agents, and put the team to work on a real change in a sample repo. You'll walk away with a multi-agent workflow to drop into your projects.

title: What's new with OpenSearch: AI-native search, agents & observability
title_ko: OpenSearch의 새로운 기능: AI 네이티브 검색, 에이전트 및 관측성
summary_ko: OpenSearch의 AI 네이티브 검색, 에이전트 지원, 관측성 관련 최신 기능을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: The OpenSearch project has shipped its most transformative year ever. From agentic search with persistent memory, to GPU-accelerated vector search with 58% throughput gains, to a reimagined observability stack with Prometheus and Apache Iceberg support, the 3.x release train delivers capabilities builders can use today. OpenSearch Ambassador Dotan Horovits and TSC Chair Andrew Ross walk you through what's new, what it means for your architecture, and how to put it to work, whether you're building RAG pipelines, deploying monitoring, or creating AI agents.

title: Hugging Face on AWS: AI Model Deployment at Scale
title_ko: AWS 기반 Hugging Face: 대규모 AI 모델 배포
summary_ko: AWS에서 Hugging Face 모델을 대규모로 배포하고 운영하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: AWS and Hugging Face collaborate on open source Deep Learning Containers, optimized inference frameworks, and Neuron integrations that make deploying community models production-ready. This session covers the open source stack - from Transformers library optimizations for Graviton and Trainium to TGI container contributions - that enables customers to serve Hugging Face models at 50% lower cost. Learn deployment patterns used by enterprises running open weight LLMs at millions of requests per day.

title: Building Production Graph Pipelines with Nodestream and Amazon Neptune
title_ko: Nodestream과 Amazon Neptune으로 프로덕션 그래프 파이프라인 구축
summary_ko: 오픈소스 Nodestream과 Amazon Neptune을 활용해 프로덕션 수준의 그래프 데이터 파이프라인을 구축하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Nodestream is an open source declarative framework for building, maintaining, and analyzing graph data, built collaboratively by engineers at Intuit and AWS. In this chalk talk, we'll explore how Nodestream connects data sources like Apache Kafka, APIs, and files to graph databases with automatic schema migrations and zero database-specific code. We'll dive into the Amazon Neptune plugin, discuss how declarative pipelines eliminate brittle ETL, and share lessons learned from real world customer scenarios. Bring your graph data challenges and we'll solve them live.

title: Kiro Crew: Architecture of an open source AI coding agent built on Kiro
title_ko: Kiro Crew: Kiro 기반 오픈소스 AI 코딩 에이전트의 아키텍처
summary_ko: Amazon 내부에서 39,000명 사용자로 성장한 Kiro CLI 기반 오픈소스 AI 코딩 워크스페이스의 멀티스텝 오케스트레이션과 공유 컨텍스트 구조를 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Kiro Crew is an open source AI coding workspace built on Kiro CLI that grew from a side project to 39,000 users and nearly 500 contributors inside Amazon. Unlike single-session assistants, Kiro Crew combines multi-step task orchestration, tool-use planning, and a shared context layer for real engineering workflows. In this chalk talk, we'll walk through how Kiro Crew decomposes complex tasks, selects and chains tools, manages execution state, and integrates with existing developer environments. We'll discuss the design trade-offs that enabled rapid adoption and our journey to open source.

title: Kiro Crew: Architecture of an open source AI coding agent built on Kiro

title: Bootstrapping GitOps on Amazon EKS with Argo CD, ACK, and kro
title_ko: Argo CD, ACK, kro로 Amazon EKS에 GitOps 구축하기
summary_ko: Argo CD, ACK, kro를 활용해 Kubernetes 앱과 IAM·AWS 인프라 리소스를 GitOps 방식으로 함께 프로비저닝하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Deploying an application to Kubernetes is straightforward. Provisioning its AWS resources, IAM roles, policies, and supporting infrastructure is more complex. Separate infrastructure and application toolchains create fragmented workflows and increase the risk of drift. In this session, we'll build a GitOps platform using EKS Capabilities, Argo CD, AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK), and kro. See how kro packages Kubernetes workloads and their AWS dependencies behind a single, self-service custom resource. Learn how Argo CD continuously reconciles the entire application stack from one Git repository. Finally, watch several microservices deploy, with their cloud resources provisioned and continuously managed alongside their workloads.

title: Powertools for agent DevOps: Debug reasoning, not just exceptions
title_ko: 에이전트 DevOps를 위한 Powertools: 예외가 아닌 추론을 디버깅하라
summary_ko: Powertools for AWS를 사용해 예외 없이 잘못된 답을 내는 에이전트의 추론 과정을 관측하고 디버깅하는 실습 세션입니다.
abstract: Your agent returned the wrong answer — no exception, no alarm, it just reasoned poorly. Traditional monitoring catches crashes, not bad decisions. In this builder session, you'll use Powertools for AWS Lambda to build agent observability: Logger with log buffering to capture decision context only on failure, Tracer with annotations for confidence scores and tool selections, and Metrics tracking token cost and reasoning steps. Wire OTEL with Strands SDK for end-to-end traces across the agent loop. You leave with dashboards that answer "why did the agent decide this?" - not "did it crash?"

title: Powertools for agent DevOps: Debug reasoning, not just exceptions

title: Performance tuning for streaming ingestion with Apache Iceberg
title_ko: Apache Iceberg 스트리밍 수집 성능 튜닝
summary_ko: Apache Iceberg로의 실시간 스트리밍 수집 파이프라인을 최적화하는 고급 성능 튜닝 기법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Unlock real-time streaming into Apache Iceberg with advanced performance tuning. Learn how to optimize ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka and Apache Flink for fraud detection, IoT monitoring, and real-time analytics. This session covers throughput optimization through partitioning, parallelism, write distribution, batching, and checkpoint tuning. Discover techniques to reduce small file issues with compaction, minimize write amplification with deduplication, and maintain low-latency ingestion at scale, turning raw streaming data into actionable insights with efficiency and reliability.

title: Expedite model loading times on Kubernetes using kro and ACK - from storage to GPU
title_ko: kro와 ACK로 Kubernetes 모델 로딩 시간 단축 - 스토리지에서 GPU까지
summary_ko: Kubernetes에서 수 GB 모델 가중치를 스토리지에서 GPU로 로딩하는 병목을 kro와 ACK로 줄여 LLM 추론 시작을 가속하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: LLM inference on Kubernetes is bottlenecked by loading multi-gigabyte model weights through the storage → network → CPU → PCIe → GPU path. In this chalk talk we benchmark four approaches to accelerating model delivery to GPU memory: SOCI for lazy-loading container image layers, s5cmd parallel downloads, Mountpoint for Amazon S3 CSI streaming, and Run.ai Model Streamer for direct S3-to-GPU pipelining. We walk through when each technique shines, how they compose together, and the tradeoffs platform teams face when optimizing inference cold starts on Amazon EKS. Learn how kro and ACK enable declarative provisioning of optimized storage pipelines, allowing platform teams to compose reusable stacks.

title: Expedite model loading times on Kubernetes using kro and ACK - from storage to GPU
title_ko: kro와 ACK로 Kubernetes 모델 로딩 시간 단축 - 스토리지에서 GPU까지

title: Apache Iceberg V4: Fast commits, smart metadata, and portable tables
title_ko: Apache Iceberg V4: 빠른 커밋, 스마트 메타데이터, 이식 가능한 테이블
summary_ko: 배치 중심에서 실시간 대응으로 전환하는 Apache Iceberg V4의 아키텍처 변화와 빠른 커밋, 메타데이터 개선을 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Orange Theater
abstract: Apache Iceberg V4 is the biggest architectural evolution of the format, shifting from batch-first to real-time ready. Explore how single-file commits eliminate metadata bottlenecks for streaming ingestion, how Parquet-based metadata and redesigned content statistics accelerate query planning, and how relative paths make tables portable across regions and clouds without costly rewrites. We'll walk through what's changing under the hood and what it means for the way you design and operate lakehouses. Discover how V4 delivers the speed and flexibility modern lakehouses demand.

title: Reduce LLM inference costs up to 80% through caching with Valkey
title_ko: Valkey 캐싱으로 LLM 추론 비용 최대 80% 절감
summary_ko: KV 캐시와 Valkey를 활용해 에이전틱 AI 앱의 중간 연산 상태를 재사용하고 LLM 추론 비용을 크게 줄이는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: LLM inference depends on limited GPU memory, and a KV cache lets agentic AI applications reuse computed intermediate states across prompts to reduce latency and costs. In this talk, we explain how KV caching works and walk through a production architecture using Valkey as a high-performance datastore, LMCache for KV reuse at inference, and llm-d for cache-aware routing. You will leave with practical implementation guidance and a framework for evaluating when a KV caching tier is the right choice to reduce costs for your AI applications.

title: Cut token costs by 50%: Building context efficient agents with Strands
title_ko: 토큰 비용 50% 절감: Strands로 컨텍스트 효율적인 에이전트 구축
summary_ko: Strands로 검색 전략, 압축 정책, 적응형 컨텍스트 관리를 적용해 긴 대화에서도 성능을 유지하며 토큰 비용을 줄이는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: AI agents degrade as conversations exceed context windows. You need retrieval strategies, compression policies, and adaptive storage backends. This code talk covers the three-tier context cache hierarchy of AWS's open source Strands Agents SDK. We'll discuss context management as composable primitives with extension points for custom backends, compression, and retrieval. We'll explore trade-offs between framework and agent-controlled context, how plugins compose without coupling, and where abstractions break under extreme workloads. For developers building or extending agent frameworks.

title: Cut token costs by 50%: Building context efficient agents with Strands
title_ko: 토큰 비용 50% 절감: Strands로 컨텍스트 효율적인 에이전트 구축

title: Kubernetes-native agentic AI on Amazon EKS with open source primitives
title_ko: 오픈소스 프리미티브로 Amazon EKS에서 구현하는 Kubernetes 네이티브 에이전틱 AI
summary_ko: 런타임, LLM 접근 거버넌스, 메모리, 관측성, 도구 탐색 등 프로덕션 에이전틱 AI 요소를 EKS와 오픈소스로 구성하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Production agentic AI needs a scalable runtime, governed LLM access, persistent memory, observability, tool discovery, and secure code isolation. In this workshop you'll build all six on Amazon EKS using native Kubernetes primitives and open source projects. Tackle all six end-to-end or take individual modules home. Deploy LiteLLM as a multi-model gateway, Mem0 for user-scoped memory, Langfuse for observability into reasoning and tool calls, an MCP registry for tool discovery, and sandboxes for hardware-level code isolation. Leave with a scalable, GitOps-ready, portable reference architecture.

title: Kubernetes-native agentic AI on Amazon EKS with open source primitives
title_ko: 오픈소스 프리미티브로 Amazon EKS에서 구현하는 Kubernetes 네이티브 에이전틱 AI

title: Connect agents across frameworks live using the A2A open protocol
title_ko: A2A 오픈 프로토콜로 프레임워크 간 에이전트 실시간 연결하기
summary_ko: Strands 등 서로 다른 프레임워크로 만든 에이전트를 A2A 프로토콜로 연결해 협업시키는 과정을 라이브로 구축합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Agents built on different frameworks need to talk to each other. In this session we will build two agents on Strands and LangGraph, then wire them together using the A2A protocol hosted at the Linux Foundation. You will see the full handshake: AgentCard publication for discovery, task negotiation, streaming artifact exchange, and multi-turn collaboration between agents that share nothing except the protocol. We will deploy both sides on AgentCore Runtime and demonstrate cross-framework interoperability working live. You will leave with the patterns to make any framework's agents collaborate over a standard wire.

title: Building Your AI Practice: From Business Model to Partner Revenue
title_ko: AI 프랙티스 구축: 비즈니스 모델부터 파트너 수익까지
summary_ko: 에이전틱 성과를 기대하는 기업 고객에 맞춰 파트너가 AI 프랙티스와 비즈니스 모델, 딜리버리 방식을 재설계하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Enterprises expect agentic outcomes. That changes how solutions are built and deployed. Traditional delivery practices are evolving to agentic delivery, outcome-based models, and scalable IP transacted through AWS Marketplace. Partners moving first are delivering measurable business outcomes faster and building new revenue alongside their customers. In this session, learn the three-stage practice-building path. See how Forward Deployed Engineering gives partners a new engagement architecture and faster delivery: pod-based, and time-boxed. See where AWS co-investment programs and AI-specific enrollment paths de-risk each stage of practice growth. Walk away with example GTM models and a concrete action plan.

title: Go-Live to ROI: How Partners Turn Customer Outcomes into Revenue
title_ko: Go-Live에서 ROI까지: 파트너가 고객 성과를 수익으로 전환하는 방법
summary_ko: AI 시대에 배포를 넘어 비즈니스 가치를 입증하고 고객 성과를 파트너 수익으로 연결하는 전략을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: The partners thriving in the AI era aren't the ones who just deploy, they're the ones who prove impact. The Business Value Realization (BVR) motion is how consulting and managed services partners are building their next growth engine: documenting outcomes, unlocking milestone-based funding, and turning deployments into expansion revenue. Explore how BVR helps partners quantify ROI, earn a new Competency, build customer success practices that drive revenue beyond go-live, and where the motion is heading next. As AI moves from pilot to production, the partners who own the value conversation won't just retain customers, they'll shape what is built next.

title: Sell to the AI Buyer, Scale Revenue, and Build Long-Term Value
title_ko: AI 구매자에게 판매하고, 매출을 확장하고, 장기적 가치를 구축하라
summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 소프트웨어를 자율적으로 평가·구매하는 시대에 맞춰 솔루션을 발견되고 선택되게 만드는 전략을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: The buying journey is shifting to AI agents and assistants that evaluate and procure software autonomously. If your solution isn't readable and transactable by a machine, you're invisible to a growing share of the market. This session shows AWS Partners how to show up for the AI buyer, from listing optimization to working alongside other agents, and how a growth toolkit (trials, bundling, demand generation) turns visibility into compounding revenue. Walk away with an implementation path that covers day-one discoverability through long-term governance.

title: Speed Wins: Compress Migration Timelines from Pipeline to Production
title_ko: 속도가 이긴다: 파이프라인에서 프로덕션까지 마이그레이션 기간 단축
summary_ko: 기술 부채를 해소하고 AWS Transform 등을 활용해 마이그레이션 일정을 단축하여 AI 기회를 앞당기는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Enterprises face a wall of technical debt standing between them and the AI opportunity. In this session, learn how AWS Transform helps compressing the entire partner lifecycle — from intelligent prospecting and AI-powered co-sell through to automated delivery and simplified funding — and why first-movers will own disproportionate share of the opportunity.

title: AI-Powered Profitability: How Partners Are Winning with AWS
title_ko: AI 기반 수익성: 파트너가 AWS와 함께 성공하는 방법
summary_ko: AWS VP Julia Chen이 AI가 바꾸는 파트너 경제와 수익성 높은 AI 우선 비즈니스 구축 방법을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: AI is reshaping partner economics. Hear from AWS VP Julia Chen about how to build a profitable AI-first business. This session covers the evolution of AWS Partner Programs, from transactional resell to outcome-driven partnerships, and reveals which programs, incentives, enablement, and tools deliver the highest ROI. Discover how AI-powered differentiation lowers your cost of sales, attracts high-value customers, deepens relationships, and enables innovation at scale. You'll leave with insights about where to invest and pathways for growth.

title: Agentic Process Transformation at Enterprise Scale
title_ko: 엔터프라이즈 규모의 에이전틱 프로세스 혁신
summary_ko: 단순 자동화 도구를 넘어 에이전틱 AI로 기업 프로세스를 근본적으로 혁신하는 파트너 접근법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Your customers don't need another automation tool, they need the leap forward they're actually looking for with AI. Agentic Process Transformation (APT) is the framework partners use to help customers move past isolated task automation and into enterprise-wide process reinvention: redesigning entire processes from the ground up to grow revenue and improve the bottom line at a scale automation alone can't reach. We'll share how to spot these transformation opportunities and the architectural patterns that turn them into production solutions. Leave with a concrete strategy for helping your customers make that leap today.

title: Agentic AI Meets the Line-of-Business Buyer
title_ko: 현업 부서 구매자를 만나는 에이전틱 AI
summary_ko: 예산 권한이 CIO에서 CFO 등 현업 리더로 이동하는 상황에서 이들에게 에이전틱 AI를 판매하는 전략을 살펴봅니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Budget authority is migrating from CIOs to line-of-business leaders - CFOs, Chief Medical Officers, Heads of Manufacturing - who buy outcomes, not infrastructure. At the same time, agentic AI is making it possible to automate entire business processes end-to-end, not just assist them. The partners who win are the ones who can connect these two shifts: framing autonomous agents as measurable business outcomes (revenue acceleration, cost compression, speed-to-market) in the language LOB leaders understand.

title: Scaling ISV Revenue: Accelerating Co-Sell with AWS Marketplace
title_ko: ISV 매출 확장: AWS Marketplace로 공동 판매 가속화
summary_ko: ISV가 AWS Marketplace를 활용해 AWS와의 공동 판매(Co-Sell)를 확대하고 매출을 빠르게 키우는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: AWS Marketplace has become the fastest path for ISVs to scale co-sell, but unlocking its full potential means going beyond procurement and using it as the backbone of how you sell. This session unpacks how high-performing ISVs combine ISV Accelerate with AWS Marketplace to accelerate co-sell. Three points separate top performers: (1) structuring AWS seller alignment to generate Marketplace-routed pipeline, (2) using private offers and channel-partner workflows to compress enterprise deal cycles by 30-40%, and (3) mining Marketplace buyer signals to drive expansion and proactive renewal. Walk away with a focused playbook for turning Marketplace into a scalable revenue motion.

title: Agentic-Led Modernization: First Movers' Winning Formula with AWS Transform
title_ko: 에이전트 주도 현대화: AWS Transform 선도 기업의 성공 공식
summary_ko: 지속적 현대화를 경쟁력의 엔진으로 삼은 선도 기업들이 AWS Transform으로 거둔 성과와 방법을 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Continuous modernization isn't optional — it's the engine of speed and competitive advantage. In this session, hear what early-adopter AWS Partners discovered building on AWS Transform, how composability lets them embed their own IP while harnessing AWS's customer reach, funding, and brand, and where the roadmap

title: Delivering Measurable Customer Business Outcomes
title_ko: 측정 가능한 고객 비즈니스 성과 제공
summary_ko: C레벨에 비즈니스 임팩트를 입증해 단순 배포 파트너에서 전략 자문가로 도약하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: Proving business impact at the C-suite level is what separates a deployment partner from a strategic advisor. That's where the Value Realization Plan (VRP) comes in, the structured approach at the heart of the AWS Business Value Realization motion. We'll cover building a compelling case for change, defining KPIs that resonate with executives, and driving adoption through change management. Learn the pitfalls that stall outcome conversations, how to accelerate buy-in, and how to frame impact in terms executives act on. Leave with a repeatable approach for your next engagement and a foundation for a customer success practice that scales.

title: The Agentic MSP: How AI Compounds Customer Outcomes at Every Layer
title_ko: 에이전틱 MSP: 모든 계층에서 고객 성과를 증폭하는 AI
summary_ko: AI를 내부 활용을 넘어 고객 성과의 선순환 구조로 만드는 수익성 높은 관리형 서비스 제공업체(MSP) 전략을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: The most profitable Managed Services Providers aren't just using AI internally. They're creating a compounding cycle: automate your own operations with Agentic AI, deliver measurably better outcomes to customers, then help those customers adopt AI themselves so the results multiply. This session shows how the AWS Managed Services Provider Program rewards that progression, from foundational automation through outcome-based delivery powered by AI agents. Leave with your own assessment and a concrete plan to reach the next level.

title: Agentic Selling: Scaling Revenue through Expertise on Demand
title_ko: 에이전틱 셀링: 온디맨드 전문성으로 매출 확장
summary_ko: 새 지역과 AI 네이티브 솔루션, 복잡한 딜 구조로 빠르게 확장하는 파트너를 위한 에이전트 기반 판매 지원을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: AWS Partners are moving faster than ever, into new regions, new AI-native solution categories, and more complex deal structures, while manual selling processes haven't kept pace. The expertise that wins deals is still locked in a few people and a separate portal. This session reveals how a new generation of AI agents puts that expertise on demand: surfacing co-sell intelligence and funding eligibility in the tools Partners already use, so every seller works with the best of the organization behind them.

title: The Economics of an AWS Partner: Revenue, Incentives & AWS Marketplace
title_ko: AWS 파트너의 경제학: 매출, 인센티브, AWS Marketplace
summary_ko: 내년을 위한 파트너 경제를 재조명하며 매출 측정, 인센티브, AWS Marketplace 활용 전략을 살펴봅니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: A forward-looking session reframing Partner economics for the year ahead. Revenue measurement is no longer just tracking, it's the backbone connecting all AWS Partner Programs. Walk away with a clear action plan to position for next year’s benefits.

title: Scale Through Partners: The Partner-Led SMB Growth Engine
title_ko: 파트너를 통한 확장: 파트너 주도 SMB 성장 엔진
summary_ko: 1조 달러 규모의 SMB 시장에서 AI 지출 증가를 기회로 삼는 파트너 주도 성장 모델을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: SMB is a $1T opportunity—98% of global businesses are small/mid-size, 81% are increasing AI spend, yet fewer than 300 AWS partners hold the SMB Competency. This session unpacks AWS's Indirect Selling engine: new incentives aligned to growth, AI-powered lead generation, SMB solution selling, and a Partnership Maturity Framework turning opportunistic engagement into repeatable business practice. You'll leave with unit economics proving indirect selling reaches SMBs globally, a clear activation timeline from Opportunity through full Business Practice, and specific first moves to build a scalable, profitable SMB practice on AWS—your 20-minute roadmap to outsized growth.

title: Intelligent Co-Sell in Action
title_ko: 인텔리전트 공동 판매(Co-Sell) 실전
summary_ko: 딜의 모든 단계에서 AWS 파트너와 함께 일하며 다음 행동을 예측하는 새로운 에이전틱 공동 판매 기능을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Partner Advantage Theater
abstract: A new generation of agentic capabilities now works alongside AWS Partners at every stage of the deal—anticipating the next move, cutting the busywork, and surfacing opportunity right where sellers already work. This high-energy demo session follows a deal from first opportunity to proven outcome.

title: Co-Sell to Co-Marketing: An AI-powered, end-to-end partner motion.
title_ko: 공동 판매에서 공동 마케팅까지: AI 기반 엔드투엔드 파트너 모션
summary_ko: 계정 계획, 리드 관리, 캠페인 실행을 AI로 통합해 공동 판매와 공동 마케팅을 연결하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: AWS Partners manage account planning, lead management, and campaign execution across multiple workflows. Discover how to unify these activities and build a seamless co-sell-to-co-marketing motion.

title: Sell to AI agents through AWS Marketplace
title_ko: AWS Marketplace로 AI 에이전트에게 판매하기
summary_ko: 구매자를 대신해 탐색과 구매를 수행하는 자율 AI 에이전트에게 AWS Marketplace로 판매하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Ballroom F | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Today, buyers are using autonomous AI agents for discovery and digital purchases on their behalf. AWS Marketplace enables buyers' agents to discover partner solutions, transact securely, and meet their enterprise governance controls. As a seller in AWS Marketplace, learn how to sell products that support agentic discovery and procurement to position your offerings for this new frontier.

title: Connecting sellers with their AWS Marketplace buyers
title_ko: 판매자와 AWS Marketplace 구매자 연결하기
summary_ko: AWS Marketplace 구독 시점에 구매자 정보를 확보하고 판매자와 연결하는 방법을 다루는 라이트닝 토크입니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: AWS Marketplace connects buyers and software sellers at subscription. In this lightning talk, explore how you can capture a buyer's contact details earlier during procurement to reduce friction from purchase to onboarding, support, and initial product engagement.Â

title: Multi-Tenant Agentic Platforms: A Scalable Reference Architecture
title_ko: 멀티테넌트 에이전틱 플랫폼: 확장 가능한 레퍼런스 아키텍처
summary_ko: AI 네이티브 SaaS로 전환하는 ISV를 위해 서드파티 에이전트를 대규모로 오케스트레이션하는 멀티테넌트 아키텍처를 제시합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: SaaS is going AI-native. ISVs must orchestrate third-party agents at scale. This session presents a multi-tenant architecture covering MCP, A2A, and AgentCore for orchestration, entitlement-based monetization, secure token exchange, agent lifecycle via Agent Registry, and cross-tenant observability.

title: Govern, Bill, and Attribute: The Unit Economics of Production Agents
title_ko: 거버넌스, 과금, 귀속: 프로덕션 에이전트의 단위 경제학
summary_ko: 프로덕션 에이전트의 실제 호출 비용을 파악하고 수익성 있게 가격을 책정·과금·귀속하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Neopolitan III
abstract: Your agent demo costs $0.02 a call; in production it's $4. Can you still price it profitably, and can you capture the full AWS consumption it drives downstream? This chalk talk walks the complete unit economics of a production agent: right-sizing cost with prompt caching, model routing, and tool-call minimization; pricing through consumption versus outcome-based billing; and attributing the full impact through AWS Marketplace metering and PRM, so it converts into AWS investment back to you. Real examples like bid optimization, content moderation, and shopping advisors ground each step.

title: How to Build Autonomous Enterprise Agents with SOPs using Kiro and Bedrock AgentCore
title_ko: Kiro와 Bedrock AgentCore로 SOP 기반 자율 엔터프라이즈 에이전트 구축하기
summary_ko: SAP 같은 ERP의 예외 처리량을 사람이 감당하지 못하는 문제를 SOP 기반 자율 에이전트로 해결하는 방법을 Kiro와 Bedrock AgentCore로 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: Enterprise operations hit a limitation when humans can't keep up with the volume of exceptions in ERP systems like SAP which is solved by autonomous AI agents. In this session, learn how to build production agents by writing SOPs in natural language. We'll cover how to write SOPs that let agents exercise judgment while embedding guardrails. A single SOP becomes a deployable agent, and this pattern scales across different business processes. Using Kiro's spec-driven development and Strands agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, partners own the full agent lifecycle and differentiate by layering domain expertise and industry-specific IP into SOPs. Walk away with hands-on experience building the agentic architecture that enables autonomous enterprise operations for your customers.

title: Ship Agents You Can Trust: An Agent Evaluation Framework for Partners
title_ko: 신뢰할 수 있는 에이전트 출시: 파트너를 위한 에이전트 평가 프레임워크
summary_ko: 프로덕션 에이전트가 고객에게 충분히 좋은지 판단하기 위한 파트너용 에이전트 평가 프레임워크를 소개합니다.
abstract: Partners shipping production agents at scale need to answer: is this good enough for customers? Agentic transformation doesn't end at build; quality evaluation is the missing layer. In this chalk talk, we walk through an open-source evaluation framework: define test criteria for your agent, run it in a sandbox on Bedrock, calibrate an automated judge against human labels, and track failure rates in CI. For multi-agent systems, attribute failures to the agent that caused them, not where the harm showed up.

title: The Agentic MSP: AI Agents & Amazon Bedrock AgentCore in Action
title_ko: 에이전틱 MSP: AI 에이전트와 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 실전
summary_ko: 수백 개 고객 환경을 관리하는 MSP가 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 기반 에이전트로 수동·사후 대응 업무를 자동화하는 실습 워크숍입니다.
abstract: MSPs managing hundreds of customer environments can no longer rely on manual, reactive workflows. In this hands-on workshop, MSP teams will deploy a multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — using natural language to monitor, diagnose, and remediate issues across accounts in real time. Participants will trigger live incidents, orchestrate autonomous fixes with DevOps, FinOps, and Security agents, and explore how Kiro and AWS Transform accelerate development and modernization. The session covers agent-to-agent coordination, cross-account operations, and MCP-based tool access. MSPs will leave with a production-ready blueprint to transform operations from reactive to agentic. Laptops required — everyone builds live.

title: From Manual to Autonomous: Agentic AWS Partner Growth via Quick & MCP
title_ko: 수동에서 자율로: Quick과 MCP로 이끄는 에이전틱 AWS 파트너 성장
summary_ko: 전문가에 묶인 지식과 비싼 수동 파트너 운영을 Amazon Quick과 MCP 기반 아키텍처로 확장 가능하게 바꾸는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Expertise locked in SMEs doesn't scale, and manual partner operations are expensive. The answer is architectural. Amazon Quick, Partner Central MCP Server, and Marketplace AI experiences cut three costs. Cost of sales: AI Listing Experiences, prospecting and co-sell PC agents, demand generation, Funding Agents, and Express Private Offers. Cost of customer operations: Tools to manage customers at scale, auto-renewals, adoption-nudging and reporting agents. Cost of partnerships: automated AWS Specializations, onboarding and journey agents, and Partner revenue telemetry. We cover real-time SME guidance, MCP integration, and orchestration across Partner Central and Marketplace. Leave ready to build your own workflows at scale.

title: Turbocharge your Agentic Consulting Practice with Agentic Consultants
title_ko: 에이전틱 컨설턴트로 에이전틱 컨설팅 프랙티스 강화하기
summary_ko: 인간 컨설턴트에 AI 에이전트 컨설턴트를 더해 컨설팅 업무를 10배 더 많이 수행하는 파트너 프랙티스 모델을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Builders' Session
abstract: Partners are building agentic consulting practices with human consultants, but what if they could deliver 10x more engagements by augmenting their teams with consulting agents? In this hands-on builders' session, work alongside a team of consulting agents that guide a human consultant through structured discovery — asking the right questions and validating assumptions — then build out business requirements, generate agent designs and AWS architectures, calculate ROI-backed financial models, and export ready-to-use Statement of Work — all in a single, AI-accelerated workflow you can take straight back to your practice.

room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: As agentic AI expands into regulated industries, autonomous decisions must meet compliance before production. This session gives partners a governance framework spanning technical and non-technical requirements — not just architecture. We demo a working multi-agent system and share the code.

title: Turn AWS Marketplace listings into self-service buyer journeys
title_ko: AWS Marketplace 리스팅을 셀프서비스 구매 여정으로 전환하기
summary_ko: 고객이 평가부터 구독, 배포까지 스스로 진행할 수 있도록 AWS Marketplace 리스팅을 셀프서비스 경로로 만드는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Make it easier for customers to find, subscribe and deploy your software in by providing a self-service path from evaluation to purchase. In this session, explore how to transform your AWS Marketplace listing using demos, free trials, AI-guided evaluation and usage-based pricing. Learn the repeatable patterns for reducing procurement delays, measuring buyer progression, activating listings, and directing qualified buyers.

title: AWS Marketplace checkout, your website, your brand
title_ko: AWS Marketplace 결제를 내 웹사이트와 브랜드로
summary_ko: 자사 웹사이트에서 구매 준비가 된 고객에게 이미 승인된 AWS Marketplace 조달 경로를 브랜드 경험 그대로 제공하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: When a buyer on your website is ready to purchase, AWS Marketplace gives them a procurement path their company has already approved. AWS Marketplace Storefront brings that path onto your own domain, so you keep your brand, your journey, and your sales team's visibility. In this chalk talk we'll build one live: catalog selection, buyer routing, embedding on your domain, and wiring requests into your CRM.

title: Align cost with value through outcome-based pricing in AWS Marketplace
title_ko: AWS Marketplace 성과 기반 가격 책정으로 비용과 가치 일치시키기
summary_ko: 해결된 티켓 같은 결과에만 비용을 지불하는 성과 기반 가격 모델을 AWS Marketplace에서 구현하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Customers increasingly expect software to be priced in terms of value delivered, paying only for results like resolved tickets or documents processed not API calls or compute hours or seats. In this Code Talk, learn how to implement outcome-based pricing and see live examples of metering and billing in AWS Marketplace. Follow along as we go from prototype to published listing, billing per resolved ticket, processed document, or any measurable result you choose.

title: The Last Mile of Agentic AI: Get Agents Adopted with Bedrock & Quick
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI의 라스트 마일: Bedrock과 Quick으로 에이전트 도입 이끌기
summary_ko: 고객이 일하는 AI 업무 공간 안에 제품을 녹여 넣어 에이전트 채택을 높이는 방법을 Bedrock과 Quick으로 실습합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Your customers increasingly live inside an AI work surface, and your product needs to be there too. In this hands-on session, you'll take a SaaS product—its API and a simple agentic capability—and bring it into Amazon Quick using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. You'll adapt it for AgentCore, wire up secure identity, then build Chat Agents, Research, Flows, and Apps that put your product's intelligence in front of users. Customers get your whole product in Quick, as-is. Walk out with a working reference pattern and the ability to spin up POCs for product leadership.

title: Building Managed Security Practices with AWS Security Hub Extended and Partners
title_ko: AWS Security Hub Extended와 파트너로 관리형 보안 프랙티스 구축하기
summary_ko: AWS Security Hub Extended, AWS Artifact 등을 활용해 도구가 아닌 보안 성과를 제공하는 관리형 보안 서비스 구축 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Your customers don't want more tools—they want outcomes. In this session, learn how AWS Security Hub Extended, AWS Artifact, and other tools combine to create a powerful foundation for partners delivering managed security and compliance services at scale. Security Hub Extended gives MSSPs a single pane of glass and OCSF-normalized findings that eliminate integration headaches. Pair this with our extended security portfolio to create the foundation for audit-ready compliance frameworks across financial services, healthcare, and public sector, and you have a differentiated "detect, respond, and prove compliance" offering your customers can't get elsewhere. Whether you're an MSSP building SOC-as-a-Service, an ISV integrating into the Security Hub ecosystem, or a consulting partner delivering compliance transformations, this session shows you the better together story of working with AWS.

title: Automate your AWS partnership with a unified agentic operating model
title_ko: 통합 에이전틱 운영 모델로 AWS 파트너십 자동화하기
summary_ko: 수작업 중심의 파트너 관리 대신 통합 에이전틱 운영 모델로 AWS 파트너십 활동을 자동화하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Getting the most from your AWS partnership requires thoughtful and sustained engagement from both sides. Instead of heavy manual lifts, an agentic partner operating model supports this engagement at scale through strategic automation, delivering the right guidance, insight, and capabilities to team members who need them most. In this workshop, build a unified agentic operating model that connects pipeline, co-sell coordination, and AWS consumption measurement into a single orchestration layer using your CRM, AWS Partner Central, and Amazon Quick, enabling all team members to easily leverage AWS tools, insights, and investments from one agentic surface to increase your AWS engagement.

title: AI-Powered Migrations: AWS Transform Across the Lifecycle
title_ko: AI 기반 마이그레이션: 전체 라이프사이클에 걸친 AWS Transform
summary_ko: AWS Transform의 조합형 AI 에이전트로 평가부터 실행까지 마이그레이션 전 과정을 자동화하는 실습 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: Get hands-on with AWS Transform's composable AI agents automating the full migration lifecycle. Qualify using AI-powered agents to automate migration and modernization deal qualification along with funding orchestration. Migrate and modernize by leveraging Transform Custom agents to modernize legacy workloads at enterprise scale. Finally, measure by implementing Partner Revenue Measurement (PRM) to attribute revenue and impact to your delivery.

title: Composable Agentic AI: Build Your Partner Offerings for Enterprises
title_ko: 조합형 에이전틱 AI: 엔터프라이즈를 위한 파트너 오퍼링 구축
summary_ko: 안정적인 계층 계약을 가진 분산 시스템으로 수렴하는 엔터프라이즈 에이전트 패턴에 맞춰 파트너 오퍼링을 설계하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano I
abstract: Enterprises deploying agents in production are converging on a common pattern: distributed systems with stable layer contracts, bounded autonomy, and security and observability built in from day one. That raises a concrete question for AWS partners - does your product plug into the architecture your customers are already standardizing on? In this hands-on workshop for ISVs and consulting partners, you'll learn the composable Enterprise Agentic AI Reference Architecture, see exactly where your product fits at each layer, and build alongside AWS GenAI services, that compose into a single coherent production system. You'll leave with working reference code for an enterprise-ready agentic architecture and a playbook for co-building on the AWS agentic stack.

title: Building a Zero Trust for Agentic AI Practice: A Partner Framework
title_ko: 에이전틱 AI를 위한 제로 트러스트 프랙티스 구축: 파트너 프레임워크
summary_ko: AI 에이전트의 ID, 권한, 거버넌스, 테넌트 격리 문제를 파트너 수익 기회로 연결하는 제로 트러스트 프레임워크를 소개합니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: AI agents create identity, authorization, governance, and tenant-isolation challenges that map directly to partner revenue streams. In this builders' session, you'll work hands-on with the Zero Trust Agent Maturity (ZAM) Framework and configure Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity and Gateway to enforce verifiable agent identities, auditable interaction chains, and centralized policy authorization that scopes every agent action to its tenant boundary. You'll run a live ZAM assessment on a sample multi-tenant deployment, revealing security gaps that become partner opportunities: red-teaming engagements, MCP security proxies, multi-tenant isolation reviews, and compliance automation. Leave with a repeatable assessment methodology to secure multi-tenant agent deployments.

title: Powering Your Forward Deployed Engineers with Kiro and AIDLC
title_ko: Kiro와 AIDLC로 Forward Deployed Engineer 역량 강화하기
summary_ko: Kiro와 AI 주도 개발 라이프사이클(AIDLC)을 활용해 FDE의 AI 기반 딜리버리를 전 과정 실습하는 워크숍입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Milano IV
abstract: Learn how to power your Forward Deployed Engineers with AI-driven delivery in this hands-on workshop. Work through a full agentic-driven development lifecycle using Kiro: elaborate requirements, generate domain models and code, produce tests and IaC, and deploy, all while staying in control of architecture decisions. Along the way, see how partners scaled persona-based agents across the SDLC, with gains of 2-10X velocity, 3-5X productivity, and 50-70% reduction in design cycle time. Leave with a repeatable approach your teams can apply on the next engagement, and the next, sharpening your AI-driven delivery.

title: Architect, launch, and optimize solutions with AWS Marketplace
title_ko: AWS Marketplace로 솔루션 설계, 출시, 최적화하기

abstract: Discover how new AWS Marketplace capabilities can help turn your solutions into scalable commercial offerings including AI-powered and multi-product offerings. In this interactive workshop, explore key decisions across architecture, packaging, deployment, pricing, and launch readiness. Connect directly with AWS Marketplace subject-matter experts to evaluate approaches for your business, validate your listing strategy, and identify opportunities to simplify the customer experience. Leave with practical guidance and an actionable plan to accelerate launch, drive recurring revenue, and improve customer retention.

title: Build Composable Agents with the AWS Transform Agent Builder Toolkit
