title: Modernizing VMware workloads with Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
title_ko: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP으로 VMware 워크로드 현대화
summary_ko: VMware 워크로드에 맞춘 스토리지 기반으로 FSx for NetApp ONTAP을 활용해 현대화하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Migrating VMware workloads to AWS often means rethinking storage, but it doesn't have to. In this chalk talk, we explore how Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP provides a storage foundation built for VMware migrations. Learn how FSx for ONTAP delivers multi-protocol support, enterprise data management, and ONTAP compatibility that VMware administrators already know. We'll discuss real world migration patterns, cost optimization through deduplication and compression, and high availability with Multi-AZ and zero RPO. Bring your questions and join us to design a migration strategy that minimizes disruption and maximizes your existing ONTAP investments.

title: Storage decisions when you're building a multi-tenant business
title_ko: 멀티테넌트 비즈니스 구축 시 스토리지 의사결정
summary_ko: 사일로·브리지·풀 배포 모델별로 워크로드 특성에 맞는 멀티테넌트 스토리지 선택 기준을 설명합니다.
abstract: When your business delivers cloud services to your customers, how you map tenants to storage is one of the earliest architectural choices, and it shapes everything that follows: onboarding automation, billing boundaries, isolation guarantees, and how accounts, users, and data relate to each tenant. Your workload mix adds another dimension, because data types using object, file, or block storage drive the handling of tenancy differently. In this chalk talk, we walk through silo, bridge, and pool deployment models, examining how workload profile, tenant count, and business requirements drive the choice. Bring your architecture and we'll work through it.

title: Architecting video search at trillion scale with Amazon S3 Vectors
title_ko: Amazon S3 Vectors로 조 단위 규모의 동영상 검색 설계하기
summary_ko: Bright Data가 Amazon S3 Vectors 위에 대규모 동영상 검색 계층을 구축한 아키텍처와 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Storing and querying 1.5 trillion vectors demands rethinking traditional vector database architecture. Join this talk to learn how Bright Data built its video search retrieval layer on Amazon S3 Vectors, covering index partitioning across massive collections, embedding storage layout for sub-second nearest-neighbor queries, and cost/latency trade-offs versus dedicated vector databases at this scale. Bright Data walks through its approach to sharding, metadata filtering, and query routing, with benchmarks comparing throughput and cost per million queries. You'll leave with concrete architectural patterns for evaluating S3 Vectors in large-scale search, RAG, or embedding retrieval systems.

title: Connect NetApp FSx for ONTAP File Data to AI Apps with S3
title_ko: S3를 통해 NetApp FSx for ONTAP 파일 데이터를 AI 앱에 연결하기
summary_ko: FSx for ONTAP에 저장된 기업 문서와 비정형 데이터를 S3 액세스로 AI 워크로드에 연결하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Your AI workloads need enterprise data including documents, datasets, and unstructured content already sitting in ONTAP. The usual answer is to copy it to S3, build a sync pipeline, and hope nothing drifts. There's a better option. This session shows how to use FSx for ONTAP file shares directly via the S3 API so Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker can read them in place with no migration, no pipeline. Your existing access controls and data management policies stay intact. We'll cover the architecture, configuration steps, and how to pair ONTAP's data management capabilities with S3-based AI/ML services.

title: AWS Backup: Architecture deep dive
title_ko: AWS Backup: 아키텍처 심층 분석
summary_ko: AWS 전문가와 함께 AWS Backup 아키텍처와 새 기능을 설계에 통합하는 방법을 깊이 있게 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Dive into AWS Backup architecture with AWS experts, including how new capabilities fit into your design. We work through deployment strategies, backup storage options, restore scenarios, and security posture. Bring your questions, leave with a plan.

title: What's new with AWS Backup
title_ko: AWS Backup의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: 데이터 보호를 간소화하고 강화하는 AWS Backup의 최신 기능과 활용 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Learn about the latest AWS Backup capabilities and how they can help you simplify and strengthen your data protection strategy. We cover new features, use cases, and guidance for getting started.

title: Modernizing file transfer with AWS Transfer Family
title_ko: AWS Transfer Family로 파일 전송 현대화하기
summary_ko: AWS Transfer Family를 안전한 파일 교환을 위한 완전 관리형 기반으로 활용해 레거시 파일 전송을 현대화하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Legacy file transfer platforms are costly to maintain and fragile under pressure. When outages and bottlenecks start compounding, patching isn't enough. In this session, learn how AWS Transfer Family provides a fully managed foundation for secure file exchange that scales with demand. We'll cover core capabilities including managed SFTP servers, connectors, browser-based web apps, and event-driven automation. A customer joins to share how they replaced a failure-prone platform with a modern, AWS-native architecture on Transfer Family and S3.

title: Speed up latency-sensitive workloads with Amazon S3 Express One Zone
title_ko: Amazon S3 Express One Zone으로 지연 시간에 민감한 워크로드 가속화
summary_ko: 고객들이 프로덕션에서 S3 Express One Zone으로 저지연 성능을 확보하는 설계 패턴을 단계별로 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: For data-intensive workloads such as ML training, analytics, and AI search, every millisecond spent waiting on data costs money without advancing the work. When workloads make millions of small, random reads and writes, low-latency storage keeps compute productive without provisioning for peak demand. S3 Express One Zone brings this low latency to Amazon S3, with single-digit millisecond data access up to 10x faster than S3 Standard. In this session, we walk through the design patterns customers use in production to add low-latency performance to data already in S3, and how to tell whether your workload is a fit.

title: Building resilience against ransomware using AWS Backup
title_ko: AWS Backup으로 랜섬웨어 복원력 구축하기
summary_ko: 최소 존속 기업 범위를 정의해 복구 우선순위를 정하고 사이버 RPO 개념을 반영한 AWS Backup 랜섬웨어 대응 전략을 다룹니다.
room: MGM Grand | Level 3 | Chairman's 363 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: To counter evolving cyber threats, organizations must fortify their backup infrastructure for recovery resilience. This session applies threat modeling to design a multi-account AWS Backup architecture across three pillars: immutability with isolation, integrity validation, and guaranteed accessibility. Walk through a phased reference architecture using logically air-gapped vaults for tamper-proof backups, restore testing and GuardDuty malware scanning for integrity assurance, and multi-party approval for secure recovery during account compromise. Learn how to define your minimum viable company to sequence recovery priorities, distinguish cyber RPO from operational RPO, and align your strategy to NIST CSF 2.0 for recovery resilience and business continuity.

title: Build a real-time data lakehouse with CDC streams on S3 Tables
title_ko: S3 Tables 기반 CDC 스트림으로 실시간 데이터 레이크하우스 구축
summary_ko: Amazon S3 Tables와 Apache Iceberg로 CDC 스트림을 받아 실시간 트랜잭션 데이터 레이크하우스를 구축하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Learn how to build a real-time transactional data lakehouse using Amazon S3 Tables with Apache Iceberg. In this hands-on session, you will ingest CDC streams from Amazon MSK into a medallion architecture, transform batch and streaming data into business-ready gold layer tables with Amazon SageMaker, and query the results through Amazon Quick. You'll configure S3 Tables maintenance policies per layer and compare binpack, sort, and z-order compaction strategies to optimize query performance. You will leave with production patterns for continuous ingestion, incremental processing, and low-latency analytics at scale.

title: Advanced S3 performance engineering: From multipart to resilience
title_ko: 고급 S3 성능 엔지니어링: 멀티파트부터 복원력까지
summary_ko: 멀티파트 업로드 등 스토리지 클래스별 고급 Amazon S3 성능 최적화 기법과 복원력 확보 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Master advanced Amazon S3 performance optimization techniques across storage classes, including S3 Standard for general purpose storage and S3 Express One Zone for the highest performance needs. This expert-level workshop focuses on implementing sophisticated data transfer patterns using multipart uploads and Transfer Manager. Design and deploy resilient applications with advanced retry strategies and robust error handling mechanisms. Through technical exercises, build high-performance solutions for large-scale data transfers across different S3 storage classes. Learn to optimize your applications for specific performance requirements, from cost-effective general storage to ultra-low latency implementations. Participants must bring a laptop for this session.

title: Advanced S3 performance engineering: From multipart to resilience
title_ko: 고급 S3 성능 엔지니어링: 멀티파트부터 복원력까지
summary_ko: 멀티파트 업로드 등 스토리지 클래스별 고급 Amazon S3 성능 최적화 기법과 복원력 확보 방법을 다룹니다.

Through technical exercises, build high-performance solutions for large-scale data transfers across different S3 storage classes. Learn to optimize your applications for specific performance requirements, from cost-effective general storage to ultra-low latency implementations. title: Deploying mission-critical applications with Amazon EBS
title_ko: Amazon EBS로 미션 크리티컬 애플리케이션 배포하기
summary_ko: Amazon EC2와 EBS에 고성능 애플리케이션을 배포하고 성능과 가용성을 최적화하는 방법을 실습하는 워크숍입니다.
abstract: Millions of customers run their performance-intensive enterprise applications and databases on AWS. In this workshop, explore deploying a high-performance application on Amazon EC2 and Amazon EBS for optimized availability, resiliency, and cost performance. Discover and choose the ideal Amazon EC2 instance types and Amazon EBS volume types for various workloads. Learn about on-demand storage flexibility and performance using Elastic Volumes. Monitor and optimize Amazon EBS using Amazon CloudWatch metrics, and observe how AWS DevOps Agent autonomously investigates and helps remediate storage performance issues. Build resilience and fault tolerance using AWS Fault Injection Service. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: Build ransomware recovery with AWS Backup air-gapped vaults
title_ko: AWS Backup 에어갭 볼트로 랜섬웨어 복구 체계 구축
summary_ko: 계정 침해 상황을 가정해 AWS Backup 논리적 에어갭 볼트로 데이터를 복구하는 과정을 실습하는 워크숍입니다.
abstract: When ransomware compromises your account, your backups are the last line of defense. The question is whether they're isolated, verified, and accessible when you need them most. In this workshop, you'll work through a simulated account compromise using AWS Backup logically air-gapped vaults. You'll configure vault isolation policies to put backups out of reach, validate their integrity through restore testing, and orchestrate recovery when primary credentials are compromised. Backup Audit Manager ties it together with compliance monitoring to prove your posture holds. You'll finish with a tested recovery playbook built against a live compromise scenario. Participants must bring a laptop.

title: Find and fix storage bottlenecks for self-managed OLTP on EC2 with EBS
title_ko: EBS 기반 EC2 자체 관리형 OLTP의 스토리지 병목 찾아 해결하기
summary_ko: EC2에서 자체 운영하는 OLTP 데이터베이스의 실제 스토리지 병목을 찾아내고 EBS 설정으로 해결하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: ​​When you run a self-managed OLTP database on Amazon EC2, the storage bottleneck is rarely where you assume. This hands-on session teaches a repeatable method for finding and fixing it. Use Flexible IO tester and a PostgreSQL/pgbench workload to connect storage metrics to database symptoms. Measure latency, IOPS, throughput, and queue depth; determine whether the limit is the volume, instance bandwidth, or I/O pattern; then tune the right EBS volume configuration. Validate every change with EBS detailed performance statistics and CloudWatch. Leave with a proven sizing-and-tuning method for database workloads on EC2.

title: Amazon S3 security and access control best practices
title_ko: Amazon S3 보안 및 액세스 제어 모범 사례
summary_ko: 여러 계정과 팀에 걸쳐 Amazon S3에 집중된 중요 데이터를 안전하게 관리하기 위한 보안·액세스 제어 모범 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: As organizations consolidate critical data in Amazon S3 across accounts, teams, and workloads, security and access control decisions multiply. Which identity model scales without becoming brittle? Where do you enforce encryption policy? How do you detect misconfigurations? This session walks you through a layered security framework for S3: perimeter controls that prevent unintended public exposure, identity and attribute-based access that scales across organizational boundaries, encryption options that satisfy compliance without adding operational friction, and monitoring that continuously validates your posture. You will learn how these layers compose into a cohesive strategy and which controls matter most as your environment grows.

title: Optimizing containerized applications with shared file storage
title_ko: 공유 파일 스토리지로 컨테이너 애플리케이션 최적화하기
summary_ko: 컨테이너 애플리케이션에서 발생하는 공유 파일 스토리지 문제를 식별하고 해결하는 기법을 인터랙티브 칠톡으로 다룹니다.
abstract: Containerized workloads can face unpredictable latency spikes, throughput bottlenecks, and runaway costs as they scale. In this interactive chalk talk, we'll walk through techniques for identifying these issues and solving them in production environments. Bring your use cases, performance questions, and architecture challenges as we tune Amazon EFS, Amazon S3 Files, and Amazon FSx for real-world EKS and ECS deployments. We'll cover IO profiling, throughput vs. latency tradeoffs, cost-optimization strategies, multi-attach EFS configurations, FSx volume sizing, and POSIX-compatible pipeline design on S3 Files. You'll leave with practical insights you can apply to your environment immediately.

title: Advanced vaulting: Ransomware resilience with AWS Backup
title_ko: 고급 볼팅: AWS Backup으로 랜섬웨어 복원력 확보
summary_ko: 공격자가 백업까지 노리는 상황에 대비해 AWS Backup 기반의 볼팅 전략을 수립하는 방법을 설명합니다.
abstract: Bad actors increasingly target backups alongside production data, and organizations need a vaulting strategy that puts them out of reach. Isolation, immutability, and encryption form the pillars of that strategy, and this session dives deep into how to implement all three with AWS Backup. We'll cover logically air-gapped vault architecture, including how backups are stored in isolated, immutable infrastructure by default, encryption with AWS-owned and customer-managed keys, and durable recovery pathways with Multi-party approval. We'll also cover how these vaulting patterns feed into recovery workflows so that what's protected stays recoverable.

title: AWS Backup clean room recovery: Comprehensive resilience framework
title_ko: AWS Backup 클린룸 복구: 종합 복원력 프레임워크
summary_ko: AWS Backup으로 격리된 복구 환경을 설계해 백업의 무결성을 검증하고 안전하게 복구하는 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Having an isolated vault is only half the battle. When a cyber event hits, you need confidence your backups are clean and recoverable. In this chalk talk, learn how to design an Isolated Recovery Environment using AWS Backup that validates and restores data in a secure space separate from production: reducing blast radius, breaking the kill chain, and proving recoverability on demand. We'll cover immutable air-gapped copies, automated restore testing with malware scanning, and Multi-party approval to control recovery access during account compromise. Leave with a framework for building recovery confidence into your backup strategy.

title: The multi-account AWS Backup playbook: centralized data protection
title_ko: 멀티 계정 AWS Backup 플레이북: 중앙 집중식 데이터 보호
summary_ko: 수백 개 계정에 AWS Backup을 배포할 때 생기는 과제와 이를 중앙에서 관리하기 위한 실전 방법을 공유합니다.
abstract: Deploying AWS Backup across hundreds of accounts brings challenges that a single-account setup never surfaces: centralized policy enforcement, cross-account and cross-Region copy, delegated administration, and consistent compliance evidence across the organization. This chalk talk walks through the patterns that hold up in large AWS Organizations - backup policies at the OU level, delegated administrator setup, cross-account vaults, and monitoring that scales. Bring your toughest multi-account backup questions; we'll whiteboard the architecture and trade-offs together.

title: AWS Transfer Family: SFTP meets agentic AI workflows
title_ko: AWS Transfer Family: SFTP와 에이전틱 AI 워크플로의 만남
summary_ko: AWS Transfer Family로 엔터프라이즈 파일 전송 솔루션을 만들고 이를 에이전틱 AI 워크플로로 확장하는 방법을 배웁니다.
abstract: Learn how to build enterprise-grade file transfer solutions using AWS Transfer Family and extend them into agentic AI workflows. In this chalk talk, we'll walk through building secure SFTP servers, integrating with enterprise identity providers like Okta and Azure AD, and automating file processing using Terraform. We'll explore how event-driven architectures handle malware scanning with GuardDuty, and how AI agents via Amazon Bedrock AgentCore take over downstream tasks like data extraction and fraud detection. Bring your questions. We'll dig into how each layer connects so you can extend your own Transfer Family deployment the same way.

title: Inside Amazon S3 Vectors: architecture and cost optimization for vector search
title_ko: Amazon S3 Vectors 내부 구조: 벡터 검색의 아키텍처와 비용 최적화
summary_ko: Amazon S3 Vectors가 대규모 벡터 검색을 제공하는 내부 아키텍처와 비용 최적화 방법을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Vector embeddings power everything from semantic search to RAG, but running them at scale often means high infrastructure costs and operational overhead. In this session, go inside the architecture of Amazon S3 Vectors to see how it delivers vector search at up to 90% lower cost than specialized alternatives, with support for up to 2 billion vectors per index. We'll whiteboard the indexing approach that makes this possible, then explore recent enhancements, including a 100x increase in the per-query search result limit and reduced query pricing, and what they mean for your application's performance and cost.

title: Advanced security patterns on Amazon S3
title_ko: Amazon S3 고급 보안 패턴
summary_ko: 정책 평가 최적화 등 대규모 액세스 관리를 위한 검증된 Amazon S3 보안 패턴을 칠톡으로 소개합니다.
abstract: Amazon S3 security settings and access controls suit virtually any workload, but as data estates grow to millions of buckets across organizational boundaries, standard policy approaches hit limits. In this chalk talk, equip yourself with proven patterns for managing access at scale: optimizing policy evaluation with access points and access grants, scaling beyond IAM policy limits with cross-account structures, implementing attribute-based controls that adapt as teams and datasets grow, and securing your data lake perimeter with resource control policies. Join the S3 security team for a structured discussion of the patterns that solve the hardest multi-account access problems at scale.

title: Need for Speed: The journey to high EBS performance on EC2 instances
title_ko: Need for Speed: EC2 인스턴스에서 EBS 고성능을 향한 여정
summary_ko: Amazon EBS 아키텍처의 진화 과정과 EC2 인스턴스에서 높은 스토리지 성능을 달성하게 된 혁신들을 살펴봅니다.
abstract: Achieving consistent, low-latency block storage at cloud scale requires rethinking every layer of the IO stack. In this session, we walk you through the architectural evolution of Amazon EBS, and show how a series of innovations reduced hypervisor overhead, slashed network latency, and enabled higher block storage IOPS and throughput on your EC2 instances. We will also discuss how Nitro enabled specific EBS features such as Instance bandwidth Configuration, Torn Write Protection, and detailed performance statistics via NVMe logs. Bring your questions and leave with an understanding of how EBS delivers high performing block storage for your mission-critical applications.

title: Dive deep into resilience architectures for Amazon EBS
title_ko: Amazon EBS 복원력 아키텍처 심층 분석
summary_ko: 복원력 있는 아키텍처를 위한 Amazon EBS 신규 기능과 작동 방식, 이를 활용한 설계 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Learn about new Amazon EBS capabilities for resilient architectures and how they work. We cover how to plan your approach and optimize your block storage. Bring your questions.

title: The state of commercial open source in the age of AI
title_ko: AI 시대 상용 오픈소스의 현황
summary_ko: 오픈소스 기업이 채택을 매출로 전환하는 방법에 대해 Linux Foundation 조사 결과를 바탕으로 인사이트를 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: How do open source companies turn adoption into revenue? Matthieu Lavergne shares findings from the Linux Foundation's State of Commercial Open Source 2026 report, produced with AWS and French venture capital firm Serena for the second consecutive year. The research examines what fast-growing companies in open source are doing differently to monetize adoption, and what founders building on open source can learn from the data on what separates commercially successful open source companies from the rest.

title: Beyond the pilot: Why VCs are betting on FDE-led growth
title_ko: 파일럿을 넘어서: VC가 FDE 주도 성장에 베팅하는 이유
summary_ko: AWS Forward Deployed Engineering 리더와 VC가 FDE 중심 성장 모델이 스타트업에 주는 가치를 논의하는 패널 토론입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Successful AI pilots no longer guarantee revenue. As enterprise pricing shifts to consumption and outcomes, startups get paid only when customers deploy, adopt, and realize value, and forward deployed engineering (FDE) is how AI-native companies close that gap. In this panel discussion moderated by [AWS FDE startup leader], Asa Kalvade (VP, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering), Anu Bharadwaj (Partner, ICONIQ), and a [insert second VC partner] discuss whether FDE is consulting under a new name or a compounding moat, how to separate margin-diluting services from deployment that drives retention and expansion, and when founders should tap AWS FDE rather than build the function alone. Series A+ founders and investors will leave knowing when to invest in FDE, which metrics prove deployment creates durable value, and how to get stalled enterprise deals into production.

title: Winning enterprise customers with AWS Global Startup Program
title_ko: AWS Global Startup Program으로 엔터프라이즈 고객 확보하기
summary_ko: AWS Global Startup Program을 활용해 스타트업이 엔터프라이즈 고객을 확보하고 확장하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: The AWS Global Startup Program helps startups win and expand enterprise accounts. This session covers how the program drives growth for startups moving into enterprise customers, the resources and support it provides, and how founders can tap into it to accelerate their own path to winning and expanding enterprise business.

title: Serving world models in under 40ms across 10,000 concurrent sessions
title_ko: 1만 동시 세션에서 40ms 미만으로 월드 모델 서빙하기
summary_ko: Reactor가 1만 개 동시 세션에서 40ms 미만의 지연 시간으로 월드 모델을 서빙하는 아키텍처와 노하우를 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Reactor serves world models in under 40ms of latency across 10,000 concurrent sessions. This session covers the infrastructure and architecture decisions that let Reactor hit that latency and scale bar, the tradeoffs involved in serving world models at that speed, and what it takes to run this class of model in production at scale.

title: Turning AI deserts into markets — 0 to 30+ countries in 18 months
title_ko: AI 불모지를 시장으로: 18개월 만에 0개국에서 30개국 이상으로
summary_ko: AI 역량과 기업의 실제 가치 창출 사이의 격차를 메우며 18개월 만에 30여 개국으로 확장한 스타트업의 경험을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: There is a major gap between what AI can achieve and where enterprises are extracting value from it today. Closing that gap requires strong execution, deep partnerships and a new approach to implementation. Drawing on Wonderful’s experience across 100+ deployments in 35+ markets, Moritz Amann, GTM Switzerland, will explain what it takes to put AI into production across entire enterprises and workflows, particularly in fast-moving, complex markets. The session will explore how enterprises can use the AWS ecosystem to move beyond isolated AI initiatives and deploy AI at scale without compromising security, compliance or governance. Attendees will leave with a practical view of the infrastructure, integrations and implementation discipline required to turn AI’s potential into measurable enterprise value.

title: Sequoia + Edelbyte: What VCs really look for in AI-first startups
title_ko: Sequoia + Edelbyte: VC가 AI 퍼스트 스타트업에서 실제로 보는 것
summary_ko: Sequoia와 Edelbyte가 AI 퍼스트 스타트업을 평가할 때 투자자들이 실제로 중요하게 보는 기준을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Sequoia and Edelbyte share what VCs are really looking for when evaluating AI-first startups. This session covers how investment criteria have shifted for AI-native companies, what separates fundable AI startups from the rest, and what founders should understand about how VCs are thinking about AI-first business models today.

title: Enterprise buying trends and the startup playbook for AWS Marketplace
title_ko: 엔터프라이즈 구매 트렌드와 AWS Marketplace 스타트업 플레이북
summary_ko: 기업의 최신 구매 방식을 살펴보고 스타트업이 AWS Marketplace에 제품을 등록·판매하는 과정을 실습형으로 안내합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: An interactive session on how enterprises actually buy today, with a working walk-through of getting a startup's product discoverable and co-sell ready on AWS Marketplace. Selling into the enterprise is one of the biggest hurdles for the founders in the Zone, so programming that demystifies the buying process meets them with exactly what they need to grow. It connects the founder audience directly to a durable go-to-market path on AWS, turning a session into a tangible next step for revenue rather than just inspiration. Could be repeated during the week.

title: Founder's therapy
title_ko: 창업자 테라피
summary_ko: 창업 과정에서 실제로 효과가 있었던 것과 그렇지 않았던 것에 대한 솔직한 이야기를 나누는 소규모 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: Founders get real about building a company—the wins, the mistakes, the 3 a.m. moments when everything feels impossible. In this intimate session, you'll hear candid stories about what actually works and what doesn't, and have space to share your own struggles and ask the questions you're afraid to ask on a conference floor. Expect honest conversation with peers who've been where you are. No slides, no polish, just founders talking to founders.

title: FDE for startups: What it is, why you need it, and how to run it
title_ko: 스타트업을 위한 FDE: 개념, 필요성, 운영 방법
summary_ko: 엔터프라이즈 계약 이후 90일간 갱신과 확장을 이끄는 Forward Deployed Engineering 운영 방법을 스타트업 관점에서 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: The enterprise contract is signed. The next ninety days decide whether it renews, grows, or becomes a pilot nobody mentions again. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is how a growing number of AI startups make those ninety days count: engineers who sit inside the customer, own production code, and answer for a business result rather than a ticket queue. This session starts with what FDE is and how it differs from solutions engineering, customer success and professional services. We follow one AI startup through a single enterprise deployment and into its second year. You’ll leave with a practical guide to scoping a deployment around a business outcome, getting through enterprise security and production, turning each deployment into reusable product, and knowing when to hire your first FDE.

title: Building a brain in under an hour: The knowledge layer for physical AI agents
title_ko: 한 시간 안에 두뇌 만들기: 피지컬 AI 에이전트를 위한 지식 계층
summary_ko: Amazon Bedrock 기반 Raspberry Pi 로봇 개를 라이브 데모로 만들며 피지컬 AI 에이전트의 지식 계층을 구축합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: Agents don't fail because the model is weak. They fail because they lack context. In this hands-on session, we will build a live demo: a Raspberry Pi robot dog powered by Amazon Bedrock. You'll see how to layer context from the ground up: live camera and voice input, memory, and safety guardrails that keep it from doing something dangerous. Walk away with a reference architecture for agent knowledge layers, patterns for connecting Bedrock to physical hardware, and a blueprint for prototyping embodied AI on low-cost hardware.

title: Catch risky changes and triage incidents with AWS DevOps agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps agent로 위험한 변경 사항 포착 및 인시던트 분류
summary_ko: 하나의 릴리스와 인시던트 시나리오를 따라가며 AWS DevOps agent가 위험 변경을 감지하고 장애를 분류하는 과정을 설명합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: Downtime can cost startups customers, yet early-stage teams rarely staff a dedicated operations engineer, even as they own both release safety and on-call. The AWS DevOps Agent, delivered through AWS Startup Advisor, runs inside the IDEs and coding agents engineers already use. It surfaces risky changes before they ship and helps triage production incidents by correlating signals, suggesting likely causes, and guiding remediation, all without a context switch. In this chalk talk, we trace one release and incident scenario end to end on the whiteboard, covering agent setup and cost model. Bring your on-call questions and we'll pressure-test it against your stack.

title: Training and simulation turn robot capabilities into useful products
title_ko: 학습과 시뮬레이션으로 로봇 역량을 유용한 제품으로 전환하기
summary_ko: 로보틱스 스타트업 리더들이 학습과 시뮬레이션을 통해 로봇 기술을 실제 제품으로 만드는 방법을 논의하는 패널입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Making humanoid and autonomous robots useful takes more than a capable chassis. In this panel moderated by Deap Ubhi, who leads startup Solutions Architects globally at AWS, leaders from NEURA Robotics, 1X, and Highlanders dig into the intelligence behind their robots: how they train and simulate behaviors, which AI models they rely on, and how data pipelines support development. They also explore the application layer that turns raw capability into products. Founders and robotics builders will hear how these teams connect training and simulation with real-world deployment.

title: Containment or defense: a debate on securing agents in production
title_ko: 격리인가 방어인가: 프로덕션 에이전트 보안에 관한 토론
summary_ko: METR와 Horizon3가 프로덕션 AI 에이전트 보안에 격리와 방어 중 어떤 접근이 맞는지 토론합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: METR and Horizon3 debate containment versus defense as the right approach to securing AI agents in production. This session covers the tradeoffs between containing agent behavior through strict boundaries versus building defenses that let agents operate with more autonomy, and what security teams should weigh when deciding how to secure agents running in production environments.

title: Building faster: AI-native development workflows (SDLC)
title_ko: 더 빠르게 구축하기: AI 네이티브 개발 워크플로(SDLC)
summary_ko: Superblocks와 Starfolk AI가 AI 네이티브 워크플로를 중심으로 소프트웨어 개발 수명 주기를 재구성한 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Superblocks and Starfolk AI rebuild the software development lifecycle around AI-native workflows. This session covers how they build faster with AI woven into the development workflow itself, the patterns that make AI-native SDLC work in practice, and what founders can take from their approach to rethinking how software gets built.

title: How Clay turns CRM and first-party data into a context graph for GTM AI
title_ko: Clay가 CRM과 퍼스트파티 데이터를 GTM AI용 컨텍스트 그래프로 만드는 방법
summary_ko: Clay가 CRM과 퍼스트파티 데이터를 컨텍스트 그래프로 전환해 시장 진출(GTM) AI를 구동하는 플랫폼 구축 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Clay built a platform that turns CRM and first-party data into a context graph that powers go-to-market AI. This session covers how Clay structures that context graph, how it feeds AI-driven GTM workflows, and what founders building GTM AI products can learn from Clay's approach to combining and enriching first-party data at scale.

title: Simile: Making interview-trained AI that predicts consumer decisions
title_ko: Simile: 인터뷰로 학습해 소비자 결정을 예측하는 AI 만들기
summary_ko: Simile이 인터뷰 데이터로 학습해 소비자 의사결정을 예측하는 'what-if' AI 모델을 구축한 과정을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Simile built AI models trained on interviews that predict consumer decisions, essentially a “what-if” machine for consumer behavior. This session covers how Simile trains these interview-based models, the architecture behind predicting consumer decisions, and what it unlocks for companies trying to understand how customers will respond before they build.

title: Scaling AI agents: How Forlex turned failures into mechanisms
title_ko: AI 에이전트 확장: Forlex가 실패를 메커니즘으로 바꾼 방법
summary_ko: Forlex가 규제 업무에서 150개 이상의 AI 에이전트를 운영하며 프로덕션 실패를 경계 설정 메커니즘으로 활용한 사례입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Forlex uses production failures to set boundaries for 150+ AI agents operating in regulated workflows. Silent regressions, runaway tail latency, and privilege creep emerged as Forlex scaled its agent fleet. This session covers how Forlex turned each failure into a durable mechanism, covering the guardrails, monitoring, and operational practices that let them scale agents safely in production.

title: Accelerating Physical AI with AWS for Startups
title_ko: AWS for Startups로 피지컬 AI 가속화하기
summary_ko: 로보틱스, 자율 시스템, 하드웨어 혁신을 이끄는 스타트업·파트너와 피지컬 AI 가속 방안을 나누는 파이어사이드 챗입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: The next wave of AI won't just answer questions. It will move, build and explore. Join us for a fireside chat with startups and partners turning breakthroughs in robotics, autonomy and hard tech into real products. Learn how they handle data, simulation, compute and go-to-market to bring AI into the physical world.

title: Can self-improving AI overcome reward hacking and hardware limits?
title_ko: 자기 개선 AI는 보상 해킹과 하드웨어 한계를 극복할 수 있을까?
summary_ko: Core Automation이 자기 개선 AI 시스템이 보상 해킹과 하드웨어 제약을 극복할 수 있는지를 탐구합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Core Automation explores whether self-improving AI systems can overcome reward hacking and hardware constraints. This session covers the technical challenges of building AI that improves itself without gaming its own reward signals, the hardware limits that constrain self-improvement loops, and what it takes to build self-improving systems that actually hold up in practice.

title: Building AI products at startup speed
title_ko: 스타트업 속도로 AI 제품 만들기
summary_ko: 모델이 매주 바뀌는 환경에서 스타트업이 AI 제품을 빠르게 만들고 출시하기 위한 접근 방식을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Startups building AI products face a different speed problem than traditional software: models change weekly, and what worked last month may already be outdated. This session covers how to build AI products that keep pace, drawing on patterns for iterating quickly, evaluating new models, and shipping AI features without getting stuck re-architecting every time the underlying technology shifts.

title: Shipping your startup idea, not the plumbing, with AgentCore
title_ko: AgentCore로 인프라가 아닌 스타트업 아이디어를 출시하기
summary_ko: AgentCore로 에이전트를 처음부터 끝까지 구축하며 AgentCore가 대신 처리해 주는 영역과 직접 할 일을 설명합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: Startups burn precious time building infrastructure plumbing instead of shipping their actual idea. AgentCore handles the plumbing, agent identity, memory, gateway, and runtime, so you can focus on the product. In this session, we walk through standing up an agent on AgentCore end to end, covering what it handles for you and what you still own. You'll leave with a clear picture of how to go from idea to a running agent without building infrastructure from scratch.

title: Beyond the coding assistant: Build a software factory for your startup
title_ko: 코딩 어시스턴트를 넘어: 스타트업을 위한 소프트웨어 팩토리 구축
summary_ko: 소규모 엔지니어링 팀이 고객 요청을 안정적인 릴리스로 전환하는 AI 기반 소프트웨어 팩토리 구축 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: Startups need to turn customer requests into reliable releases without overwhelming a small engineering team. This demo-driven session explores how software factories combine AI agents, repeatable workflows, independent verification, and human judgment to handle engineering work from request to delivery. We'll follow a bounded change through implementation, testing, review, and release, and show what happens when the generated solution fails a required check. Attendees will learn how to start with one useful workflow, measure its value, and expand delegation as evidence builds confidence.

title: Reshape AI-driven software development for your startup with harness engineering
title_ko: 하네스 엔지니어링으로 스타트업의 AI 기반 소프트웨어 개발 재편하기
summary_ko: 소규모 팀이 얇고 구성 가능한 하네스를 점진적으로 구축해 AI 중심 개발 방식을 정착시키는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: Startups build software with AI coding agents, but new models ship every few weeks, and open-weight models rival frontier ones at a fraction of the cost. An agent is a combination of the model along with a harness: the context, tools, deterministic checks, and human decision points. In this session, we will walk you through how a lean team can build a thin configurable harness incrementally, enabling them to swap models underneath as needed and build context from continual learning loops. You'll leave knowing what to set up first, when to let agents run autonomously, and what decisions stay human.

title: Zero to one: Crafting a GTM playbook for frontier AI startups
title_ko: 제로 투 원: 프런티어 AI 스타트업을 위한 GTM 플레이북 만들기
summary_ko: 프런티어 AI 스타트업의 시장 진출(GTM) 전략이 실제로 어떤 모습인지 화이트보드로 함께 설계해 보는 칠톡입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: You built a model the world hasn't seen before. Now you need your first ten enterprise customers and the playbook that got the last generation of SaaS startups to market won't work for frontier AI. Pricing is different, buyer psychology is different, and the competitive window is measured in months, not years. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard what a go-to-market strategy actually looks like for frontier AI startups navigating the zero-to-one phase while still searching for product-market fit. We'll cover how to identify your beachhead customers, position against incumbents and leverage AWS distribution channels to accelerate enterprise traction.

title: Kiro as your founding engineer
title_ko: 창업 멤버 엔지니어로서의 Kiro
summary_ko: 초기 90일의 개발 습관이 코드베이스를 오래 좌우한다는 관점에서 Kiro를 창업 엔지니어처럼 활용하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: The habits you establish in your first 90 days can shape your codebase for years. This session examines how to work with Kiro as your founding engineer, starting with the project context it needs to produce useful code. We cover how to structure development work so output stays consistent as your product grows, and which early mistakes make a codebase harder to maintain. Founders will learn how to give Kiro clear context and maintain consistent code quality as delivery accelerates. The focus is on decisions you can make early to keep the codebase maintainable as the pace of delivery increases.

title: Get from idea to app in seconds
title_ko: 아이디어에서 앱까지 단 몇 초 만에
summary_ko: 스타트업 빌더들이 Kiro, Q Developer 등 에이전트를 활용해 아이디어를 빠르게 작동하는 앱으로 만드는 방법을 보여 줍니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: AI coding agents help startups ship faster. In this session, see how startup builders use Kiro, Q Developer, and other agents to turn an idea into a working app in seconds. We'll show prompt-to-app flows, common pitfalls, and how to go from prototype to something you can actually ship.

title: Unlocking inference: How OpenRouter scaled to 10M+ users with AWS
title_ko: 추론의 잠재력 해제: OpenRouter가 AWS로 1천만 사용자 이상으로 확장한 방법
summary_ko: OpenRouter GTM 책임자가 AWS와의 협력을 통해 1천만 명 이상의 사용자로 추론 서비스를 확장한 과정을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: As AI moves from experimentation to production, developers want access to every leading model through one simple interface. OpenRouter and Amazon Bedrock unlock this access for millions of customers. In this lightning talk, OpenRouter's Head of GTM, Glenn Rachlin shares how the two companies partnered to support that hypergrowth. Learn what it takes to scale an AI platform globally, how startups and AWS can grow together, and what OpenRouter's journey shows about where AI adoption is heading.

title: The future of Agents with Sierra and AWS
title_ko: Sierra와 AWS가 그리는 에이전트의 미래
summary_ko: Sierra 창업자와 함께 성공하는 AI 에이전트를 가르는 인프라 요구 사항과 에이전트의 미래를 논의하는 파이어사이드 챗입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Enterprise AI agents are reshaping customer experience, and success requires infrastructure and architecture built for enterprise scale. Join Pol Sanchez, founder of Sierra, in this fireside chat to explore the infrastructure demands that separate agents that work at scale from those that only work in demos: reliability, low latency, burst capacity, and the security and compliance posture that regulated industries demand. Discover why the winning architecture isn't locked to a single model. Instead, choose and swap models based on the task, with Amazon Bedrock enabling that diversity at scale. Learn how the future of agents extends beyond smarter individual agents to specialized agents collaborating directly in real conversations, sharing context, and resolving more customer issues in fewer interactions while keeping customers in control.

title: Building AI agents you can trust: From models to supply chain
title_ko: 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 에이전트 구축: 모델부터 공급망까지
summary_ko: 모델, 오케스트레이션, 공급망 등 엔터프라이즈 AI 에이전트 배포의 모든 단계에서 신뢰를 확보하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Deploying AI agents across the enterprise requires trust at every step: the models powering them, the orchestration layer controlling them, and the ecosystem of tools they consume. OpenAI provides the foundation—state-of-the-art language models that can reason, plan, and act autonomously. Runlayer solves the orchestration challenge: giving every employee a safe, governed path to delegate work to agents, with policy enforcement, identity integration, and audit trails built in. AIR addresses an emerging concern—the AI supply chain—ensuring the skills, plugins, and MCP servers agents use are vetted and secure. From capable models to controlled deployment to verified tooling, this panel illustrates how organizations can scale agent adoption while maintaining security, auditability, and control.

title: How KOHO governs banking AI agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
title_ko: KOHO가 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore로 뱅킹 AI 에이전트를 거버넌스하는 방법
summary_ko: 캐나다 핀테크 KOHO가 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore로 뱅킹 AI 에이전트를 통제·관리하는 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: KOHO, a Canadian fintech, governs its banking AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This session covers the governance model KOHO built to keep AI agents compliant and auditable in a regulated banking environment, and what other Fintechs can learn from applying AgentCore to agent governance in regulated industries.

title: Triomics speeds cancer trial matching with Amazon Bedrock
title_ko: Triomics, Amazon Bedrock으로 암 임상시험 매칭 가속화
summary_ko: Triomics가 Amazon Bedrock을 활용해 환자와 암 임상시험을 더 빠르게 매칭하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Triomics speeds up cancer clinical trial matching using Amazon Bedrock. This session covers how Triomics built its trial-matching pipeline on Bedrock, the challenges of applying AI to clinical trial workflows, and what it takes to speed up matching patients to trials in a high-stakes healthcare setting.

title: From 1,500 to 1M+ databases a week: how Supabase provisions at scale
title_ko: 주당 1,500개에서 100만 개 이상의 데이터베이스로: Supabase의 대규모 프로비저닝
summary_ko: AI 에이전트 기반 개발 확산으로 급증한 데이터베이스 생성을 Supabase가 대규모로 처리하게 된 과정을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: With Supabase, developers can use AI agents to build application backends in minutes instead of weeks. Adoption grew from 1,500 databases launched daily in early 2024 to more than one million in a single week in Q3 2026. Running entirely on AWS, Supabase uses Amazon S3 and Amazon EC2 instances with AWS Graviton processors alongside Amazon EKS and Amazon CloudWatch to support that growth. This session shows how startups can use Supabase to launch AI applications quickly and examines the infrastructure behind its database provisioning at scale. Builders of developer tools and AI applications will explore how simpler backend setup reduces the time needed to test ideas.

title: Training Agility’s Digit robot for manufacturing with Amazon SageMaker
title_ko: Amazon SageMaker로 Agility의 Digit 로봇을 제조용으로 학습시키기
summary_ko: Agility Robotics가 Amazon SageMaker로 휴머노이드 로봇 Digit을 제조 작업에 맞게 학습시키는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Agility Robotics' humanoid robot Digit is being trained for manufacturing work using Amazon SageMaker. This session walks through the training pipeline that gets Digit from simulation to real-world manufacturing tasks, covering the data, simulation, and SageMaker-based training workflow that makes it possible. You'll leave with a view into what it actually takes to get a humanoid robot production-ready for manufacturing environments.

title: From AI to enterprise impact: Deploy decision agents on AWS in one day
title_ko: AI에서 기업 성과로: 하루 만에 AWS에 의사결정 에이전트 배포하기
summary_ko: 기업이 단 하루 만에 AWS에 의사결정 AI 에이전트를 배포해 실제 비즈니스 성과로 연결하는 방법을 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: What if your enterprise could go from AI ambition to AI-powered decisions in just one day? This session examines how Aily Labs orchestrates agents across business functions and supports deployment in regulated enterprises.

title: 171 agents at scale: How Halter automated internal ops and engineering
title_ko: 171개 에이전트의 대규모 운영: Halter가 내부 운영과 엔지니어링을 자동화한 방법
summary_ko: Halter가 내부 운영과 엔지니어링 전반에 171개의 AI 에이전트를 배포해 업무를 자동화한 경험을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Halter built and deployed 171 AI agents across its internal operations and engineering functions, saving 215 engineering hours. This session covers how Halter identified which workflows to automate, how they built and scaled that many agents, and what it takes to get an organization comfortable running that much of its internal work through AI agents.

title: For startups: Bringing vibe-coded apps to AWS
title_ko: 스타트업을 위한 바이브 코딩 앱의 AWS 이전
summary_ko: 바이브 코딩으로 만든 프로토타입을 마이그레이션 계획부터 배포까지 진행해 AWS에서 실제 앱으로 운영하는 실습입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: You vibe-coded an app over the weekend. Now you want to move it to production on AWS with auth, a database, and an architecture that scales. In this hands-on session, walk your prototype from code to live app on AWS. You'll generate a migration plan, provision infrastructure with the Agent Toolkit, and deploy with AWS Blocks. Bring your own startup scenarios, and we'll work through them together with the people who built the tools.

title: Run agent evals and tuning on AgentCore without a QA team
title_ko: QA 팀 없이 AgentCore로 에이전트 평가와 튜닝 실행하기
summary_ko: 전담 QA 팀이 없는 스타트업이 AgentCore로 에이전트 평가와 튜닝을 수행해 회귀 문제를 미리 잡는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: Startups shipping AI agents often lack a dedicated QA team to catch regressions before they reach customers. This session shows how to run agent evaluations and tuning directly on AgentCore, covering how to set up evals, catch regressions early, and iterate on agent behavior without a dedicated QA function. You'll leave with a practical approach to testing and tuning agents as a small team.

title: Designing real-time voice AI experiences
title_ko: 실시간 음성 AI 경험 설계하기
summary_ko: 실시간 음성 AI 경험을 구현하기 위한 설계 및 아키텍처 의사결정을 단계별로 살펴봅니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Studio
abstract: Voice is becoming a primary interface for AI products, but building voice experiences that feel natural is hard: latency, interruption handling, and turn-taking all have to work together. In this session, we walk through the design and architecture decisions behind real-time voice AI experiences on AWS, covering latency budgets, interruption handling, and how to keep conversations feeling natural. You'll leave with a practical framework for designing and building your own voice AI product.

title: The economics of inference: Where startups are finding efficiency
title_ko: 추론의 경제학: 스타트업이 효율을 찾는 지점
summary_ko: 추론 가격 하락에도 마진 확보가 어려운 AI 기업들이 비용 효율을 찾는 방법을 분석합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: AI companies are finding it harder to earn margins even as inference prices have dropped twentyfold. This session covers where startups are finding efficiency and margin in an environment of falling inference prices, and what RadixArk has learned about the economics of running AI workloads profitably as the underlying cost curve keeps shifting.

title: AI security without borders: A global defense strategy
title_ko: 국경 없는 AI 보안: 글로벌 방어 전략
summary_ko: 7AI, OAK, CloudSEK가 국경을 넘는 위협에 대응하기 위한 글로벌 AI 보안 방어 전략의 필요성을 논의합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: 7AI, OAK, and CloudSEK makes the case for AI security without borders, arguing for a global defense strategy against AI-driven threats. This session covers why security approaches need to transcend regional and organizational boundaries as AI threats scale globally, what a global defense strategy looks like in practice, and what these industry leaders have learned building security products meant to defend against borderless AI threats.

title: Cyber defense at the frontier: What we learned building Vega on Amazon S3
title_ko: 최전선의 사이버 방어: Amazon S3 위에 Vega를 구축하며 배운 점
summary_ko: Amazon S3에 저장된 데이터에서 직접 AI 위협 탐지를 수행하는 Vega 팀의 구축 경험과 교훈을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Vega runs AI threat detection directly on data sitting in Amazon S3. This session covers what the Vega team learned building AI-driven threat detection directly against data in S3, the architecture behind that approach, and what it means for the frontier of cyber defense as AI threat detection moves closer to where the data lives.

title: From $0 to $100M ARR: Scaling real-time voice AI on AWS
title_ko: ARR 0달러에서 1억 달러로: AWS에서 실시간 음성 AI 확장하기
summary_ko: Retell AI가 AWS에서 실시간 음성 AI 에이전트로 ARR 1억 달러를 달성하기까지의 아키텍처와 확장 과정을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Retell AI went from $0 to $100M ARR building real-time voice AI agents on AWS. This session covers the architecture and scaling decisions behind that growth, the infrastructure choices that let Retell AI handle real-time voice at scale, and what founders building voice AI products can learn from their path to $100M ARR.

title: How Dharma-AI cut LLM costs 99% with fine-tuned models on AWS
title_ko: Dharma-AI가 AWS의 파인튜닝 모델로 LLM 비용을 99% 절감한 방법
summary_ko: 범용 파운데이션 모델에서 파인튜닝 모델로 전환해 LLM 비용을 99% 줄인 Dharma-AI의 사례를 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Dharma-AI cut its LLM costs by 99% by moving from general-purpose foundation models to fine-tuned models running on AWS. This session walks through the fine-tuning and deployment approach that got them there, covering the tradeoffs between general-purpose and fine-tuned models, and what legal AI and other cost-sensitive AI applications can learn from Dharma-AI's approach to driving down inference costs.

title: Manifold Bio scales drug discovery workloads 4x across AWS regions
title_ko: Manifold Bio, AWS 리전 전반으로 신약 개발 워크로드 4배 확장
summary_ko: Manifold Bio가 여러 AWS 리전에 컴퓨팅을 분산해 신약 개발 워크로드를 4배로 확장한 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Manifold Bio scaled its drug discovery compute workloads 4x by distributing them across multiple AWS regions. This session covers the architecture behind that scale-out, the challenges of running scientific compute workloads across regions, and what other biotech and drug discovery startups can learn from Manifold Bio's approach to scaling compute-intensive research on AWS.

title: Voice AI on AWS silicon: Cartesia’s AWS Trainium stack
title_ko: AWS 실리콘 위의 음성 AI: Cartesia의 AWS Trainium 스택
summary_ko: Cartesia가 AWS Trainium 칩 위에서 엔드투엔드로 동작하는 저지연 음성 AI 플랫폼을 구축한 사례를 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum Event Plaza | Startup Plaza Theater
abstract: Cartesia built a voice AI platform that runs end-to-end latency on AWS Trainium silicon. This session covers how Cartesia architected their stack to hit that latency bar, the tradeoffs of building on custom silicon, and what it takes to make voice AI feel truly real-time in production.

title_ko: 명상실
summary_ko: 명상, 기도, 요가를 하거나 정신 건강 관련 자료를 찾을 수 있는 어둡고 조용한 공간을 제공합니다.

title: Building your first event-driven application
title_ko: 첫 번째 이벤트 기반 애플리케이션 구축하기
summary_ko: Amazon EventBridge 등을 활용해 각 단계가 독립적으로 실행되는 소매 주문 시스템을 직접 구축하는 빌더 세션입니다.
abstract: A customer places an order. Inventory updates. Payment processes. Notifications fire. In a monolith, one failure cascades through everything. In this builders' session, build a retail order system where each step runs independently using Amazon EventBridge, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB. Through guided exercises, you'll publish and subscribe to events, handle failures in one service without breaking others, and trace event flows across your system. No prior event-driven experience required—you'll leave with a working application and the core patterns for decomposing synchronous workflows into resilient, asynchronous systems. Bring your laptop.

title: Building interactive web applications on AWS Lambda Web Functions
title_ko: AWS Lambda Web Functions로 인터랙티브 웹 애플리케이션 구축하기
summary_ko: AWS Lambda Web Functions로 풀스택 웹 애플리케이션을 배포해 보는 빌더 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: You want to build web applications on Lambda without changing how you write code. Lambda Web Functions make that direct. In this builders' session, deploy a full-stack web application with AWS Lambda Web Functions. Working in small groups with AWS experts, run an HTTP server on Lambda, serve static assets alongside application routes, render a DynamoDB-backed product catalogue, and stream live activity with Server-Sent Events. Walk away with a working app and deployment patterns for interactive web workloads. Bring your laptop.

title: Building lightning-fast web apps
title_ko: 초고속 웹 앱 구축하기
summary_ko: 한 고객이 AWS 서버리스만으로 풀스택 웹 애플리케이션을 구축한 사례를 소개하는 라이트닝 토크입니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Lightning Theater
abstract: Modern web applications demand fast iteration, automatic scaling, and minimal operational overhead. In this lightning talk, hear how a customer built a full-stack web application entirely on AWS Serverless services, from API endpoints and business logic to data persistence and authentication. They cover architectural patterns for handling HTTP routing, server-side rendering, static assets, and real-time features without managing servers, and how serverless simplifies common web framework patterns while delivering built-in high availability and pay-per-use economics. Whether you're migrating an existing web app or starting from scratch, you'll leave with practical takeaways for production-ready serverless web development.

title: Modernizing your compute stack with Lambda's new execution models
title_ko: Lambda의 새로운 실행 모델로 컴퓨팅 스택 현대화하기
summary_ko: 워크로드별로 어떤 Lambda 실행 모델을 표준으로 삼을지 결정하는 운영상의 의사결정 트리를 논의합니다.
abstract: You're running workloads across Lambda, EC2, and containers because no single service handled orchestration, always-on compute, and isolated execution. Lambda's new execution models change that: durable functions add checkpointed orchestration, Managed Instances provide always-on compute at EC2 economics, and MicroVMs offer hardware-level sandboxes with persistent state. In this breakout, we discuss the operational decision tree: which execution model to standardize on for each workload class, how to manage mixed-model deployments, monitoring differences across models, and when to migrate workloads between them. Bring your workload portfolio. We'll help you build an operational playbook for multi-model Lambda.

title: How AI-native startups run untrusted agent code on Lambda MicroVMs

In this session, see how [Customer] built production agent sandboxes on Lambda MicroVMs, walking through the full lifecycle that delivers hardware-level isolation per session. See how they scale to thousands of concurrent sandboxes and the operational tradeoffs they navigated to get there.

abstract: Build production-ready AI agent architectures using AWS serverless services. In this builders' session, design and deploy an agentic system that uses AWS Lambda for agent hosting, tool execution, Amazon Bedrock for reasoning, and Amazon EventBridge and AWS Step Functions for inter-agent communication and orchestration. Working in small groups with AWS experts, you'll implement tool-calling patterns, configure agent memory, and wire up event-driven and workflow-based coordination between specialized agents. Walk away with a working multi-agent architecture you can extend for your own use cases. You must bring your laptop to participate.

abstract: AI coding assistants generate code. Customers upload plugins. Third parties submit extensions. All of it needs to run somewhere and that somewhere can't be your production environment. In this builders' session, use AWS Lambda MicroVMs to build secure sandboxes that execute untrusted code at scale with hardware-level tenant isolation. You'll configure sandbox lifecycle management, implement resource limits and permissions boundaries, and test failure modes when code misbehaves. Walk away with a working isolation architecture you can adapt for your own multi-tenant workloads. Bring your laptop.

title_ko: 서버리스 분산 데이터 처리 워크로드 구축하기

abstract: Processing large-scale data shouldn't require provisioning clusters or managing batch infrastructure. In this builders' session, design and deploy a distributed data processing pipeline using AWS Step Functions Distributed Map, AWS Lambda, and Amazon S3. Working in small groups, you'll implement fan-out patterns that process thousands of objects in parallel, handle partial failures gracefully, and optimize for cost and throughput. Learn when Distributed Map is the right choice versus other parallelization strategies, and walk away with a reusable pipeline template. Bring your laptop.

title: Production-ready Lambda: Security and performance patterns
title_ko: 프로덕션 수준의 Lambda: 보안 및 성능 패턴
summary_ko: 동작하는 Lambda 함수에 프로덕션 운영에 필요한 보안과 성능 계층을 단계적으로 추가해 보는 빌더 세션입니다.
abstract: A Lambda function that handles traffic well in prototype isn't necessarily production-ready—there's a gap between "works" and "hardened." In this builders' session, take a working Lambda function and add the security and performance layers that production demands. You'll implement least-privilege IAM policies, add request validation and secrets management, reduce cold start duration with SnapStart and right-sized memory, and configure reserved concurrency for predictable performance under load. Each change includes the trade-off: what you gain, what it costs, and when to skip it. Bring your laptop.

title: Reducing Lambda cost with Graviton and managed instances
title_ko: Graviton과 관리형 인스턴스로 Lambda 비용 절감하기
summary_ko: 기준 워크로드를 ARM64(Graviton)로 전환하고 관리형 인스턴스를 적용해 Lambda 비용을 줄이는 방법을 실습합니다.
abstract: Lambda's default x86 pricing works fine until your steady-state workloads make the per-invocation model expensive at scale. In this builders' session, start with a baseline workload and apply two cost levers: migrate to ARM64 (Graviton) for better price-performance, then deploy on Lambda Managed Instances for EC2 economics with multi-concurrency on steady-state traffic. You'll measure before-and-after cost and performance data at each step, evaluate when each approach makes sense versus default Lambda pricing, and leave with a repeatable migration playbook. Bring your laptop.

title: Integrating AI agents with event-driven architectures
title_ko: AI 에이전트를 이벤트 기반 아키텍처와 통합하기
summary_ko: 이벤트 기반 패턴이 AI 에이전트 간 조정 문제를 해결하는 이유와 그 설계 방법을 칠톡으로 논의합니다.
abstract: Most multi-agent systems start with direct API calls between agents—then debugging becomes impossible, one slow agent blocks the chain, and replaying a failed workflow means re-running everything. In this chalk talk, discuss why event-driven patterns solve these coordination problems and how to design multi-agent systems using EventBridge for routing, human-in-the-loop controls that pause and resume agent actions via events, and compute selection—such as Lambda, Fargate, or AgentCore—based on your agent's execution profile. Bring architecture questions; we'll whiteboard patterns for decoupling agents across domains without sacrificing observability.

abstract: Runtime deprecations pile up. Legacy code sits untouched because manual upgrades across hundreds of functions take weeks your team doesn't have. In this builders' session, use AWS Transform Custom to assess, plan, and execute Lambda runtime upgrades at scale. Working hands-on, you'll run the full agentic loop: codebase assessment, transformation planning, incremental code changes committed to Git, and self-validating test execution. You'll scale transformations across hundreds of functions in parallel using AWS Batch and Fargate. Walk away with patterns for automated, large-scale modernization. Bring your laptop.

title: Same code, any compute: Portable architecture on AWS
title_ko: 같은 코드, 어떤 컴퓨팅이든: AWS의 이식 가능한 아키텍처
summary_ko: 헥사고날 아키텍처와 12-factor 패턴으로 컴퓨팅 환경을 바꿔도 코드를 그대로 쓰는 워크로드 설계 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 2
abstract: Your business logic shouldn't be coupled to a compute service. In this session, apply Hexagonal Architecture and 12-factor patterns to design workloads where compute is a deployment decision, not an architectural one. Through live code, see the same logic packaged as a Lambda function, a Fargate task, and an EKS pod using AWS Lambda Web Adapter and runtime-neutral handler patterns. You'll learn where portability pays off, where it adds unnecessary abstraction, and how to evaluate the trade-offs between pay-per-request, always-on containers, and orchestrated clusters for your workloads.

title: Serverless streaming data processing with AWS Lambda and Apache Kafka
title_ko: AWS Lambda와 Apache Kafka로 서버리스 스트리밍 데이터 처리
summary_ko: Kafka 이벤트를 받아 처리하는 실시간 위치 추적 앱을 AWS Lambda로 설계·배포하는 빌더 세션입니다.
services: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
abstract: Build a serverless streaming data pipeline in 60 minutes. In this builders' session, you design and deploy a real-time location tracking app that ingests events from Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK), processes them with AWS Lambda, and pushes live updates to a dashboard through AWS AppSync—no consumer fleet to manage, no scaling logic to write. Experiment with Lambda event source mapping for Kafka, applying recent improvements in filtering, batching, and error handling. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: Build self-healing Serverless applications with AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 자가 치유 서버리스 애플리케이션 구축하기
summary_ko: 배포된 서버리스 애플리케이션의 문제를 AWS DevOps Agent로 진단하고 해결하는 과정을 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: Production incidents at 2 a.m. don't wait for your team to wake up. In this builders' session, work with a deployed serverless application and use AWS DevOps Agent to resolve real-world failures autonomously. You'll inject common production issues—such as Lambda throttling, timeout cascades, DynamoDB throughput exceeded, and SQS dead-letter queue buildup—then configure the agent to perform root cause analysis, propose remediation, and apply fixes. You'll tune detection sensitivity, set approval gates for automated actions, and evaluate where autonomous remediation is safe versus where human oversight is required. Bring your laptop.

title: Orchestrating agentic workflows: Step Functions & durable functions

summary_ko: 에이전틱 워크로드에 AWS Step Functions와 Lambda durable functions 중 무엇이 적합한지 비교하는 칠톡입니다.
abstract: AI agents need orchestration that handles long-running tasks, human approvals, and recovery from partial failures. In this chalk talk, compare AWS Step Functions and Lambda durable functions for agentic workloads, and learn when to choose code-first, replay-based recovery versus visual state-machine semantics. We’ll whiteboard how durable functions checkpoint progress and resume after failures, how Step Functions handle branching and parallel tool calls, and where Lambda MicroVMs fit for sandboxing agent-generated code execution. Bring your architecture questions—we’ll design hybrid patterns that combine both orchestrators based on your workload shape.

title: Orchestrating agentic workflows: Step Functions & durable functions
title_ko: 에이전틱 워크플로 오케스트레이션: Step Functions와 durable functions
summary_ko: 에이전틱 워크로드에 AWS Step Functions와 Lambda durable functions 중 무엇이 적합한지 비교하는 칠톡입니다.
abstract: AI agents need orchestration that handles long-running tasks, human approvals, and recovery from partial failures. In this chalk talk, compare AWS Step Functions and Lambda durable functions for agentic workloads, and learn when to choose code-first, replay-based recovery versus visual state-machine semantics. We’ll whiteboard how durable functions checkpoint progress and resume after failures, how Step Functions handle branching and parallel tool calls, and where Lambda MicroVMs fit for sandboxing agent-generated code execution. Bring your architecture questions—we’ll design hybrid patterns that combine both orchestrators based on your workload shape.

title: Building agentic apps with serverless: Lambda as your agent's toolbox
title_ko: 서버리스로 에이전틱 앱 구축하기: 에이전트의 도구 상자가 되는 Lambda
summary_ko: 명확한 단일 책임 도구로서 Lambda를 설계하는 등 에이전틱 서버리스 설계 원칙을 논의하는 칠톡입니다.
abstract: Agents need tools—functions they can call to retrieve data, take actions, and interact with external systems. Lambda is well-suited for this, but designing functions as agent tools requires different thinking than traditional API backends. In this chalk talk, discuss design principles for agentic Serverless: single-responsibility tools with clear input/output schemas, MCP-compatible interfaces for universal agent consumption, and multi-tenant isolation that keeps workloads secure. We'll whiteboard the trade-offs that matter—provisioned concurrency versus on-demand cold starts, cost per invocation at agent scale, and where Serverless fits versus where you need different compute.

room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Builders' Session 1
abstract: Distributed transactions across microservices break in ways monoliths never did: partial failures, inconsistent state, rollbacks that don't roll back. In this builders' session, build a payment processing using saga pattern that orchestrates multiple serverless microservices using AWS Step Functions and Lambda durable functions. You'll implement compensation mechanisms that handle partial failures, compare orchestration approaches for short-lived versus long-running transactions, and monitor transaction flows across distributed services. Walk away with working saga patterns and the observability setup to troubleshoot them in production. Bring your laptop.

title: Thinking agentic: What developers using Serverless need to know
title_ko: 에이전틱 사고: 서버리스 개발자가 알아야 할 것
summary_ko: 스키마 우선 인터페이스를 갖춘 도구로 함수를 재정의하는 등 에이전트 시대에 서버리스 개발에서 달라지는 점을 다룹니다.
abstract: You've been building event-driven, async systems for years. Agents are a new type of consumer in your existing architecture. In this chalk talk, we discuss what actually changes: reframing functions as tools with schema-first interfaces, managing agent state with storage and checkpoints, and handling non-deterministic failures from LLM calls. We walk through a practical path from "I have a serverless app" to "my app has agent capabilities," adding capabilities incrementally without rewriting what already works. Bring your architecture. We'll whiteboard where agents fit in what you've already built.

title: Build interactive web apps with AWS Lambda
title_ko: AWS Lambda로 인터랙티브 웹 앱 구축하기
summary_ko: Express, Hono, Next.js 같은 웹 프레임워크를 Lambda에서 직접 실행하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Web applications need persistent connections, session state, and native HTTP handling - capabilities that don't map obviously to Lambda's request-response model. In this session, see how to run web frameworks like Express, Hono, and Next.js directly on Lambda using runtime adapters that preserve the framework's native patterns. If you're running containerized web apps today, we walk through practical migration paths that move your existing framework code to Lambda with minimal changes.

title: Guardrails for AI-generated Serverless infrastructure
title_ko: AI가 생성한 서버리스 인프라를 위한 가드레일
summary_ko: AI가 생성한 인프라에 대한 자동 보안 검토 등 운영 통제 방안을 칠톡으로 논의합니다.
abstract: Coding agents generate full serverless architectures in seconds, but without guardrails they produce over-permissioned IAM policies, skip encryption at rest, and deploy resources that violate your organization's tagging and cost policies. In this chalk talk, discuss operational controls for AI-generated infrastructure: automated security reviews that catch policy violations before deployment, cost estimation gates that flag unexpected spend, compliance checks against organizational standards, and MCP server configurations that enforce service boundaries and naming conventions. We whiteboard which guardrails to automate versus which require human review, and where teams are getting the balance wrong.

title: Serverless application testing in the age of agents
title_ko: 에이전트 시대의 서버리스 애플리케이션 테스트
summary_ko: 서버리스 및 이벤트 기반 애플리케이션에 가장 중요한 테스트 패턴을 화이트보드로 정리하는 칠톡입니다.
abstract: Serverless and agentic tools let you ship fast. A strong testing foundation is what makes that speed sustainable - for you and your agents. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard the testing patterns that matter most for serverless and event-driven applications: structuring code for testability, validating service interactions in the cloud, and building harnesses for asynchronous workflows. Join to explore local versus cloud testing tradeoffs and what new test dimensions agents enable for serverless developers. Walk away knowing how to give your agents the feedback loops they need to move quickly, iterate autonomously, and stay on the rails.

title: Operating Lambda at scale: Choosing the right execution model
title_ko: 대규모 Lambda 운영: 적합한 실행 모델 선택하기
summary_ko: 워크로드별로 표준화할 Lambda 실행 모델을 고르는 운영 의사결정 트리를 화이트보드로 정리하는 칠톡입니다.
abstract: You're running workloads across Lambda, EC2, and containers because no single service handled orchestration, always-on compute, and isolated execution. Lambda's new execution models change that: durable functions add checkpointed orchestration, Managed Instances provide always-on compute at EC2 economics, and MicroVMs offer hardware-level sandboxes with persistent state. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard the operational decision tree: which execution model to standardize on for each workload class, how to manage mixed-model deployments, monitoring differences across models, and when to migrate workloads between them. Bring your workload portfolio. We'll help you build an operational playbook for multi-model Lambda.

title: Serverless Java in 2026
title_ko: 2026년의 서버리스 Java
summary_ko: 콜드 스타트를 넘어 Java 모놀리스를 서버리스로 옮기기 위한 리팩터링 패턴 등을 논의하는 칠톡입니다.
abstract: Java on Lambda used to mean cold start anxiety and compromised JIT performance. Not anymore. SnapStart and GraalVM native AOT deliver sub-second startup, and Lambda Managed Instances give steady-state JVM workloads full JIT optimization at EC2 economics. In this chalk talk, we go beyond cold starts: discuss refactoring patterns for moving Java monoliths to serverless, framework choices that work well on Lambda (and ones that don't), and how AI-assisted tools identify decomposition boundaries and generate Lambda handlers from existing service classes. Bring your Java architecture.

title: Lambda Managed Instances: Always-on Serverless Compute
title_ko: Lambda Managed Instances: 상시 가동 서버리스 컴퓨팅
summary_ko: Managed Instances가 표준 Lambda 요금보다 유리한 경우와 도입 시 고려 사항을 정리하는 칠톡입니다.
abstract: Some Lambda workloads run constantly. For steady-state, high-throughput functions, per-invocation pricing becomes more expensive than running the same code on EC2, but you don't want to manage instances. Lambda Managed Instances give you EC2 economics with multi-concurrency while Lambda handles instance lifecycle, patching, and scaling. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard the decision: when Managed Instances beat standard Lambda pricing, what workloads migrate cleanly versus what needs adaptation, and how to model your break-even point. Bring your Lambda bill. We'll help you find where Managed Instances save money and where they don't.

title: Lambda MicroVMs: Secure stateful sandboxes for code execution
title_ko: Lambda MicroVMs: 코드 실행을 위한 안전한 상태 유지 샌드박스
summary_ko: 파일 시스템 상태를 유지하는 VM 수준의 격리 샌드박스인 Lambda MicroVMs의 특징과 활용법을 설명합니다.
abstract: AI agents generate code, customers upload plugins, and third-party extensions need execution environments. All of it requires strong isolation. In this chalk talk, we discuss Lambda MicroVMs: VM-level, isolated sandboxes with filesystem state that persists across invocations. We cover the security model (how isolation boundaries prevent lateral movement), stateful session management for multi-turn agent interactions, lifecycle controls that limit resource consumption, and integration patterns with Step Functions and EventBridge for orchestrating sandboxed workloads. Bring your multi-tenant architecture questions. We'll whiteboard where MicroVMs fit versus standard Lambda.

title: Serverless observability: OpenTelemetry and vended logs
title_ko: 서버리스 관측성: OpenTelemetry와 vended logs
summary_ko: OpenTelemetry 설정과 API Gateway vended logs를 활용한 엔드투엔드 추적 등 서버리스 관측성을 다룹니다.
abstract: Debugging distributed serverless applications used to mean stitching together X-Ray traces, CloudWatch logs, and custom metrics from multiple extensions. In this chalk talk, we cover setup and configuration, end-to-end tracing with API Gateway vended logs, and distributed tracing across Step Functions, EventBridge, and SQS. We also discuss observability for agentic workloads: tracking token consumption, tool call success rates, and workflow checkpoint state. Bring your observability questions, especially around cost at scale: sampling, filtering, and cardinality management.

title: Operating Serverless at scale: What changes at 1000+ functions
title_ko: 대규모 서버리스 운영: 함수가 1,000개를 넘으면 달라지는 것
summary_ko: 수많은 함수에 코드를 안전하게 배포하는 전략 등 서버리스가 대규모로 커질 때 달라지는 운영 방식을 논의합니다.
abstract: What works at 10 Lambda functions may not work at 1,000. Deployments that took seconds now take hours. A single misconfigured function triggers account-level throttling. Observability drowns in noise. In this chalk talk, we discuss what changes at scale: deployment strategies that roll out code safely across hundreds of functions, account structure and concurrency management to prevent blast radius problems, observability approaches that surface signal without drowning in cardinality, and platform engineering patterns that let application teams ship independently. We share what large-scale Serverless operators do differently and where the common pitfalls are.
