title: Building production AI agents on AWS: compute, security, state, and cost
title_ko: AWS에서 프로덕션 AI 에이전트 구축: 컴퓨팅, 보안, 상태, 비용
summary_ko: IAM, AgentCore Identity, 게이트웨이, 시크릿 관리로 에이전트를 보호하는 등 프로덕션 에이전트 구축의 핵심 요소를 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Orange Theater
abstract: Agents are moving from demos to production, and the compute you pick shapes security, state, and cost downstream. This session follows a real agent running on AWS and the decisions behind it. Explore serverless compute choices for agents: Lambda durable functions for orchestration and long-running workflows, and Lambda MicroVMs for running untrusted agent-generated code in isolation. Learn how to secure agents with IAM, AgentCore Identity, gateways, and secrets management, making agents stateful with RAG knowledge bases and AgentCore Memory. Control cost through token visibility, caching, pause-snapshot-resume, and right-sizing. Bring your agent architecture and the tradeoffs you're weighing.

title: AWS Lambda MicroVMs: Strong isolation for agents & beyond
title_ko: AWS Lambda MicroVMs: 에이전트와 그 이상을 위한 강력한 격리
summary_ko: 생성된 코드 실행, 멀티테넌트 플랫폼 등 강력한 격리가 필요한 워크로드에 Lambda MicroVMs를 활용하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Blue Theater
abstract: Agents running generated code, multi-tenant platforms, and untrusted workloads all need strong isolation, but each traditional compute option forces a tradeoff. VMs isolate well but start slowly. Containers are fast but share a kernel. Functions scale to zero but limit state. Teams close the gaps with isolation logic they build and maintain themselves. Lambda MicroVMs offer sandboxes with VM-level isolation for each agent, tenant, or task: state that persists across invocations, automatic suspend on idle, resume on demand. This session covers how MicroVMs work, the security and isolation model, lifecycle management, and patterns for agentic sandboxing and untrusted code execution.

title: Serverless developers in the agentic era: What changes, what doesn't
title_ko: 에이전틱 시대의 서버리스 개발자: 달라지는 것과 그대로인 것
summary_ko: 기존 서버리스 패턴 중 그대로 유효한 것과 에이전트 시대에 실제로 달라지는 것을 구분해 설명합니다.
room: Wynn/Encore | Upper Convention Promenade | Cristal 2 | Content Hub | Purple Theater
abstract: Serverless architectures that worked well for API backends and event processing now have a new type of consumer: AI agents that call your functions as tools, generate events, and write code that deploys alongside yours. In this session we cover where existing serverless patterns hold up without modification, what actually changes, and how to start with what you have and add only what you need. See how the calls you already run can become tools that describe themselves to the agent that uses them. Learn how coding agents and skills make best practices part of every build, and where doing less with AI pays off.

title: What's new with Amazon API Gateway
title_ko: Amazon API Gateway의 새로운 기능
summary_ko: Amazon API Gateway의 최근 출시 기능과 직접 서비스 통합 등 새로운 기능을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Orange Theater
abstract: Your next API consumer might not be a person. AI agents, MCP servers, and coding assistants are calling APIs programmatically, and they need machine-readable schemas, predictable error contracts, and discoverable endpoints. In this session, we cover what's new with Amazon API Gateway: recent launches, direct service integrations that eliminate Lambda glue code, declarative event wiring, and patterns from real customer deployments. We also discuss how to design APIs that serve both human developers and autonomous agents without maintaining separate interfaces.

title: Lambda performance tuning and cost optimization
title_ko: Lambda 성능 튜닝과 비용 최적화
summary_ko: SnapStart와 프로비저닝된 동시성을 이용한 콜드 스타트 제거 등 메모리 튜닝을 넘어서는 최적화 방법을 다룹니다.
abstract: Most Lambda functions run at default memory settings, which means you're paying more for slower execution. Right-sizing memory often reduces cost and latency at the same time. In this chalk talk, we go beyond memory tuning: cold start elimination with SnapStart and provisioned concurrency, architecture-level savings like batching and right-sizing event source mappings, and when Lambda Managed Instances deliver better economics than per-invocation pricing. We whiteboard the decision points using real cost data and discuss which CloudWatch and Cost Explorer metrics actually drive optimization decisions.

title: Coding the tool layer for AI agents on Serverless
title_ko: 서버리스 기반 AI 에이전트를 위한 도구 계층 코딩
summary_ko: 기존 서버리스 API를 프로덕션 수준의 에이전트 도구로 바꾸는 과정을 라이브 코딩으로 보여 주는 코드 토크입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Agents don't need new infrastructure - they need access to what you've already built. In this code talk, you'll retrofit a Serverless API into a production-ready agent tool, live in code. Implement an MCP server with versioned tools, wire it to AgentCore Gateway for discovery and invocation, then expose an entire Step Functions workflow, human-in-the-loop gates and all, as a single callable tool. Add scoped agent identity, watch an unauthorized call get blocked, then an authorized one go through. Walk away with a repeatable playbook for turning existing APIs into agent-ready tools.

title: A day in the life of a Serverless builder
title_ko: 서버리스 빌더의 하루
summary_ko: 서버리스 애플리케이션을 첫 코드 작성부터 프로덕션 배포까지 따라가 보는 코드 토크입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: In this code talk, follow a Serverless application from first line of code to production deployment, all live. Start with an AI coding agent generating infrastructure and function scaffolding, iterate locally with hot reload, deploy in one command, then debug a failing request by tracing it across Lambda, EventBridge, and DynamoDB using native OpenTelemetry. Along the way, see how recent Serverless launches change the workflow: faster deploys, built-in observability, and simplified local testing. No slides, no diagrams. Just a terminal, an editor, and the workflow a Serverless developer uses in 2026.

title: Modernizing .NET to Serverless: Native AOT and SnapStart, live
title_ko: .NET을 서버리스로 현대화: Native AOT와 SnapStart 라이브
summary_ko: NET 함수를 AOT로 라이브 전환하며 직렬화 등에서 발생하는 실패를 현장에서 해결해 보는 코드 토크입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: .NET workloads on Lambda have historically meant slower cold starts and JIT warmup time that doesn't match Serverless execution patterns. Native AOT and SnapStart on .NET 10 close that gap, bringing cold starts under 200ms, but modernization isn't flip-a-switch. In this code talk, modernize a .NET function to AOT live, watch it fail, then fix it on stage: serialization with source generators, reflection-based DI replaced, trimming warnings resolved. See real measurements across AOT, SnapStart, and the managed runtime. Walk away with a library compatibility matrix and modernization patterns for your own .NET Serverless journey.

title: Building and scaling low latency web applications with AWS Lambda Web Functions
title_ko: AWS Lambda Web Functions로 저지연 웹 애플리케이션 구축 및 확장
summary_ko: AWS Lambda Web Functions로 풀스택 애플리케이션을 라이브로 구축하고 확장하는 과정을 보여 주는 코드 토크입니다.
room: Caesars Forum | Level 1 | Forum 120 | Content Hub | Code Talk
abstract: Modern web applications demand fast iteration, automatic scaling, and minimal operational overhead. In this code talk, join us to build a full-stack application live with AWS Lambda Web Functions. See how each execution environment handles concurrent HTTP requests, serving server-sent event streams alongside API traffic while scaling on demand. Using Express and React without Lambda-specific adapters, add routing, static assets, runtime configuration, business logic, and DynamoDB persistence. Then go global with multi-Region latency routing, observability, canary deployments, and fast rollback. Leave with practical patterns for building and scaling low-latency web applications on AWS Lambda.

title: Serverless compute built for the web
title_ko: 웹을 위해 만들어진 서버리스 컴퓨팅
summary_ko: API부터 프런트엔드까지 AWS 서버리스 서비스만으로 풀스택 웹 애플리케이션을 구축하는 방법을 소개합니다.
abstract: Modern web applications demand fast iteration, automatic scaling, and minimal operational overhead. In this session, see how to build full-stack web applications entirely on AWS serverless services, from API endpoints and business logic to data persistence and authentication. We cover architectural patterns for handling HTTP routing, server-side rendering, static assets, and real-time features without managing servers, and how serverless simplifies common web framework patterns while delivering built-in high availability and pay-per-use economics. Whether you're migrating an existing web app or starting from scratch, you'll leave with practical blueprints for production-ready serverless web development.

title: Managing Lambda Runtimes at Scale for Platform Teams
title_ko: 플랫폼 팀을 위한 대규모 Lambda 런타임 관리
summary_ko: 플랫폼 팀이 Lambda 런타임 계층을 체계적으로 통제하고 관리하는 전략을 화이트보드로 논의하는 칠톡입니다.
abstract: Lambda's managed runtimes work until your platform team needs a pinned language version, a pre-loaded monitoring agent, or an SDK that every function must use. Today that means managing custom layers, coordinating updates across teams, and hoping nobody is running a version you deprecated last quarter. In this chalk talk, we whiteboard strategies for taking control of your Lambda runtime layer. Bring your runtime requirements and the constraints you're working around today.

title: Lambda Web Functions: From Event Handlers to Standard HTTP on Lambda
title_ko: Lambda Web Functions: 이벤트 핸들러에서 Lambda 기반 표준 HTTP로
summary_ko: Express, Hono, Fastify 앱을 이벤트 래퍼 없이 표준 HTTP 방식으로 Lambda에서 실행하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade Level | Roman I
abstract: If you're running Express, Hono, or Fastify on Lambda today, you're wrapping your HTTP server in an event-handler adapter. Lambda Web Functions drops that requirement. Your code listens on a port, same as localhost. Multi-concurrency keeps sandboxes warm across requests, delivering consistent response times. Active-duration billing charges for CPU consumed, not time spent waiting on a database response. Opt-in multi-region replication puts your app closer to users: pick your regions, code distribution handles the rest. This session covers the execution model, billing mechanics at real workloads, multi-region setup, and a live deployment from zero to global endpoint.

title: Lambda Managed Instances: EC2 Power with Serverless Simplicity
title_ko: Lambda Managed Instances: 서버리스의 단순함과 EC2의 성능
summary_ko: 원하는 EC2 컴퓨팅에서 Lambda 함수를 실행할 수 있는 Lambda Managed Instances의 기능과 활용법을 설명합니다.
abstract: AWS Lambda Managed Instances enables you to run Lambda functions on your choice of EC2 compute. With Lambda Managed Instances, you can optimize the performance and cost efficiency of your functions by utilizing specialized EC2 instance types and EC2 pricing benefits, while maintaining the familiar Serverless programming model and benefits like automatic patching, scaling, and 200+ AWS services integration for event-driven workloads. This session will provide an in-depth overview of how to get started with Lambda Managed Instances, recent launches like 90-minute function timeout, enhanced observability, and a behind-the-scenes look at how Lambda manages and scales your instances to ensure a seamless serverless experience.

title: Orchestrating agentic applications with Lambda durable functions
title_ko: Lambda durable functions로 에이전틱 애플리케이션 오케스트레이션
summary_ko: AWS Lambda durable functions와 MCP 도구로 에이전틱 오케스트레이션을 구축해 보는 워크숍입니다.
abstract: AI agents are powerful, but production workloads need more than an LLM and a prompt. They require deterministic routing, audit trails, compensation logic, and human oversight. In this workshop, build agentic orchestration using AWS Lambda durable functions and MCP tools. Learn to design workflows that checkpoint progress, recover from failures automatically, and pause for human-in-the-loop approval—all without managing additional infrastructure. You'll implement tool-calling patterns, handle multi-step reasoning with retries, and deploy agents that are observable, testable, and production-ready. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: Building stateful AI workflows with Serverless orchestration
title_ko: 서버리스 오케스트레이션으로 상태 유지 AI 워크플로 구축하기
summary_ko: 진행 상황을 체크포인트로 저장하고 장애에서 복구하는 상태 유지 AI 워크플로를 서버리스로 구축하는 빌더 세션입니다.
abstract: AI workflows need state such as conversation history, intermediate results, and human approvals, but managing it shouldn't require a database and custom recovery logic. In this builders' session, build a stateful AI workflow that checkpoints progress, recovers from failures automatically, and pauses for external callbacks. Working hands-on with AWS experts, you'll implement multi-step reasoning chains with retry semantics, compare orchestration approaches for different workflow shapes, and deploy a working agent pipeline. Bring your laptop.

abstract: AWS Technical Essentials gives you the foundation to start building on AWS with confidence. In this bootcamp, navigate the AWS Management Console, configure IAM security controls, deploy compute workloads across EC2, Lambda, and containers, set up databases with RDS and DynamoDB, manage storage with S3, explore networking services, and monitor resources with CloudWatch. Hands-on labs reinforce each topic, so you leave ready to design available, scalable, and cost-effective solutions.

title: Become an AWS AI Business Strategist
title_ko: AWS AI 비즈니스 전략가 되기
summary_ko: Discover, Design, Deliver 프레임워크로 비즈니스 문제를 진단하고 AI 도입 기회를 평가하는 방법을 배우는 부트캠프입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom I
abstract: Turning an AI idea into enterprise reality requires more than technical knowledge. In this bootcamp, you apply the Discover, Design, Deliver framework to diagnose business problems, assess organizational readiness, and scope AI pilots with clear success criteria. You navigate responsible AI tradeoffs, lead change management across cross-functional teams, evaluate agentic AI architectures for autonomy versus control, and build phased scaling strategies from proof of concept through production deployment.

title: The Amplification Effect: How AI Sharpens the Builder
title_ko: 증폭 효과: AI가 빌더를 더 날카롭게 만드는 방법
summary_ko: AI와 협업하며 방향을 다듬는 과정이 오히려 빌더에게 필요한 인간 고유의 역량을 키워 준다는 점을 다룹니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Replacement anxiety dominates the AI conversation, but builders who use AI as a daily collaborator are discovering the opposite: AI amplifies human capability. This breakout session presents a practical framework for using AI tooling as a skills accelerator. We'll show how builders who integrate AI into daily workflows develop stronger critical thinking, faster adaptability, and deeper domain reasoning. Drawing from real-world examples, you'll learn how the act of collaborating with AI and refining its direction builds the exact human capabilities organizations need most. Walk away with a progression model from proficiency to mastery and techniques to start sharpening your skills immediately.

title: How T&C Empowers Partners to Build AI-Ready Teams and Drive Customer Impact?
title_ko: AWS T&C는 어떻게 파트너의 AI 대응 팀 구축과 고객 성과 창출을 돕는가?
summary_ko: AWS Training and Certification이 파트너의 인력을 AI 역량을 갖춘 팀으로 전환하도록 지원하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: Join this session to discover how AWS Training and Certification empowers partners to transform their workforce through strategic AI skills development. A partner shares their firsthand journey of designing AI learning pathways, implementing gamification that drove engagement at scale, and building sustainable certification programs tied to measurable business outcomes. You'll see how T&C enables this transformation, from foundational cloud fluency through advanced GenAI and Agentic AI readiness and leave with a concrete action plan to accelerate AI readiness across your teams.

title: AWS Certification & Proficiency Path: How to be Proficient in the Age of AI Agents?
title_ko: AWS 자격증 및 숙련도 경로: AI 에이전트 시대에 숙련도를 갖추는 방법
summary_ko: AI로 숙련도의 의미가 바뀌는 시대에 자격증과 학습 경로를 통해 역량을 유지하고 증명하는 방법을 다룹니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Builder Theater
abstract: Skills decay at unprecedented speed as AI reshapes what proficiency means. Certifications still validate expertise, but practitioners now need to demonstrate they can design, build, and optimize AI-powered systems alongside traditional cloud architecture. This lightning talk explains how AWS Training and Certification developed exam content, hands-on labs, and simulation-based assessments for agentic AI domains. You will also see how our team validated new competency frameworks, mapped learning paths to job roles, and built assessment experiences that measure real-world readiness rather than knowledge recall alone.

title: Lab Maker: From Prompt to Personalized Lab in Minutes
title_ko: Lab Maker: 프롬프트로 몇 분 만에 맞춤형 실습 랩 만들기
summary_ko: AWS Skill Builder의 Lab Maker로 자연어 프롬프트에서 개인화된 실습 랩을 생성하는 방법을 소개합니다.
room: Venetian | Level 2 | Hall B | Expo | Industry Theater
abstract: Lab Maker on AWS Skill Builder generates personalized hands-on labs from natural language prompts, allowing you to learn and experiment in the Console without incurring costs or risking production environments. During this session, we will generate a custom lab in real time before saving and sharing it with a team, demonstrating the full creation-to-collaboration workflow. We will then push Lab Maker further by generating a lab for a recently launched AWS service and uploading real organizational constraints to show how the tool adapts to your specific environment. You will leave this session with the knowledge and confidence to create your own labs.

title: Spec-Driven AI Development with Kiro
title_ko: Kiro를 활용한 스펙 기반 AI 개발
summary_ko: Kiro에서 AI-DLC와 기능 명세를 적용해 프로덕션 애플리케이션을 구축하는 부트캠프입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom I
abstract: The AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) brings structure, traceability, and human oversight to every phase of high-velocity, Agentic-AI powered software delivery. In this bootcamp, apply AI-DLC in Kiro to build a production application through Feature Specs, control agent behavior with steering files and execution modes, extend capabilities with MCP servers and Kiro Powers, and automate workflows with hooks. Leave with a governed, repeatable process for shipping quality software with AI assistance.

title: Automate Penetration Tests with AWS Security Agent
title_ko: AWS Security Agent로 침투 테스트 자동화하기
summary_ko: AWS Security Agent로 자동화된 침투 테스트를 구성하고 실행해 보는 실습 랩입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Palace Ballroom II
abstract: Security testing shouldn't require weeks of manual effort anymore. In this hands-on lab, configure and execute automated penetration tests using AWS Security Agent. Set up an Agent Space with VPC networking, verify target domains, scope tests by risk type, and monitor execution in real time. Analyze findings with CVSS scores and reproduction steps, then generate actionable reports for your development teams.

title: AI Powered Business Intelligence with Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick을 활용한 AI 기반 비즈니스 인텔리전스
summary_ko: Quick Sight로 대시보드와 시각화를 만들고 팀 지식을 정리하는 등 Amazon Quick 기반 BI를 익히는 부트캠프입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom III
abstract: Amazon Quick brings AI-powered analytics, automation, and research into a single workspace. In this bootcamp, build interactive dashboards and visualizations with Quick Sight, organize team knowledge resources in Spaces with appropriate permissions, create custom Chat Agents to surface insights conversationally, automate repetitive workflows with Quick Flows, and conduct multi-source research with proper validation. The three hands-on labs give you practical experience to apply these skills immediately in your organization

title: AWS Partner: Govern AI agents by hacking one first
title_ko: AWS 파트너: 먼저 해킹해 보며 AI 에이전트 거버넌스 익히기
summary_ko: AWS 파트너 전용 부트캠프로, 실제 AI 에이전트에 프롬프트 인젝션 공격을 수행해 보고 거버넌스 방안을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Emperors Ballroom I
abstract: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. Exploit a live AI agent with a prompt injection attack that approves a fraudulent transaction, then defend it. Fix it with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to block prompt attacks and PII leaks. Verify it: prove your controls are in place with AWS Config conformance packs and find ungoverned AI resources with Resource Explorer. Observe it: trace agent decisions and guardrail interventions in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Leave ready to assess a customer's AI agents for governance gaps, protect them, and prove the controls work. You must bring your laptop to participate.

room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Emperors Ballroom I
abstract: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. Walk through a hands-on business scenario using Amazon Quick, the agentic AI workspace that connects to your tools and learns your workflows. Create knowledge spaces, run deep-research agents, connect external APIs, automate multi-step processes with Flows, and build a custom AI agent in a browser. Leave able to help customers put agentic AI to work across their teams and business applications. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: AWS Partner: Build the AgentCore agent your demo pretends to be
title_ko: AWS 파트너: 데모 수준을 넘어 실제로 동작하는 AgentCore 에이전트 구축
summary_ko: AWS 파트너 전용 부트캠프로, 챗봇 데모를 넘어 AgentCore로 프로덕션 수준의 에이전트를 구축하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Emperors Ballroom I
abstract: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. A good prompt gets you a chatbot. Everything else on AgentCore turns it into an agent. Build a customer support agent from scratch and progressively add persistent memory so it stops forgetting, tools through Gateway to reach real data, and Cedar policies that enforce boundaries, plus production traces, quality evaluations, and AI-driven optimization with A/B testing. Leave with hands-on experience on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and ready to show customers what separates a chatbot from an agent worth paying for. You must bring your laptop to participate.

title: Automate Investigations to Resolve Application Failures with AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 조사를 자동화해 애플리케이션 장애 해결하기
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent가 AWS 환경 전반의 운영 문제를 자율적으로 조사하고 해결하도록 하는 실습 랩입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Palace Ballroom II
abstract: Every minute of downtime is a minute your customers notice. What if an agent could correlate your logs, metrics, and change history the moment an application fails? In this hands-on lab, use AWS DevOps Agent to autonomously investigate operational issues across your AWS environment. Trigger investigations from simulated application failures, observe the agent correlate logs, metrics, and change history in real time, and review root cause analyses with actionable mitigation plans.

title: Building an AI Travel Assistant with AgentCore Gateway
title_ko: AgentCore Gateway로 AI 여행 어시스턴트 구축하기
summary_ko: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway를 만들고 Lambda 함수를 도구로 등록해 AI 여행 어시스턴트를 구축하는 SimuLearn 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom V
abstract: Your agent handles conversations well, but to search for flights or check weather it needs access to external tools and APIs. In this SimuLearn session, you create an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and register Lambda functions as MCP-compatible tool targets. You then deploy a travel planning agent using the Strands Agents SDK that connects to the Gateway, sequentially invokes flight search and weather tools, and synthesizes results into a trip recommendation through one secure MCP endpoint.

title: From our Agents to yours: Build, Optimize and Certify
title_ko: 우리의 에이전트에서 여러분의 에이전트로: 구축, 최적화, 인증
summary_ko: AWS Well-Architected 모범 사례로 추론 에이전트를 구축한 경험과 에이전트 최적화·인증 방법을 공유합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Promenade South | Octavius 4 | Content Hub | Red Theater
abstract: AWS builds its certification exams, from foundational cloud to agentic AI, using production AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. In this session, we show how we built our reasoning agents with AWS Well-Architected practices to solve real operational challenges: climbing latency, spiraling token costs, and non-deterministic failures. You’ll leave with concrete patterns to apply on AWS, plus a clear path to validate those skills through AWS Certification

title: Organizing Enterprise Knowledge and Securing Data with Amazon Quick
title_ko: Amazon Quick으로 기업 지식 정리 및 데이터 보안
summary_ko: Amazon Quick에서 Spaces를 설계해 기업 지식을 정리하고 데이터 보안 설정을 구성하는 SimuLearn 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom V
abstract: Amazon Quick transforms how teams access insights and automate decisions. In this SimuLearn session, you design Spaces in Quick to organize enterprise knowledge, configure custom Chat Agents with specialized instructions and curated knowledge bases, and integrate Quick with enterprise systems using Actions and connectors backed by Amazon S3 or Amazon DynamoDB. You then apply row-level and column-level security controls to protect sensitive data and explore Quick Research for comprehensive multi-source analysis and reporting.

title: Go from Code to Deployed Agent with AgentCore CLI
title_ko: AgentCore CLI로 코드에서 배포된 에이전트까지
summary_ko: AgentCore CLI로 에이전트를 스캐폴딩해 한 시간 안에 관측 가능한 AI 에이전트를 배포하는 과정을 실습합니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Palace Ballroom II
abstract: Go from zero to a deployed, observable AI agent in under an hour. Use the AgentCore CLI to scaffold a Strands agent with a custom tool, test it locally against the Runtime contract, then deploy to AgentCore Runtime via CDK. Invoke the agent to demonstrate session isolation, inspect automatic CloudWatch logs and X-Ray traces, and confirm the framework-agnostic contract by replacing the agent with a plain Python function.

title: Evaluate Enterprise AI Agents with an Eval-First Approach
title_ko: 평가 우선 접근 방식으로 엔터프라이즈 AI 에이전트 평가하기
summary_ko: RAG 응답 채점용 THELMA 등 맞춤형 평가기 두 개를 직접 만들어 에이전트를 평가하는 스포트라이트 랩입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Palace Ballroom II
abstract: A successful agent demo does not guarantee production readiness because agents can behave inconsistently across question types and multi-turn sessions. In this spotlight lab, you build two custom evaluators for an agent: THELMA, which scores single-turn RAG quality across seven dimensions including hallucination detection via groundedness scoring, and Mind the Goal, which computes Goal Success Rate across entire conversations and attributes failures to root causes. You register both as native AgentCore evaluators, run batch evaluations, and use diagnostic outputs to pinpoint exactly what to optimize first.

title: Agentic Powered AWS Frontier Agents
title_ko: 에이전틱 기반 AWS 프런티어 에이전트
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent를 설정하고 로그와 지표를 통해 장애 조사를 자동화하는 방법을 배우는 부트캠프입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom III
abstract: Application failures and security vulnerabilities demand fast answers to reduce downtime. In this bootcamp, learn how to setup AWS DevOps Agent and automate investigation failures through logs, metrics, and code changes, then generate remediation plans. Learn how to use AWS Security Agent to configure domain-scoped penetration tests, monitor real-time execution, and interpret severity-rated findings. Gain hands-on experience with two agents that compress hours of investigation into minutes.

title: AWS Partner: Build AI workflows that laugh in the face of disruption
title_ko: AWS 파트너: 장애에도 끄떡없는 AI 워크플로 구축하기
summary_ko: AWS 파트너 전용 부트캠프로, 프로덕션에서야 드러나는 AI 워크플로 장애에 대비해 복원력 있게 설계하는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Emperors Ballroom I
abstract: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. AI workflows fail in ways that don't show up until production: a human misses the deadline, an external system says no, a sub-workflow loses state mid-flight. Fix it. Combine Step Functions, Lambda durable functions, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore into a three-layer stack that routes decisions, checkpoints execution, and reasons through uncertainty. Run real scenarios through the Simulator Panel and trace every layer live. Leave ready to build AI workflows that laugh in the face of disruption. You must bring your laptop to participate.

room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Emperors Ballroom II
abstract: Prepare for AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate by playing this 3D virtual escape room game. Enter a 3D virtual environment, select your avatar, and navigate rooms locked behind AWS Solutions Architect Associate challenges and design your way out. Build VPCs, select storage and database services, configure high availability, and implement fault-tolerant architectures while solving exam-aligned puzzles and completing hands-on labs. Each room builds on the previous, testing progressively deeper architectural knowledge. Collaborate with peers or compete solo and escape first to claim the leaderboard.

title: Validate your hands-on AWS skills & earn a Microcredential
title_ko: 실무 AWS 역량 검증 및 마이크로크리덴셜 취득
summary_ko: AWS Skill Builder에서 원하는 마이크로크리덴셜 시험에 응시해 실무 역량을 검증하고 인증을 받는 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Emperors Ballroom II
abstract: In this session, you will be given time to attempt a microcredential exam of your choice on AWS Skill Builder. These timed, hands-on exams test your skills in a live, provisioned AWS environment and test on popular topics. The product and developer team will be onsite to walk you through the UI and introduce the exam. Please note - this is an individual exam, and you will not be provided any hints or guidance outside of what is provided in the typical test environment. This exam is free to take on AWS Skill Builder. Attendees are required to bring their own device to complete the exam. Those who pass will be issued a microcredential badge on Credly.

summary_ko: Kiro의 AI 지원 개발을 활용해 운영 중인 애플리케이션에 새 기능을 추가해 보는 실습 랩입니다.

abstract: Legacy .NET Framework applications tied to Windows limit your deployment options and increase operational costs. You review the AWS Transform generated assessment report and migration plan, accept the automated transformation, then use Kiro to identify and fix the residual runtime issue that remains after the port.

room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom V
abstract: Customers expect personalized service and context retention without repeating themselves every session. In this lab, you build a customer service agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that remembers each client across conversations. You create a Memory resource with Semantic, Summary, and User Preference strategies, deploy a Lambda-based agent backed by Amazon Nova Lite, and seed multi-turn conversations. The agent retrieves preferences and facts from long-term memory to personalize responses and recommend products from a DynamoDB catalog.

room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom V
abstract: You need more than one agent to reason across inventory, shipments, forecasts, and suppliers at the same time. In this lab, you deploy a multi-agent supply chain system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. You load data into DynamoDB, build container images with CodeBuild, and deploy specialist agents plus a supervisor orchestrator powered by Amazon Nova models. The orchestrator classifies questions, routes them to the right specialists in parallel, and synthesizes their responses into one coherent answer.

abstract: In this SimuLearn session, you leverage the entire Amazon Bedrock AgentCore platform ito build production-grade wealth management advisor. The result is a multi-agent advisor that recognizes each client, remembers their goals, and produces auditable financial guidance through governed tools.

Then build a self-service AI agent that handles routine customer requests autonomously, using MCP tools for Cases and Customer Profiles, and structured escalation paths that preserve full conversation context when a human is needed.

Configure distributed tracing, build evaluation frameworks, and design deployment strategies that take your agentic systems from prototype to production-ready state.

summary_ko: AWS 파트너 전용 부트캠프로, 데모에서는 잘 되지만 프로덕션에서 깨지는 에이전트를 체계적으로 검증해 출시하는 방법을 배웁니다.

abstract: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. AI agents work great in demos but break in production. Replace luck with observability. Prototype a role-based agent with the Strands SDK. Evaluate it with custom evaluators for quality and compliance. Deploy it to production on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Observe it with OpenTelemetry tracing and CloudWatch dashboards. Detect drift by evaluating production traffic at scale. Leave ready to take a customer's AI agent from prototype to production-grade. You must bring your laptop to participate.

Configure AI Guardrails for content safety and structured escalation paths that preserve full conversation context for human agents.

room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Palace Ballroom II
abstract: Your agent may handle basic conversations well, but to take real-world actions it needs access to external tools and APIs. In this hands-on lab, use Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to expose Lambda functions as MCP-compatible tools with JWT authorization. Register tool targets, connect to a pre-deployed nutrition coach agent, and validate how it dynamically discovers and invokes new capabilities at runtime without redeployment.

room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Palace Ballroom II
abstract: A personal finance assistant agent deployed on AgentCore Runtime starts showing intermittent failures and slow responses. In this lab, you will use AgentCore Observability with CloudWatch GenAI dashboards and Transaction Search to diagnose production issues. Trace errors through spans, correlate telemetry with application logs, and identify root causes including a tool timeout and conversation history bloat. Apply fixes, redeploy to AgentCore Runtime, and set up CloudWatch Alarms to catch issues before users do.

room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Palace Ballroom II
abstract: Building a production-ready AI agent meant writing orchestration code, packaging containers, and managing deployment pipelines. AgentCore Harness eliminates all of that. In this hands-on lab, you declare what your agent does through configuration and let AgentCore handle the execution loop. You create a harness agent, iteratively add tools, attach AWS Skills, swap models mid-session to suit your output requirements, and publish versioned endpoints for safe rollout to your customers.

You set up an Amazon Cognito user pool as the identity provider, obtain and decode a JSON Web Token (JWT), and test that the agent rejects unauthenticated callers while allowing verified employees through.

title: Securing AI Agents on AgentCore

summary_ko: 보안 전문가 역할로 API Gateway, AWS WAF 등을 활용해 AgentCore 기반 AI 에이전트를 보호하는 SimuLearn 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Palace Ballroom II
abstract: A customer runs a support agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that reaches destinations nobody reviewed and takes requests from any caller. In this SimuLearn session, you work the case as their security expert. Behind Amazon API Gateway, AWS WAF Bot Control labels each script and AI crawler, and you write the rule that refuses them with a 403 that names the reason. On the way out, AWS Network Firewall tags every destination by content category. You watch in alert mode, then reject AI and search categories while permitted sites still load. You leave knowing how to classify, then control, what enters and leaves an agent.

title: Securing AI Agents on AgentCore
title_ko: AgentCore에서 AI 에이전트 보안 강화하기
summary_ko: 보안 전문가 역할로 API Gateway, AWS WAF 등을 활용해 AgentCore 기반 AI 에이전트를 보호하는 SimuLearn 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom V
abstract: A customer runs a support agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that reaches destinations nobody reviewed and takes requests from any caller. In this SimuLearn session, you work the case as their security expert. Behind Amazon API Gateway, AWS WAF Bot Control labels each script and AI crawler, and you write the rule that refuses them with a 403 that names the reason. On the way out, AWS Network Firewall tags every destination by content category. You watch in alert mode, then reject AI and search categories while permitted sites still load. You leave knowing how to classify, then control, what enters and leaves an agent.

title_ko: AI 주도 개발 수명 주기(AI-DLC)
summary_ko: Inception, Construction, Operation 3단계로 구성된 AI-DLC 방법론을 배우고 실제로 적용해 보는 부트캠프입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom I
abstract: The AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) reimagines how teams plan, build, and ship software with AI as a first-class participant. In this bootcamp, learn the three phases (Inception, Construction, Operation) , apply the Intent-Unit-Bolt framework to decompose requirements into AI-executable work items, then use Kiro IDE's Spec-Driven Development to generate domain models, application code, tests, and infrastructure. You leave with a working application built entirely through the AI-DLC methodology.

title: Agentic Modernization with AWS Transform
title_ko: AWS Transform을 활용한 에이전틱 현대화
summary_ko: 현대화 목표를 정하고 AI 에이전트가 .NET Framework 코드를 분해·변환하도록 하는 부트캠프입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom III
abstract: AWS Transform orchestrates AI agents that analyze, refactor, and convert legacy applications without manual line-by-line rewrites. In this bootcamp, set modernization objectives, let AI agents decompose and transform .NET Framework code to cross-platform .NET on Linux, then migrate a SQL Server database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Practice agentic assessment, wave planning, code transformation, and schema conversion end to end.

title: Resilient Cloud Ops: From IaC to Fault Injection
title_ko: 복원력 있는 클라우드 운영: IaC에서 장애 주입까지
summary_ko: AWS CDK와 CloudFormation으로 인프라를 코드로 관리하고 장애 주입 실험으로 복원력을 검증하는 부트캠프입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom III
abstract: Production infrastructure needs two guarantees: repeatable deployment and proven resilience. In this bootcamp, use AWS CDK and CloudFormation to define and provision cloud resources as code, eliminating manual configuration drift. Then validate your architecture under stress. Troubleshoot VPC connectivity using flow logs, inject controlled faults with AWS Fault Injection Service, and confirm your infrastructure recovers gracefully. Deploy it right, then prove it holds.

title: AWS Partner: Unblock AI agents on legacy apps from assessment to fix
title_ko: AWS 파트너: 레거시 앱의 AI 에이전트 장애 요인 평가부터 해결까지
summary_ko: AWS 파트너 전용 부트캠프로, 오래된 레거시 앱을 평가하고 개선해 AI 에이전트가 안정적으로 동작하게 만드는 방법을 배웁니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Emperors Ballroom I
abstract: This bootcamp is for AWS Partners only. An agent is only as reliable as the app underneath it. A ten-year-old booking platform stands between your customer and their first AI agent. Run an Agentic Readiness Analysis (ARA) with AWS Transform, predict what it finds, and read the findings by severity. Map the blockers to modernization routes, build a prioritized roadmap with Kiro, then apply an automated remediation: a machine identity for agents, plus an audit trail and idempotency. Leave with a repeatable method to assess any customer app and decide what to fix first. Bring your laptop.

title: Resolving and Preventing Production Incidents with AWS DevOps Agent
title_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 프로덕션 인시던트 해결 및 예방하기
summary_ko: AWS DevOps Agent로 인시던트의 조사·해결·예방 전체 수명 주기를 하나의 흐름으로 체험하는 SimuLearn 세션입니다.
room: Caesars Palace | Emperors Level | Augustus Ballroom V
abstract: AWS DevOps Agent investigates production incidents end-to-end: tracing failures to the responsible change, guiding the fix, and verifying recovery. Once the service is stable, the agent converts root cause findings into automated prevention rules that enforce mandatory review gates on the same class of risk in future deployments. In this SimuLearn session, experience the full investigate, resolve, and prevent lifecycle as one continuous workflow in a single session.

title: Managing Bots, Mentoring Brains: The Future of Hybrid Leadership
title_ko: 봇을 관리하고 인재를 멘토링하기: 하이브리드 리더십의 미래
summary_ko: 사람과 AI가 함께 일하는 하이브리드 조직에서 경영 리더십이 어떻게 근본적으로 바뀌는지 논의합니다.
abstract: The traditional playbook for executive leadership is undergoing fundamental change as hybrid ecosystems of human employees and autonomous AI agents become commonplace, with agents acting as co-workers, specialists, and decision-makers. This shift requires executives to expand their skill set, dividing organizational goals between human creative strategy and agentic operational execution. Moving past the AI hype, this session examines how human roles must evolve from executors to context engineers and decision architects, and how career progression must be rewritten when entry-level and repetitive work is owned by digital labor. Explore how women in leadership will adapt and build tomorrow's leaders.
